text.body:
daśamahāvidyāstapuraścaraṇaviśeṣāśca
pradarśyante |
tathā ca (muṇḍamālāyām)
kālī tārā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvarī | bhairavī chinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī tathā || 9-1 ||
vagalā siddhividyā ca mātaṅgī kamalātmikā | etā daśa mahāvidyāḥ siddhividyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 9-2 ||
tatrādau prathamavidyā proktā (kumārītantre)
bhairava uvāca |
asti guhyatamaṃ hyetajjñānamekaṃ sanātanam | atīva hi sugopyaṃ ca kathituṃ naiva śakyate || 9-3 ||
atīva matpriyā'sīti kathayāmi tava priye | sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ hyetat saṃsāraṃ sthūlasūkṣmakam ||4 ||
prakṛtiṃ tu vinā naiva saṃsāramupadyate | tasmācca prakṛtermūlakāraṇaṃ naiva dṛśyate || 9-5 ||
rūpāṇi bahusaṅkhyāni prakṛterasti bhāmini | eṣāṃ madhye maheśāni kālīrūpaṃ manoharam || 9-6 ||
viśeṣataḥ kaliyuge narāṇāṃ bhuktimuktidam | tasyā upāsakāścaiva brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || 9-7 ||
indraḥ sūryaśca varuṇaḥ kuvero'gnistathā'paraḥ | durvāsāśca vaśiṣṭaśca dattātreyo bṛhaspatiḥ || 9-8 ||
bahunā kimihoktena sarve devā upāsakāḥ | kālīkāyāḥ prasādena bhuktimuktyādibhāginaḥ || 9-9 ||
tasyā mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yato rakṣejjagattrayam | kakāraṃ vahnisaṃyuktaṃ rativindusamanvitam || 9-10 ||
triguṇaṃ ca tataḥ kūrcayugmaṃ lajjāyugaṃ tataḥ | dakṣiṇe kālike ceti pūrvabījāni coccaret || 9-11 ||
vahnijāyāvadhiḥ prokto kālikāyā manuḥ śive | dvāviṃśatyakṣarī siddhividyeyamīritā || 9-12 ||
mantrārthamāha (saṃketatantre)
kakārādviśvamutpannaṃ tena sṛṣṭisvarūpiṇī | rephaḥ kālāgnirudrātmā tena saṃhārarūpiṇī || 9-13 ||
īkāraśca mahālakṣmīrlokatrayavibhāvinī | teneyaṃ pālinī śaktiḥ sāmarasyaṃ ca vindunā || 9-14 ||
(kālītantre)
kakārācchivarūpatvāt sarveśvaryapradāyinī | jvalanārṇasamāyogāt sarvatejomayī śubhā || 9-15 ||
vindumālī kevalaṃ tu sarvatatattvaprakāśikā | vindunā niṣkalatvācca kaivalyaphaladāyinī || 9-16 ||
kūrcabījaṃ kevalaṃ tu sarvabodhaprakāśakam | caitanyarūpaṃ saṃsārabhīṣaṇaṃ muktidāyakam || 9-17 ||
vyomnā prakāśamānatvaṃ grasamānatvamagninā | tayorvisarga īkāro vindunā (*) tāntrikī matā || 9-18 ||
dakṣiṇā siddhasādhyādirahitā kṣiprasiddhidā | kālasaṃkalanāt kālī kālagrāsaṃ karotyataḥ || 9-19 ||
svāheti viṣayāḥ sarve devatāyāṃ samarpitāḥ | evaṃ samastarūpeṇa kevalaṃ citkalā'parā || 9-20 ||
sarvadevamayī sākṣācchabdabrahmasvarūpiṇī | evaṃ dhyāyedviśuddhātmā jīvanmuktaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ || 9-21 ||
vidyāmāhātmyamāha (bhairavītantre)
nātra cittāviśuddhiḥ syānnārimitrādidūṣaṇam | na vā prayāsabāhulyaṃ samayāsamayādikam || 9-22 ||
na vittavyayabāhulyaṃ kāyakleśakaraṃ na ca | devairdevatvavidhaye siddhaiḥ khecarasiddhaye || 9-23 ||
pannagai rākṣasairmattyairmunibhiśca mumukṣubhiḥ | kāmibhirdharmibhiścārthamīpsubhiḥ sevyate sadā || 9-24 ||
ya enāṃ cintayenmantrī sarvakāmasamṛddhidām | tasya haste sadaivāsti sarvasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ || 9-25 ||
tasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhāṃ gatāḥ | rājāno'pi ca dāsatvaṃ bhajante kiṃ pare janāḥ || 9-26 ||
vahneḥ śaityaṃ jalastambhaṃ gatistambhaṃ vivasvataḥ | divārātrivyatyayaṃ ca sa kartuṃ bhavati kṣamaḥ || 9-27 ||
ante ca labhate devyā gaṇatvaṃ durlabhaṃ naraḥ | candrasūryasamo bhūtvā vaset kalpāyutaṃ divi || 9-28 ||
na tasya durlabhaṃ kiṃcidyaḥ smaredghorakālikām |
(kālītantre)
asyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa siddhayo'ṣṭau bhavanti hi || 9-29 ||
evaṃ samastavidyānāṃ rājñī stotuṃ na śakyate | vaktrakoṭisahasraistu jihvākoṭiśatairapi || 9-30 ||
sarvasiddhidā devī aniruddhasarasvatī | tasmādasyā jñānamātrāt siddhayaḥ saṃbhavanti hi || 9-31 ||
tathā |
api cet tvatsamā nārī matsamaḥ puruṣo'sti cet | aniruddhasarasvatyāḥ samo mantraḥ sadā bhavet || 9-32 ||
tantrāntare |
kalau kālī kalau kālī kalau kālī tu kevalā | sādhitā kālanāthena pratyakṣā kālikā kalau || 9-33 ||
kalau kālīṃ vihāyātha yaḥ kaścinmokṣakāmukaḥ | sa bhojanaṃ vinā nūnaṃ kṣunnivṛttimabhīpsati || 9-34 ||
kalau kālīṃ vihāyātha yaḥ kaścicchāntimicchati | sa hi śīnivṛttyarthaṃ himaśailaṃ viṣevate || 9-35 ||
kalau kālīṃ vihāyātha yaḥ kaścit kāvyamicchati | sa tu duḥkhanivṛttyarthaṃ pāpāni kurute sadā || 9-36 ||
śrīmahākālikā vidyā kalau pūrṇaphalapradā | kalirhi yasyā dāsasya pādapūjāṃ karoti hi || 9-37 ||
ajñānājjñānati vā'pi salīlaṃ vā sahelayā | smṛtā'pi siddhidā kālī sakṛdeva maheśvari || 9-38 ||
mahāvidyā siddhividyā vidyābhedaiḥ pratiṣṭhitā | upavidyādibhedaiśca kālikā saṃsthitā bhuvi || 9-39 ||
tārādyāḥ sakalā vidyāḥ kālikāyāḥ prajajñire | sarvā vidyāḥ kālikāyāṃ saṃsthitā eva pārvati || 9-40 ||
atha ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ (kālītantre)
bhairavo'sya ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ uṣṇikchandaḥ udāhṛtam | devatā kālikā proktā lajjābījaṃ tu bījakam || 9-41 ||
śaktistu kūrcabījaṃ syādaniruddhasarasvatī |
(kālīkrame)
kīlakaṃ cādyabījaṃ tu caturvargārthasiddhidam || 9-42 ||
(kālītantre)
kavitvārthe niyogaḥ syādevamṛṣyādikalpanā | aṅganyāsakaranyasau yathāvadabhidhīyate || 9-43 ||
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena praṇavādyena kalpayet |
(vīratantre'pi)
dīrghaṣaṭkayutādyena praṇavādyena kalpayet ||44 ||
nyāsāntarāṇi tatraiva draṣṭavyāni |
atha dhyānaṃ (merutantre)
karālavadanāṃ ghorāṃ muktakeśīṃ caturbhujām | kālikāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ divyāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇām || 9-45 ||
khaḍgābhayavarā(/)śchinnaṃ muṇḍaṃ ca dadhatīṃ karaiḥ | mahāmeghaprabhāṃ śyāmāṃ tathā caiva digambarām || 9-46 ||
kaṇṭhāvasaktamuṇḍālīṃ galadrudhiracarcitām | karṇāvataṃsatānītaśavayugmavirājitām || 9-47 ||
ghoradaṃṣṭrāṃ karālāsyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām | śavānāṃ karasaṅghātaiḥ kṛtakāñcīṃ hasanmukhīm || 9-48 ||
sṛkkadvayagaladraktadhārāvicchuritānanām | ghorarūpāṃ mahāraudrīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīm || 9-49 ||
danturāṃ dakṣiṇavyāpimuktalambakacoccayām | śavarūpamahādevahṛdayoparisaṃsthitām || 9-50 ||
śivābhirghorarāvābhiścaturdikṣu samanvitām | mahākālasamāyuktāṃ śavopariratānvitām || 9-51 ||
sukhaprasannavaradāṃ smerānanasaroruhām | evaṃ saṃcintayet kālīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīm || 9-52 ||
tathā |
kapilāratnasampūrṇapṛthvīdānasya yat phalam | koṭihomasahasrasya devyā dhyānena tat phalam || 9-53 ||
etanmantrajapānmantrī mucyate brahmahatyayā | pitṛmātṛvadhādyaiśca kimanyaiḥ (*) kṣudraghātakaiḥ || 9-54 ||
atha śāpoddhārastatrāntare |
śāpoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi vaśiṣṭhamuninā kṛtam | caturviṃśatilakṣāṇi japtvā kopena śaptavān || 9-55 ||
adya prabhṛti deveśi kālike kālarūpiṇi | tava mantreṣu saṃsiddhiḥ kaṣṭenaiva bhaviṣyati || 9-56 ||
iti śrutvā mahādevī prādurbhūtā prasādya tam | uvāca putra kimidaṃ śāpadānaṃ vṛthā kṛtam || 9-57 ||
evaṃ phalaṃ yathā na syāt tathā kuru munīśvara | jñānaṃ dattaṃ durārādhyaṃ durlabhaṃ yat surairapi || 9-58 ||
tataḥ prītyā varaṃ labdhvā jñānavijñānasaṃyutam | uvāca prītamanasā śāptāntaṃ mantrasaṅkaṭe || 9-59 ||
mātaḥ krodhena kathitaṃ tatropāyamahaṃ bruve | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya ghorarūpe ca dakṣiṇe || 9-60 ||
siddhiṃ kurudvayaṃ procya kāliketi padaṃ tataḥ | mamābhīṣṭaphalaṃ śīghraṃ dehi draviṇasampadam || 9-61 ||
japādau mantramuccārya japāntaṃ ca punaḥ paṭhet | bhaviṣyati tataḥ siddhiracirāt parameśvari || 9-62 ||
athāsanabhedā uktā matsyasūkte | mṛdvacūḍakamāsīnaścānyeṣu komaleṣu ca || 9-63 ||
viṣṭare vā samāsṛtya sādhayet siddhimuttamām |
eṣā lakṣaṇāni tatraiva
arvāk ṣaṇmāsato garbhacyutamāhurmṛduṃ budhāḥ || 9-64 ||
cūḍopanayanairhīnametaccācūḍakaṃ viduḥ | nivṛttacūḍako bālo hīnopanayanaḥ pumān || 9-65 ||
yo mṛtaḥ pañcame varṣe tameva komalaṃ viduḥ |
tathā |
mṛtāsanaṃ vinā devi yo japet kālikāṃ naraḥ || 9-66 ||
tāvat sa nārakī jñeyo yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam | yo vīra ityarthaḥ | paśostu tādṛśāsananiṣedhāt || 9-67 ||
mṛddhāsanādyabhāve'nukalpa ukto (vīratantre)
śavābhāve viṣṭaraṃ tu śavarūpa prakalpayet | pañcāśadbhirbhavedbrahmā tadardhena tu viṣṭaram || 9-68 ||
(kālītantrādau)
mṛtābhāve kuśarūpaṃ viṣṭaraṃ parikalpayet | viṣṭaraḥ sādhakasyātha kathyate śṛṇu sāmpratam || 9-69 ||
bhūtapatrāṇi yasmin vai sa kuśetyabhidhīyate | haste pāde daśa daśamitā digyugaṃ hṛtsaroje || 9-70 ||
viṃśatsaṅkhyāḥ sakalavarade mastake kīrtitāśca | guhye jihvāvadanaradane ghrāṇakarṇastaneṣu || 9-71 ||
liṅge cāṇḍe yugaparimitā yojanīyāḥ kuśāśca | ityeṣa viṣṭaraḥ proktaḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || 9-72 ||
kuśairvā bandhanaṃ kāryaṃ nāḍyā vā parameśvari | raktamiśritasūtreṇa paṭṭasūtreṇa vā punaḥ || 9-73 ||
viṣṭaraṃ parikalpyātha tasyopari japaṃ caret | vidhiviṣṭarapadmasya vidhiḥ prokto mayā tava || 9-74 ||
śavarūpaṃ prakalpyātha kavirvāgmī bhavennaraḥ | svayambhuvāktaṃ sūtraṃ ca kartavyaṃ sarvasiddhaye || 9-75 ||
śavābhāve viṣṭarastu śavarūpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | viṣṭaraḥ śivarūpaḥ syāt svasya śaktitvakalpanā || 9-76 ||
śivaśaktisamāyogāt kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale |
atha viṣṭarasaṃskāraḥ (śaktisaṃṅgame)
gāyatryā troṭanaṃ kāryaṃ mūlena grathanaṃ caret || 9-77 ||
kṛtasaṅkalpako mantrī komalaṃ vāmapāṇinā | kūrcabījena saṅguhya astramantreṇa prokṣaṇam || 9-78 ||
praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśīṃ ca samuccārya tu taṃ vadet | śavarūpa mahāpreta cāṣṭasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 9-79 ||
iti stutvā tu taṃ samyak kuśamadhye nidhāpayet | tasya dehe trikoṇaṃ tu raktacandanakena vai || 9-80 ||
māyāṃ tanmadhyagāṃ likhya bahirmaṇḍalakaṃ caret | praṇavam (-) āḥ surekhe ca vajrarekhe tataḥ param || 9-81 ||
kūrcaṃ cāstraṃ vahnivadhūrayaṃ ca maṇḍale manuḥ | ā(/)kāraṃ ca tato māyāṃ kro(/)kāraṃ haṃsa eva ca || 9-82 ||
vahnijāyāṃ samuccārya śavaprāṇāḥ padaṃ vadet | iha prāṇāḥ padaṃ coktvā śavajīva iha sthitaḥ || 9-83 ||
śavasya sarvendriyāṇi vāṅmanaścakṣureva ca | kṣotraghrāṇānīhāgatya sukhaṃ ca cirameva ca || 9-84 ||
tiṣṭhantu svāhayā yuktaḥ prāṇasaṃsthāpane manuḥ | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccāryādhāraśaktipadaṃ tataḥ || 9-85 ||
komalāsanapadaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ namo'ntena tamarcayet | praṇavaṃ kāmapīṭhāya namaḥ śabdānnamaskriyā || 9-86 ||
svarṇairmāṣatrayaiḥ paṭṭe kāryā mūrtiḥ śavasya tu | saṃsthāpya vistarasyānte sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 9-87 ||
mṛtābhāva iti vacanāt paśoḥ śavānukalpakuśaviṣṭaramapi nāsti mukhye'dhikāriṇa evānukalpe'dhikārāditi sudhārṇavakṛtaḥ | āsanāntarasaṃskāro'pyukto (bhairavatantre)
kuśaṃ vyāghrājinaṃ vā'pi kambalaṃ lohitaṃ tathā | komalādyāsanaṃ vā'pi pītavastreṇa veṣṭayet || 9-88 ||
āsanaṃ samyagāpādya tataḥ śodhanamācaret | kalpoktena vidhānena pūjāṃ samyak samācaret || 9-89 ||
pūjārthamāsanamahaṃ śodhayāmi maheśvari | devyājñāmevamādāya mūlahṛnmanunā'pi ca || 9-90 ||
jalenāsanamabhyukṣya kavacenāvaguṇṭhya ca | astramantreṇa saṃrakṣya sadāśivanibhaṃ smaret || 9-91 ||
tatra pīṭhamanuṃ bhaktyā japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | yathā vibhavasambhāraiḥ pūjayitvā sadāśivam || 9-92 ||
siddhiśvara mahādeva sarvasiddhipradāyaka | dehi me'bhīṣṭasiddhiṃ tvametadāsanarūpataḥ || 9-93 ||
idaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya upaviṣyāsane tataḥ | yathāvidhi vidhāyātha gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 9-94 ||
ityāsanasaṃskāraḥ |
atha deśāḥ (phetkāriṇīye)
ekaliṅge śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣṭaye | tatrasthaḥ sādhayedyogī vidyāṃ tribhavamocinīm || 9-95 ||
ekaliṅgalakṣaṇamuktaṃ tatraiva |
pañcakrośāntare yatra na liṅgāntaramīkṣate | tadekaliṅgamākhyātaṃ tatra siddhiranuttamā || 9-96 ||
śmaśānādilakṣaṇamuktaṃ (triśaktiratnākare)
dahyante vyasavo yatra śavakīlakasaṃkule | gṛdhragomāyukākādyairmāṃsaṃlubdhairyadāvṛtam || 9-97 ||
tat śmaśānamiti khyātaṃ piśācagaṇasevitam | kākādinīḍasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtticchatrādisaṃyutam || 9-98 ||
nāgarairdūranirmuktaṃ sādhyasodvegakārakam | saudhasaṃrūḍhaghāsāṭyaṃ śūnyāgāraṃ taducyate || 9-99 ||
caturṇāṃ ca yathā yatra saṃyogo yugapadbhavet | taccatuṣpathamityuktaṃ rajanyāmiṣṭadāyakam || 9-100 ||
pūrvapūrvamidaṃ śastaṃ jaghanyaścoratottaram | ujjaṭe parvate vā'pi nirjane vā catuṣpathe || 9-101 ||
devāgāre devaśūnye vilvamūle nadītaṭe |
svagṛhe nirjanārāme tathā cāśvatthasannidhau || 9-102 ||
(kumārītantre)
tadbhāve divyagehe sindūrādibhiraṅkite | khaḍgaśūlagadākarttrīcāmaravyajanādibhiḥ || 9-103 ||
vitānadhūpasaṃṅkīrṇe kṛṣṇāgurusuvāsite | yuvatīnāṃ surāpīnāṃ veśyānāṃ lāsyaśobhite || 9-104 ||
śaṅkhaghaṇṭāravākīrṇe dīpāvalivirājite | evambhūte gṛhe pūjā kālikāyāḥ suśobhanā || 9-105 ||
atha puraścaraṇavidhiḥ (vīratantre)
ādau mantrasya siddhyarthaṃ puraścaraṇamācaret | tataḥ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet || 9-106 ||
(svatantratantre)
divā lakṣaṃ śucirbhūtvā haviṣyāśī japennaraḥ | tatastu taddaśāṃśena homayeddhaviṣā priye || 9-107 ||
tarpayet tīrthatāyena payasā sarpiṣā'pi vā | madhunā vā sitāmiśratoyena parameśvarīm || 9-108 ||
devīṃ cābhiṣiñcet toyaistarṇasya daśāṃśataḥ | taddaśāṃśa haviṣyānnairbhojayedbhaktitaḥ priye || 9-109 ||
kālīmantravido viprān dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadet | pāśavaṃ kaṭhinaṃ kalpaṃ śṛṇu vairaṃ tataḥ priye || 9-110 ||
rātrau māṃsāśavairdevīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | tato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno raman kledayuto'pi vā || 9-111 ||
japellakṣaṃ tato devīṃ homayejjvalite'nale | yonikuṇḍe sthite sarpirmāṃsamadyayutaṃ tathā || 9-112 ||
daśāṃśaṃ tarpayenmadyairmāṃsamiśraistu sādhakaḥ | tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena abhiṣiñcya jaganmayīm || 9-113 ||
daśāṃśaṃ bhojayet vā sādhu sādhakaṃ kālikāpriyam | madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca carvaṇaṃ ca pradāpayet || 9-114 ||
tatastu toṣayedbhaktyā guruṃ svarṇādibhiḥ priye | etatkalpadvayāddevi mantraḥ sidhyati vai dhruvam || 9-115 ||
(kālītantre)
ādau puraskriyāṃ kuryānniyamena yathāvidhi | lakṣamekaṃ japedvidyāṃ haviṣyāśī divā śuciḥ || 9-116 ||
rātraiḥ tāmbūlapūrṇāsyaḥ śayyāyāṃ lakṣamānataḥ | tataḥ siddhamanurmantrī prayogārho na cānyathā || 9-117 ||
(sādhanasamuccaye)
nityakarma divā kṛtvā rātrau pūjāṃ samācaret | pūjānte tu japaṃ kuryāt kāraṇāsvādamoditaḥ || 9-118 ||
japena lakṣamātreṇa kālī vidyā prasidhyati |
(bhairavatantre)
lakṣaṃ japeddhaviṣyāśī dinenaiva jitendriyaḥ || 9-119 ||
brahmacaryaparo bhūtvā puraścaraṇakarmaṇi | tathā rātrau japellakṣaṃ mantrī maithunatatparaḥ || 9-120 ||
kṛtvā'cārakrameṇaivaṃ sādhayenmantramātmanaḥ | vidhānenātha siddhiḥ syānmanureva na saṃśayaḥ || 9-121 ||
(bhairavayāmale)
dīkṣāvidhānamadhigamya guroḥ sakāś ā(-) llabdhvā manuṃ japati lakṣamitaṃ divā yaḥ | rātrau haviṣyabhugamatsarakāmakopa(-) lobhādyacañcalamanāḥ sa tu sādhakendraḥ || 9-122 || lakṣaṃ niśi svavanitāsu ratāvasāne nagno vimuktacikurastvayi dattacittaḥ |
(mahākālastutau)
vaśī lakṣaṃ mantraṃ prajapati haviṣyāśanarato divā mātaryuṣmaccaraṇayugaladhyānanirataḥ || 9-123 || paraṃ naktaṃ nagno nidhuvanavinodena ca manuṃ jano lakṣaṃ sa syāt smaraharasamānaḥ kṣititale ||
(merutantre)
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī divā śuciḥ || 9-124 ||
aśuciśca tathā rātrau lakṣamekaṃ japenmanum | daśāṃśaṃ homayedājyaistarpayedabhiṣecayet || 9-125 ||
homaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ pūjā kartavyā tu viśeṣataḥ | tataḥ prayogān kurvīta kāmyāniṣṭaphalāptaye || 9-126 ||
(vīracūḍāmaṇau)
sādhanasya vidhiṃ vakṣye saṃketaparamādbhutam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecaratvaṃ ca jāyate || 9-127 ||
homaṃ kuryāt prayatnena pāyasena tilena vā | snātaḥ śuklāmbaradharo nityakarmadivāśuciḥ || 9-128 ||
rātrau pūjāṃ prakurvīta pañcamudrāvidhānataḥ | anenaiva vidhānena lakṣamekaṃ japedbudhaḥ || 9-129 ||
svasvakarma puraskṛtya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | hāvabhāvādikaṃ kuryānmahācīnalatāṃ haret || 9-130 ||
(śrutisiddhāntatantre)
tenaiva tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt snānapānādikaṃ sadā | dakṣiṇe pāśavaḥ kalpo vīrakalpastu vāminām || 9-131 ||
kalpadvayaṃ samāśritya mantraṃ sidhyati satvaram | gurorājñāṃ samādāya snātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ || 9-132 ||
divā lakṣaṃ japedvidyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ samāśritaḥ | rātrau ca devadeveśīmiṣṭvā vāmopacārakaiḥ || 9-133 ||
śaktīḥ saṃpūjya vidhivat kṛtvā nidhuvanotsavam | komalādyāsanāsīno muktadeśī digambaraḥ || 9-134 ||
tāmbūlaparipūrṇāsyaḥ sindūrāṅkitabhālakaḥ | rahasyamālāmādāya japellakṣamananyadhīḥ || 9-135 ||
kulamārgaprapannānāṃ vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
atra brāhmaṇasya paśorvā dakṣiṇopacāreṇa divakalakṣajapaḥ | śūdrasya vīrasya ca rātrau vāmopacāreṇaikalakṣaṇajapa iti rāghavabhaṭṭādayaḥ |
teṣāmayamāśayaḥ |
bhaikṣyādiniyamāhāraḥ sakṛdrātrau vidhiyate || 9-136 ||
divā caiva japaṃ kuryāt pauraścaraṇiko dvijaḥ |
iti (phetkāriṇī-)tantravacanāt |
snātaḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 9-137 ||
divā sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye | dvijānāmatra sarveṣāṃ vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 9-138 ||
iti (merutantra-)vacanācca viprādikartṛkapuraścaraṇe |
trisandhyaṃ devapūjāṃ ca trisandhyaṃ japamācaret | rātrau mantraṃ ca mālāṃ ca spṛśennaiva kadācana ||139 ||
iti paśubhāvaprakaraṇīya(-)(bhāvacūḍāmaṇi-) vacanāt | paśukartṛkapuraścaraṇe ca divasa eva kālaḥ |
evaṃ ca |
dvijānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ divāvidhirihocyate | śūdrāṇāṃ ca tathā proktaṃ rātrāviṣṭaṃ mahāphalam ||140 ||
iti (mahākālasaṃhitā-) vacanottarādhāt | śūdrakartṛkapuraścaraṇe |
gate tu prathame yāme tṛtīyapraharāvadhi | niśāyāmeva japtavyaṃ rātriśeṣe japenna ca ||141 ||
vīrapuraścaraṇaprakaraṇīya(-)(muṇḍamālā-) vacanādvīrakartṛkapuraścaraṇe ca rātrireva kāla iti vyavasthitau |
paśurgurumukhāllabdhāṃ vidyāṃ kālaghanaprabhām | pāśavena tu kalpena lakṣaṃ japati sādhakaḥ ||142 ||
divyagurumukhāllabdhvā kālikāṃ divyarūpiṇīm | lakṣaṃ japyāt sadā mantraṃ vīrakalpena sādhakaḥ ||143 ||
iti (kālīkulārṇava-)vacanāt |
svācāranirato nityaṃ divā lakṣaṃ japet paśuḥ | divyo vā'pyatha vā vīro rātrau lakṣaṃ japaṃ caret ||144 ||
iti (kālīkrama-)vacanācca sarveṣāmekalakṣajapātmakameva puraścaraṇaṃ sidhyatīti | asmin mate |
lakṣamekaṃ japedvidyāṃ haviṣyāśī divā śuciḥ | rātrau tāmbūlapūrṇāsyaḥ śayyāyāṃ lakṣamānataḥ ||145 ||
evaṃ lakṣadvayaṃ japtvā taddaśāṃśena mantravit | ayutaṃ homayeddevi divārātriprabhedataḥ ||146 ||
iti sarveṣāṃ bhinnabhinneti karttavyatākasamucitalakṣadvayajapātmakapuraścaraṇādividhāyaka(kumārītantra-)virodho durvāraḥ |
(niruttaratantre'pi) lakṣadvayaparimita eva japa uktaḥ |
lakṣadvayaṃ japedvidyāṃ divārātriprabhedataḥ (-) iti |
sudhārṇavakṛtastu (-)
evaṃ lakṣadvayaṃ japtvā ityā (-) (kumārītantrā-)divacanāddivārātryorbhinnabhinnācāreṇaikaikalakṣajapātmakasamucitalakṣadvayajapaḥ sarvasyaiva prāptaḥ |
svācāranirato nityaṃ divā lakṣaṃ japet paśuḥ ||147 ||
divyo vā'pyatha vā vīro rātrau lakṣaṃ japaṃ caret |
iti (kālīkrama-)vacanenāpavādyate | evaṃ vīrabrāhmaṇasyāpi rātrau maireyādyupādānapuraḥsaraḥ |
brāhmaṇo madirāṃ datvā brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate || 9-148 ||
ityādivākyaviruddho vīrabhāvaprakaraṇīyabrāhmaṇakartṛkakṣīropādānavidhāyaka(-)(bhāvacūḍāmaṇi-) viruddhaśca japaḥ prāptaḥ |
tatra
dvijānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ divāvidhiriheṣyate |
ityapavādakaṃ vākyam | tena vīrasyāpi brāhmaṇasya maireyādyupādānapūrvakaṃ divālakṣajapaḥ paryavasanno bhavati | evaṃ ca rājanyavaiśyayorapi rātrimātrajapāpavādaka |
śūdrāṇāṃ ca tathā proktaṃ rātrāviṣṭaṃ mahāphalam || 9-149 ||
ityuttarādham | tena (kumārīkalpa-)vacanaṃ rājanyavaiśyaviṣayaṃ paryavasyati | apavādavisayaparihāreṇotsargasya vyavastitaiḥ paśūnāṃ rātrajapaśca paśubhāvaprakaraṇīya (-) (bhāvacūḍāmaṇi-)vacanaparāsta eveti sarvamanavadyam |
vastutastu (-)
paśurgurumukhāllabdhvā ityādi (kālīkulārṇava-)vacanāt paśorlabdhamantrasya paśubhāvena vīrāllabdhamantrasya vīrabhāvena ca sādhane ekalakṣajapo vaiparītye ca lakṣadvayajapa ityāhuḥ atra vaiparotye (kumārītantro-)ktarītyā lakṣadvayajapasya kartavyatayā vīrāllabdhamantrasya paśubhāvena sādhanāsambhavāt paśorlabdhamantrasya vīrabhāvena sādhanameva vaiparītyamiti dhyeyam atra kṛṣṇabhaṭṭapādāḥ | evaṃ lakṣadvayaṃ japtvā ityād i(-)(kumārītantrā-)divacanāt sarveṣāmapi lakṣadvayaparimita eva japaḥ | paśudivyavīrāṇāmekaikalakṣajapavidhāyaka(-)(kālīkulārṇavakālīkramā-)divacanaṃ tu siddhamantraviṣayam |
ata evoktaṃ (yāmalādaiḥ)
guruṇā sādhito mantro yadi bhāgyena labhyate | lakṣamātraṃ tadā japtvā sarvakarṇāṇi sādhayet (-) iti ||150 ||
tatra viśeṣastu |
rātrau māṃsāsavairdevīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | tato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno raman (-) ityādi (svatantratantrā-)divacanāt | brāhmaṇo madirāṃ datvā (-) ityādimahākāloktaviruddhamaireyadānādikam | ajñānāt svastriyam gatvā (-) ityādisāmānyapuraścaraṇaprakaraṇīya (-) (siddhāntasampradāyā-)divacanaviruddharātrijapaprākkālīnasuratādikaṃ brāhmaṇasyāpi prāptam |
tadubhayamapi |
dravyeṇa sāttvikenaiva brāhmaṇaḥ pūjayecchivām || 9-151 ||
svakīyāṃ parakīyāṃ vā sāmānyavanitāṃ tathā | japeyustāḥ samākṛṣya kṣatravidaśūdrajātayaḥ || 9-152 ||
iti (mahākālasaṃhitā-) vacanenāpavādyate |
evaṃ ca |
svajātakusumaṃ caiva hetudravyaṃ ca bhairava | spṛṣṭvā tathā samāghrāya pañcagavyena śuddhyati ||153 ||
ṛtukālaṃ vinā cāpi na gacchet striyamādarāt |
ityādibhiḥ paśubhāvaprakāreṇa (-) (bhāvacūḍāmaṇi -)vacanairvipretarapaśorapi tadubhayaṃ nirastameva | paśumātrasya rātrijapaniṣedhaka (-) (bhāvacūḍāmaṇi-)vacanaṃ tu etaddevatādyatiriktadevatopāsakapaśuparam |
rātrāvapi japet tāvat pratyavāyopaśāntaye || 9-154 ||
iti paśukartṛkakāmyaprakaraṇīya (-) (śrutisiddhāntatantra-)vacanena etaddevatopāsakapaśo rātrijapasyāpi vihitatvāt |
śūdrāṇāṃ ca tathā proktaṃ rātrāviṣṭaṃ mahāphalam |
iti vacanaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ rātrijape phalātiśayabodhakaṃ na tu śūdrakartṛkadivātanajapapratiṣedhakam |
tathā ca |
vīradivyayordivāpāśavakalpenaikalakṣajapo vīrakalpena rātrāvekalakṣajaparatatrāpi sākṣanmaireyādyupādānaṃ śūdrasyaiva na tu vīrasyāpi traivarṇikasya tadupādānam |
kṣīreṇa brāhmaṇaistarpyā ghṛtena nṛpavaṃśajaiḥ || 9-155 ||
mākṣikairvaiśyavarṇaistu āsavaiḥ śūdrajātibhiḥ |
iti (bhairavatantra-)vacanāt |
ata evoktaṃ (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
śrūyate yat phalādhikyaṃ tatrādau madyadānataḥ || 9-156 ||
taddhi śūdraparaṃ jñeyaṃ na tu dvijaparaṃ priye (-) iti |
paśostu dakṣiṇacāreṇa divaikalakṣajapastenaivācāreṇa rātrāvekalakṣajapa iti sarveṣāmapi lakṣadvayajapātmakameva puraścaraṇaṃ paryavasannamiti pāhuḥ |
mama tvevaṃ pratibhāti |
dakṣiṇe pāśavaḥ kalpo vīrakalpastu vāminām || 9-157 ||
ityādi (śrutisiddhānta-) tantravacanāddakṣiṇamargiṇaḥ pāśavakalpa eva vāmamārgiṇo vīrakalpa evādhikāritve siddhe pāśavakalpena ca puraścaraṇamuktvā (-)
kulamārgaprapannānāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ |
iti tatraivoktatvāt |
kulācārakrameṇaivaṃ sādhayenmantrātmanaḥ || 9-158 ||
iti (bhairavatantra-)vacanāt |
dakṣavāmakriyāyuktaḥ kaulaścobhayamiśritaḥ |
ityācāraprakaraṇīya (-) (vāḍavānala-)vacanācca etatkalpadvayāśrayaṇe kaulikasyaivādhikāraḥ pratīyate |
tathā ca |
pāśavakalpena divaikalakṣajaparūpapuraścaraṇaṃ dakṣiṇamārgiṇaḥ | vīrakalpena rātrāvekalakṣajaparūpapuraścaraṇaṃ vāmamārgiṇaḥ | etadubhayātmakapuraścaraṇaṃ kaulikasyeti mārgabhedena puraścaraṇasyāpi bhedaḥ |
dvijānāṃ caiva sarveṣām (-) ityādau dvijapadaṃ paśuparaṃ na tu vipramātraparam | tasya traivarṇikavācakatvāt | ata eva kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ saṃgrahāya sarveṣāmiti padamupāttam | uttarārdhe tu nopāttam | anyathā rājanyavaiśyaviṣayakākāṅkṣāyā anivṛttiprasaṅga iti tu sudhārṇavakṛtaivoktam | paśuśca dakṣiṇamārgo | evamuttarārdhe śūdrapadaṃ vāmamārgiparam |
ata evoktaṃ (merutantre)
śūdrādiyavanāntānāṃ siddhirvāmapathe sthitā (-) iti || 9-159 ||
divyo gurumukhāt (-) ityatra divyo vā'pyatha vā vīraḥ (-) ityatra ca divyavīrau vāmamārgiṇo a tu kaulikau | kaulikavāmamārgibhedena tayoḥ pratyeke dvaividhyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt tathā ca divaikalakṣajapavidhāyakāni (kālikulārṇavā-) divacanāni dakṣiṇamārgaparatayā rātrāvekalakṣajapavidhāyakāni (sādhanasamuccayā-)divacanāni vāmamārgaparatayā divārātribhedena samucitalakṣadvajapavidhāyakāni-)divacanāni vāmamārgaparadivacanāni ca kulamārgaparatayā saṃgamanīyānīti sakalamakalaṅkam |
kiñca
lakṣamekaṃ japedvidyāṃ haviṣyāśī divā śuciḥ | aśuciśca tathā rātrau lakṣamekaṃ japenmanum ||160 ||
ityādāvapi trividhamārgopayuktaṃ trividhapuraścaraṇaṃ sudhībhirākalanīyam | nanu paśūnāmetaddevatārādhane kathamadhikāraḥ |
divyabhāvaṃ vīrabhāvaṃ vinā kālīṃ na pūjayet | pūjayennarakaṃ yāti duḥkhaṃ tasya pade pade ||161 ||
paśubhāvāśrito devi yadi kālīṃ prapūjayet | rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam ||162 ||
iti (niruttaratantra-)vacanena niṣedhāditi cenna | divyabhāvamityādivacanānāṃ vāmācāraprakaraṇīyatayā vāmamārgiṇāṃ paśubhāvāśrayaṇaniṣedhaparatvāt | tathā ca |
vāmamārgī divyabhāvaṃ vinā kālīṃ na pūjayet |
paśubhāvāśritaḥ san yadi pūjayet tadā rauravaṃ narakaṃ yātīti tadarthaḥ |
taduktamanyatrāpi |
divyabhāvaṃ vīrabhāvaṃ vāmamārgī samāśrayet || 9-163 ||
paśoḥ saṃsargamātreṇa rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet (-) iti || tathā ca |
paśubhāvo hi viprāṇāṃ śreyaskarato mataḥ || 9-164 ||
tasmāt pāśavakalpena vipraḥ kālīṃ prapūjayet |
iti (śrutisiddhāntatantra-)vacanāt |
vipro dakṣiṇamārgeṇa mayāmāyāṃ prapūjayet ||165 ||
ityādi (siddhāntasāra-)vacanācca paśūnāmetaddevatopāsanādhikāritvamakṣatameva | anyathā |
paśurgurumukhāllabdhvā (-) ityādipūrvokta (-) (kālokulārṇava-)vacanasya | svācāranirato nirataṃ divā lakṣaṃ jayet paśuḥ |
ityādi (kālī krama-)vacanasya cāsaṅgatyāpatteḥ | evaṃ ca |
sādhake kṣobhamāpanne devīkṣobhaḥ prajāyate || 9-166 ||
tasmādbhuktvā ca pītvā ca pūjayet parameśvarīm | vinā pītvā surāṃ bhuktvā māṃsaṃ gatvā rajasvalām || 9-167 ||
yo japeddakṣiṇāṃ kālīṃ tasya duḥkhaṃ pade pade | kalāvāsavayogena tarpayet kālikāṃ priye || 9-168 ||
ityādi (-) (niruttaratantra-)vacanānāmapi vīraparatvamavagantavyam | vīrasyāpi brāhmaṇasya maireyādyupādānaniṣedhādbrāhmaṇetaravīraparatvamuktavacanānāmiti bahavaḥ | vastuto brāhmaṇasya vīrādibhāva eva niṣiddhaḥ |
paśubhāvo hi viprāṇām (-) ityuktatvāt |
nanu |
madyaṃ matsyaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ mudrāṃ ca maithunaṃ tataḥ | brāhmaṇo vīrabhāvena kālikāyai nivedayet ||168 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca kulayogataḥ | pañcamaiḥ pūjayet kālīṃ mokṣārthī yaḥ kalau bhavet ||169 ||
ityādi (niruttaratantra-)vacanādbrāhmaṇasya vīrabhāve kathaṃ nādhikāra iti cenmaivam |
brāhmaṃ vīryaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ saṃskārā brahmasaṃbhavāḥ | brahmaṇācaraṇādbrahmavidyābhirbrāhmaṇo bhavet ||170 ||
iti (merutantro-)kteṣu pañcasulakṣaṇeṣu nirdeśakramaprātilomyena lakṣaṇacatuṣṭayahīnasya śūdratulyasyaiva brāhmaṇasya vāmācārādhikāritayā sarvācāraparibhraṣṭasya tādṛśasyaiva brāhmaṇasya kulācārādhikāritayā ca taditarasya viprasya tadubhayānadhikāritvena vīrabhāvaniṣedhāt | taduktaṃ (merutantre)
ukteṣu lakṣaṇeṣvekaṃ yasmin vipre pradṛśyate | tasyaiva brāhmaṇasyātra vāme syādadhikāritā ||171 ||
tathā |
caturlakṣaṇahīnānāṃ mārgāḥ syu kaulikādayaḥ |
tathā |
sarvācāraparibhraṣṭaḥ kulācāraṃ samāśrayet || 9-172 ||
kulācāraparibhraṣṭo rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet (-) iti |
ata evoktaṃ (bhāvanirṇaye)
vṛṣalaḥ paśubhāvaṃ tu na kadā'pi samāśrayet || 9-173 ||
brāhmaṇo vīrabhāvaṃ ca manasā'pi na bhāvayet |
iti ca śabdāddivyabhāvamapi | evaṃ ca brāhmaṇakartṛkamadirādyupādānavidhyāyakaṃ vākyaṃ yatra yatropalabhyate tatra tatra brāhmaṇapadasya pūrvoktalakṣaṇacatuṣṭayahīnavīrabrāhmaṇaparatvamavadheyam | tāntrikamate tādṛśo'pi brāhmaṇapadaprayogāt | ata eva tasyaiva brāhmaṇasyetyuktaṃ (merutantre)
brāhmaṇaistu sadā peyaṃ kṣatriyaistu raṇāgame || 9-174 ||
vaiśyairdhanaprayoge ca śūdrernaiva kadācana |
iti (-) (kulārṇava-)vacanaṃ tu sadā peyamityatra sadā apeyamityakārapraleṣādapi saṅgacchate | evaṃ ca kalidharmaprakaraṇe gṛhyapariśiṣṭe harināthopādhyāyaiḥ sautrāmaṇyāṃ surāgrahaṇaniṣedhasyoktatvāt | kulācārādhikāribrāhmaṇasyāsmābhirupadarśitatvācca |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ kulācāre brāhmaṇaḥ prapivet surām || 9-175 ||
iti (samayācāra-)vacanaṃ saṅgacchata eva | yat tu |
tretāyāṃ pūjitā devī ghṛtena sarvajātibhiḥ | madhubhiḥ sarvavarṇaistu pūjitā dvāpare yuge ||176 ||
pūjanīyā kalau devī kevalairāsavaiḥ (-) (yāmala-)vacanam | tatra sarvavarṇaśabdo brāhmaṇetaraparaḥ |
trayyadhvaroṇo bhūdevastripadāyajñasūtradhṛk | na kadā'pi spṛśedbālāṃ na ca devyai nivedayet ||177 ||
iti (mahākālasaṃhitā-)vacanena brāhmaṇasya sarvadā maireyadānaniṣedhāt | itthaṃ ca |
yatrāvaśyaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ madirādānamumuttamam | brāhmaṇastāmrapātre tu gavyaṃ madyaṃ pralpayet ||178 ||
iti (bhairavatantro-)kto'nukalpavidhirapi pūrvoktavīrabrāhmaṇapara eva | taditarasya tatrāpi nādhikāraḥ |
brāhmaṇastvanukalpaṃ na kṛtvā cāṇḍālatāmiyāt |
iti tantrāntaravacanāt | (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
kadā cidanukalpoktāṃ dadyāddevyai dvijaḥ surām || 9-179 ||
upamadyāni te vacmi tāni devyavadhāraya | ārdrakasya guḍasyāpi samabhāge bhavet surā || 9-180 ||
tāmrapātre tathā kṣaudraṃ payo gavyaṃ tathā'tra ca | nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye rītau tālaraso'pi ca || 9-181 ||
rasālaśca raso raṅge vā pānaso dravaḥ | madhūkapuṭake drākṣā tatpuṣpaṃ taddale'pi ca || 9-182 ||
ciñcārasaṃ padmapatre'śvatthe kārakapānakam | upamadyāni caitāni dvādaśa syurvarānane || 9-183 ||
dvijo ditsati cenmadyaṃ dadyādetāni no surām | etānyapi na deyāni sāttvikairdharmabhīrubhiḥ || 9-184 ||
madyaṃ vā'pyupamadyaṃ vā madyanāma na gacchati | pātityaṃ kintu nāmībhistathaiva patito bhavet || 9-185 ||
atra dvijapadaṃ brāhmaṇetaradvijaparaṃ na tu brāhmaṇaparam | ata evoktaṃ tatraiva |
nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmre gavyaṃ tathā madhu | rājanyavaiśyayordānaṃ na viprasya kadācana || 9-186 ||
evaṃ pradānamātreṇa hīnāyurbrāhmaṇo bhavet (-) iti | evaṃ ca |
nānopacārasambhārairbhaktitaḥ pūjitā'pi ca || 9-187 || vinā makārayogena naiva tuṣyati kālikā |
ityādi (kularatnāvalī-) vacanamapi śūdrādikartṛkārādhanaparaṃ boddhavyaṃ | viprādikartṛkopāsanāyāṃ na sāttvikairevocāraistasyāstuṣṭiśravaṇāt | etat sarvaṃ (mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ) spaṣṭam |
tathā hi |
vastuṣvanyeṣu tiṣṭatsu devīprītikareṣu ca || 9-188 ||
kimetayā vai surayā kadannamalarūpayā | bhūtapretapiśācārthaṃ pūyamiśraṃ (*) surāmiṣam || 9-189 ||
tadbrāhmaṇena no deyaṃ devyai nāttavyameva ca | na caitayā tuṣyati sā bahu vā'pi ghṛṇāyate || 9-190 ||
udvignā ca bhavet tasmāddadyānnaiva dvijaḥ surām | hato vedo hato dharmaḥ paraloko hataḥ svakaḥ ||191 ||
kulaṃ hataṃ hatā jātirhataṃ brāhmaṇyameva ca | prājñaṃmanyena mūrkheṇa pivatā'jñānataḥ surām ||192 ||
kiṃ kṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ ca vā samupārjitam | yadayaṃ hṛtavān svasya sarvaṃ madyopasevanāt || 9-193 ||
evamevājñānamagno māmapyāśu haniṣyati | udvignaiva mahāmāyā bhavet tadavalokanāt || 9-194||
kaivarttapukkaśamleccharajakāntyāvasāyinām | carmakāranaṭaprothamedoveṇūpajīvinām || 9-195||
siddhadurgandhiśuṣkānnaṃ dravyaṃ mahyaṃ nivedya hi | sudhāvat pivatāṃ pusāṃ kathaṃ vidasu na hi spṛhā || 9-196 ||
anye na santi vastvādyā naivedyakaraṇāya kim | aspṛśyaṃ yat tadānīya mahyaṃ dadati kualikāḥ || 9-197 ||
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni hyatharvāṅgirasastathā | vedebhyaḥ koṭiguṇitā mahāmantrāstathaiva ca || 9-198 ||
ye pāvayanti dehasthān madyairākaṇṭhapūritaiḥ | māmapi plāvayiṣyanti kimāścaryaṃ hi te janāḥ || 9-199 ||
sāttvikaireva niavedyaiḥ kandaiḥ puṣpaiḥ palairdalaiḥ | abhāve bhāvabhaktibhyāṃ satyaṃ tuṣṭā bhavāmyaham || 9-200 ||
na madyamāṃsavistāraiḥ pretarākṣasabhojanaiḥ | brāhmaṇo mānasāḥ putrā marīcyatryaṅgiromukhāḥ || 9-201 ||
eteṣāmanvayodbūtāḥ punaranye sahasraśaḥ | kaśyapaścaiva durvāsā dattātreyaśca candramāḥ || 9-202 ||
bṛhaspatirviśravāśca śaktirdakṣo mṛkaṇḍujaḥ | nāradaḥ kapilo vyāsaḥ kālāgnirjamadagnijaḥ || 9-203 ||
dākṣaḥ kaviratharvā ca śāṇdilyo gautamo manuḥ | nāciketā bharadvājaḥ śvetāśvatara eva ca || 9-204 ||
aurvo dadhīciścyavana ṛcīkaśca parāśaraḥ | śātātapo lomaśaśca jaigīṣavyaśca devalaḥ || 9-205 ||
paiṭhīnasirvītihavyaḥ saṃvarto'gastirāsuriḥ | upamanyurmataṅgaśca tathā vājasravāḥ kaṭhaḥ || 9-206 ||
uddālakaścāruṇeya āśvalāyana eva ca | uttaṅkaśca yavakrītaḥ kātyāyana ṛtaśravāḥ || 9-207 ||
ete cānye ca munayo vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ | ījānāḥ ṛtubhiḥ sarvaiḥ samāptavadakṣiṇaiḥ || 9-208 ||
gṛṇantī nigamaṃ sarvaṃ kurvanto duścaraṃ tapaḥ | dhyāyanto niṣkalaṃ brahma japanto māmakaṃ manum || 9-209 ||
sarvadā sāttvikairevīpacāraiḥ pūjayanti mām | sadā mayyarpitahṛdaḥ sadā sadbhāvabhāvitāḥ || 9-210 ||
sadā maccharaṇaṃ prāptāḥ śāntāḥ dāntā jitendriyāḥ | vāyvāhārā nirāhārā ūrdhvaretasa eva ca || 9-211 ||
tapobalādbhraṃsayituṃ śakramapyalamīdṛśāḥ | na niveditavantaste kimarthaṃ madirāṃ mayi || 9-212 ||
vijñāyāsyāṃ mahādoṣaṃ nindyatāṃ pāpahetutām | garhākaratvaṃ pātityakāritvaṃ pūtitāmapi || 9-213 ||
paralokavināśitvaṃ tathā narakahetutām | vipratvajātihantṛtvaṃ mlecchatulyatvakāritām || 9-214 ||
atastatyajurevaināṃ saṃgṛhya śrutipaddhatim | yadyasyāṃ doṣarāhityaṃ puṇyakāritvameva ca || 9-215 ||
syāt tadā te kathaṃ mahyaṃ dadurnaiva surāṃ dvijāḥ | dharmavyavasthāṃ jñātvetthamanye'pi dvijajātayaḥ || 9-216 ||
nivedayiṣyanti naiva mahyaṃ madyaṃ kathaṃ cana | bodhitā api śāstrārthairanādṛtya vaco mama || 9-217 ||
mohādvyavahariṣyanti lobhopahatacetasaḥ | ye ke cit tāṃ dharmarājaḥ śāsiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 9-218 ||
tīvrairdaṇḍairmahāghoranarakādinipatanaiḥ | iti satyaṃ purā mahyaṃ provāca jagadambikā || 9-219 ||
tatrāhamavadaṃ devi devīvakkrotthitākṣaraiḥ | ata paraṃ śrutyaditaṃ dharmamadvākyameva ca || 9-220 ||
devyājñāṃ ca samullāṅghya ye dāsyanti surāṃ dvijāḥ | teṣāṃ śāstrī mahāmāyā śrotavyaṃ śṛṇvataḥ param || 9-221 ||
dvijetaraḥ saṃpradadyāddevyai madyaṃ sadā rahaḥ | svayaṃ mahāprasādaṃ ca yuñjīta pratyahaṃ priye || 9-222 ||
māṃsāni dagdhamīnā(/)ścasarvadaiva nivedayet | śudrādīnāmathaiteṣāṃ sadyastuṣyati kālikā || 9-223 ||
dvijānāṃ yāvatī nindā kathitā madyadānataḥ | śūdrāṇāṃ tāvatī jñeyā praśastirvaravarṇini || 9-224 ||
ataḥ śūdraḥ prayatnena devyai madyaṃ nivedayet | dīrghāyuṣṭvamarogitvaṃ vāgmitvaṃ rājamānyatām || 9-225 ||
putrakṣetrakalatrārthaparipūrṇatvameva ca | ante svargādigamanaṃ śūdraḥ prāpnoti madyataḥ || 9-226 ||
śrūyate yat phalādhikyaṃ tantrādau madyadānataḥ | taddhi śūdraparaṃ jñeyaṃ naiva dvijaparaṃ priye || 9-227 ||
svayaṃ yadanno bhavati tadannā tasya devatā | pitaraśca tadannāḥ syurityevaṃ vaidikī sthitiḥ || 9-228 ||
prāṇijātiṣu sarvāsu mānuṣyamatidurlabham | mānuṣyeṣvapi deheṣu śūdraḥ śreṣṭho'ntyajātitaḥ || 9-229 ||
śūdrācchataguṇo vaiśyo veśyāt sāhasriko nṛpaḥ | nṛpāt koṭiguṇo vipro jñeyaḥ svādhyāyatatparaḥ || 9-230 ||
ata eva hi sargādau jagat sṛṣṭvā carācaram | yadyat sārataraṃ vastu tadbrahmā'dāddvijātaye || 9-231 ||
vedāḥ ṣaḍaṅgaśāstrāṇi kṣamā satyaṃ tapo dhṛtiḥ | śaucaṃ dāntaṃ dayā dharmo vivekaḥ kalabhāṣitā || 9-232 ||
tyāgaḥ śāntiśca maryādā svādhyāyo'dhyātmacintanam | yajñāḥ sarvahavirgavyaṃ payo medhyānnameva ca || 9-233 ||
eteṣāṃ viparītāni dadau śūdrebhya eva ca | trayāṇāmapi varṇānāṃ dāsabhāvamadāt tataḥ || 9-234 ||
sarvaśilpopajīvitvaṃ mantrarāhityameva ca | anāśīstvamaśaucatvamapāṅkteyatvameva ca || 9-235 ||
aspṛśyatvamapāṭhitvamasamhāṣyatvameva ca | madyamāṃsopayogitvaṃ tadvikretṛtvameva ca || 9-236 ||
devebhyastatpradātṛtvaṃ tadutpāditvameva ca | mlecchādideśagamanaṃ tatsaṃparkitvameva ca || 9-237 ||
mahāsāhasakāritvaṃ vedāśrotṛtvameva ca | etasmāt kāraṇāddevi vedamaryādayā'nayā || 9-238 ||
bravīmi madirādāneṣveṣāmevādhikāritā | doṣo'ṇurapi naiteṣāṃ devebhyo madyadānataḥ || 9-239 ||
phalātirekatā vā'pi śrūyate nigamādiṣu | ataḥ prayatnataḥ śūdro dadyāddevyai pariśrutam || 9-240 ||
tāmeva varjayedvipraḥ sadā prāṇātyaye'pi hi | niśamyāpīdṛśān doṣānatha ceddātumicchati || 9-241 ||
sa ca sā ca vijānāti dharmaṃ vā pāpameva vā |
(agastyasaṃhitāyāmapi)
āvāṃ tu piśitai raktaiḥ surayā'pi sureśvari || 9-242 ||
varṇāśramocitaṃ dharmamavicārya yajanti ye | bhūtaprepiśācāste bhavanti brahmarākṣasāḥ || 9-243 ||
(merutantre)
amṛtena sahotpannaṃ sthāne madyaṃ sudhāyate | viṣeṇāpi sahotpannaṃ tena madyaṃ viṣāyate || 9-244 ||
tathā |
gauḍī paiṣṭhī ca mādhvī ca surā ityabhidhīyate | sā kṣatravaiśyorneṣṭā brāhmaṇasya tu kā kathā (-) iti || 9-245 ||
atha vidyābhedaḥ (kālītantre) |
kalīhṛdayāvidyā ca siddhividyā mahodayā | purā yena yathā japtvā siddhimāyurdivaukasaḥ || 9-246 ||
kāmākṣaraṃ vahnisaṃsthāmindirānādavindubhiḥ | mantrarājamidaṃ khyātaṃ durlabhaṃ pāpacetasām || 9-247 ||
triguṇā tu viśeṣeṇa sarvaśāstraprabodhikā | anayā sadṛśī vidyā na hi sārasvatapradā || 9-248 ||
ākarṣaṇavaśīkāramāraṇoccāṭanaṃ tathā | śāntipuṣṭyādikarmāṇi sādhayedanayā'cirāt (-) ityādi || 9-249 ||
tathā |
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ sādhanaṃ ca puraskriyā | aniruddhasarasvatyāḥ samānaṃ sarvamīritam || 9-250 ||
(merau)
japapūjādikaṃ prāgvaddiśeṣādbhogamokṣadam |
(śrutisiddhānte)
svabījaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya kālike vahnigohinī || 9-251 ||
eṣā ṣaḍakṣarī vidyā bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
(merutantre)
nyāsapūjādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣādbhogado mataḥ || 9-252 ||
tatraiva |
krī(/) hū(/) hrī(/) tryakṣarātmā'yaṃ mantraḥ kālyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ | prāgvajjapādikaṃ cāsya viśeṣāt santatipradaḥ || 9-253 ||
kālībījaṃ ca hū(/) māyāṃ hu(/) phaṭ pañcakṣaro manuḥ | nyāsadhyānādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣādbhūtanāśanam || 9-254 ||
krī(/) hū(/) hrī(/) hu(/) phaḍatyuktvā svāhāntaḥ saptavarṇakaḥ | māyādvandvaṃ kūrcayugmamaindrāntaṃ madanatrayam || 9-255 ||
māyāvindviśvarayutaṃ dakṣiṇe kālike padam | saṃhārakramayogena bījasaptakamuddharet || 9-256 ||
ekaviṃśatyakṣarātmā tārādyaḥ kālikāmanuḥ |
(merutantre'pi)
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi ekaviṃśativarṇakam || 9-257 ||
oṃ hrī(/) hrī(/) hū(/) śaktiyugmamasya nyāsādi pūrvavat | vilvamūle śavārūḍho vaṭamūle tathaiva ca || 9-258 ||
lakṣaṃ manumimaṃ japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | pañcamaṃ pratinidhyāyaṃ dakṣiṇāmnāyasiddhidam || 9-259 ||
tathā |
dakṣiṇe kālike svāhā manuraṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥ | nyāsaḥ prāgvaddhyānamantraśavarūpaśivasthitām || 9-260 ||
mahākālaratāsaktāṃ śivābhirdikṣu veṣṭitām |
tathā |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śakravarṇamanūttamam || 9-261 ||
krī(/) hū(/) hrī(/) dakṣiṇe kālike krī(/) hu(/) hrī(/) dahanapriyā | yajanaṃ pūrvavat proktaṃ nyāsadhyānajapādikam || 9-262 ||
viśeṣānnṛsurādīnāmayamākarṣaṇakṣamaḥ | hū(/) hū(/) triḥ krī(/) dviśca lajjāṃ svāhetyākṛtivarṇavān || 9-263 ||
nyāsapūjādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣeṇa vaśīkṛtiḥ | japādetasya bhavati sarvamanyat tu pūrvat || 9-264 ||
krī(/) krī(/) krī(/) hū(/) samuccārya hū(/) lajjādvayamuccaret | dakṣiṇe kālike svāhā tithivarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 9-265 ||
mantrarājo'yamākhyātaḥ pūrvavat syādupāsanā | viśeṣādgatarājyānāmayaṃ rājyaprado bhavet || 9-266 ||
athaitadgātryāḥ puraścaraṇamuktaṃ (siddhāntasaṃgrahe)
evaṃ dhyātvā mahākalīṃ japellakṣacatuṣṭayam | raktāktairvilvapatraiśca taddaśāṃśena homayet (-) iti || 9-267 ||
atha mahākālamantraḥ (śaktisaṅgame )
śrīśiva uvāca |
mahākālaṃ samārabhya nityānāṃ nirṇayaṃ śṛṇu | mahākālī mahābhīmaḥ pralayānalasannibhaḥ || 9-268 ||
kālīmāyāsamudbhūtaḥ kālīmānasikaḥ śivaḥ | mahākālaḥ paraḥ śambhuḥ parātītaguṇākaraḥ || 9-269 ||
tasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena rakṣejjagattrayam | kūrcayugamaṃ mahākāla prasīdeti padadvayam || 9-270 ||
lajjāyugmaṃ vahnijāyāsaṃyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇakaḥ | ṣoḍaśārṇā yathā mukhyāḥ sarvaśīcakramaṇḍale || 9-271 ||
tathā'yaṃ sarvakālīṣu mahākālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kālikā'sya ṛṣiḥ prikto virāṭ chandaḥ prakīrtitam || 9-272 ||
devatā tu mahākālaḥ sarvarūpī nirañjanaḥ | kūrcabījaṃ tathā māyā śaktirasya prakīrtitā || 9-273 ||
svāhākīlakamuddiṣṭaṃ kālyarthe viniyogatā | māyayā tu ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānaṃ śṛṇu varānane || 9-274 ||
atha dhyānam |
koṭikālānalābhāsaṃ caturbāhuṃ trilocanam | śmaśānāṣṭakamadhyasthaṃ muṇḍāṣṭakavibhūṣitam || 9-275 ||
pañcapretasthitaṃ devaṃ triśūlaṃ ḍamarūṃ tathā | khaḍgaṃ ca kharparaṃ caiva vāmadakṣiṇayogataḥ || 9-276 ||
vibhrataṃ sundaraṃ dehaṃ śmaśānaṃbhasmabhūṣitam | nānāśavaiḥ krīḍamānaṃ kālikāṃ hṛdayasthitām || 9-277 ||
lālayantaṃ ratāsaktaṃ ghoracumbanatatparam | gṛdhragomāyusaṃyuktaṃ pheravīgaṇasaṃyutam || 9-278 ||
jaṭāpaṭalaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvaśūnyālaye sthitam | sarvaśūnya muṇḍabhūṣaṃ prasannavadanaṃ śivam || 9-279 ||
bhāvayediti śeṣaḥ |
atha puraścaraṇam |
evaṃ pūjā vidhāyātha lakṣasaṅkhya japecchive | taddaśāṃśena havanaṃ karavīraprasūnakaiḥ || 9-280 ||
svayambhūvā'ktairbījāktaiḥ kāraṇāktaiśca vā hunet | nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kālīvat sarvamācaret || 9-281 ||
atha mahākālīmantro (merutatre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahākālīmahāmanum | oṃ kṣa(/) kṣre(/) kṣre(/) kre(/) tataḥ kre(/) ca paśuṃ gṛhāṇa coccaret || 9-282 ||
hu(/) phaṭ svāhā śakravarṇaḥ siddhamantra udāhṛtaḥ | nāsya munyādikaṃ nyāsaḥ siddhamantrasya vidyate || 9-283 ||
kṛṣṇatoyena saṃpūrṇe ghaṭe cāhūya kālikām | brāhmyādibhiśca dūtībhiryuktāṃ saṃpūjya bhaktaḥ || 9-284 ||
aṣṭamīṃ caṇḍikāṃ tvatra devīṃ dhyāyedgṛhe punaḥ |
dhyāna yathā |
pañcavakkrāṃ mahāraudrīṃ prativakraṃ trilocanām || 9-285 ||
śaktiśūladhanurbāṇakheṭakhaḍgavarābhayān | dakṣādakṣabhujairdevīṃ bibhrāṇāṃ bhogibūṣaṇām || 9-286 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ vāmācāreṇa sādhakaḥ | picumardasya samidho ghṛtāktā juhuyāt tataḥ || 9-287 ||
rajjvā prajvalite vahnau tarpaṇādi tataścaret | evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī mārayedacirādripun || 9-288 ||
atha bhadrakālīmantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhadrakālyāḥ paraṃ manum | hau(/) kālīti mahākālī dviḥ kiṇiḥ phaḍvasupriyā || 9-289 ||
caturdaśākṣarī mantro bhadrakālyā udāhṛtaḥ | padaiḥ ṣadbhiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni jātiyuktāni kalpayet || 9-290 ||
atha dhyānam |
dhyātavyeyaṃ sadā devī bhadrakālī bhayāvahā | kṣutkṣāmā koṭarākṣī ca nāhaṃ tṛpteti vādini || 9-291 ||
masīmukhī muktakeśī jagadgrasanalālasā | jambūphalābhadaśanā lolajihvā bhayaṅkarī || 9-292 ||
śūlaṃ kapālaṃ ca śṛṇiṃ jvalatpāśaṃ ca bibhratī | aśeṣaṃ kālikātantre yat proktaṃ tadihāpi ca || 9-293 ||
japanyāsaprayogādyaṃ yo viśeṣaḥ sa ucyate | ārādhya prajapenmantraṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 9-294 ||
riṣṭamālā vidhātavyā japārthaṃ siddhimicchatā | iyaṃ devī mahādevī śatrunigrahakāriṇī || 9-295 ||
yatheṣṭaceṣṭayā cintyā dharmakāmārthasiddhidā | atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye bhadrakālyāḥ sugopitam || 9-296 ||
gṛdhrakarṇi virupākṣi lambastani mahodari | utpādayotpārayeti dvidhopari padaṃ bhavet || 9-297 ||
dvidhā vetti padaṃ hu(/) phaṭ svāhā saptagnivarṇakaḥ | pippalādo muniḥ prokto nivṛcchanda udāhṛtam || 9-298 ||
bhadrakālī devatā syāddvirutpādaya hṛt smṛtam | uparibhyāṃ śiraḥ proktaṃ vettibhyāṃ tu śikhā smṛtā || 9-299 ||
hu(/) phaḍbhyāṃ kavacaṃ svāhayā'stramudīritam |
atha dhyānam |
atiraudrā mahādaṃṣṭrā bhṛśaṃ dīrghā kṛśodarī || 9-300 ||
suvṛttanayanā śūrā dīrghaghoṇā madāturā | snigdhagambhīranirghoṣā nīlajīmūtasannibhā || 9-301 ||
bhṛgudyaghaṭasaṃdīptā mahāradanabhīṣaṇā | daṃṣṭroṣṭhakopatāmrākṣī raktadīrghaśiroruhā || 9-302 ||
triśūlavyagradordaṇḍā narakīṭapalāśinī | atiraktāmbarā devī raktamāṃsāsavapriyā || 9-303 ||
śiromālā bhūṣitāṅgī pivantī śoṇitāsavam | nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca piśācagaṇasevitā || 9-304 ||
piśācaskandhamārūhya bhramantī vasudhātalam | śaṅkarasya mukhotpannā yoginī yogavallabhā || 9-305 ||
itthambhūtā bhadrakālī mātṛbhiḥ parivāritā |
atha puraścaraṇam |
dhyātvā samyak samārādhya tato mantraṃ japedbudhaḥ || 9-306 ||
ayutaṃ mantrasiddhyarthaṃ mātṛkānyāsatatparaḥ | ghṛtahomastathā kāryastarpaṇādi samācaret || 9-307 ||
dhūmāvatyāṃ ca yat proktamanayā'pi tadācaret |
atha siddhikālīmantraḥ (kālītantre)
atha vakṣye mahādevi siddhavidyāṃ mahodayām || 9-308 ||
īśvareṇa purā proktā devīṃ hṛdīśasaṃjñitām | praṇavaṃ pūrvasuccārya hṛllekhābījamuddharet || 9-309 ||
ṭhadvayena samāyuktaṃ vidyā rājñī prakīrtitā | bhairavo'sya ṛṣiḥ prokto virāṭ chanda udāhṛtam || 9-310 ||
siddhikālī brahmarūpā devatā bhuvaneśvarī | ratībījaṃ bījamasyā hṛllekhā śaktirucyate || 9-311 ||
hṛllekhayā ṣaḍdīrgheṇa praṇavādyena kalpayet | aṅgaṣaṭkaṃ tato nyasya dhyātvā devīṃ śivo bhavet || 9-312 ||
dhyānaṃ yathā |
khaḍgodbhinnenduvimbasravadamṛtarasāplāvitāṅgo trinetrā savye pāṇau kapālādgaladamṛtamayaṃ muktakeśī pivantī | digvastrā baddhakāñcī maṇimayamukuṭādyairyutā dīptajihvā pāyānnīlotpalābhā raviśaśivilasatkuṇḍalālīdhapādā || 9-313 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
japeddviṃśatisāhasraṃ sahasraireva saṃyutaiḥ | homayet taddaśāṃśena mṛdupuṣpeṇa mantravit || 9-314 ||
atha śmaśānakālīmantraḥ (svatantratantre)
śmaśānakālikāmantraṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahitā śive | vāṇīṃ māyāṃ tao lakṣmīṃ kāmabījaṃ tataḥ param || 9-315 ||
kālike saṃpuṭatvena catuṣkaṃ bījamālikhet | ekādaśārṇā deveśi caturvargaphalapradā || 9-316 ||
ṛṣirbhṛgurnivṛcchando devatā kālikā parā | śmaśānādyā ca vāṅmāyā bījaṃ śaktirmaheśvari || 9-317 ||
kīlakaṃ kāmābījaṃ tam (---------------------------) iti | catuścatustricatustu vidyāmantraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 9-318 ||
vinyasya dhyānaṃ kurvīta kālikāyāṃ samāhitaḥ | añjanādrinibhāṃ devīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīm || 9-319 ||
trinetrāṃ muktakeśīṃ ca śuṣkamāṃsātibhīṣaṇām | piṅgākṣīṃ vāmahastena madhyapūrṇaṃ kapālakam || 9-320 ||
sadyaḥ kṛttaśiro dakṣahastena dadhatīṃ śivām | smitavaktrāṃ sadā vāmamāṃsatarpaṇatatparām || 9-321 ||
nānālaṅkārabhūṣāṅgīṃ nagnāṃ mattāṃ sadā śavaiḥ |
758> evaṃ dhyāyediti śeṣaḥ |
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśena (-) iti ||322 ||
atha siddhilakṣmīmantraḥ (kālānalatantre)
oṃ hrī(/) hu(/) hā(/) phre(/) kṣo(/) kro(/) namaḥ | śrutiścaṭī ca dogdhrī ca śoṣiṇī śirayā saha || 9-323 ||
dolā tadanu mālūraḥ sāmaraśca niratyayaḥ | śeṣe daṇḍaḥ parijñeya iyamuktā navākṣarī || 9-324 ||
naitasya sadṛśo mantrastriṣu lokeṣu vidyate |
atha mantrāntaraṇ tatraiva |
athoddhariṣye deveśīṃ ṣoḍaśārṇāṃ manūttamām || 9-325 ||
yāmekavāramuccārya mucyate janmasaṃkaṭāt |
hrī(/) hū(/) phre(/) chrī(/) hsau(/)ḥ hrī(/) kro(/) phre(/) strī(/) śrī(/) ho(/) jū(/) blau(/) vrī(/) svāhā || 9-326 ||
caṭī dogdhrī śirosiddhibhūmarddhiḥ prota eva ca | phalī punaḥ śiro retaḥ prātarāntre tataḥ param || 9-327 ||
puraścaraṇahomāḥ syurmalināhradaparyaṭāḥ | mantrī'yamapi sarveṣāṃ manūnāmuttamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 9-328 ||
anayor-ṛṣyādinyāsa uktastatraiva |
śrīsiddhilakṣmīmantrasya ṛṣīrnārada īritaḥ | gāyatrī chanda ākhyātaṃ siddhilakṣmīśca devatā || 9-329 ||
caṭībījaṃ tathā'khyātaṃ samīhā śaktiriṣyate | prabandhaḥ kīlakaṃ vidyāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye || 9-330 ||
viniyogo'sya mantrasya kathitastvayi nārada |
atha karāṅganyāsau |
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena karāṅganyāsamīritam || 9-331 ||
idānīṃ te sugamena kathayāmi dvijarṣabha | śrutipūrvaṃ bījamuktvā aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ padaṃ tataḥ || 9-332 ||
śeṣe daṇḍaḥ samākhyātaḥ punarbījadvayaṃ vadet | tarjanībhyāṃ yadā tatra daṇḍa ityabhidhīyate || 9-333 ||
punarbījadvayaṃ yatra bhyāmantrā madhyamā tataḥ | daṇḍaḥ śeṣe ca vijñeyaḥ punastadbījameva ca || 9-334 ||
anāmikā bhyāmantā ca tato daṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | bījadvayāt kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ padāddaṇḍabījaṃ smṛtam || 9-335 ||
bījadvayaṃ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ daṇḍa ityapi | iti karanyāsaṃ kṛtvā aṅganyāsaṃ caret sudhīḥ || 9-336 ||
krameṇānena vai brahman saṃbhavanyāsamācaret | śruticaṭyau samābhāṣya hṛdayāya padaṃ tataḥ || 9-337 ||
daṇḍastadanu viprarṣe bījadvayaṃ tathā param | śirase padataścaiva dogdhrībījaṃ smṛtaṃ tadā || 9-338 ||
tadbījadvayamuccārya śikhāyai padameva ca | indrabījaṃ samākhyātaṃ punarbījadvayaṃ vadet || 9-339 ||
kavacāya padāccaiva dogdhrībījaṃ hi nārada | bīje tathā samuccārya netratrayāya vauṣaḍiti || 9-340 ||
ṣaḍaṅganyāsamityuktamarcayāṃ kāyaśodhanam |
atha dhyānam |
dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi tannibodha ajātmaja || 9-341 ||
śvetāṃ śvataśavārūḍhāṃ nṛmuṇḍakṛtakuṇḍalām | pañcavaktrāṃ mahāraudrīṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanām || 9-342 ||
vyāghracarmāvṛtakaṭīṃ śuṣkāvayabhūṣitām | ābaddhayogapaṭṭāṃ ca narāsthikṛtabhūṣaṇām || 9-343 ||
hastaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdīptāṃ visrastaghanakuntalām | khaḍgaṃ bāṇaṃ tathā śūlaṃ cakraṃ śaktiṃ gadāmapi || 9-343 ||
japamālāṃ kartṛkāṃ ca bibhratīṃ dakṣiṇairbhujaiḥ | phalakaṃ kārmukaṃ nāgapāśaṃ paraśumeva ca || 9-344 ||
ḍamaruṃ pherupotaṃ ca naramuṇḍakapālakam | udvahantīṃ karairvāmairdīghasarvāṅgabhūṣaṇām || 9-345 ||
eta dhyānaṃ navākṣaryāḥ | ṣoḍasārṇavidyāyāstu dhyānāntaramuktaṃ tatraiva |
mahātejomayī lakṣmi raśmikoṭyuyutaprabhā | pañcavaktrā daśabhujā tripañcanayanairyutā ||| 9-346 ||
śvetavarṇanibhā devī mahāpretoparisthitā | mātṛkāṣṭakamadhyasthā siddhiyoganiṣevitā || 9-347 ||
dāritāsyā lelihānā jvālāluptajagattrayī | ucchrāsocchvāsavegena cālayan kulaparvatān || 9-348 ||
kva ciddeśe kvacit kūṭe kvacit saṃharate kṣaṇāt | kvacit sṛjet pālayacca svatantrādvā pravartate || 9-349 ||
gonāsābharaṇairyuktā uragendravibhūṣitā | pāśāṅkuśadharā devī varābhayakarāmbujā ||350 ||
savyahaste dhṛtaṃ khaḍgaṃ trailokyakṣobhakārakam | vāme khaṭvāṅgamatyugra dakṣiṇe śūlamuttamam ||351 ||
vāme tu kalaśaṃ divyaṃ mahāratnaprapūritam | eṣā pratyaṅgirā devī unmattā vyomadehajā ||352 ||
ekātmā naikabhedena viśvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitā | pratyaṅgirā mahādevī siddhilakṣmīrjayapradā ||353 ||
(paddhatau)
khaṭvāṅgāṅkuśapāśaśūlavarakṛdbhītrāṇapātra śiraḥ kumbhāsijvalitodbhaṭairbhujavarairābhāsamānāṃ śivām | rudraskandhagatāṃ śaracchaśinibhāṃ pañcānanāṃ sundarīṃ pañcatryakṣavirājitāṃ bhagavatīṃ śrīsiddhilakṣmīṃ bhaje ||354 ||
uktayoḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīmantrayoḥ puraścaraṇaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇa(-)(mahākālasaṃhito-)ktaguhyāpuraścaraṇavajjñeyam | taduktaṃ (kālānalatantre)
yathā kāmakalā kālī guhyakālī yathā dvija | yathā chinnā yathā tārā vajrakāpalinī yathā || 9-355 ||
siddhilakṣmīstathā devī viśeṣo nāsti kaścana | ekaiva pūjā vijñeyā prayogāśca tathā dvija || 9-356 ||
atrānuktaṃ hi yat kiñcit saṃhitāyāṃ ca tadbiduḥ | granthagauravabhītyā ca noktamanyat tvayi dvija || 9-357 ||
saṃkṣepeṇa siddhilakṣmyāstvayi sarvaṃ prakīrtitam | vistṛtaṃ ca mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ dino(?)ttama || 9-358 ||
japaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ ca ācāraśca (*) pa nārada | mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ kāmakalābhyāse prakīrtitaḥ || 9-359 ||
tenaiva vartmanā vipra siddhilakṣmyā'khilaṃ (*) viduḥ | paunaruktyabhayenātra nigadāmi na nārada || 9-360 ||
atha guhyakālīmantraḥ (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
guhyakālyāstu mantrāṇāmaṣṭādaśa bhidāḥ priye | sarvāgameṣu gopyāste na prakāśyāḥ kadā cana || 9-361 ||
mantrāṇāṃ bhedato dhyānabhedāḥ syurvividhāstathā | yantrabhedā api tathā vāhanānāṃ bhidāstathā || 9-362 ||
yo mantro yena cābhyastastatrāmnāyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | brahmaṇā ca vaśiṣṭhena rāmeṇa ca tathā priye || 9-363 ||
hiraṇyākṣāujenāpi kuvereṇa yamena ca | bharatena daśāsyena valinā vāsavena ca || 9-364 ||
viṣṇunā'nyaiśca devaiśca daityendrairvividhairapi | upāsitā siddhihetorlabdhvā siddhiśca bhūyasī || 9-365 ||
śatavaktrā'śītivaktrā ṣaṣṭivaktrā tathaiva ca | ṣaṭtriṃśadānanā viṃśadānanā parikīrtitā || 9-366 ||
tathā viṃśativaktrā ca daśavaktrā ca kālikā | pañcavaktrā trivaktrā ca dvivaktrā caikavaktrikā || 9-367 ||
yā guhyakālī tanmadhye bharatopāsitā priye | daśavaktrā ṣoḍaśārṇā catuṣpañcaśaddoryutā || 9-368 ||
sarvāsāṃ guhyakālīnāṃ sā vai mukhyatamā smṛtā | tāmevādau vyāharāmi vyāhariṣye tataḥ parāḥ || 9-369 ||
ṣoḍaśākṣarako ma (*)(?) kīlitaścāpyakīlitaḥ | tatrādau kīlitaṃ vacmi tato vakṣyāmyakīlitam || 9-370 ||
kīlakākīlakadhyānamekameva hi pārvati |
mantroddhāramāha |
ādau vedādimuddhṛtya tataḥ pasya dvitīyakam || 9-371 ||
ekārayuktaṃ tadadho rephaṃ vinduṃ ca yojayet | siddhiśabdaṃ tataḥ procya karāliṃ ca vinirdiśet || 9-372 ||
lajjāṃ krodhamanusmṛtya kaphoṇiṃ vāmamuddharet | vāmadṛgvindvadhovahniyuktaṃ kuryāt tataśca tam || 9-373 ||
vadhūbījaṃ punarmantradvitīyaṃ bījamuddharet | hṛnmantro vahnijāyā ca mantro'yaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ || 9- 374 ||
prakārāntaramāha |
atha vā kāminībījāt pūrvaṃ krodhamanusmaret | iyaṃ hi bharatopāsyā kīlitā'pi ca śāpataḥ || 9-375 ||
bharatopāsitā ṣoḍaśākṣarī dvividhā | tatrādyā kīlitā dvitīyā tvakīlitetyarthaḥ | saptadaśākṣarīmāha |
rāmopāsyāmato vakṣye'kṣarasaptadaśānvitām | sā'pi hārītamuninā kīlitā tapaso balāt || 9-376 ||
ādau tasyaiva mantrasya caturo'rṇān samuddharet | dvitīyabījopari ca hasakhaṃ viniyojayet || 9-377 ||
evaṃ tu pañcamaṃ bījaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ khena ca varjitam | saptāṃ hasahīnaṃ ca karāli tadanantaram || 9-378 ||
trayodaśaikādaśake sthāne saptamamakṣaram | pañcamaṃ dvādaśasthāne dvitīyaṃ ca caturdaśe || 9-379 ||
ādyaṃ pañcadaśe kuryādvahnijayā (**)(?) manuḥ | hārītopāsitā hyeṣā cyavanopāsitāṃ śṛṇu || 9-380 ||
ṣaṣṭhapañcamayorasya vyatyayaḥ samudīritaḥ | etāvataiva bhavati cyāvanī sumahāphalā || 9-381 ||
atrā rāmopāsitā saptadaśākṣarī dvidhā hārītopāsitā cyavanopāsitā ceti | tayormadhye hārītopāsitaiva kīlitā cyavanopāsitā tu na kīliteti bodhyam | ṛṣyādikamāha |
ṣoḍaśākṣarayormantrabhedayoradhunā bruve | ṛṣyādikaṃ tataḥ saptadaśyāśca kathayāmi te || 9-382 ||
atharvā ṛṣiruddiṣṭo jagatī chanda ucyate | devatā guhyakālī ca dvitīyārṇaṃ tu kīlakam || 9-383 ||
śaktistu daśamaṃ bījaṃ dvitīye navamaṃ bhavet | puruṣārthacatuṣkasya siddhaye kāmanāsthitiḥ || 9-384 ||
saptadaśyāstu mantrasya parameṣṭhī ṛṣirmataḥ | chandaśca sapratiṣṭhākhyaṃ devatā guhyakālikā || 9-385 ||
pañcamārṇaṃ kīlakaṃ syāt saptamaṃ śaktirucyate | tadeva viparītaṃ hi cyāvanīsamudīritam || 9-386 ||
prayogaḥ sarvasiddhyarthaṃ jape proccārito bhavet | anyeṣāṃ mantrabhedānāṃ yaduddhāraṃ vadāmi te || 9-387 ||
tadā ṛṣyādikaṃ teṣāṃ kathayiṣyāmi pārvati |
atha ṣaḍaṅganyāsastatraiva |
dve pañca trīṇi ca dvi ca dve punardve punastathā || 9-387 ||
varṇākṣarāṇāṃ bhāratyāstattatsthāne pravinyaset | tāvanto'rṇāḥ sapraṇavāstatra tatra sthale nyaset || 9-388 ||
yādṛśī cyāvanī mantravarṇāvalyanutiṣṭhati | tārayormadhyavartīni (*)(?)vīvarṇāni tāni hi || 9-389 ||
nyasyet sthāneṣu teṣveva hārītopasite manau |
dhyānamāha |
bharatopāsitā yā ca rāmopāsyā ca yā smṛtā || 9-390 ||
dhyānaṃ tayorekameva kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu | dhyāyeddevīprabhāvotthaprocchaladraktavāridhim || 9-391 ||
uttuṅgottuṅgakallolaprapūritadigantaram | tatra dvīpaṃ raktamāṃsapūritaṃ raktavālukam || 9-392 ||
navakoṭikacāmuṇḍākoṭibhairavaveṣṭitam |
tanmadhye maṇḍalaṃ dhyāyedyojanāyutavistṛtam || 9-393 ||
bhairavīkoṭighaṭitaṃ prākāraṃ tatra cintayet | ekaṃ śmaśānaṃ tanmadhye śatayojanavistṛtam || 9-394 ||
cintayet procchaladvahnijvālāvyāptarkṣamaṇḍalam | yoginīkoṭivihitakaratālikaceṣṭitam || 9-395 ||
nārāntranaddhamuṇḍasrakkṛtatoraṇamālikam | tadantaḥsthāpinīṃ kālīṃ dhyāyenniścalamānasaḥ || 9-396 ||
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ hīramuktādinirmitam | dhārayantaṃ catuṣkoṇe yugaṃ vedaṃ vicintayet || 9-397 ||
satyayugaṃ ca ṛgvedaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ ca pūrvagam | tretāyugaṃ yajurvedaṃ pītavarṇaṃ ca dakṣagam || 9-398 ||
dvāparaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca raktaṃ paścimadiggatam | atharvavedaṃ ca kaliṃ śyāmamuttaradiggatam || 9-399 ||
upavedasya śubhrasya mūrdhni siṃhāsanaṃ sthitam | tasya siṃhāsanasyordhvamanyat siṃhāsanaṃ mahat || 9-400 ||
svasvāstravāhanayutairdigaṣṭapari (**)(?)bharvṛtam | devyāḥ siṃhāsanadharā(/)stā(/)śca dhyāyedatandritaḥ || 9-401 ||
svā svāṃ diśamavaṣṭabhya sthitān paramaśobhitān | indraṃ pītaṃ savajraṃ ca sthitamairāvatopari || 9-402 ||
pāvakaṃ raktavarṇaṃ ca chāgasthaṃ śaktipāṇikam | yamaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāsarasthaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ turaṅgam || 9-403 ||
varuṇaṃ pāśahastaṃ ca śubhraṃ makaravāhanam | śyāmaṃ vāyuṃ dhvajadharaṃ hariṇopari saṃsthitam || 9-404 ||
gadādharaṃ kuveraṃ ca kuṅkumābhaṃ nare sthitam | īśānaṃ śubhravarṇaṃ ca śūlahastaṃ vṛṣe sthitam || 9-405 ||
siṃhāsanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca pañcapretairghṛtaṃ priye | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || 9-406 ||
ete pañcamahāpretāḥ sthitāḥ siṃhāsanādadhaḥ | pītaḥ śyāmastathā rakto dūmraḥ śvetaḥ kramādime || 9-407 ||
daṇḍaṃ cakraṃ ca śaktiṃ ca śūlaṃ khaṭvāṅgameva ca | dhārayanto mukhe nyastatarjanīkāstrilocanāḥ || 9-408 ||
keśaridvipakolāśca phetkāraravabhīṣaṇāḥ | ūrdhvaṃ pīṭhaṃ tato dhyāyedbhairavākhyaṃ bhayānakam || 9-409 ||
kharvaṃ sthūlataraṃ ghoraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ caturbhujam | pañcavakkraṃ trinetraṃ ca kīkaśābharaṇānvitam || 9-410 ||
khaṭvāṅgaṃ kartṛkāṃ dakṣe kapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathā | dhārayantaṃ muṇḍamālāyutaṃ daṃṣdrāgrabhīṣaṇam || 9-411 ||
tadūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ padmaṃ yajñopakalpitam | jyotiṣṭomo'gniṣṭā (*) (?) vājapeyaśca ṣoḍaśī || 9-412 ||
cayanaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca rājasūyo'śvamedhakaḥ | bārhaspatyaṃ viśvajicca gomedho naramedhakaḥ || 9-413 ||
sautrāmaṇyardhasāvitrī sūryakānto'calambhidaḥ | etādṛśaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdalaiḥ padmaṃ prakalpitam || 9-414 ||
tasyopari tato dhyāyecchivāsanamanuttamam | vindunādayutaṃ nīlaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtalāñchanam || 9-415 ||
mahārgharatnābharaṇaṃ trinetraṃ bhīmadarśanam | vajradaṃṣṭrānakhasparśaṃ padmapṛṣṭhe śivottamam || 9-416 ||
piṅgograikajaṭābhāraṃ dvibhujaṃ nāgahāriṇam | vasānaṃ carma vaiyāghraṃ śūlakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇam || 9-417 ||
aṣṭapatrāmbujaṃ tasyopariṣṭānnavamāsanam | dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca caturdiśi || 9-418 ||
yaśo vivekaḥ kāmaśca mokṣaśceti vidigdiśi | evamaṣṭadalāmbhojopaviṣṭāṃ guhyakālikām || 9-419 ||
dhyāyennīlotpalaśyāmāmindranīlasamadyutim | ghanāghanatanudyotāṃ snigdhadūrvādaladyutim || 9-420 ||
jñānaraśmicchaṭāṭopajyotirmaṇḍalamadhyagām | daśavaktrāṃ guhyakālīṃ saptaviṃśatilocanām || 9-421 ||
dvidvinetrayutāṃ vaktre vāmadakṣiṇasaṃmukhe | saptasvanyeṣu vaktreṣu tritrilocanasaṃyutām || 9-422 ||
ūrdhvavaktraṃ dvipakākhyaṃ caṇḍayogeśvarīti hi | tasyādhaḥ keśarimukhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ vibhīṣaṇam || 9-423 ||
tasyādhaḥ pheruvaktraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ trailokyaḍāmaram | vānarāsyaṃ tato vāme raktava (*)(?)mahojjvalam || 9-424 ||
narāsyaṃ tadho jñeyaṃ kirmīrābhaṃ mahotkaṭam | ṛkṣavaktraṃ bhaveddakṣe dhūmravarṇaṃ bhayānakam || 9-425 ||
gāruḍāsyaṃ tato vāme piṅgavarṇaṃ sucañcukam | dakṣiṇe makarāsyaṃ ca haritābhaṃ prakīrtitam || 9-426 ||
gajāsyaṃ vātaḥ proktaṃ gauravaktraṃ sravanmadam | hayāsyaṃ dakṣiṇe kālyāḥ śyāmavarṇaṃ vicintiyet || 9-427 ||
mahādaṃṣṭrākarālāni dāruṇasvanavanti ca | aṭṭāṭṭahāsayuktāni sravadraktāni sarvadā || 9-428 ||
lelihānaviniṣkrāntalalajjihvānvitāni ca | aharniśaṃ kampamānānyāsyāni dadhatīṃ śivām || 9-429 ||
bhīmanirhrādinīṃ bhīmāṃ bhrūṅgaṅgakuṭilānanām | piṅgalordhvajaṭājūṭāṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharām || 9-430 ||
nānāratnavinirmāṇasamuṇḍasvarṇabhūṣaṇām | sravadrakranṛmuṇḍāsrakkṛtanakṣatramālikām || 9-431 ||
ākaṇṭhagulphalambinyā'laṅkṛtāṃ muṇḍamālayā | śvetāsthigulikāhāragraiveyakamahojjavalām || 9-432 ||
śavadīrghāṅgulīpaṅktimaṇḍitoraḥsthalasthirām | kaṭhorapiṅgalottuṅgavakṣojayugalānvitām || 9-433 ||
mahāmārakatagrāvavediśroṇipariṣkṛtām | viśālajaghanābhogāmatikṣiṇakaṭisthalām || 9-434 ||
attranaddhārbhakaśirovalatkiṅkiṇimaṇḍitām | catuṣpañcāśatā doṣṇāṃ bhūṣitāṃ jagadambikām || 9-435 ||
ratnamālāṃ kapālaṃ ca carma pāśaṃ tathaiva ca | śaktiṃ khaṭvāṅgamuṇḍa ca bhuśuṇḍīṃ dhanureva ca || 9-436 ||
cakraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ tato bālapretaṃ śailamataḥ param | narakaṃ kālanakulau sarpamunmādavaṃśikām || 9-437 ||
mudgaraṃ vahnikuṇḍaṃ ca ḍamaruṃ ḍiṇḍimaṃ tathā | bhindipālaṃ ca muśalaṃ pāśaṃ paṭṭiśameva ca || 9-438 ||
śataghnīṃ ca śivāpotaṃ vāmahasteṣu bibhratīm | atha dakṣabhuje ratnamālāṃ tarttrīmasiṃ tathā || 9-439 ||
tarjanīmaṅkuśaṃ daṇḍaṃ ratnakumbhaṃ triśūlakam | pañcapāśupatān bāṇān śoṣakonmādamūrchakān || 9-440 ||
saṃhārakān mṛtyukarāneva nāmapradhāriṇaḥ | kuntaṃ ca pārijātaṃ ca churikāṃ tomaraṃ tathā || 9-441 ||
puṣpamālāṃ ḍiṇḍibhaṃ ca gṛdhraṃ caiva kamaṇḍalum | māṃsakhaṇḍaṃ śruvaṃ bījapūraṃ śrucaṃ tathaiva ca || 9-442 ||
paraśuṃ ca gadāṃ yaṣṭīṃ muṣṭiṃ kuṇapalālanam | dhārayantīṃ mahāraudhrīṃ jagatsaṃhārakāriṇīm || 9-443 ||
javāpuṣpābhanāgendrakṛtanūparayugmakām | pāṭaloraganirmāṇalasadaṅgadaśobhitām || 9-444 ||
dhūsarāhikṛtasphītakaṭisūtrāvalambinīm | supāṇḍurabhujaṅgendrakṛtatāṭaṅkaśobhitām || 9-445 ||
śvetadarvīkarānaddhajaṭāmukuṭaṅkaśobhitām | vaiyāghracarmavasanāṃ dvīpicarmottarīyakām || 9-446 ||
kiṅkiṇījālaśobhāḍhyāṃ vīraghaṇṭānivādinīm | nūpurāravalalitāṃ ghargharāśabdabhīṣaṇām || 9-447 ||
kaṭakāṅgadakeyūranarāsthikṛtaśobhanām | raktapadmamayīṃ mālāṃ pādapadmāvalambinīm || 9-448 ||
kāñcīkaṭṭārakapreṅkhatakaṭimadhyavirājitām | brahmasūtrojjvalatkaṇṭhayogapaṭṭottarīyakām || 9-449 ||
saumyograbhūṣaṇairyuktāṃ nāgāṣṭakavirājitām | ratnakuṇḍalakarṇaśrīpañcakālānalasthitām || 9-450 ||
padmoparisthitāṃ devīṃ nṛtyamānāṃ sadoditām | padmāsanasukhāsīnāṃ sarvadevādhidevatām || 9-451 ||
muktahu(/)kārajihvāgraṃ cālayantīṃ vicintayet | trikoṭiśakticāmuṇḍānavakoṭibhiranvitām || 9-452 ||
770> mahāyoginīkoṭonāmaṣṭādaśabhirūrjitām | carantīṃ ca hasantīṃ ca ḍākinī ṣaṣṭikoṭibhiḥ || 9-453 ||
bhairavyaśītikoṭībhiḥ parivāraiśca veṣṭitām | koṭikālānalajvālānyakkārodyatkalevarām || 9-454 ||
mahāpralayakoṭyarkavidyudarvudasannibhām | durnirīkṣāṃ mahābhīmāṃ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ || 9-455 ||
śatrupakṣakṣayakarīṃ detyadānavasūdinīm | nirvikārāṃ nirābhāsāṃ kūṭasthāṃ cidvilāsinīm || 9-456 ||
advitāṃ paramānandāṃ nityāṃ śuddhāṃ nirañjanām | sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhāro'nākhyā bhāsā padābhidām || 9-457 ||
vedāntavedyāṃ kaivalyarūpāṃ nirvāṇakāriṇīm | guṇātītāmātmarūpaprabodhātītagocarām || 9-458 ||
evaṃ dhyeyā mahākālī prodbhinnanavayuvanā | pañcavaktrasya madhyasthāṃ guhyakālī paraśvarī || 9-459 ||
atha puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
parvate vā nadī kū (*)(?) śūnyāgāre śivālaye | pīṭhe catuṣpathe kuryāt puraścaraṇamuttamam || 9-460 ||
niyamāstatra bhūyāṃsaḥ prakartavyāḥ prayatnataḥ | avaidhakaraṇāt siddhihāniḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 9-461 ||
trikālamācaret snānaṃ haviṣyaṃ bhakṣayenniśi | svamantraṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca gurorapi na darśayet || 9-462 ||
tyajedduṣṭapravādaṃ ca parīvādaṃ ca varjayet | tathā durjanasaṃsargān strīśūdrālāpanaṃ tathā || 9-463 ||
vastraṃ kuśāśanaṃ vyāghracarma cāpi nṛmuṇḍakam | āsanaṃ ca mahādevi praśastaścottarāmukhaḥ || 9-464 ||
śuddhasphaṭikarudrākṣanṛmuṇḍāsthivinirmitām | japamālāṃ śubhāṃ viddhi praśastāmuttarottarām || 9-465 ||
anenoktavidhānena lakṣasaṅkhyaṃ japenmanum | homaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryāt tarpaṇ cābhiṣecanam || 9-466 ||
tataḥ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācaret priye |
(mahātharvaṇasaṃhitāyām)
ṣoḍaśārṇāṃ mahāvidyā devānāmapi durlabhā || 9-467 ||
koṭijanmārjitaiḥ puṇyairmahadbhirbhaktinoditaiḥ | yena labdhā kuleśāni sadgurormukhapaṅkajāt || 9-468 ||
sa dhanyaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjyastribhuvanaukasām | nātaḥ paratarā vidyā triṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 9-469 ||
ataḥ sarvaprayatnena vidyeyaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarī | japtavyā sādhaśreṣṭhairdhyātavyā guyakālikā || 9-470 ||
yeneyaṃ sādhitā vidyā sa eva sā (*)(?) sadāśivaḥ |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
daśavaktrā tu yā proktā guhyakālī mayā tava || 9-471 ||
prakṛtiḥ sa parijñeyā kālīnāṃ jagadambikā | anyā vikṛtayaḥ proktāḥ kāryakāraṇabhedataḥ || 9-472 ||
tathā |
saiva jñeyā varārohe nirguṇabrahmarūpiṇī | jagat sarvaṃ vaśe tasyā vaśyā kasyāpi sā na ca || 9-473 ||
viśvaṃ sarvaṃ sṛjati sā ko'pi sṛjati tāṃ na hi | sā pālayati saṃsāraṃ tāṃ pālayati ko'pi na || 9-474 ||
tāṃ na saṃharate ko'pi sā sarvaṃ saharatyadaḥ | tadājñayā'nilo vāti sūryastapati tadbhayāt || 9-475 ||
tadbhītyā'gniḥ pacatyannaṃ mṛtyuścarati tadbhayāt |
(mhātharvaṇasaṃhitāyām)
śrīdevyuvāca |
parāt para pareśāna śaśāṅkakṛtaśekhara || 9-476 ||
yogādiyogin sarvajña sarvabhūtadayāpara | tvattaḥ śrutā mayā mantrāḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitāḥ || 9-477 ||
vidhivat pūjanaṃ cāpi nyāsāvaraṇakakramaiḥ | tārā ca cchinnamastā ca tathā tripurasundarī || 9-478 ||
bālā ca vagalā cāpi tripurā bhairavī tathā | kālī dakṣiṇakālī ca kubjikā vivareśvarī || 9-479 ||
aghorā rājamāta (**)(?) siddhilakṣmīstvarundhatī | aśvārūḍhā bhogavatī nityaklinā ca kukkuṭī || 9-480 ||
kaumārī cāpi vārāhī cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikā'pi ca | bhuvaneśī tathocchiṣṭacāṇḍālī caṇḍaghaṇṭikā || 9-481 ||
kālasaṃkarṣiṇī cāpi guhyakālī tathā'parā | etāścānyāśca vai devyaḥ samantrāḥ kathitāstvayāḥ || 9-482 ||
kintu kāmakalākālīṃ noktavānasi me prabho | tat kiṃ mayyapi gopyaṃ te prāyaśaḥ parameśvara || 9-483 ||
na hīdṛśaṃ trilokeṣu tata kiṃ cana vidyate |
yadakathyaṃ mayi bhavedapi prāṇādhikādhikam || 9-484 ||
tat kiṃ gopayasi prājña mayīdaṃ daivataṃ mahat | yadyasmi te dayāpātraṃ mānyā'smi snehabhājanam || 9-485 ||
anugrāhyā'smi kāntā'smi tademāṃ vada sāmpratam | devīṃ kāmakalākālīṃ samantradhyānapūrvikām || 9-486 ||
śrīmahākāla uvāca |
dhanyā'syanugṛhītā'si tayā devyaiva sarvathā | yat te buddhiḥ samutpannā tāṃ devīṃ prati bhāmini || 9-487 ||
vidhāya śapathaṃ devi kathayāmi tavāgrataḥ | na hīdṛśaṃ bhuktimuktisādhanaṃ bhuvi vidyate || 9-488 ||
yathārthamāttha devi tvaṃ gopyatvaṃ cāpi sarvathā | kintu bhaktiviśeṣāt te kathayāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 9-489 ||
rājyaṃ dadyāddhanaṃ dadyāt striyaṃ dadyācchirastathā | na tu kāmakalākālīṃ dadyāt kasyāpi na kvacit || 9-490 ||
indreṇopāsitā pūrvaṃ devarājyamabhīsitā | varuṇena kuvereṇ brahmaṇā ca (*) yā(?) tathā || 9-491 ||
rāmeṇa rāvaṇenāpi yamenāpi vivasvatā | candreṇa viṣṇunā cāpi tathā'nyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ || 9-492 ||
sahelaṃ vā salīlaṃ vā yasyāḥ smaraṇamātrataḥ | vidyālakṣmīḥ rājyalakṣmīḥ kīrtilakṣmīrvaśe sthitā || 9-493 ||
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam | rājyārthi labhate rājyaṃ kāntārthī kāminīṃ śubhām || 9-494 ||
yaśo'rthī kīrtimāpnoti muktyarthī muktimāpnuyāt | aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhyarthī siddhyaṣṭakamavāpnuyāt || 9-495 ||
tathā |
dvisaptatitamaṃ yāvat puruṣāḥ pūrvajāḥ sthitāḥ | teṣāṃ bhāgyodayaiḥ pūrṇairvidyeyaṃ yadi labhyate || 9-496 ||
tadā sarvasvadānena gṛhṇīyādavicārayan | kṛtakṛtyaṃ manyamāno guroḥ pādāvabhispṛśan || 9-497 ||
tathā |
ekataḥ prāṇadānaṃ syādekataścaitadarpaṇam | tulayā vidhṛtaṃ cet syādetaddānaṃ viśiṣyate || 9-498 ||
tathā |
koṭijanmārjitaiḥ puṇyairlabhyate vā na labhyate | śapathaṃ kuru deveśi prakāśyeyaṃ na kutra cit || 9-499 ||
satyaṃ satyaṃ trisatyaṃ me tato vakṣyāmi pārvati | no cet te'pi na vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ tatra saiva me || 9-500 ||
devyuvāca |
śape tvaccaraṇābjābhyāṃ himādriṃ śirasā śape | śape skandaikada (***)(?) yadyenāmanyato bruve || 9-501 ||
śape'tha vā tayā devyā yāṃ me tvaṃ kathayiṣyasi | prakāśayāmi yadyenāṃ saiva me vimukhī bhavet || 9-502 ||
mahākāla uvāca |
sādhu sādhu mahābhāge pratītirme'dhunā tvayi | akārṣīḥ śapathaṃ yasmāt tasmādvakṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 9-503 ||
samāhitā sāvadhānā bhava devi varānane | vidhehi cittamekāgraṃ baddhvā'ñjalipuṭaṃ priye || 9-504 ||
kālīṃ kāmakalāpūrvāṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahitā mama |
tathā |
yā guhyakālī saiveyaṃ kālī kāmakalā'bhidhā || 9-505 ||
mantrabhedāddhyānabhedādbhavet kāmakalātmikā | yathā tribhedā tārā syāt sundarī saptasaptatiḥ || 9-506 ||
dakṣiṇā pañcabhedā syāt tatheyaṃ guhyakālikā | saptadhā dhyānamantrābhyāṃ jāyate bhinnarūpiṇī || 9-507 ||
yathā pañcākṣaro mantro devī caikajaṭā smṛtā | dvāviṃ (-) satyakṣaro mantro devī dakṣiṇakālikā || 9-508 ||
tathā'nyeṣvapi deveṣu mukhyāsu bahuṣu priye | devi kāmakalākālī manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ || 9-509 ||
ṣoḍaśārṇā yathā mukhyā sarvaśrīcakramadhyagā | tatheyaṃ navakālīṣu sadā mukhyatamā smṛtā || 9-510 ||
trailokyākarṣaṇo nāma mantro'syāḥ parikīrtitaḥ | tasyoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena pārvati || 9-511 ||
śrutvā'vadhārayasvemāṃ sarvakalyāṇahetave |
mantroddhāramāha |
ādyavargādyavarṇo'kṣṇā vāmena pariśīlitaḥ || 9-512 ||
mūrdhni mūrdhnā yatṛtīyayugadhaḥ parikartitaḥ | vinduvāmākṣisaṃyukto vahniḥ khaparamastakaḥ || 9-513 ||
vāmaśrutyardhacandreṇa tṛtīyaḥ saparo bhavet | dakṣaskandhordhvadantābhyāṃ cākṣaro vindumastakaḥ || 9-514 ||
oṣṭhavargadvitīyo hapūrvādharoṣṭhavinduyuk | ṣaḍakṣarāṇi sambodhya yathānāmasthitikramāt || 9-515 ||
pratilomena coddhṛtya tāni bījāni pañca vai | bhūtabījādyamārabhya mārabījāntameva hi || 9-516 ||
vaiśvānaravadhūyukto mantro hyaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ | asyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa yāvantyaḥ santi siddhayaḥ || 9-517 ||
svayamāyānti purato japādīnāṃ ca kā kathā | sapta kāmakalākālyā manavaḥ santi gopitāḥ ||| 9-518 ||
teṣu sarveṣu mantreṣu mukhyo'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ | smaraṇādasya mantrasya mūrcchitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 9-519 ||
stambhitā vepamānāśca uttiṣṭhantyativihvalāḥ | nideśavartino bhūtvā vartante ceṭakā iva || 9-520 ||
kiṃ bahūktena deveśi satyapūrvaṃ bravīmyaham | sahasravadanenāpi lakṣakoṭyānanena vā || 9-521 ||
mahimā varṇituṃ śakyo nāsya varṣāyutairmayā | sāmānyato vijānīhi yadyadicchati sādhakaḥ || 9-522 ||
tat tat karoti sakalaṃ prajāpatirivāparaḥ | trailokyākarṣakā (**) nāma(?) mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 9-523 ||
ṛṣyādinyāsamāha |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi chandaścarṣiṃ ca bījakam | asya kāmakalākālīmantrasyāhamṛṣirmataḥ || 9-524 ||
chandaśca bṛhatīkhyātaṃ devī ceyaṃ prakīrtitā | ādyabījaṃ tu bījaṃ syāt krodhārṇaṃ śaktireva ca || 9-525 ||
viniyogo'sya sarvasya sarvadā sarvasiddhaye | ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pañcabījaistairnāmnā'pyekaṃ ca kārayet || 9-526 ||
nāmākṣarāṇi pratyekaṃ tatra deyāni pārvati |
atha dhyānam |
dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi kuru cittaikatānatām || 9-527 ||
udyaddhanāghanāśliṣyajjapākusumasannibhām | mattakokilanetrābhāṃ pakvajambūphalaprabhām || 9-528 ||
sudīrghaprabalālambivisrastaghanamūrdhajām | jvaladaṅgāravacchoṇanetratritayabhūṣitām || 9-529 ||
udyacchāradasaṃpūrṇacandrakokanadānanām | dīrghadaṃṣṭrāyugodañcadvikarālamukhāmbujām || 9-530 ||
vitastimātraniṣkrāntalalajjihvābhayānakām | vyāttānanatayā dṛśyadvātriṃśaddantamaṇḍalām || 9-531 ||
nirantaraṃ vepamānottamāṅgāṃ ghorarūpiṇīm | aṃsāsaktanṛmuṇḍāsṛkpivantīṃ vaktrakandarāt || 9-532 ||
sṛkvadvandvasravadraktasnāpitorojayugmakām | urojāmbhojasaṃsaktasampatadrudhiroccayām || 9-533 ||
saśvītkṛtiṃ dhayantīṃ tallelihānarasajñayā | lalāṭe ghananārāsṛgvihita (**)(?) citrakām || 9-534 ||
sadyaśchinnagaladraktanṛmuṇḍakṛtakuṇḍalām | śrutinaddhakacālambivataṃsalasadaṃsakām || 9-535 ||
sravadasraughayā śaśvanmānavyā muṇḍamālayā | ākaṇṭhagulphalambinyā'laṅkṛtāṃ keśabaddhayā || 9-536 ||
śvetāsthigulikāhāragraiveyakamahojjvalām | śavadīrghāṅgulipaṅktimaṇḍitoraḥsthalasthirām || 9-537 ||
kaṭhorapīvarottuṅgavakṣojayugalānvitām | mahāmārakatagrāvavediśroṇipariṣkṛtām || 9-538 ||
viśālajaghanābhogāmatikṣīṇakaṭisthalām | antranaddhārbhakaśirovalatkiṅkiṇīmaṇḍitām || 9-539 ||
supīnaṣoḍaśabhujāṃ mahāśaṅkhāñcadaṅgadām | śavānāṃ dhamanīpuñjairveṣṭitaiḥ kṛtakaṅkaṇām || 9-540 ||
grathitaiḥ śavakeśaiḥ sragdāmabhiḥ kaṭisūtriṇīm | śavapotakaraśreṇīgrathanaiḥ kṛtamekhalām || 9-541 ||
śobhamānāṅgulīmāṃsamedomajjāṅgulīyakaiḥ | asiṃ triśūlaṃ cakraṃ ca śaramaṅkuśameva ca || 9-542 ||
lalānaṃ ca tathā karttrīmakṣamālāṃ ca dakṣiṇe | pāśaṃ ca paraśuṃ nāgaṃ cāpaṃ mudgarameva ca || 9-543 ||
śivāpotaṃ kharparaṃ ca vasāsṛṅmedasā'nvitam | lambatkacaṃ nṛmuṇḍaṃ ca dhārayantīṃ svavāmataḥ || 9-544 ||
vilasannūpurāṃ devīṃ grathitaiḥ śavapañjaraiḥ | śmaśānaprajvaladghoracitāgnijvālamadhyagām || 9-545 ||
adhomukhamahā(?)dīrghaprasuptaśavapṛṣṭhagām | vamanmukhānalajvālājālavyāptadigantarām || 9-546 ||
protthāyaiva hi tiṣṭhantīṃ pratyālīḍhapadakramāt | vāmadakṣiṇasaṃsthābhyāṃ nadantībhyāṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 9-547 ||
śivābhyāṃ ghorarūpābhyāṃ vamantībhyāṃ mahānalam | vidyudaṅgāravarṇābhyāṃ veṣṭitāṃ parameśvarīm || 9-548 ||
sarvadaivānulagnābhyāṃ pa (-) syantībhyāṃ mahe (-) svarīm | atīva bhīṣamāṇābhyāṃ śivābhyāṃ śobhitāṃ muhuḥ || 9-549 ||
kapālasaṃsthaṃ mastiṣkaṃ dadatīṃ ca tayordvayoḥ | digambarāṃ muktakeśīmaṭṭahāsabhayānakām || 9-550 ||
saptadhā baddhanārāntrayogapaṭṭavibhūṣitām | saṃhārabhairaveṇaiva sārdhaṃ saṃbhogamicchatīm || 9-551 ||
atikāmāturāṃ kālīṃ hasantīṃ kharvavigrahām | koṭikālānalajvālānyakkārodyatkalevarām || 9-552 ||
mahāpralayakoṭyarkavidyudarvudasannibhām | kalpāntakāriṇīṃ kālīṃ mahābhairavarūpiṇīm || 9-553 ||
mahābhīmāṃ durnirīkṣāṃ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ | śatrupakṣakṣayakarīṃ daityadānavasūdanīm || 9-554 ||
cintayedīdṛśīṃ devīṃ kālīṃ kāmakalābhidhām |
atha puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pauraścaraṇikaṃ vidhim || 9-555 ||
ekasmin patravihite siddhistātkālikī bhavet | bhūmiśuddhirdravyaśuddhiḥ pūrvaiva kathitā mayā || 9-556 ||
yamāśca niyamā ye syuḥ puraścaraṇakarmaṇi | sarvāneva prayuñjīta satataṃ bhaktitatparaḥ || 9-557 ||
kṛtanityakriyaḥ prātaḥ kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ śuciḥ | narāsthi nikhanedbhūmāvastramantramudīrayan || 9-558 ||
tāraṃ krodho'nu hrī(/) pāśasmarabhūtān samuddharet | siddhimuccārya dehīti yugmaṃ vahnyaṅganāṃ vadet || 9-559 ||
bhūtabījaṃ phromiti | tathā |
taduparyeva cāstīrya svāsanaṃ suṣṭhu kalpitam | nṛmuṇḍamagrataḥ kṛtvā narāsthijapamālāyā || 9-560 ||
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī divā śuciḥ |
aśuciśca tathā rātrau lakṣamekaṃ tathaiva ca || 9-561 ||
daśāṃśaṃ homayenmantrī tarpayedabhiṣecayet | home santarpaṇe caiva pūjāvat kathito vidhiḥ || 9-562 ||
pūjāyāṃ vā prayoge vā home vā tarpaṇe'tha vā | guhyakālīvidhānena sarvaṃ kāryaṃ śucismite || 9-563 ||
atrānuktaṃ vidhānaṃ yat tatratyaṃ tat prakalpayet | tatrāpyanuktaṃ yat kiñcit tatrokto dakṣiṇāvidhiḥ || 9-564 ||
iti prathamamahāvidyāprakaraṇam |
atha dvitīyavidyāyāḥ (phetkāriṇītantre)
kailāśaśikharāsīnaṃ candrakhaṇḍavirājitam | vakṣaḥsthale samāsīnā pṛcchati sma nagātmajā || 9-565 ||
kathamīśāna sārvajña malabha(/)ste tapodhanāḥ | kāṃ vidyāṃ prāpya kavayo bhāratādi pracakrire || 9-566 ||
śrutvā nagātmajāvākyaṃ vihasya parameśvaraḥ | prāha priyāṃ pariṣvajya sādhu sādhviti pūjayan || 9-567 ||
śṛṇu sādhvi mahāvidyāmajñānendhanadāhinīm | yāmavāpya mahātmāno dharmakāmārthamuktiṣu || 9-568 ||
nāsādhyaṃ menire kiñcit kavayaḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ | vāde sadasi yā vācaḥ stambhinī prativādinām || 9-569 ||
vidyāhānikarī devi viduṣāṃ validānataḥ | hāsyāya yā sadasyānāmaśuddhamapi jalpayet || 9-570 ||
vādinaṃ cāpi rājānaṃ mantriṇaṃ vaśamānayet |
jalpayedvādinamityanvayaḥ |
mantrasya jñānamātreṇa japāt sarvajñatāṃ nayet || 9-571 ||
mantroddhāraṇamāha |
saparaṃ prathamaṃ datvā caturthasvarabhūṣitam | rephārūḍhaṃ sphuraddīptaminduvindusamanvitam || 9-572 ||
trakāraṃ ca tato dadyāccaturthenaiva bhūṣitam | dīrghokārasamāyuktaṃ hakāraṃ yojayet tataḥ || 9-573 ||
phaṭkāraṃ ca tato dadyāt saṃpūrṇaḥ siddhamantrataḥ |
(**)(?)rī hakāraḥ | śeṣaṃ spaṣṭam | (matsyasūkte)
atha vakṣye mahādevyā mantroddhāramanuttamam || 9-574 ||
yacca jñātvā naro bhāti vācaspatirivāparaḥ | māyābījaṃ samuddhṛtya tavargaprathamaṃ tathā || 9-575 ||
rativinduvahniyutaṃ dvitīyaṃ bījamuttamam | kūrcabījaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu phaṭkārastadanantaram || 9-576 ||
sampūrṇasiddhamantrastu raśmipañcakasaṃyutaḥ |
pañcaraśmiḥ praṇavaḥ | taduktaṃ (tārārṇave)
anantaraṃ samuddhṛtya māyottaramanuṃ tataḥ || 9-577 ||
papañcamaḥ samāyuktaṃ pañcaraśmiḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
anuttaramakāraḥ | māyottaramukāraḥ | papañcamo makāraḥ | (tattvabodhe)
tāraṃ lajjāṃ ntrakāmeśīṃ hu(/) phaḍityugratārikā || 9-578 ||
māyā ttrī(/) hūmathāstrāntamityekajaṭayā'rcayet | astrahīnamidaṃ nīlasarasvatyā vinirdiśet || 9-579 ||
kāmeśī īkāraḥ |
tryakṣaro'sau mahāmantraḥ phaṭkārāntau hṛdi sthitaḥ | pañcaraśmisamāyukto'thājñānendhanadāhakaḥ || 9-580 ||
(matsyasūkte)
lajjābījaṃ badhūbījaṃ kūrcabījaṃ tathā hi phaṭ | evaṃ pañcākṣarī vidyā pañcabhūtaprakāśinī || 9-581 ||
tathā |
tārāstrarahitā tryarṇā mahānīlasarasvatī | kulluketi samākhyātā triṣu lokeṣu gopitā || 9-582 ||
(tārārṇave)
vaśiṣṭhārādhitā cogrā na śīghraphaladā yataḥ | atastenaiva muninā śāpo dattaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 9-583 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti vidyeyaṃ phaladātrī na kasya cit | śaktibījaṃ trapāntasthabījopari niyojitam || 9-584 ||
tataḥ pabhṛti vidyeyaṃ vadhūriva yaśasvinī | phalinī sarvavidyānāṃ jayinī jayakāṅkṣiṇām || 9-585 ||
viṣakṣayakarī vidyā amṛtatvapradāyinī | mantrasya jñānamātreṇa vijayī bhuvi jāyate || 9-586 ||
mūko bhavati vāgīśo gīṣpatirjāyate naraḥ |
śaktibījamiti | śaktibījaṃ sakāraḥ | trapāntasthabījaṃ troṅkāraḥ | tena strīmiti vadhūbījaṃ bhavati | śāpastu kṛṣṇāvatāraparyantameva |
jāte kṛṣṇāvatāre tu punaḥ śāpāt pramucyate || 9-587 ||
iti tantrāntaravacanāt | mantrārthamāha (sādhanasamuccaye)
praṇavādbrahmarūpā sā so'haṃ tattvasvarūpiṇī | vyomnā prakāśamānatvaṃ grasamānatvamagninā || 9-588 ||
tayorvisarga īkāro vindunā tāntrikī matā | takāraḥ sarvapāpaghno rephastattvaprakāśakaḥ || 9-589 ||
vindumālī mahābījaṃ śabdabrahmaprakāśakam | kūrcaṃ prabodharūpaṃ syādastraṃ jāḍyavināśakam || 9-590 ||
evaṃ yo vetti śuddhātmā sa tu sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ |
(matsyasūkte)
śrībījādyā yadā vidyā tadā śrīḥ sarvato mukhī || 9-591 ||
eṣaiva hi mahāvidyā māyādyā sakaleṣṭadā | vāgbhavādyā mahāvākyasvarūpā sarvavāṅmayī || 9-592 ||
tathā |
guṭikāsiddhivetālapātālavaṭayakṣiṇī | parapurapraveśaśca ājñāsiddhiḥ prajāyate || 9-593 ||
jihvāyāṃ cintanādeva trikālajño bhaveddhruvam | yastu vidyāmabhedena cintayet sādhakottamaḥ || 9-594 ||
jīvanmukto vimuktaśca ante so'pi bhaveddhruvam |
(brahmasaṃhitāyāṃ phetkāriṇyāṃ ) ca |
kṣipraprasādājjagatāṃ sadā nīlasarasvatī || 9-595 ||
viśeṣataḥ kaliyuge matprasādādbhaviṣyati | siddhamantro yadā mantrī bāliśasyāpi mūrdhani || 9-596 ||
karaṃ datvā diśatyāśu so'pi ślokān paṭhet punaḥ |
diśati ślokaṃ kurvityājñāpayati | tathā |
mantrasya jñānamātreṇa anubhāvadvayaṃ bhavet || 9-597 ||
tātkālikī ca kavitā parairanavibhāvyatā |
atha ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ (merutantre)
munirakṣobhyasaṃjño'syā bṛhatīchanda īritam || 9-598 ||
tārādevī hrī(/) ca bījaṃ hū(/) śaktiścāsya kīrtitā ||
(mantracūḍāmaṇau)
akṣobhya ṛṣiretasyā bṛhatīchanda īritam || 9-599 ||
nīlasarasvatī devī triṣu lokeṣu gopitā | hū(/) bījamastraṃ śaktiḥ syāccaturvargaphalapradā || 9-600 ||
dāmodaramiśrakṛtasaṃgrahe |
akṣobhya ṛṣiretasyā bṛhatīcchanda īritam | nīlasarasvatī devī triṣu lokeṣu gopitā || 9-601 ||
hū(/) bījamantraḥ śaktiḥ syānmāyā strī(/) kīlakaṃ smṛtam | viniyogo bhaveddevi caturvargaphalāptaye || 9-602 ||
ugratārā devateti (mantracūḍāmaṇau) atha karāṅganyāsau | tatrādau ugratārāyāḥ (tārākalpe)
ṣaḍdīrghamāyābījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ |
nīlasarasvatyāstu (siddhasārasvate)
akhilavāgrūpiṇīṃ procya hṛdāya namo vadet || 9-603 ||
akhaṇḍavāgrūpiṇīṃ ca śirase vahnivallabhā | brahmavāgrūpiṇīmuktvā śikhāyai vaṣaḍityayi || 9-604 ||
viṣṇuvāgrūpiṇīmuktvā kavacāya humuccaret | rudravāgrūpiṇīṃ netratrayāya vauṣaḍityapi || 9-605 ||
sarvavāgrūpiṇīmuktvā astrāya phaḍiti smaret | ṣaḍdīrghamāyayā bījaṃ bījānte tāni yojayet || 9-606 ||
ekajaṭāyāḥ (tantracūḍāmaṇau)
bījānte ekajaṭāyai hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam | tāriṇyai śirase tadvadvajrodake śikhāṃ tathā || 9-607 ||
ugrajaṭe ca kavacaṃ mahāparisare tathā | piṅgograikajaṭe tadvannetrāstre parikīrtite || 9-608 ||
nyāso'yamugratāraikajaṭayorviruddha iti sāmpradāyikaḥ | atha dhyānam (gandharvatantre)
śmaśānaṃ tatra saṃcintya tatra kalpadrumaṃ smaret | tanmūle maṇipīṭhaṃ ca nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam || 9-609 ||
śivābhirbahumāṃsāsthimodamānābhirantataḥ | caturdikṣu śavāmuṇḍāścitāṅgārāsthibhūṣitāḥ || 9-610 ||
tanmadhye bhāvayeddevīṃ yathoktadhyānayogataḥ |
(nīlatantre)
pratyālīḍhapadāṃ ghorāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām || 9-611 ||
kharvāṃ lambodarīṃ bhīmāṃ vyāghracarmavṛtāṃ kaṭau | navayauvanasaṃpannāṃ pañcamudrāvibhūṣitām || 9-612 ||
caturbhujāṃ lalajjihvāṃ mahābhīmāṃ varapradām | khaḍgakarttrīdharāṃ savye vāme muṇḍotpalānvitām || 9-613 ||
piṅgograikajaṭāṃ dhyāyenmaulāvakṣobhyabhūṣitām | bālārkamaṇḍalākāralocanatrayabhūṣitām || 9-614 ||
prajvalatpitṛbhūmadhyagatāṃ daṃṣṭrākarālinīm | sāveśasmeravadanāmasthyālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 9-615 ||
viśvavyāpakatoyāntaḥ śvetapadmoparisthitām |
(śyāmārahasyādau)
khaḍgakarttrīsamāyuktasavyetarabhujadvayām || 9-616 ||
kapālotpalasaṃyuktasavyapāṇiyugānvitām (-) iti pāṭhaḥ |
(tantrāntare)
khaḍgakarttrīdharāṃ devīṃ kapālotpaladhāriṇīm (-) iti pāṭhaḥ || 9-617 ||
(mantracūḍāmaṇau)
tasyoparigṛhe devīṃ kharvāṃ nīlamaṇiprabhām | lambodarīṃ vyāghracarmasamāvṛtanitambinīm ||618 ||
pīnonnatapayobhārāṃ raktavarttulalocanām | lalajjihvāṃ mahābhīmāṃ daṃṣṭrākoṭisamujjvalām || 9-619 ||
nīlotpalalasanmālāṃ baddhajūṭāṃ bhayaṅkarīm | śvetāsthipaṭṭikāyuktakapālapañcaśobhitām || 9-620 ||
lalāṭe raktanāgena kṛtakarṇāvataṃsakām | atiśubhramahānāgakṛtahāramahojjvalām || 9-621 ||
dūrvādalaśyāmanāgakṛtayajñopavītinīm | caturbhujāṃ raktamāṃsakhaṇḍamaṇḍitamuṣṭinā || 9-622 ||
jaṭājūṭākṣasūtreṇa śobhitāṃ tīkṣṇadhārayā | khaḍgena dakṣiṇasyordhve śobhitāṃ vīranādinīm ||
tadadhaḥsthādvījavṛntakarttrikālaṅkṛtāṃ parām | vāmordhve raktanālena digambaramanoharām || 9-623 ||
dadhatīṃ nīlapadmaṃ ca tadadhaḥsthāt kapālakam | jagatāṃ jāḍyasaṃyuktaṃ dadhatīṃ kundasannibham || 9-624 ||
dhūmrābhanāgasaṃdohakṛtakeyūrasatvarām | suvarṇavarṇanāgena kaṅkaṇojjvalapāṇikām || 9-625 ||
śubhravarṇamahādevakṛtasadvimalāsanam | niryantraṇabhiyā tadvat saṃkucatprapadātmikām || 9-626 ||
śavapādadvayārūḍhavāmapādāṃ mahonmukhīm | kundābhanāgasaṃśobhikaṭisūtrāṃ trilocanām || 9-627 ||
asṛgraktena nāgena kṛtanūpurapallavām |
sadyaśchinnagalatadraktamuṇḍai raktavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||628 ||
anyonyakeśagrathitaiḥ pādapadmavilambitaiḥ | pañcāśadbhirmahāmālāśobhitāṃ parameśvarīm ||629 ||
jvalaccitāmadhyasaṃsthāṃ dvīpicarmottarāṃśukām | akṣobhyanāgasambaddhajaṭājūṭāṃ varapradām ||630 ||
evambhūtāṃ mahādevīmātmānaṃ yāgavastu ca | vijñāpayenmahādevapaṇḍitohe mahākaviḥ ||631 ||
(tāropaniṣadi)
viruddhavākyārthaśarīramaṇḍale navāmbudābhāṃ gurumunnatodarīm | atīva kharvāṃ navayauvanasthā (-) madhaḥsthaśārdūlakakṛttimūrdhajām || 9-632 ||
anaikyamāhatya śavoparisthitāṃ śavārdhamālīḍhaparītamadhyamām | viśīrṇavarṇāṃ nṛśiraḥsrajodbhavāṃ trayīvivarttāruṇalocanatrayām || 9-633 ||
abhedapiṅgaikajaṭāvirājitāṃ vibhūṣaṇācchinnasitāsthibhīṣaṇām | mahāṣṭasiddhiprakarāhibhūṣaṇā (-) maṭṭādṛhāsairjagatāmabhītidām || 9-634 ||
jaṭāsvanantaḥ śravasośca takṣako mahāhipadmo hṛdi hārabhūṣaṇām | tathaiva karkoṭakṛtopavītikāṃ sumekhalāyāmatha devavāsukiḥ || 9-635 ||
saśaṅkhapālaḥ kilakaṅkaṇo mataḥ padeṣu padmaḥ kilanūpuraśriyam | bhujeṣu nāgaḥ kuliko'ṅgado mato bhujo'rdhamālāmahatā sthitiḥ sthitā || 9-636 ||
sitaśca rakto dhavalaśca mecaka (-) stathaiva nāgo'tha sitaśca pāṇḍaraḥ | bhujaṅgamānāmiha varṇajātayo bhavanti sarve munibhirjvalaccitām || 9-637 ||
kapālakarttrīgrathitogramūrddhajāṃ sanālamindīvarakāntimālām | vikoṣakhaḍgaṃ satataṃ ca dakṣiṇe svapauruṣotthairdadhatīṃ bhujaiḥ sadā || 9-638 ||
padārthadaṃṣṭrādvayapañcamudrayā virājamānāmasitotpalasrajam | vicintayet tāṃ ca kavitvakāriṇ ī(-) manyāgatārthaṃ prajapecca tāriṇīm || 9-639 ||
(phetkāriṇītantre'pi)
pratyālīḍhapadārpitāṅghriśavahṛdghorāṭṭahāsā varā kha (-) ngendīvarakarttṛkharparabhujā hū(/)kārabījodbhavā | kharvā nīlaviśālapiṅgalajaṭājūṭogranāgairvṛtā jāḍyaṃ nyasya kapālake trijagatāṃ hantyugratārā svayam || 9-640 ||
pratyālīḍhalakṣaṇaṃ tu (saṃgītaratnākare)
vāmo yatra niṣaṇṇorurantare pūrvamānataḥ | dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ cāgre pañcatālaprasāritam || 9-641 ||
astrau dvāvapi tadvindyādālīḍhaṃ tu sadaivatam | ālāḍhāṅgaviparyāsāt pratyālīḍhamudāhṛtam || 9-642 ||
tālaṃ vitastiḥ | asrau cakrau | maulāvakṣobhyabhūṣitāmiti | atrākṣobhyo nāgarūpaḥ | akṣobhyo devīmūrdhanyastrīmūrtirnāgarūpadhṛgiti (bhāvacūḍāmaṇi-) vacanāt | atha puraścaraṇavidhiḥ | tatrādau mantradhyānamuktaṃ (sādhanasamuccaye)
mūlacakre ca hṛllekhāṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhām | svādhiṣṭhāne pītavarṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca vibhāvayet || 9-643 ||
nābhau jīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ kūrcabījaṃ mahāprabham | astrabījaṃ hṛdi dhyāyet kālāgnisadṛśaprabham || 9-644 ||
mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ vidyāṃ vibhāvayet | sūryakoṭipratīkāśāṃ yogināṃ dṛṣṭigocarām || 9-645 ||
taduktaṃ (tārātanre)
svecchācāraparo mantrī puraścaraṇasiddhaye | rahasyamālāmādāya lakṣamekaṃ japet sadā ||
(surendrasaṃhitāyām)
lakṣamātraṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśamasitotpalaiḥ | ājyāktairjuhuyānmantrī taddaśāṃśena tarpayet || 9-646 ||
kālāgurudravopetairvimalairgandhavāribhiḥ | tarpayecca parāṃ devīṃ tatprakāramihocyate || 9-647 ||
jale cāvāhya vidhivat pādyādyairupacārakaiḥ | saṃtarpya vidhivaddevīṃ parivārān sakṛt sakṛt || 9-648 ||
devībuddhyā svamānmānaṃ saṃpūjya sādhakottamaḥ | tāriṇīṃ siñcayāmīti jalaṃ mūrdhni viniḥkṣipet || 9-649 ||
kumbhākhyamudrayā devi namo'ntenābhiṣecanam |
(vīracūḍāmaṇau)
caturlakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt sudhīḥ || 9-650 ||
padmaistrimadhuropetairvākpatirjāyate naraḥ |
(tārārṇave)
evaṃ dhyātvā haviṣyāśī japellakṣacatuṣṭayam || 9-651 ||
rahasyamālāmādāya japedvā lakṣameva ca |
(merutantre)
rataṃ kurvannadan bhakṣyamanekaṃ dadhi madhvapi || 9-652 ||
madhu māṃsaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ japellakṣacatuṣṭayam | daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādraktapadmaiḥ kṣīrājyalolitaiḥ || 9-653 ||
