śavamuṇḍaṃ pūrayitvā japasthāne japaṃ caret | nārīṃ paśyan spṛśan gacchan mahāniśi valiṃ haret || 9-654 ||
na kāryaḥ subhruvāṃ dveṣo yatnataḥ paripūjayet | jape na kālaniyamo na sthitau sarvadā japet || 9-655 ||
śmaśāne śūnyasadane devāgāre'tha nirjane | parvate vanamadhye vā śavamāruhya mantravit || 9-656 ||
samare śatrunihataṃ yadvā ṣaṇmāsikaṃ śiśum | vidyāṃ saṃsādhayecchīghraṃ sādhitaivaṃ prasidhyati || 9-657 ||
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogān karttumarhati |
athaitadvidyābhedāstatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi daityānāṃ varasiddhaye || 9-658 ||
brahmaṇopāsitāṃ tārāṃ valyādibhirūpāsitam | oṃ trī(/) hrī(/) hū(/) samucārya hrī(/) hu(/) phaḍnagavarṇakaḥ || 9-659 ||
munirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chandastārā ca devatā | nyāsā(/)stu pūrvavat kuryāddhyānamasyā nirūpyate || 9-660 ||
śvetāmbarāṃ candrakāntiṃ candrardhakṛtaśekharām | karttarīṃ ca kapālaṃ ca karābhyāṃ dadhatīṃ bhajet || 9-661 ||
nānālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ trīkṣaṇāṃ padmasaṃsthitām | japapūjādikaṃ sarvamasyāḥ pūrvavadācaret || 9-662 ||
madhuyukparamānnena homādvidyānidhirbhavet | raktāṃ vaśye svarṇavarṇāṃ stambhane māraṇe'sitām || 9-663 ||
uccāṭane dhūmravarṇāṃ śāntau śvetāṃ smaredimām | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tārakasya varāya tu || 9-664 ||
brahmaṇopāsitāṃ tārāṃ dvādaśārṇāṃ sudurlabhām | vācaṃ lajjāṃ ramāṃ kāmaṃ hasarā ausamanvitāḥ || 9-665 ||
visargāḍhyāḥ pañcamaṃ tu kūṭametadudīritam | hu(/) ugratāre hu(/) phaṭ mantraḥ prokto japādikam || 9-666 ||
sarvaṃ pūrvavadevāsya kalau pratyayakāriṇī | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā samupāsitām || 9-667 ||
hiraṇyakasipordātuṃ varaṃ saptārṇasaṃmitām | praṇavaṃ kavacaṃ māyāṃ klī(/) prāk kūṭaṃ ca pañcamaṃ || 9-668 ||
hu(/) phaḍantaḥ sarvamasyā nyāsādyaṃ pūrvavadbhavet | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi hariṇā yā hyupāsitā || 9-669 ||
bauddhamārgapracārārthaṃ siddhidā dvādaśākṣarī | upāsitā brahmaṇā yā tasyāḥ kūṭe tu pañcame || 9-670 ||
sauruktvā sādhitā vidyā dvādaśārṇā'tibuddhidā | yatprabhāvāddivo dāsaḥ kāśyā uccāṭitaḥ purā || 9-671 ||
tasyāstu pūrvavajjñeyaṃ nyāsadhyānajapādikam | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi saptārṇāṃ rāmasevitām || 9-672 ||
lakṣmīprabhṛti nāśārthaṃ tena mattaḥ sadā halī | brahmopāsitasaptārṇā madhye kūṭaṃ tu pañcamam || 9-673 ||
tat tyaktvā sau(/)statra coktvā balarāmeṇa sevitā | śatrukṣayakarī ceyaṃ tathā vāksiddhikāriṇī || 9-674 ||
dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvat prayogādikameva ca | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi nārāyaṇasusevitā || 9-675 ||
pañcārṇā yatprabhāveṇa daityānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam | trī(/) hu(/) phaṭ klī(/) vāgbhavaṃ ca pañcārṇā sarvasiddhidā || 9-676 ||
asāṃ trayāṇāṃ tu munirviṣṇuḥ prāgvajjapādikam | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mayā yā samupāsitā || 9-677 ||
dattā ca raviṇā'dityai sā vidyā tu ṣaḍakṣarī | oṃ hrī(/) hū(/) hrī(/) hu(/) phaḍiti muniḥ so'haṃ ca pūrvavat || 9-678 ||
jñeyaṃ nyāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ prayogādi ca pūrvavat | athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi cāsyāḥ pañcākṣaraṃ manum || 9-679 ||
jalandharavadhārthaṃ tu mayā siddhaṃ kṛtaṃ surāḥ | strī(/) hu(/) māyāṃ hu(/) phaḍiti manuḥ pañcākṣaro mataḥ || 9-680 ||
tantrāntare'pi |
vadhūbījaṃ ca kavacaṃ māyāṃ kūrcaṃ tathā'strakam | sārdhaṃpañcākṣaro mantro dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 9-681 ||
(merutantre)
mayā pañcamukhairjapto dakṣamārgeṇa bho surāḥ | devāṃśeṣu ca vipreṣu tathā dharmapareṣu ca || 9-682 ||
yamānāṃ niyamānāṃ ca tantrasthā nānyadevatāḥ | vāmamārgārādhitāstu kāryaṃ sādhayituṃ kṣamāḥ || 9-683 ||
dakṣiṇārādhitā devā raṇasāhāyyakārakāḥ | tejonidhīn ripūn hatvā nayanti brahmaśāśvatam || 9-684 ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ kṣayārthaṃ tu mayā rāmāya cārpitā | pañcāmṛtaṃ surāsthāne māṃsasthāne ca sūraṇam || 9-685 ||
matsyasthāne khaṇḍo bodhyo dharmapatnyāṃ rataṃ ratam | anyat pūrvavadeva syādguhyametat prakāśitam || 9-686 ||
lubdhastārāṃ na seveta lokadvayaparikṣayāt | asyāḥ pūjādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣo'tra nirūpitaḥ || 9-687 ||
tārāyāḥ sadguroḥ siddhiḥ strīrate bhrāntatā bhavet | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mahātārāmanuṃ surāḥ || 9-688 ||
siddhirmārgadvayenāpi varṇāvarṇādhikārataḥ | trī(/) hrī(/) hrā(/) hu(/) namastārāyai mahāpadamuccaret || 9-689 ||
tārāyai sakaletyuktvā usvarān tāraya dvayam | tāradvayaṃ vahnijāyā dvātriṃśārṇo manurmataḥ || 9-690 ||
nyāsapūjājapādyaṃ tu prāgvat sarvaṃ samācaret |
(tāriṇītantre)
īśvara uvaca |
śrūyatāṃ śailatanaye jāḍyanāśakari pūrā || 9-691 ||
caturvargaphalā vidyā mantrasiddhipradāyikā | vargādyaṃ vahnisaṃyuktaṃ vāmākṣiparibhūṣitam || 9-692 ||
nādavindusamāyuktaṃ vasusiddhipradāyakam | punaścaturmukhaṃ devi rakāreṇa vibhūṣitam || 9-693 ||
svareṇaiva caturthena candrakhaṇḍena ca priye | lāñchitaṃ vai mahābījaṃ caturvargaphalapradam || 9-694 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇe padaṃ coktvā tato devīpadaṃ smṛtam | hrī(/)kāraṃ ca tato dadyāt svapūrvamuddharet tataḥ || 9-695 ||
ikāreṇa ca repheṇa makāreṇa ca bhūṣitam | tato vāgbhavamuccārya mantramenaṃ samuddharet || 9-696 ||
navākṣaro manurdevi tāriṇyāḥ samudīritaḥ | iyameva mahāvidyā svarge martye sudurlabhā || 9-697 ||
aṣṭasiddhipradā devi caturvargaphalapradā |
atha ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ
śaktirasya ṛṣiḥ prokto bṛhatīchanda īritam || 9-698 ||
tāriṇī devatā proktā hrī(/)kāraṃ bījamucyate | vāgbhavaṃ śaktirityuktamiti ṛṣyādikaṃ caret || 9-699 ||
atha dhyānam |
kṛṣṇāṃ lambodarīṃ bhīmāṃ nāgakuṇḍalaśobhitām | raktamukhīṃ lalajjihvāṃ raktāmbaradharāṃ kaṭau || 9-700 ||
pīnonnatastanīmugrāṃ mahānāgena veṣṭitām | śavasyopari deveśi tasyopari kapālake || 9-701 ||
nāsāgradhyānaniratāṃ mahāghorāṃ varapradām | caturbhujāṃ dīrghakeśīṃ dakṣiṇasyordhvabāhunā || 9-702 ||
bibhratīṃ nalinīmekāṃ vāmordhve pānapātrakam | varābhayadharāṃ devīmadhastāddakṣavāmayoḥ || 9-703 ||
pivantīṃ raudhirīṃ dhārāṃ pānapātre sadāśive | sarvasiddhipradāṃ devīṃ nityāṃ girinivāsinīm || 9-704 ||
locanatrayasaṃyuktāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm | dīrghanāsāṃ dīrghajaṅghāṃ dīrghāṅgīṃ dīrghajihvikām || 9-705 ||
candrasūryāgnibhedena trilocanasamanvitām | śatrunāśakarīṃ devīṃ mahābhīmāṃ varapradām || 9-706 ||
vyāghracarmaśirobaddhāṃ jagattrayavibhāvitām | sādhakānāṃ sukhaṃ karttrī sarvalokabhayaṅkarīm || 9-707 ||
evambhūtāṃ mahādevīṃ tāriṇīṃ praṇamāmyaham |
atha puraścaraṇam |
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā ca ebhirdravyairmaheśvari || 9-708 ||
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ |
athākṣobhyamantraḥ | (brahmasaṃhitāyām)
akṣobhyasya manuṃ tyaktvā devīṃ tārāṃ japedyadi || 9-709 ||
siddhihānirbhavet tasya rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | akṣobhyasya manuṃ vipra kavacaṃ sāramuttamam || 9-710 ||
atiguhyaṃ mahādhyānaṃ sarvadhyāneṣu cottamam | agre manuṃ pravakṣyāmi dhyānaṃ caiva tataḥ param || 9-711 ||
kavacaṃ ca tataḥ paścāt kathayāmi krameṇa tu | anuttaraṃ samuddhṛtya papañcamavibhūṣitam || 9-712 ||
akṣobhyeti(?) ca svāheti ramādyantaṃ mahāmanuḥ | svayam (-) ṛṣiśca saṃprokto virāṭchanda udīritam || 9-713 ||
akṣobhyo devatā proktastrimūrttirnāgarūpadhṛk | viniyogastu niyataṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye || 9-714 ||
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasaubhāgyadāyakam | sahasrādityasaṃkāśaṃ nāgarūpadharaṃ śubham || 9-715 ||
vidyutkoṭisamaṃ vaktraṃ vahnibhāsvaralocanam | sārdhatrivalayopetaṃ jaṭākoṭyagrasaṃsthitām || 9-716 ||
mahālāvaṇyasaṃyuktaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam | sūryavidyutsamābhāsaṃ mahāmaṇiśikhopari || 9-717 ||
etadrūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ devairapi supūjitam |
tantrāntare |
akṣobhyaṃ pūjayitvā'dau tārāṃ saṃpūjayet sudhīḥ || 9-718 ||
tathā |
puraścaryādikaṃ cāsya tāriṇīvat samācaret |
iti tārāprakaraṇam |
atha śrīvidyā |
tatrādau kāmarājavidyā (candrapīṭhe)
smaro bhagaṃ vindumatī laparā vāgbhavaṃ matam || 9-719 ||
śivo jīvaḥ smaraḥ śambhurlaparā kāmakūṭakam | bhṛguḥ kāmaḥ kṣamā māyā kāmarājābhidhā matā || 9-720 ||
kūṭatrayasya vāgbhavādisaṃjñā ca tatraivoktā |
prathamaṃ vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ kāmakūṭakam | tṛtīyaṃ śaktikūṭaṃ syāt kūṭatrayatanurmanuḥ || 9-721 ||
atha lopāmudrākhyā vidyā (jñānārṇave)
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi lopāmudrābhidhāṃ parām | kāmarājākhyavidyāyāḥ śaktiṃ tuyā catu (**)m || 9-722 ||
hitvā mukhe śivendvāḍhyā lopāmudrā prakāśitā |
kāmarājākhyavidyāyā vāgbhave ekāramīkāraṃ ca vihāyādau hakārasakārau dadyādityarthaḥ | iyamagastyopāsitā |
atha ṣoḍaśī (yoginītantre)
śrībījamāyā smarayoniśakt i(-) stāraṃ ca māyā kamalā'tha vidyā || 9-723 ||
śaktyādibījaiśca vilomatoktyā śrīṣoḍaśīyaṃ ca śivopadiṣṭā |
tantrāntare |
śrībījaṃ śaktibījaṃ ca kāmabījaṃ ca vāgbhavam || 9-724 ||
bālāntasaṃsthitaṃ bījaṃ praṇavaṃ ca tataḥ param | śaktibījaṃ ramāṃ caiva vidyāṃ ca parameśvari || 9-725 ||
lopāṃ vā kāmarājaṃ vā trikūṭāmatha vā parām | vinyasya praṇavādyāni bījāni pañca sundari || 9-726 ||
viparītakrameṇaiva vinyaset ṣoḍaśīṃ parām |
(māyātantre'pi)
lakṣmīḥ parā madanayoniyutā ca śakt i(-) stāraḥ parā ca kamalā'pyatha mūlavidyā || 9-727 ||
śaktyādibhiśca viparītatayā pradiṣṭā śrīmantrarāja uditaḥ paradevatāyāḥ ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
ataḥ paratarā vidyā na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati || 9-728 ||
kenāpi naiva śapteyaṃ na ca kenāpi kīlitā |
(jñānārṇave)
vaktrakoṭisahasraistu jihvākoṭiśatairapi || 9-729 ||
varṇituṃ naiva śakyeyaṃ śrīvidyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī | brahmavidyā svarūpā hi bhuktimuktiphalapradā || 9-730 ||
ekoccāreṇa deveśi vājapeyasya koṭayaḥ | aśvamedhasahasrāṇi prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā || 9-731 ||
kāśyāditīrthayātrāḥ syuḥ sārdhakoṭitrayānvitāḥ | tulāṃ nāyānti deveśi nātra karyā vicāraṇā || 9-732 ||
ekoccāreṇa girije kiṃ punarbrahmakevalam | ṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā na prakāśyā kadā cana || 9-733 ||
gopitavyā tvayā bhadre svayoniriva pārvati | api priyatame deyaṃ sutadāradhanādikam || 9-734 ||
rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī | saptalakṣaṃ mahāvidyāstantrādau kathitāḥ priye || 9-735 ||
sārāt sāratarā ceyaṃ mahāvidyā sugopitā |
atha ṛṣyādinyāsastatraiva |
ṛṣirasya maheśāni dakṣiṇāmūrtiravyayaḥ || 9-736 ||
paṅktiśchandaḥ samākhyātaṃ devī tripurasundarī | vāgbhavaṃ bījamityuktaṃ śaktistu śaktikūṭakam || 9-737 ||
kāmarājaḥ kīlakaṃ syādṛṣyādinyāsa īritaḥ |
vāgbhavādīnāṃ bījādirūpatve heturukto (dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām)
niḥsaranti mahāmantrā mahāgnerviṣphuliṅgavat || 9-738 ||
tathaiva mātṛkā varṇā niḥsṛtā vāgbhavā priye | ata evāsya devasya vāgbhavaṃ bījamucyate || 9-739 ||
yoṣit puruṣarūpeṇa sphurantī viśvamātṛkā | mahāmohena deveśi kīlayantī jagattrayam || 9-740 ||
atastatkīlakaṃ devi tena saubhāgyagarbhitā | pālayantī jagat sarvaṃ teneyaṃ śaktirucyate || 9-741 ||
atha karāṅganyāsastantrāntare |
a(/) ā(/) sau(/) riti proktaṃ bījaṃ trividhamuttamam | etadbījaṃ dvirāvṛtya madhyamādyaṅgulīṣu ca || 9-742 ||
śuddhiṃ karasya kurvīta talayoḥ pṛṣṭhayorapi | caturthī natisaṃyuktā nāmamantraiḥ pṛthak prṭhak || 9-743 ||
madhyamā'nāmikā caiva kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhatarjanī |
krameṇa nāma cākhyātamaṅgulīnāṃ maheśvari || 9-744 ||
(navaratneśvare)
sarvajñatā nityasutṛptatā ca anādibodhaśca svatantratā ca | aluptaśaktitvamanantatā ca ṣaḍāhuraṅgāni śive śivādyāḥ || 9-745 ||
atra bahuvidhanyāsajālaṃ (jñānārṇavādau) draṣṭavyam | atha dhyānam |
bālārkamaṇḍalābhāsāṃ caturbāhuṃ trilocanām | pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇadhārayantīṃ śivāṃ śraye || 9-746 ||
(siddhāntasaṃgrahe mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ) ca |
udyaccandrodayakṣubdharaktapīyūṣavāridheḥ | madhye hemamayī bhūmī ratnamāṇikyamaṇḍitā || 9-747 ||
tanmadhyenandanodyānaṃ madanonmādanaṃ mahat | nityābhyuditapūrṇendujyotsnājālavirājitam || 9-748 ||
sadā saha vasantena kāmadevena rakṣitam | kadambacūtapunnāganāgakeśaracampakaiḥ || 9-749 ||
vakulaiḥ pārijātaiśca sarvarttukusumojjvalaiḥ | jhaṅkāramukharairbhṛṅgaiḥ kūjadbhiḥ kokilaiḥ śukaiḥ || 9-750 ||
nānāvarṇairathānyaiśca dvijasaṅghairniṣevitam | śikhikāraṇḍahaṃsādyairnānāpakṣibhirāvṛtam || 9-751 ||
nānāpuṣpalatākīrṇaiḥ śobhitaṃ vṛkṣakhaṇḍakaiḥ | paryantadīrghikotphallakamalotpalasambhavaiḥ || 9-752 ||
rajobhirdhūsaraiḥ samyak sevitaṃ malayānilaiḥ | dhyātvaivaṃ nandanodyānaṃ tadantaḥ prāṅgaṇaṃ smaret || 9-753 ||
śuddhakāñcanasaṃkāśavasudhābhiralaṅkṛtam | prāṅgaṇaṃ cintayitvetthaṃ surasiddhaniṣevitam || 9-754 ||
tanmadhye maṇḍapaṃ dhyāyedvyāptabrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam | sahasrādityasaṃkāśaṃ caturasraṃ suśobhitam || 9-755 ||
ratnatejaḥprabhāpuñjapiñjarīkṛtadiṅmukham | madhyastambhavinirmuktaṃ koṇastambhasamanvitam || 9-756 ||
mahāmāṇikyavaidūryaratnakāñcanabhūṣitam | muktādāmavitānāḍhyaṃ ratnasopānamaṇḍitam || 9-757 ||
mandavāyusamākrāntaṃ gandhadhūpataraṅgitam | ratnacāmaraghaṇṭādivitānairupaśobhitam || 9-758 ||
jātīcampakapunnāgaketakīmallikādibhiḥ | raktotpalasitāmbhojamādhavībhiḥ supuṣpakaiḥ || 9-759 ||
baddhābhiścitramālābhiḥ sarvatra samalaṅkṛtam | tiryagūrdhvalasadraktaputtalīkoṭimaṇḍitam || 9-760 ||
nānāratnādibhirdivyairnirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā | tanmadhye bhāvayenmantrī parijātaṃ manoharam || 9-761 ||
svarṇādiratnabhūmiṃ ca vālukāṃ kāñcanaprabhām | udyadādityasaṃkāśaṃ vyāptabrahmāṇḍamaṇḍapam || 9-762 ||
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ jyotirmandiramuttamam | caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ hemaprākāramaṇḍitam || 9-763 ||
ratnopakḷptisaṃśobhikapāṭāṣṭakasaṃyutam | navaratnasamākḷptatuṅgagopuratoraṇam || 9-764 ||
hemadaṇḍaśikhālambidhvajāvalipariṣkṛtam | madhyakoṇasthitastambhanavaratnasamanvitam || 9-765 ||
mahāmāṇikyavaidūryaratnacāmaraśobhitam | kalpavṛkṣe gireḥ pārśve chatraṃ tanmaṇḍapopari || 9-766 ||
suvarṇasūtrai racitaṃ tanmadhye ratnamaṇḍapam | tanmadhye sphuritaṃ dhyāyet triśṛṅgaṃ jyotiruttamam || 9-767 ||
tasya madhye mahācakraṃ pīyūṣaparipūritam | ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasyā vedyā madhye smarecchubham || 9-768 ||
viriñciviṣṇurudreśarūpapādacatuṣṭayam | sadāśivamayaṃ sākṣāt tasmin paraśivātmakam || 9-769 ||
puṣpaparyaṅkatanmadhye śrīmadudyānapīṭhake | paryaṅkabandhavilasatsvastikāsanaśālinīm || 9-770 ||
dhyāyet paraśivāṅkasthāṃ padmamadhyojjvalākṛtim | tripurāṃ sundarīṃ devīṃ bālārkakiraṇāruṇām || 9-771 ||
japākusumasaṃkā (-) sāṃ dāḍimīkusumopamām | padmarāgapratīkāśāṃ kuṅkumāruṇasannibhām || 9-772 ||
sphuranmukuṭamāṇikyakiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitām | kālālikulasaṃkāśakuṭilālakapallavām || 9-773 ||
pratyagāruṇa saṃkāśavadanāmbhojamaṇḍitām | kiñcidardhendukuṭilalalāṭamṛdupaṭṭikām || 9-774 ||
pinākadhanurākārabhrūlatāṃ parameśvarīm | ānandamuditollāsalīlāṃ dolitalocanām || 9-775 ||
sphuranmayūkhasaṅghātavilasaddhemakuṇḍalām | svagaṇḍamaṇḍalābhogajitendvamṛtamaṇḍalām || 9-776 ||
viśvakarmavinirmāṇasūtravispaṣṭanāsikām | tāmravidrumavimbābharaktoṣṭhīmamṛtopamām || 9-777 ||
dāḍimībījapaṅktyābhadantapaṅktivirājitām | smitamādhuryavijitamādhuryarasasāgarām || 9-778 ||
anaupamyaguṇopetacivukoddeśaśobhitām | kambugrīvāṃ mahādevīṃ mṛṇālasadṛśairbhujaiḥ || 9-779 ||
raktotpaladalākārasukumārakarāṃ bhujām | karāmbujanakhajyotirvidyotitanabhastalām || 9-780 ||
muktāhāralatopetasamunnatapayodharām | trivalīvalayāmuktamadhyadeśasuśobhitām || 9-781 ||
lāvaṇyasaridāvarttanimnanābhivibhūṣitām | anarghyaratnaghaṭitakāñcīyutanitambinīm || 9-782 ||
nitambabimbadviradaromarājivarāṅkuśām | kadalīlalitastambhasukumārorumīśvarīm || 9-783 ||
lāvaṇyakusumākārajānumaṇḍalabandhurām | lāvaṇyakadalītulyajaṅghāyugalamaṇḍitām || 9-784 ||
gūḍhagulphapadadvandvaprapadājitakacchapām | tanuṃ dīrghāṅgulīcchannanakharājivirājitām || 9-785 ||
brahmaviṣṇuśiroratnanighṛṣṭacaraṇāmbujām | śītāṃśuśatasaṃkāśakāntisaṃtānahāsinīm || 9-786 ||
lauhityajitasindūrajapādāḍimarāgiṇīm | raktavastraparīdhānāṃ pāśāṅkuśakarodyatām || 9-787 ||
raktapadmaniviṣṭāṃ tu raktābharaṇabhūṣitām | jagadāhlādajananīṃ jagadrañjanakāriṇīm || 9-788 ||
caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ tu pañcabāṇadhanurdharām | karpūraśakalonmiśratāmbūlapūritānanām || 9-789 ||
mahāmṛgamadoddāmakuṅkumāruṇavigrahām | sarvaśṛṅgāraveśāḍhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 9-790 ||
jagadānandajananīṃ jagadrañjanakāriṇīm | jagadākarṣaṇakarīṃ jagatkāraṇarūpiṇīm || 9-791 ||
sarvalakṣmīmayīṃ nityāṃ sarvaśaktimayīṃ bhaje |
atha dīpinīvidyā tatraiva |
vāṅmāyākamalābījaṃ vāgbhavādye niyojayet || 9-792 ||
tāraṃ lakṣmīṃ ca vāgbījaṃ manmathaṃ bhuvaneśvarīm | tajjaptvā ca tataḥ paścādvāgbhavākhyaṃ samuccaret || 9-793 ||
praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ ramāṃ kāmaṃ ca vāgbhavam | kāmarājaṃ tato japtvā trailokyakṣobhakārakam || 9-794 ||
oṃkāraṃ cāpi vāgbījaṃ ramāṃ manmathamāyayā | svapnāvatīṃ mahādevi japet tatra samāhitaḥ || 9-795 ||
praṇavaṃ cādharaṃ kāmaṃ ramāṃ ca bhuvaneśvarīm | madhumatīṃ tato japtvā māyāśrīkūrcabījakam || 9-796 ||
praṇavādyaṃ ca deveśi haṃsabījapuṭīkṛtam | etadbījaṃ samuccārya śaktikūṭaṃ tato japet || 9-797 ||
japaniyamastu |
japedādau japet paścāt sapta vārānanukramāt | kāmarājādibījānāṃ dīpanaṃ caiva kārayet || 9-798 ||
atha puraścaraṇavidhiḥ (vāmakeśvaratantre)
tatra sthitvā japellakṣaṃ sākṣāddevīsvarūpadhṛk | kiṃśukairhavanaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśaṃ ca varānane || 9-799 ||
kusumbhakusumairvā'pi madhuratrayamiśritaiḥ |
(siddhāntasāre'pi)
lakṣamātraṃ japedvidyāṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ || 9-800 ||
homaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśena kiṃśukairmadhurāplutaiḥ |
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogān karttumarhati (-) iti || 9-801 ||
atha tripurabhairavamantraḥ (vāmakeśvare)
māyā lakṣmīstathā haṃsaḥ prāsādabījameva ca | vahnijāyāntako mantro bhavet traipurabhairavaḥ || 9-802 ||
ṣaḍaṅgamūlamantreṇa valipūjādikaṃ tathā |
atha dhyānam |
ekavakkraṃ trinayanaṃ caturbāhusamanvitam || 9-803 ||
dakṣiṇe cāṅkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ vāme kheṭakapāśakau | dhārayantaṃ raktavarṇaṃ vṛṣāsanagataṃ vibhum || 9-804 ||
urddhvakeśaṃ hārahāraṃ kapālamālayā'nvitam | evaṃvidhaṃ mahādevi dhyāyet tripurabhairavam || 9-805 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṃ ṣoḍaśīpuraścaraṇasamānam | atha bālāmantraḥ (tripurāsārasamuccaye)
atha trilokārcitaśāsanāyā vakṣyāmi bījatrayamambikāyāḥ | goptavyametat kuladharmavidbhi (-) ramuṣya hetornijasiddhaye ca || 9-806 ||
kāntādibhūtapadagaṃ kagatārdhacandraṃ dantāntapūrvajaladhisthitavarṇayuktam | etajjapaṃ naravaro bhuvi vāgbhavākhyaṃ vācāṃ sudhārasamucāṃ labhate sa siddhim || 9-807 ||
kāntāntaṃ kulapūrvapañcamayutaṃ netrāntadaṇḍānvitaṃ kāmākhyaṃ gaditaṃ japānmanurayaṃ sākṣājjagatkṣobhakṛt | dantāntena yutaṃ sadaṇḍisakalaṃ saṃmohanākhyaṃ kulaṃ
sidhyatyasya guṇāṣṭakaṃ khacaratāsiddhiśca nityaṃ japāt || 9-808 ||
ṛṣirdakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃjño mahātmā bhavecchanda etasya mantrasya paṅktiḥ | sarasvatyacintyaprabhāvā pradiṣṭā | budhairdevatā devavṛndārcitāṅghriḥ || 9-809 ||
amuṣya mantrasya radāntayuktaṃ bījaṃ sadaṇḍaṃ nakulīśapūrvam | śaktistu sā khaṇḍalakarṇapūrvasahārdhajaivātṛkamānanāntam || 9-810 ||
(merutantre tu)
bālābījaṃ vāgbhavaṃ syāt tārttīyaṃ śaktirucyate | kīlakaṃ kāmarājaḥ syāddvirāvṛtyā ṣaḍaṅgakam (-) ityuktam || 9-811 ||
(tripurāsārasamuccaye)
varṇaḥ śuklo munibhistribhuvanamahitasya mantrarājasya | āgamapāragamatibhirgāndhāro'sya svaro gaditaḥ || 9-812 ||
vidyāmūlotpattireṣā mayoktā jñātavyeyaṃ sarvathā siddhikāmaiḥ | devyā śaptā yena vidyeyamādyā pūrvaṃ tena prāṇahīnā'bhavat sā || 9-813 ||
jñātavyetyanena tu japtavyeti sūcitam | devyā śaṣtetyanena ca niṣedhaheturdarśitaḥ | śāpanirmuktiprakārastu tatraivoktaḥ |
śivaśaktibījamata eva śambhunā nihitaṃ tayorupari pūrvabījayoḥ | akulaṃ kulopari ca madhyasādhare dahanaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti sorjitā'bhavat || 9-814 ||
saṃjñābhedamāha |
bhairavīyamuditā kulapūrvā deśikairyadi bhavet kulapūrvā |
saiva śīghraphaladā bhuvi vidyetyucyate paśujaneṣvatigopyā || 9-815 ||
akulaṃ hakārastatpūrvā cedbhairavī | kulaṃ sakārastatpūrṇa cedvidyetyucyata ityarthaḥ ādyantabījayorvahnibījābhāvādvakṣyamāṇatripurabhairavovidyāvaila(-)kṣaṇyamasyā boddhavyam | asyā dhyānamuktaṃ (merutantre)
abhayaṃ pustakaṃ bālāṃ varaṃ ca dadhatīṃ karaiḥ | aruṇāmaruṇābjasthāṃ raktavastrāṃ dvijeśakām || 9-816 ||
tantrāntare tu |
saṃsmaret tripurāṃ bālāṃ śaraccandrasamaprabhām (-) iti |
śuklavarṇeyamuktā | (tripurāsārasamuccaye)
pāśāṅkuśābhayavarodyatapāṇipadmām (---) ityāyudhaviśeṣa uktaḥ || 9-817 ||
atha puraścaraṇaṃ (jñānārṇave)
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ havanaṃ caret | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryāt sarvasaubhāgyabhāgbhavet (-) iti || 9-818 ||
iti śrīvidyāprakaraṇam |
atha bhuvaneśvarovidyā (śāradāyām)
atha vakṣye jagaddhātromadhunā bhuvaneśvarīm | brahmādayo'pi yāṃ jñātvā lebhire śriyamūrjitām || 9-819 ||
nakulīśo'gnimāruḍho vāmanetrārdhacandravān | bījaṃ tasyāḥ samākhyātaṃ sevitaṃ siddhikāṅkṣibhiḥ || 9-820 ||
ṛṣiḥ śaktirbhavecchando gāyatrī devatā manoḥ | kathitā surasaṅghena sevitā bhuvaneśvarī || 9-821 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt |
atha dhyānam |
udyadinadyutimindukirīṭāṃ tuṅgakucāṃ nayanatrayayuktām || 9-822 ||
smeramukhīṃ varadāṅkuśapāśābhītikarāṃ prabhajedbhuvaneśīm |
atha puraścaraṇam |
prajapenmantravinmantraṃ dvātriṃśallakṣamānataḥ || 9-823 ||
trisvāduyuktairjuhuyādaṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśataḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
vāgbhavaṃ śambhuvanitā ramā bījatrayātmakam || 9-824 ||
mantraṃ samuddharenmantrī trivargaphalasādhanam | ṣaḍdīrghabhājā madhyena vāgbhavādyena kalpayet || 9-825 ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni manorasya jātiyuktāni mantravit |
atha dhyānam |
sindūrāruṇavigrahāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamaulisphurat (-) tārānāyakaśekharāṃ smitamukhīmāpīnavakṣoruhām || 9-826 ||
pāṇibhyāṃ maṇipūrṇaratnacaṣakaṃ raktotpalaṃ bibhratīṃ saumyāṃ ratnaghaṭasthasavyacaraṇāṃ dhyāyet parāmambikām ||
aba puraścaraṇam |
ravilakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ pāyasairmadhurāplutaiḥ || 9-827 ||
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmantrī pīṭhe prāgīrite yajet |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
vāgbījapuṭitā māyā vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī matā || 9-828 ||
madhyena dīrghayuktena vākpuṭena prakalpayet | aṅgāni jātiyuktāni krameṇa manuvittamaḥ || 9-829 ||
atha dhyānam |
śyāmāṅgīṃ śaśiśekharāṃ nijakarairdānaṃ ca raktotpalaṃ ratnāḍhyaṃ caṣakaṃ paraṃ bhayaharaṃ saṃbibhratīṃ śāśvatīm | muktāhāralasatpayodharanatāṃ netratrayollāsinīṃ vande'haṃ surapūjitāṃ haravadhūṃ raktāravindasthitām || 9-830 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
tattvalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ | pālāśapuṣpaiḥ svādvaktaiḥ puṣpairvā rājavṛkṣakaiḥ || 9-831 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
ananto vindusaṃyukto māyābrahmāgnitāravān | pāśādistryakṣaro mantraḥ sarvavaśyaphalapradaḥ || 9-832 ||
ṛṣyādyāḥ pūrvamuktāḥ syurbījenāṅgakriyā matā |
atha dhyānam |
varāṅkuśau pāśamabhītimudrāṃ karairvahantīṃ kamalāsanasthām || 9-833 ||
bālārkakoṭipratimāṃ trinetrāṃ bhaje'hamādyāṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ tām |
atha puraścaraṇam |
haviṣyabhugjapenmantraṃ tattvalakṣaṃ jitendriyaḥ || 9-834 ||
ṣaṭsahasraṃ prajuhuyājjapānte mantravittamaḥ | dadhikṣaudraghṛtāktābhiḥ samidbhiḥ kṣīrabhūruhām || 9-835 ||
tatsaṅkhyayā tilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ payo'ktairjuhuyāt tataḥ |
asyāḥ pumānmahādevaḥ | tanmantraḥ pañcākṣarastatprakaraṇa evoktaḥ |
iti bhuvaneśvarīvidyāprakaraṇam |
atha bhairavīvidyā |
tatrādau tripurabhairavīvidyā proktā (śāradāyām)
atha vakṣye parāṃ vidyāṃ tripurāmatigopitām || 9-836 ||
yāṃ jñātvā siddhasaṅghānāmadhipo jāyate naraḥ | viyadbhṛguhutāśastho bhautiko vinduśekharaḥ || 9-837 ||
viyat tadādikendrāgnisthitaṃ vāmākṣivindumat | ākāśabhṛguvahnistho manuḥ sargendukhaṇḍavān || 9-838 ||
vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ bījaṃ kāmabījaṃ dvitīyakam |
tṛtīyaṃ śaktibījākhyaṃ tribhirbījairitīritā || 9-839 ||
pañcakūṭātmikā vidyā vedyā traipurabhairavī | ṛṣiḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrtiśchandaḥ paṅktiḥ samīritam || 9-840 ||
devatā deśikairuktā devī tripurabhairavī |
tathā |
ṣaḍdīrghayuktenādyena bījenāṅgakriyā matā || 9-841 ||
nyāsāntarāṇi vistarabhayādupekṣitāni puraścaraṇasyaivātra nirūpaṇīyatvāt |
atha dhyānam |
udyadbhānusahasrakāntimaruṇakṣaumāṃ śiromālikāṃ raktāliptapayodharāṃ japavaṭīṃ vidyāmabhītiṃ varām | hastābjairdadhatīṃ trinetravilasadvakkrāravindaśriyaṃ devīṃ baddhahimāṃśuratnamukuṭāṃ vande'ravindasthitām || 9-842 ||
atha puraścaraṇaṃ |
dīkṣāṃ prāpya japenmantraṃ tattvalakṣaṃ jitendriyaḥ | puṣpirbhānusahasrāṇi juhuyādbrahmavṛkṣajaiḥ || 9-843 ||
trimadhvaktaiḥ prasūnairvā karavīrasamudbhavaiḥ |
tattvalakṣaṃ lakṣatrayam | atha caitanyabhairavīmantro (merutantre)
caitanyabhairavīmantrastryakṣaraḥ kathyate'dhunā || 9-844 ||
sahāvaikārasaṃyuktau prathamaṃ bījamīritam | sakalā hrī(/) samāyuktā dvitīyaṃ bījamucyate || 9-845 ||
sahārā ausamāyuktā visargāntāstṛtīyakam |
atra tribhirbījairdvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ kāryaḥ | atha dhyānam |
udyadbhānusahasrābhāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 9-846 ||
mukuṭordhvalasaccandrarekhāṃ raktāmbarāñcitām |
pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ nityāṃ vāmahastakapālinīm || 9-847 ||
varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm | evaṃ dhyātvā yajeddevīṃ pūrvasiṃhāsane sthitām || 9-848 ||
puraścaryādikaṃ prāgvat prayogā(/)ścāpi sādhayet |
prāgvaditi tripurabhairavīvat | atha bhuvaneśvarabhairavīmantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhuvaneśvarabhairavīm | 849 ||
hasāvaikārasaṃyuktau prathamaṃ bījamīritam | hasakalā hrī(/) sametā dvitīyaṃ bījamucyate || 9-850 ||
hasāvaukārasaṃyuktau visargāntaṃ tṛtīyakam | ṣaḍdīrghānvitamadhyena bījenoktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 9-851 ||
atha dhyānam |
japākusumasaṃkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabhām | candrarekhājaṭājūṭāṃ trinetrāṃ raktavāsasam || 9-852 ||
nānālaṅkāraśubhagāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm | pāśāṅkuśavarābhītīrdadhānāṃ ca śivāṃ śraye || 9-853 ||
caitanyabhairavīvat syādyadyannoktamihārthavat |
asyāḥ puraścaraṇaṃ tu tripurabhairavīpuraścaraṇavadbodhyam | atha kamaleśvarībhairavī tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhairavīṃ kamaleśvarīm | hasasthāne sahetyuktvā sarvaṃ mantrādi pūrvavat || 9-854 ||
rājñā jñātā tataḥ śaptā tuhināge'bhavannadī | tyaktastayā vāmamārgo rājabhītyā tu matkṛte || 9-855 ||
yato labdhaṃ tayā duḥkhaṃ kalau khyātiṃ gamiṣyati | pranaṣṭeṣu ca deveṣu pratyakṣeyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 9-856 ||
avarṇāścāpi varṇāśca bhaviṣyanti varapradāḥ | tyaktvā mapañcakaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā ye japatatparāḥ || 9-857 ||
asyāstīre puraścaryā navakāt saṃprasīdati | bhuvaneśī bhairavī tu kṛtvā rūpāntaraṃ mama || 9-858 ||
kāryārthaṃ bahavaḥ śiṣyāḥ kaulikā vāminaḥ kṛtāḥ | tasyā dhyānādyarcanādi prāgvaddakṣiṇamārgataḥ || 9-859 ||
atha saṃpatpradābhairavī (jñānārṇave)
yathā'sau tripurā bālā tathā tripurabhairavī | saṃpatpradā nāma tasyāḥ śṛṇu nirmalamānase || 9-860 ||
śivaścandro vahnisaṃstho vāgbhavaṃ tadanantaram | kāmabījaṃ tathā devi śivacandrānvitaṃ tataḥ || 9-861 ||
pṛthvībījaṃ tu vahnyāḍhyaṃ tārttīyaṃ śṛṇu vallabhe | śaktibīje maheśāni śivavahnī niyojayet || 9-862 ||
kumāryāḥ parameśāni hitvā sargaṃ tu vaindavam | tripurābhairavī devī mahāsaṃpatpradā priye || 9-863 ||
tripurabhairavī visargarahitā saṃpatpradā bhavati |
nyāsapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ tripurābhairavīsamam |
dhyānaṃ yathā |
ātāmrārkasahasrābhāṃ sphuraccandrakalājaṭām || 9-864 ||
kirīṭaratnavilasaccitracitritamauktikām | galadrudhirapaṅkāḍhyamuṇḍamālāvirājitām || 9-865 ||
nayanatrayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pūrṇenduvadanānvitām | muktāhāralatārājatpīnonnataghanastanīm || 9-866 ||
raktāmbaraparīdhānāṃ yauvanonmattarūpiṇīm |
pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikām || 9-867 ||
varadānaratāṃ nityāṃ mahāsaṃpatpradāṃ smaret |
asyāḥ puraścaraṇamapi pūrvavadbodhyam | atha kauleśabhairavī tatraiva |
saṃpatpradābhairavīvadviddhi kauleśabhairavīm || 9-868 ||
hasarādyaiva deveśi triṣu bījeṣu pārvati | iyaṃ tu saharādyā syāddhyānapūjādikaṃ tathā || 9-869 ||
tripurabhairavīvaditi śeṣaḥ | ādipadāt puraścaraṇasyāpi saṃgrahaḥ | atha kāmeśvarabhairavī tatraiva |
kāmeśvarī ca rudrārṇā pūrvasiṃhāsane sthitā | etasyā eva vidyāyā bījadvayamudāhṛtam || 9-870 ||
tadante parameśāni nityaklinne madadrave | etasyā eva tārttīyaṃ rudrārṇā parameśvari || 9-871 ||
dhyānapūjādikaṃ devi caitanyāvat samīritam |
evaṃ puraścaraṇamapi | atha ṣaṭkūṭābhairavī (jñānārṇave)
ḍākinīrākinībīje lākinīkākinīyugam || 9-872 ||
śākinīhākinībīje āhṛtya surasundari | ādyamaikārasaṃyuktamanyadīkāramaṇḍitam || 9-873 ||
śakrasvarānvitaṃ devi tārttīyaṃ bījamālikhet | vindunādakalākrāntaṃ tṛtīyaṃ śailasambhave || 9-874 ||
dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāya parameśvari |
puraścaraṇaṃ tu pūrvavat | atha nityābhairavī tatraiva |
etasyā eva vidyāyāḥ ṣaḍarṇāḥ kramaśaḥ sthitāḥ || 9-875 ||
viparītān vada prauḍhe vidyeyaṃ bhogamokṣadā | nyāsapūjādikaṃ sarvamasyāḥ pūrvavadācaret || 9-876 ||
atha rudrabhairavī tatraiva |
śivacandrau mādanāntaṃ pāntaṃ vahnisamanvitam | śaktibhinnaṃ vindunādakalāḍhyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ priye || 9-877 ||
saṃpatpradāyā bhairavyāḥ kāmabījaṃ tadeva hi | sadāśivasya bījaṃ tu mahāsiṃhāsanasya ca || 9-878 ||
sadāśivabījaṃ pretabījam
eṣā vidyā maheśāni varṇituṃ naiva śakyate |
ṛṣyādinyāsastripurabhairavīvat | atha dhyānam |

(merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi stambhanīṃ vagalāmukhīm || 9-982 ||
tāraṃ māyāṃ samuccārya vadecca vagalāmukhi | tadagre sarvaduṣṭānāṃ tato vācaṃ mukhaṃ padam || 9-983 ||
stambhayeti padaṃ jihvāṃ kīlayeti tataḥ param |
buddhiṃ vināśaya hrī(/) oṃ svāhā ṣaṭtriṃśavarṇakaḥ || 9-984 ||
nārāyaṇo munistriṣṭupchandaśca vagalāmukhī | devī bījaṃ tu hṛllekhā svāhā śaktiḥ samīritā || 9-985 ||
viniyogo'sya vikhyātaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye | hṛllekhā hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ śiraśca vagalāmukhī || 9-986 ||
śikhā tu sarvaduṣṭānāṃ tato vācaṃ mukhaṃ padam | stambhayeti ca varmoktaṃ jihvāṃ kīlaya netrakam || 9-987 ||
buddhiṃ vināśyāstraṃ syāt ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ |
atha dhyānam |
gambhīrāṃ ca madonmattāṃ taptakāñcanasannibhām || 9-988 ||
caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ kamalāsanasaṃsthitām | mudgaraṃ dakṣiṇe pāśaṃ vāme jihvāṃ ca vajrakam || 9-989 ||
pītāmbaradharāṃ sāndravṛttapīnapayodharām | hemakuṇḍalabhūṣāṃ ca pītacandrārdhaśekharām || 9-990 ||
pītabhūṣaṇabhūṣāṃ ca svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitām |
atha puraścaraṇam |
haridrāgrathitā mālā pītāmbaradharaḥ svayam || 9-991 ||
pītāsanaḥ smaret pītamayutaṃ japamācaret | daśāṃśena kṛto homaḥ pītadravyaiḥ pratarpayet || 9-992 ||
sarvaṃ pītopacāreṇa mantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥ |
vajrayoginīmiśrakṛtasaṃgrahe tu |
pītāmbaradharo bhūtvā pūrvāśābhimukhasthitaḥ | lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ haridrāgranthimālayā || 9-993 ||
brahmacaryayuto nityaṃ prayato dhyānatatparaḥ |
priyaṅgupāyasenāpi pītapuṣpaiśca homayet (-) ityuktam || 9- 994 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ (yāmale)
vahnihīnendrayugmāyā vagalāmukhi sarvayuk | duṣṭānāṃ vācamityuktvā mukhaṃ stambhaya kīrtayet || 9- 995 ||
jihvāṃ kīlaya buddhiṃ ca vināśaya padaṃ vadet | pūrvabījaṃ tatastāraṃ vahnijāyāvadhirbhavet || 9- 996 ||
tārādhikā catustriṃśadakṣarā vagalāmukhī | nārāyaṇo (nārado'sya muniriti kva cit pāṭhaḥ) muniśchandaḥ paṅkti śrīvagalāmukhī || 9- 997 ||
devatā mantragaṃ bījaṃ śaktiḥ pāvakasundarī | sarvaśatrumukhastambhe viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 9- 997 ||
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ |
atha dhyānam |
madhye sudhābdhimaṇimaṇḍaparatnavedī (-) siṃhāsanoparigatāṃ paripītavarṇām || 9- 998 ||
(pītāmbarābharaṇamālyavibhūṣitāṅgīm ityapi pāṭho bahutra śrūyate | ) pitāmbarāṃ kanakabhūṣaṇamālyaśobhāṃ devīṃ bhajāmi dhṛtamudgaravairijihvām | jihvāgramādāya kareṇa devīṃ vāmena śatrūn paripīḍayantīm || 9- 999 ||
(gadābhighātena iti 2 pu0 pā0 |) padābhighātena ca dakṣiṇena pītāmbarāḍhyāṃ dvibhūjāṃ namāmi |
atha puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
japamālā ca deveśi haridrāgranthisambhavā || 9- 1000 ||
pītāsanasamārūḍhaḥ pītadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | pītapuṣpārcanaṃ nityamayutaṃ japamācaret || 9- 1001 ||
taddaśāṃśakṛto homaḥ pītadravyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
asyāḥ pumān mṛtyuñjayastanmantrapuraścaraṇaṃ ca śivaprakaraṇa evoktam |
iti vagalāmukhīprakaraṇam |
atha mātaṅgīvidyā |
(yāmale)
atha vakṣye mahādevīṃ mātaṅgīṃ sarvasiddhidām || 9- 1002 ||
asyāḥ sevanamātreṇa vāksiddhiṃ labhate dhruvam | praṇavaṃ ca tato māyāṃ kāmabījaṃ ca kūrcakam || 9- 1003 ||
mātaṅgī ṅeyutā cāstraṃ vahnijāyāvadhirmanuḥ | ṛṣiḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrtirvirāṭchanda udīritam || 9- 1004 ||
mātaṅgī devatā devī sarvasiddhipradāyinī | aṅganyāsakaranyāsau kuryānmantrī samāhitaḥ || 9- 1005 ||
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena praṇavādyena kalpayet |
atha dhyānam |
śyāmāṅgīṃ śaśiśekharāṃ trinayanāṃ sadratnasiṃhāsane saṃsthāṃ ratnavicitrabhūṣaṇayutāṃ saṃkṣīṇamadhyasthalām || 9- 1006 ||
āponastanamaṇḍalāṃ smitamukhīṃ dhyāyeddadhantīṃ kramād (-) vedairbāhubhiraṅkuśāsilatike pāśaṃ tathā kheḍakam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
puraścaraṇakāle tu ṣaṭsahasraṃ japenmanum || 9-1007 ||
taddaśāṃśaṃ hunedājyaiḥ śarkarāmadhubhiḥ saha | brahmatarūdbhavaiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ sādhakaḥ śaktibhiḥ saha || 9-1008 ||
evaṃ puraskriyāṃ kṛtvā prayogavidhimācaret |
atha mantrāntaraṃ (merutantre)
athocchiṣṭāṃ pravakṣyāmi mātaṅgīṃ gokuvarṇakām || 9-1009 ||
nama ucchiṣṭacāṇḍāli mātaṅgīti padaṃ vadet | sarvavaśaṅkari svāhā mantro'yaṃ mohayejjagat || 9-1010 ||
chando nivṛt sagāyatraṃ munī nāradatumburau | devatā cātra mātaṅgī dvitritritrirasākṣibhiḥ || 9-1011 ||
aṅgāni syurmantravarṇaistato dhyāyeddhṛdambuje |
dhyānaṃ yathā |
kṛṣṇāmbarāṃ yāvakārdracaraṇāmunnatastanīm || 9-1012 ||
muktāpravālamālāḍhyāṃ śaṅkhakuṇḍaladhāriṇīm |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mātaṅgīmantramadbhutam || 9-1013 ||
kāminī rañjinī svāhāṣṭākṣaro'yamudīritaḥ | ṛṣiḥ saṃmohanaśchando nivṛt proktā'sya devatā || 9-1014 ||
sarvasaṃmohinī cāṅgaṃ dvirāvṛttipadairbhavet |
atha dhyānam
śyāmāṅgī vallakoṃ dorbhyāṃ vādayantīṃ subhūṣaṇām || 9-1015 ||
candrāvataṃsāṃ vividhairgāyanairmohatīṃ jagat |
anayoḥ puraścaraṇam |
prajapedayutadvandvaṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt tataḥ || 9-1016 ||
madhūkajaistrimadhvaktaiḥ sarvaṃ saṃmohayejjagat |
atha rājamātaṅgīmantrastatraiva |
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi catuṣpañcāśadakṣaram || 9-1017 ||
oṃ hrī(/) namaśca brahmaśrīrājite rājapūjite | jaye ca vijaye gauryaṣe gāndhāripadaṃ vadet || 9-1018 ||
tribhuvanavaśaṅkari sarvastrīpuruṣeti ca | vaśaṅkari susu dudu gheghe vāvā'gnigehinī || 9-1019 ||
ajo munistathā chando nivṛdgāyatramīritam | devatā rājamātaṅgī ṣaḍaṅgādi tu māyayā || 9-1020 ||
atha dhyānam |
(etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ 5 pustake'dhika upalabhyate |) amṛtodadhimadhyasthe ratnadvīpe manohare | svarṇaprākārasaṃvīte maṇiratnavinirmite || 9-1021 ||
kadambavilvakadvāre kalpavṛkṣopaśobhite | vedimadhye sukhāstīrṇe ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe || 9-1022 ||
aṣṭapatraṃ mahāpadmaṃ keśarāḍhyaṃ sakarṇikam | tanmadhye tu trikoṇaṃ syādaṣṭapatraṃ tato bahiḥ || 9-1023 ||
punaḥ ṣoḍaśapatraṃ syāt tadvāhye syāccaturdalam | vedāsraṃ sacaturdvāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktamuttamam || 9-1024 ||
tasya madhye sukhāsīnāṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ śucismitām | kadambamālābharaṇāṃ pūjitāṃ ca surāsuraiḥ || 9-1025 ||
pralambālakasaṃyuktāṃ candrarekhāvataṃsikām | lalāṭe tilakopetāmīṣatprahasitānanām || 9-1026 ||
kiñcitsvedāmbumadhuralalāṭaphalakojjvalām | valītaraṅgamadhyābhāṃ romarājīvirājitām || 9-1027 ||
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ muktāhāravibhūṣitām | nānāmaṇigaṇonnaddhakaṭisūtrairalaṅkṛtām || 9-1028 ||
valayai ratnakhacitaiḥ keyurairmaṇibhūṣitaiḥ |
bhūṣitāṃ dvibhūjāṃ bālāṃ madāghūrṇitalocanām || 9-1029 ||
āpīnamaṇḍalābhogasamunnatapayodharām | pralambavarṇābharaṇāṃ karṇottaṃsavirājitām || 9-1030 ||
tamālanīlāṃ taruṇīṃ madhumattāṃ mataṅginīm | catuḥṣaṣṭikalārūpāṃ pārśvasthaśukasārikām || 9-1031 ||
koṭibālārkasaṃkāśāṃ japākusumasannibhām | evaṃ vā pītavarṇāṃ vā dhyāyenmātaṅginīṃ parām || 9-1032 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
(etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭha 5 pustake'dhika upalabhyate |) ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ homayet taddaśāṃśataḥ | bandhūkakusumairmantrī madhuratrayalolitaiḥ || 9-1033 ||
atha sumukhīmantraḥ (guhyātantre)
śṛṇu mantraṃ mahādevi yathāvat kathayāmi te | dadyāducchiṣṭaśabdaṃ tu tathā cāṇḍālinīti ca || 9-1034 ||
sumukhīti tato devīṃ kīrtayet tadanantaram | mahāpiśācinī tasmānmāyābījamanantaram || 9-1035 ||
vindunādasamāyuktaṃ ṭhakāratritayaṃ tataḥ | savisargaṃ mahādevi sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 9-1036 ||
iyaṃ vidyā mahāvidyā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī | svargadā mokṣadā vidyā sarvasaubhāgyadā(rājyasaubhāgyadā iti 2- 4 pu0 pā0) tathā || 9- 1037 ||
sadocchiṣṭamukho bhūtvā smareddevīṃ jayapradām | tadā'cānto bhaveddevi vinaivācamane kṛte || 9-1037 ||
durbhagā subhagā nūnaṃ duḥkhitā sukhinī bhavet |
bandhyā'pi labhate putraṃ śatahāyanajīvanam || 9-1038 ||
durbalo balamāpnoti mūrkho vidyāmavāpnuyāt | yāṃ yāṃ prārthayate siddhiṃ haṭhāt tāṃ tāmavāpnuyāt || 9-1039 ||
vidhānaṃ cātra vakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi varānane | nāridoṣo na vā vighno nāśaucaṃ niyamo na ca || 9-1040 ||
yasya tiṣṭhati mantro'yaṃ na ca vighnaiḥ sa vādhyate |
tathā |
ajo muniḥ samākhyātaśchando gāyatramasya tu || 9-1041 ||
devatā sumukhī proktā māyayā tu ṣaḍaṅgakam |
atha dhyānam |
śavoparisamāsīnāṃ raktāmbaraparicchadām || 9-1042 ||
raktālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ guñjāhāravibhūṣitām | ṣoḍaśābdāṃ ca yuvatīṃ pīnonnatapayodharām || 9-1043 ||
kapālakarttrikāhastāṃ parajyotiḥsvarūpiṇīm | vāmadakṣiṇayogena dhyāyenmantraviduttamaḥ || 9-1044 ||
ucchiṣṭena valiṃ datvā japet tadgatamānasaḥ | ucchiṣṭenaiva kartavyo japo'syāḥ siddhimicchatā || 9-1045 ||
ucchiṣṭajapamānasya jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥ |
asya mantrasya puraścaraṇamaṣṭasahasrajapaḥ |
yeṣāṃ jape ca home ca (-------------------) ityādipūrvoktavacanāt || 9-1046 ||
atha vaśyāmātaṅgīmantraḥ (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vaśyamātaṅgikāmanum | oṃ rājamukhi rājādhimukhi vaśyamukhīti ca || 9-1047 ||
māyāṃ śrī(/) klī(/) devadevi mahādevi tato vadet | devādhidevi sarveti janasya mukhamuccaret || 9-1048 ||
mama vaśaṃ kuru dvandvaṃ svāhānto'ṅgakṛtārṇakaḥ | diksaptakṛtadeveṣumantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam || 9-1049 ||
vijñeyaṃ rājamātaṅgītulyaṃ pūjājapādikam | prayogā(/)ścāpi jānīyādviśeṣādvaśakṛt tviyam || 9-1050 ||
mantrāntaramāha |
māyā namo hilidvandvaṃ caṇḍamātaṅginīti ca | svāheti tithivarṇo'syā nyāsapūjādikaṃ bhavet || 9-1051 ||
rājamātaṅgikātulyaṃ japaścāyutasaṅkhyakaḥ | ghṛtapāyasahomaśca prayogādyaṃ ca pūrvat || 9-1052 ||
atha karṇamātaṅgīmantraḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi karṇamātaṅgikāmanum | vāgbhavaṃ hṛdayaṃ cātha śrīmātaṅgipadaṃ vadet || 9-1053 ||
amoghe satyavādini mama karṇepadaṃ tataḥ | avatarapadaṃ dvedhā satyaṃ kathaya yugmakam || 9-1054 ||
ehyehi śrī(/) ca mātaṅgyai namastryabdhyarṇako manuḥ | aṅgāni vāgbhavenātra pūjādyaṃ ca kṛtākṛtam || 9-1055 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ japaḥ pāyasādyaiḥ homaḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ | karṇe tu kathayeddevī pṛcchakasya śubhāśubham || 9-1056 ||
iti mātaṅgīprakaraṇam |
atha lakṣmīvidyā |
(śāradāyām)
atha vakṣye śriyo mantrān śrīsaubhāgyaphalapradān | yasyāḥ kaṭākṣamātreṇa trailokyamapi vardhate || 9-1057 ||
vāntaṃ vahnisamārūḍhaṃ vāmanetrendusaṃyutam |
bījametacchriyaḥ proktaṃ cintāratnamivāparam || 9-1058 ||
ṛṣirbhṛgurnivṛcchando devatā śrīḥ samīritā | ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet || 9-1059 ||
atha dhyānam |
kāntyā kāñcanasannibhāṃ himagiriprakhyaiścaturbhirgaja i(-) rhastotkṣiptahiraṇmayāmṛtaghaṭairāṣicyamānāṃ śriyam | vibhrāṇāṃ varamabjayugmamabhayaṃ hastaiḥ kirīṭojjvalāṃ kṣaumābaddhanitambavimbalalitāṃ bande'ravindasthitām || 9-1060 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
bhānulakṣaṃ japenmantrī dīkṣito vijitendriyaḥ | śriyamabhyarcayennityaṃ sugandhikusumādibhiḥ || 9-1061 ||
tatsahasraṃ ca juhuyāt kamalairmadhurokṣitaiḥ | japānte juhuyānmantrī tilairvā madhurānvitaiḥ || 9-1062 ||
vailvaiḥ phalairvā juhuyāt tribhirvā sādhakottamaḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
vāgbhavaṃ vanitā viṣṇormāyā makaraketanaḥ | caturbījātmako mantraścaturvargaphalapradaḥ || 9-1063 ||
aṅgāni kuryāddīrghādyai ramābījena tantravit |
atha dhyānam |
māṇikyapratimaprabhāṃ himanibhaistuṅgaiścaturbhirgajai (-) rhastāgrāhitaratnakumbhasalilairāṣicyamānāṃ sadā || 9-1064 ||
hastābjairvaradānamabjayugalābhītīrdadhānāṃ hareḥ kāntāṃ kāṅkṣitapārijātalatikāṃ vande sarojānanām |
atha puraścaraṇam |
bhānulakṣaṃ haviṣyāśī japedante saroruhaiḥ || 9-1065 ||
p 834> juhuyādaruṇaiḥ phullaistatsahasraṃ jitendriyaḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
dīrghāyādirvisargānto brahmā bhānurvasundharā || 9-1066 ||
vānte sinyai priyā vahnermanuḥ prokto daśākṣaraḥ | ṛṣirdakṣo virāṭ chando devatā śrīḥ samīritā || 9-1067 ||
devyai hṛdayamākhyātaṃ padminyai śira īritam | viṣṇupatnyai śikhā proktā varadāyai tanucchadam || 9-1068 ||
astraṃ kamalarūpiṇyai namo'ntāḥ praṇavādikāḥ | aṅgamantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā dhyāyeddevīmanyadhīḥ || 9-1069 ||
atha dhyānam |
āsīnā sarasīruhe smitamukhī hastāmbujairbibhratī dānaṃ padmayugābhayaṃ ca vapuṣā saudāminīvallabhā | muktādāmavirājamānapṛthulottuṅgastanodbhāsinī pāyādvaḥ kamalā kaṭākṣavibhavairānandayantī harim || 9-1070 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
daśalakṣaṃ japedenaṃ mantravidvijitendriyaḥ | daśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmantrī madhurāktaiḥ saroruhaiḥ || 9-1071 ||
atha māhalakṣmīmantrastatraiva |
vāgbhavaṃ śambhuvanitā ramā makaraketanaḥ | tārttīyaṃ ca jagatpārśvo vahnibījasamujjvalaḥ || 9-1072 ||
arghīśāḍhyo bhṛgustyai hṛnmantro'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ | mahālakṣmyāḥ samuddiṣṭastārādyaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 9-1073 ||
ṛṣirvidyā samuddiṣṭo gāyatrī chanda īritam | devatā jagatāmādirmahālakṣmīḥ samīritā || 9-1074 ||
hastau saṃśodhya mantreṇa tārādi hṛdayāntikam |
bījānāṃ pañcakaṃ nyasyedaṅgulīṣu yathākramam || 9-1075 ||
mantraśeṣaṃ nyasenmantrī talayorubhayorapi | mūrdhādi caraṇaṃ yāvanmantreṇa vyāpakaṃ caret || 9-1076 ||
mūrdhākṣivakṣoguhyāṅghyaiḥ pañca bījāni vinyaset | śeṣān nyaset saptavarṇān hṛdaye saptadhātuṣu || 9-1077 ||
aṅgāni pañcabhirbījairastraṃ śiṣṭākṣarairbhavet | jñānaiśvaryādibhiryuktaiścaturthyantaiḥ sajātibhiḥ || 9-1078 ||
jñānamaiśvaryaśaktiṃ ca balavīrye svatejasā | jñānaiśvaryādayaḥ proktāḥ ṣaṭ kramādaṅgayojitāḥ || 9-1079 ||
dhyānamāha |
evaṃ nyastaśarīro'sau smaredudyānamadbhutam | campakāśokapunnāgapāṭalairupaśobhitam || 9-1080 ||
lavaṅgamādhavīvilvadevadārunamerubhiḥ | mandārapārijātādyaiḥ kalpavṛkṣaiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ || 9-1081 ||
candanaiḥ karṇikāraiśca mātuluṅgaiḥ savañjulaiḥ | dāḍimīlakucāṅkolaiḥ pūgaiḥ kuravakairapi || 9-1082 ||
kadalīkundamandāranārikelairalaṅkṛtam | anyaiḥ sugandhipuṣpādyairvṛkṣakhaṇḍaiśca maṇḍitam || 9-1083 ||
mālatīmallikājātiketakīśatapatrakaiḥ | yāvantītulasīnandyāvartairdamanakairapi || 9-1084 ||
sarvarttukusumopetairnamadbhirupaśobhitam | mandamārutasambhinnaṃ kusumāmodadiṅmukham || 9-1085 ||
tasya madhye sadā phullaiḥ kusumotpalapaṅkajaiḥ | saugandhikaiśca kahlārairnavaiḥ kuvalayairapi || 9-1086 ||
haṃsasārasakāraṇḍabhramaraiścakranāmabhiḥ | anyaiḥ kalakalārāvivihaṅgairupaśobhite || 9-1087 ||
mahāsarasi tanmadhye puline'timanohare | paritaḥ pārijātādyamaṇḍitaṃ maṇikuṭṭimam || 9-1088 ||
udyadādityasaṃkāśabhāsvaraṃ śaśiśītalam | caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ hemaprākāraśobhitam || 9-1089 ||
ratnopakḷptasaṃśobhikapāṭāṣṭakasaṃyutam | navaratnasamākḷptaṃ tuṅgagopuratoraṇam || 9-1090 ||
hemadaṇḍaṃ śikhālamvi dhvajāvalipuraskṛtam | navaratnasamābaddhastambharājivirājitam || 9-1091 ||
sahasradīpasaṃyuktadīpadaṇḍavirājitam | taptahāṭakasaṃkḷptavātāyanamanoharam || 9-1092 ||
nānāratnāṃśukodbaddhasuvarṇaśatakoṭibhiḥ | kiṅkiṇīmālikāyuktapatākābhiralaṅkṛtam || 9-1093 ||
jātarūpamayai ratnavicitrairativistṛtaiḥ | māṇikyavajravaidūryasvarṇamālāvalīyutaiḥ || 9-1094 ||
antarāntarasambaddharatnairdṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ | vicitraiścitrabaddhaiśca vitānairupaśobhitam || 9-1095 ||
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ hemakuṭṭimamujjvalam | ketakomālatījātīcampakotpalakesaraiḥ || 9-1096 ||
mallikātulasīvāśānandyāvarttakadambakaiḥ | etai ramyaiśca kusumairalaṅkṛtamahītalam || 9-1097 ||
abjakāśmīrakastūrīmṛganābhitamālakaiḥ |
candanāgurukarpūrairāmoditadigantaram || 9-1098 ||
evaṃ sañcintya manasā maṇḍapaṃ sumanoharam | tanmadhye bhāvayenmantrī parijātaṃ manoharam || 9-1099 ||
tasyādhastāt smarenmantrī ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ mahat | tasmin sañcintayeddevīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ manoharām || 9-1100 ||
bālārkadyutimindukhaṇḍavilasatkoṭīrahārojjvalāṃ ratnākalpavibhūṣitāṃ kucanatāṃ śālaiḥ karairmañjarīm | padmau kaustubharatnamapyavirataṃ sambibhratīṃ susmitāṃ phullāmbhojavilocanatrayayutāṃ dhyāyet parāṃ devatām || 9-1101 ||
śiñjanmañjīrasaṃśobhipādāmbhojavirājitām | navaratnagaṇākīrṇakāñcīdāmavibhūṣitām || 9-1102 ||
muktāmāṇikyavaidūryasambaddhodarabandhanām | vibhrājamānāṃ madhyena valitritayaśobhitām || 9-1103 ||
jāhnavīsalilāvarttaśobhinābhivibhūṣitām | paṭīrapaṅkakarpūrakuṅkumālaṅkṛtastanīm || 9-1104 ||
vārivāhavinirmuktamuktādāmagarīyasīm | bibhratīmuttarāsaṅgaṃ dukūlaparikalpitam || 9-1105 ||
taptakāñcanasambaddhavaidūryāṅgadabhūṣaṇām | padmarāgasphuratsvarṇakaṅkaṇāḍhyakarāmbujām || 9-1106 ||
māṇikyaśakalābaddhamudrikābhiralaṅkṛtām | taptahāṭakasaṃkḷptamālāgraiveyaśobhitām || 9-1107 ||
vicitravividhākalpāṃ kambusaṃkāśakandharām | udyaddinakarākāramaṇitāṭaṅkamaṇḍitām || 9-1108 ||
ratnāṅkitalasatsvarṇakarṇapūropaśobhitām | japāvidrumalāvaṇyalalitādharapallavām || 9-1109 ||
dāḍimīphalabījābhadantapaṅktivibhūṣitām | kalaṅkakārśyanirmuktaśaraccandranibhānanām || 9-1110 ||
puṇḍarīkadalākāranayanatrayaśobhitām | bhrūlatājitakandarpavarakārmukavibhramām || 9-1111 ||
vikaśattilapuṣpaśrīvijayodyatanāsikām | lalāṭakāntivibhavavijitārdhasudhākarām || 9-1112 ||
sāndrasaurabhasaṃpannakastūrītilakāṅkitām | mattālimālāvilasaddalakāḍhyamukhāmbujām || 9-1113 ||
pārijātaprasūnaśrīvāhidhamillabandhanām | anargharatnaghaṭitamuktāṭaṅkitamastakām || 9-1114 ||
sarvalāvaṇyavasatiṃ bhavanaṃ vibhramaśriyaḥ | tejasāṃ janmabhūmiṃ tāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ vicintayet || 9-1115 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
evaṃ dhyātvā tato devīṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ | bhānulakṣaṃ japenmantrī daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt tilaiḥ || 9-1116 ||
juhuyāt śrīphalaiḥ padmaiḥ pratyekamayutaṃ tataḥ | tarpayet salilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ sugandhairayutadvayam || 9-1117 ||
(merutantre)
japedbhāskaralakṣaṃ ca niyatāśī yatavrataḥ | taddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyādghṛtaistrisvādusaṃyutaiḥ || 9-1118 ||
padmaiḥ ramādrumaphalaiḥ pratyekamayutaṃ hunet | suśītaiḥ śucibhistoyaistarpayedayutadvayam || 9-1119 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
śambhupatnī śriyā ruddhā kamau bhagavatī mahī | brahmā'dityo dharā dīrghā lakāro bhagavān marut || 9-1120 ||
prasīdayugalaṃ bhūyaḥ śrīruddhā bhuvaneśvarī | mahālakṣmī namo'ntaḥ syāt praṇavādirayaṃ manuḥ || 9-1121 ||
saptaviṃśatyakṣarāḍhyaḥ proktaḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥ | kamale hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ śiraḥ syāt kamalālaye || 9-1122 ||
śikhā prasīda tenaiva kavacaṃ caturakṣaraiḥ | astrametaiḥ padaiḥ kuryācchrībījapuṭitaiḥ pṛthak || 9-1123 ||
atha dhyānam |
sindūrāruṇakāntimabjavasatīṃ saundaryavārāṃ nidhiṃ koṭīrāṅgadahārakuṇḍalakaṭīsūtrādibhirbhūṣitām | hastābjairvasupātramabjayugalādarśau vahantīṃ parā (-) māvītāṃ paricārikābhiraniśaṃ dhyāyet priyāṃ śārṅgiṇaḥ || 9-1124 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ japet phalairvilvairjuhuyānmadhurokṣitaiḥ | daśāṃśaṃ saṃskṛte vahnau prākproktenaiva vartmanā || 9-1125 ||
tatrāntare |
mandākṣamindirāruddhaṃ tryakṣaro'yaṃ mahāmanuḥ | hṛdantaḥ pañcavarṇo'sya sarvamekārṇavadbhavet || 9-1126 ||
atha sāmrājyalakṣmīmantraḥ (merutantre)
atha vakṣye gaṇeśena kāśīrājyāptaye mama | śāmbādityasya rakṣodigbhāge lakṣmīrupāsitā || 9-1127 ||
sāmrājyalakṣmīrvikhyātā gatarājyapradāyinī | lakṣmīvināyakastatra prasiddho'sau gajānanaḥ || 9-1128 ||
dakṣiṇenaiva mārgeṇa tasyāḥ siddhirna vāmataḥ | sakāraṃ ca hakāraṃ ca kalarā varṇapañcakam || 9-1129 ||
īkārasvarasaṃyuktaṃ prathamaṃ kūṭamucyate | ha(/) bījaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāt prokto'yaṃ dvyakṣarī manuḥ || 9-1130 ||
ṛṣirhariśca gāyatrī chando lakṣmiśca mohinī | sāmrājyadā devatoktā kūṭaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam || 9-1131 ||
śaktiḥ śrī(/) ca ṣaḍaṅgāni ṣaḍbhirdīrghaiḥ samācaret |
atha dhyānam |
ataśīpuṣpasaṃkāśāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 9-1132 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgabāṇadharāṃ karaiḥ | ṣaḍbhiḥ karābhyāṃ deveśīṃ varadābhayaśobhitām || 9-1133 ||
evamaṣṭabhujāṃ dhyātvā trilakṣaṃ prajapet sudhīḥ | taddaśāṃśena padmaistu hunet sāmrājyasiddhaye || 9-1134 ||
evamārādhayellakṣmīṃ sāmrājyaṃ syādasaṃśayam |
nārāyaṇamantrastu tatprakaraṇa evoktaḥ |
iti lakṣmīvidyāprakaraṇam |
atha nīlakramādayaḥ |
(śaktisaṅgamavīratantrasārasaṃgraheṣu)
devyuvāca |
deveśa śrotumicchāmi rahasyātirahasyakam || 9-1135 ||
daśānāmapi vidyānāṃ daśa vai ye kramāḥ prabho | puraiva kathitāḥ svāmi(/)stān kramān vada saṃprati || 9-1136 ||
śiva uvāca
rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca kathyate tava bhaktitaḥ | mahānīlakrameṇaiva kālikā siddhidāyinī || 9-1137 ||
mahānīlakramo devi dvividhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | sakalo niṣkalaśceti taṃ kramaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 9-1138 ||
khaḍgahastaḥ śironyastaḥ sarvadā muktakuntalaḥ | sadā māṃsāsavollāsī vijayāghūrṇalocanaḥ || 9-1139 ||
sindūratilakaṃ bhāle pāṇau tu madirārasam | rātrau paryaṭanaṃ caiva rātrau śakteḥ prapūjanam || 9-1140 ||
yonicumbanakaṃ karma śakterāliṅganaṃ tathā | na karoti naro yastu sa kathaṃ tava pūjakaḥ || 9-1141 ||
tāmbūlayonicakraṃ ca muṇḍamālāṃ śavāsanam | sindūraṃ khaḍgakaṃ caiva saṃvidāsavayo rasam || 9-1142 ||
etān vihāya yaḥ kaścit kālīṃ sādhitumudyataḥ | iha kṣobhamavāpnoti paratra narakaṃ vrajet || 9-1143 ||
koṭyarbudayugairdevi na hi sidhyati kālikā | sindūravindurbhrūmadhye svayambhūmunipatrakam || 9-1144 ||
raktacandanakaṃ vā'pi tripuṇḍraṃ ca tatopari | kurvan dale kajjalasya vindurdeyo maheśvari || 9-1145 ||
mahānīlakrame devi tilakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | śmaśānaśāyī māṃsāśī saṃvidānandamānasaḥ || 9-1146 ||
striyaṃ paśyan spṛśan gacchan sarvakālaṃ japaṃ caret | veśyārataḥ śmaśānastho mṛducūḍakasaṃyutaḥ || 9-1147 ||
dantākṣamālayā devi gajadantena meruṇā | mālāṃ kṛtvā japeddevi sadā tāmbūlacarvakaḥ || 9-1148 ||
kapālamālābharaṇo rāmācumbanatatparaḥ |
śaktyānando netrayuge mukhe hālā gṛhāṅgaṇe || 9-1149 ||
veśyā bālākare mālā śaktilīlā bhagāmbuje | yonisañcumbanaṃ kṛtvā sarvakāle japaṃ caret || 9-1150 ||
śakterbhargaṃ namaskāryaṃ sarvametaccarācaram | adhikārī prahṛṣṭātmā strībhakto vijitendriyaḥ || 9-1151 ||
īdṛgvidho naro devi mahānīlakramo mataḥ | rājadantamayī mālā dviradoṣṭrāśvasambhavā || 9-1152 ||
aśaktānāṃ niṣkalaḥ syāt taṃ kramaṃ śṛṇu pārvati | pītāyā dugdhakaṃ pitvā saccidāndamānasaḥ || 9-1153 ||
sphāṭikīṃ mālikāṃ kṛtvā vihāre japamācaret | dikkālaniyamo nāsti sthityādiniyamo na ca || 9-1154 ||
na jape kālaniyamo mahāmantrasya sādhane | yasmin mantre ya ācārastatra dharmastu tādṛśaḥ || 9-1155 ||
bhrāntistatra na kartavyā svargo vā mokṣa eva vā | mṛdu komalakaṃ devi cūḍakaṃ vā'pyacūḍakam || 9-1156 ||
śavaṃ vīrāsanaṃ kṛtvā yonitvagāsanaṃ ca vā | kāmarūpāsanaṃ devi suratāsanameva ca || 9-1157 ||
sindūrāsanakaṃ devi parvatāsanameva ca | prayogāsanakaṃ devi mahāprayogāsanaṃ tathā || 9-1158 ||
śrīmuṇḍasurataṃ vā'pi śrīvīrasurataṃ ca vā | pañcavīrāsanaṃ devi surendrādidiśāṃ kramāt || 9-1159 ||
iti nīlakramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
deveśa śrotumicchāmi mahācīnakramaṃ param |
śiva uvāca |
mahācīnakramo devi kathyate sāṃprataṃ mayā || 9-1160 ||
mahācīnakrameṇaiva tārā śīghraphalapradā | brahmacīno vīracīno divyacīnastṛtīyakaḥ || 9-1161 ||
mahācīno niṣkalaśca cīnaḥ pañcavidho mataḥ | mahācīnakramo devi dvividhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 9-1162 ||
sakalo niṣkalaśceti sakalo bauddhagocaraḥ | niṣkalo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 9-1163 ||
tathā |
snānādi mānasaṃ śaucaṃ mānasaḥ pravaro japaḥ | pūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ tarpaṇādikam || 9-1164 ||
mānaso niyamaḥ prokto mānasaṃ dantadhāvanam | sarva eva śubhaḥ kālo nāśubho vidyate kva cit || 9-1165 ||
na viśeṣo divā rātrau na sandhyāyāṃ mahāniśi | śuddhiṃ na kārayedatra nirvikalpaṃ manaścaret || 9-1166 ||
nātra śuddherapekṣā'sti na cāmedhyādi dūṣaṇam | ya evaṃ cintayenmantraṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhidam || 9-1167 ||
gadyapadyamayī vāṇī sabhāyāṃ tasya jāyate | tasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhā matāḥ || 9-1168 ||
rājāno'pi ca dāsatvaṃ bhajante kiṃ pare janāḥ | sarvadā pūjayeddevīmasnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥ || 9-1169 ||
mahāniśyaśucau deśe baliṃ mantreṇa dāpayet | strīdveṣo naiva kartavyo viśeṣāt pūjanaṃ striyaḥ || 9-1170 ||
japasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhve japaṃ caret | striyaṃ gacchan spṛśan paśyan yatra kutrāpyacūḍake || 9-1171 ||
bhuktvā tāmbūlamanyā(/)śca bhakṣyadravyān yathāruci | māṃsaṃ matsyaṃ dadhi kṣaudraṃ saṃvidāsavayo rasam || 9-1172 ||
bhojyānyaśeṣabhakṣyāṇi datvā bhuktvā'carejjapam | dikkālaniyamo nāsti sthityādiniyamo na ca || 9-1173 ||
na jape kālaniyamo nārcādiṣu valiṣvapi | svecchāniyama ukto'tra mahāmantrasya sādhane || 9-1174 ||
vastrāsanaṃ gehadehasparśāsparśādivāriṇā | tailaṃ saṃlāpya deveśi tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣayan sadā || 9-1175 ||
nānāmbarāṇi sandhārya dehaṃ vastreṇa mārjayet | evaṃ snānaṃ careddevi sarvadā tadgatāśayaḥ || 9-1176 ||
keśān saṃbardhayeddevi sarvadā tailabhūṣitaḥ | nādharmo vidyate subhru kiṃ tu dharmo mahān bhavet || 9-1177 ||
svecchācāro'tra kathitaḥ pracareddhṛṣṭamānasaḥ | kṛtārthamanyamānastu santoṣya nijamānasam || 9-1178 ||
harernāma na gṛhnīyānna spṛśet tulasīdalam | varjayedbilvapatraṃ ca maruṃ yatnena varjayet || 9-1179 ||
nānyacintā prakartavyā nānyanindā kadācana | nānyamantraṃ japeddevi nirvikalpaḥ sadā bhavet || 9-1180 ||
sadyo madyaṃ piveddevi mātaṅgībhirvihāravān | yoniṃ cumbā(/)llihan paśyan japaṃ kuryādananyadhīḥ || 9-1181 ||
yanau vicintya japtavyaṃ siddhirvatsaramātrataḥ | anyathā naiva siddhiḥ syāt prajaptairapi koṭibhiḥ || 9-1182 ||
puraścaraṇalakṣaiśca homādīnāṃ ca koṭibhiḥ | bhrūyugme kuntale devi sindūraṃ tadanantaram || 9-1183 ||
kucandanaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca paṅkajaṃ vā sakeśaram | muṇḍamālā gale dhāryā kapālaṃ pāṇisaṅgatam || 9-1184 ||
ityācāraparo nityaṃ mahācīnakramī bhavet | karṇanetrāntarastho yo mahāśaṅkhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 9-1185 ||
pañcāśanmaṇibhirmālā gonarebhāsthisambhavā | mālāṃ kuryānmaheśāni cāṣṭasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 9-1186 ||
saiva tārā maheśāni nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | yasmin mantre ya ācārastatra dharmastu tādṛśaḥ || 9-1187 ||
kṛtārthastena jāyeta svargo vā mokṣa eva vā |
(svacchandabhairavatantre)
na śaucādikriyāḥ kāryāḥ smṛtiśāstrapracoditāḥ || 9-1188 ||
ekā liṅge gude pañca ityādyā yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | na tāḥ kāryāḥ sādhakendraiḥ yadīccheccirajīvitam || 9-1189 ||
(siddhāntasaṃgrahe'pi)
na deśakālaniyamo bhakṣyādiniyamo na hi | śaucādiniyamo nāsti mahāmantrasya sādhane || 9-1190 ||
divase vā tathā rātrau rātriśeṣe niśāmukhe | māṃsaṃ bhuktvā'savaṃ pītvā striyaṃ gatvā carejjapam || 9-1191 ||
(śaktisaṅgame)
sakalastu mayā prokto niṣkalaṃ śṛṇu pārvati |
maṇibandhādadhaḥ pāṇiṃ pādau gulphādadhaḥ śive || 9-1192 ||
mukhaṃ prakṣālayeddevi cīnasnānamidaṃ bhavet | jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā bhūmau mastakamānayet || 9-1193 ||
cīnamārge namaskāraḥ kīrtitastu mayā tava | pūrvakramasya deveśi kramaḥ pratinidhirmayā || 9-1194 ||
snānadānādikaṃ kṛtvā tathā pūjādikaṃ priye | tathā mlāno na me deho na ca pāpaṃ mamāsti vai || 9-1195 ||
kiṃ snānāṃ kasyacit snānamasnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥ | sarvameva hṛdambhoje mayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 9-1196 ||
mayi jātā mantrasiddhirmama devā varapradāḥ | tejorūpaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tāriṇī tatsvarūpadhṛk || 9-1197 ||
tattejasā svasthadehaṃ saṃbhāvya japamācaret | bhāvanāvaśamāpanno bhavedyogī mahākaviḥ || 9-1198 ||
guḍārdrakarasenaiva surā tu brāhmaṇasya ca | tadabhāve jalaṃ devi saṃbhāvya pūjanaṃ caret || 9-1199 ||
tadbhāvahṛdayāsannaḥ sadā tadgatamānasaḥ | dvandvabhāvaṃ parityajya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 9-1200 ||
brahmā caiva vaśiṣṭhaśca tathā'nye ca ṛṣīśvarāḥ | niṣkalakramamārgeṇa bhajanti satataṃ śive || 9-1201 ||
tārābhaktā maheśāni brāhmaṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | brahmavidyā mahāvidyā sarvatra durlabhā kalau || 9-1202 ||
rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca goptavyaṃ paśusaṃkaṭe |
iti mahācīnakramaḥ |
atha divyacīnakramastatraiva | devyuvāca |
chinnamastāvidhau devi kramaṃ me brūhi satvaram || 9-1203 ||
śiva uvāca
divyacīnakrameṇaiva chinnamastā varapradā | kramadvayaṃ maheśāni pūrvameva prakāśitam || 9-1204 ||
etasyāstilako devi bhrūmadhye ca kucandanam | tadante rocanāpatraistripuṇḍraṃ divyavarṇakaiḥ || 9-1205 ||
śmaśānabhasmavinduṃ tu tanmadhye dāpayet priye | mukhe mukhaṃ pradatvā tu sarvakālaṃ japecchive || 9-1206 ||
yonicakraṃ samālokya yat kiṃcit kurute naraḥ | tat tadakṣayamāpnoti chinnāvidyāprasādataḥ || 9-1207 ||
dikkālaniyamo nāsti sthityādiniyamo na hi | pātāle kuhare durge parvate taṭinītaṭe || 9-1208 ||
antarikṣe tathā bhūmau sarvatra japamācaret | viśeṣaḥ kathito devi śaktitattvasya pālakaḥ || 9-1209 ||
iti divyacīnakramaḥ |
atha gandharvakramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
gandharvākhyaṃ kramaṃ deva kathayasva mayi prabho |
śiva uvāca |
gandharvākhyakrameṇaiva sundarī siddhidāyinī || 9-1210 ||
gandharvākhyakramo devi kathyate śṛṇu sāmpratam | bhrūmadhye kuṅkumaṃ devi tanmadhye mālayāguru || 9-1211 ||
aṣṭagandhatripuṇḍrasya madhye kastūrikānvitam | sugandhiśvetalauhityapuṣpaiḥ saṃbhūṣito naraḥ || 9-1212 ||
aṣṭagandhasya dhūpena nānāsaugandhyabhūṣitaḥ | raktamālyāmbaradharo muktāhāropaśobhitaḥ || 9-1213 ||
pūrṇābhiṣikte śirasi tena tatra na muṇḍanam | sadā coṣṇodakaiḥ snāyāt tadabhāve yathodakaiḥ || 9-1214 ||
gṛhaṃ citraistu saṃcitraṃ darpaṇodarasannibham | vitānadhvajabhūṣāḍhyaṃ ghaṇṭānādopaśobhitam || 9-1215 ||
pañcavāditrasaṃyuktaṃ nānāghoṣasamanvitam | antaḥsūkṣmāmbarairyuktaṃ svarṇapātrādirañjitam || 9-1216 ||
graiveyavalayāṅgulyabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitaḥ sadā | nānāmadhurabhojyaiśca dugdhapānairanekakaiḥ || 9-1217 ||
nānābhogena yukto'yaṃ gandharvākhyakramo bhavet |
iti gandharvakramaḥ |
atha bhairavakramaḥ |
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ bhairavākhyaṃ śṛṇu kramam || 9-1218 ||
svapuṣpakramayogena bhairavī bhuvi durlabhā | svapuṣpākhyakramo devi kathyate śṛṇu sāmpratam || 9-1219 ||
taruṇīṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ tāruṇyāmṛtavigrahām | sadā rate sābhilāṣāṃ maithunodyatamānasām || 9-1220 ||
mantrayantrasamāyuktāṃ samānīya maheśvari | nagnāṃ tāṃ ca vidhāyādau svayaṃ nagno japaṃ caret || 9-1221 ||
parasparālokanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ ca parasparam |
avikārī yadā devi sādhanārho na cānyathā || 9-1222 ||
vikāre bhāvamāne ca sādhako naśyati kṣaṇāt | sā'pi ceddevadeveśi savikārā yadā bhavet || 9-1223 ||
puṣpiṇīmanunā devi balāt puṣpaṃ samānayet | drāviṇīmanunā devi balāddṛṣṭyā dravaṃ nayet || 9-1224 ||
kelidoṣavaśāddevi nāyaṃ yogo bhaviṣyati | tasmāt pāśavakalpena bālā śastā'dhunā śive || 9-1225 ||
bālāyāmubhayācāro dakṣiṇo mukhya eva hi |
tathā |
śīghraṃ ca siddhikāmaścedgavākṣaṃ yogamabhyaset || 9-1226 ||
yatra strīṇāṃ samūho'sti nadīnadasamudrake | yatra snānaṃ prakurvanti gavākṣaṃ tatra kārayet || 9-1227 ||
tamālokya prayatnena japaṃ kuryānnirantaram | iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ tilakaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 9-1228 ||
vāmahastatale yantraṃ vilikhya yatnataḥ śive | aviśiṣṭena tilakaṃ kārayet parameśvari || 9-1229 ||
bhāle kastūrikāvinduṃ munipatraṃ kucandam | tanmadhye śvetavinduṃ ca keśādipūrvavadbhavet || 9-1230 ||
daśavidyāvidhau devi keśavardhanamīritam ||
iti bhairavakramaḥ |
atha kamalākramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
deveśa śrotumicchāmi kamalākramanirṇayam || 9-1231 ||
śiva uvāca |
bhrūmadhye ghusṛṇaṃ devi sindūraṃ tadanantaram |
śvetaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ deveśi tanmadhye keśaraṃ śive || 9-1232 ||
snātaḥ śuklāmbaradharastrīsandhyaṃ snānamācaret | haviṣyāśī bhūmiśāyī madhurānnapriyo naraḥ || 9-1233 ||
bhṛguvāsaraparyantaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhṛguvāsaram | pratyahaṃ pūjayed devi nānāvāditranisvanaiḥ || 9-1234 ||
dinaṣoḍaśaparyantaṃ pratyahaṃ tu samācaret | punastaddinamārabhya taddināntaṃ maheśvari || 9-1235 ||
pūjayet prayato nityaṃ devatābhāvatatparaḥ | pradakṣiṇā prakartavyā kalābhāvakrameṇa ca || 9-1236 ||
dīpāstatra pradātavyāḥ kalāvṛddhikrameṇa ca | brahmaṇān bhojayennityaṃ kalābhāvakrameṇa ca || 9-1237 ||
ityācāraparaḥ śrīmān viṣṇurūpo naro bhavet | rājacihnāni sarvāṇi prayataḥ pūjayet sadā || 9-1238 ||
sarvasāmrājyalakṣmyāstu nātho bhūyānna saṃśayaḥ | dhanadā tasya gehasthā rājā ca kiṅkaro bhavet || 9-1239 ||
iti kamalākramaḥ |
atha brahmamārgakramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
deveśa śrotumicchāmi brahmamārgakramaṃ śiva |
śiva uvāca |
veśyāyāḥ kajjalaṃ deyaṃ sindūreṇa tripuṇḍrakam | haridrā bhrūyuge deyā śvetapatraṃ samācaret || 9-1240 ||
raktavinduṃ ca tanmadhye sarvadā tadgato bhavet | bhojane śayane rātrau maithunaṃ sarvadā bhavet || 9-1241 ||
ucchiṣṭahasto deveśi ucchiṣṭena valiṃ haret | śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ parocchiṣṭaṃ bhojanaṃ sārvakālikam || 9-1242 ||
japaṃ kuryānmaheśāni rātrāveva japaṃ caret | tāmbūlabhakṣī māṃsāśī bhuktvā cārcāṃ ca kārayet || 9-1243 ||
ucchiṣṭahastaḥ prajapedbrahmamārgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
iti brahmamārgakramaḥ |
atha mahārājakramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
mahārājakramaṃ deva kathayasva mama prabho || 9-1244 ||
śiva uvāca |
mahārājakramo devi kathyate śṛṇu sāmpratam | nānāvicitrasopānamaṇḍite citramaṇḍape || 9-1245 ||
saudhāṭṭālakasaṃśobhivitānadhvajaśobhite | nānopavanasaṃyukte haṃsamāyūraśobhite || 9-1246 ||
nānāvicitraśabdena gajavājivirājite | sarvato bhadrasaṃyukte nānābharaṇabhūṣite || 9-1247 ||
dhūpāmodasamāyukte citradīpairalaṅkṛte | ratnasiṃhāsane ramye ratnābharaṇabhūṣite || 9-1248 ||
jātīcampakapunnāgaketakīgandhaśobhite | karpūrāgurukastūrīrocanākuṅkumairyute || 9-1249 ||
jaṭāmāṃsyādisaugandhalepanaiḥ paribhūṣitaḥ | ghaṇṭādinādasaṃyuktaḥ sarvadā śuddhamānasaḥ || 9-1250 ||
ānandamagnahṛdayo divyavastrairalaṅkṛtaḥ | divyamālāmbaradharo divyabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ || 9-1251 ||
tāmbūlapūrṇavadano devendra iva rājitaḥ | vedapātrairnṛtyapātrairbhogapātrairnināditaḥ || 9-1252 ||
nṛtyagītaiśca vāditraiścaturviṃśativādakaiḥ | saṅgītarāgatālaiśca dhvanibhiśca nināditaḥ || 9-1253 ||
nānādeśīyabhāṣābhirgadyapadyairalaṅkṛtaḥ | nānāvicitrabhūṣābhirbhūṣitaḥ sādhakottamaḥ || 9-1254 ||
samastarājacaryābhirmohayanrājanāyikāḥ | śrīmahārājamātaṅgī sarvadevapramohinī || 9-1255 ||
tasyāstu tilakaṃ devi kathyate śṛṇu pārvati | kucandanaṃ ca bhrūmadhye gurusārastadantare || 9-1256 ||
kastūrikātripuṇḍraṃ ca tanmadhye keśaraṃ śive | mahārājakramo devi kathitastu mayā tava || 9-1257 ||
atha vā devadeveśi svayaṃ gānaparo bhavet |
iti mahārājakramaḥ |
atha divyabhāvakramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
vada śrībhuvaneśānyāḥ kramaṃ paramadurlabham || 9-1258 ||
śiva uvāca |
divyabhāvakrameṇaiva bhuvanā śīghrasiddhidā | hakāraḥ śivarūpaḥ syādrakāraḥ pāpanāśakaḥ || 9-1259 ||
īkāraḥ kāmarūpaḥ syānmāyā tena prakīrtitā | brahmāṇḍametaddeveśi māyayā veṣṭitaṃ bhavet || 9-1260 ||
yasyā māyāṃ vinā devi na kiñcit pratibhāsate | yadbhāsarahitaṃ kiñcinna ca tadbhāsate kvacit || 9-1261 ||
yadbhāsāsahitaṃ devi jagadetat prabhāsate | yāṃ vinā tu maheśāni jagajjaḍasamaṃ bhavet || 9-1262 ||
evaṃ krameṇa deveśi sadā tadgatamānasaḥ | trailokyavijayī bhūyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 9-1263 ||
etasyāstilakaṃ devi kathyate yatnataḥ śṛṇu | śvetacandanavinduṃ tu bhrūmadhye tu pralāpayet || 9-1264 ||
gandhasāraṃ tadante syāt tripuṇḍraṃ divyavarṇakaiḥ | raktākṣatā(/)śca tanmadhye tena siddhīśvaro bhavet || 9-1265 ||
iti divyabhāvakramaḥ |
atha dhūmrakramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
deveśa śrotumicchāmi dhūmāvatyāḥ kramaṃ śiva |
śiva uvāca |
dhūmāvatyāḥ kramo devi kathyate śṛṇu pārvati || 9-1266 ||
bhrūmadhye kajjalaṃ devi bhasmavindustadantare | tripuṇḍraṃ ca lalāṭe syācchavabhasma tadantare || 9-1267 ||
kṛṣṇavastrāmbaradharaḥ kṛṣṇagandhavibhūṣitaḥ | gandhapuṣpeṇa saṃyuktaḥ śmaśānāsanasaṅgataḥ || 9-1268 ||
dhūmravarṇaṃ jagat sarvaṃ mantrī dhūmramayo bhavet | kākapicchaṃ cāsanaṃ syāt kṛṣṇadravyaṃ pradhārayet || 9-1269 ||
brahmacārī mitāhārī nirvikalpo jitendriyaḥ | satyavādī dṛḍhācāro bhūśāyī kuśaviṣṭaraḥ || 9-1270 ||
snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ kuryāduccāṭanaparāyaṇaḥ | svacittaṃ kākavat kṛtvā jagaduccāṭayeddhruvam || 9-1271 ||
ityācāraparo bhūyāddhūmrakramagato bhavet |
iti dhūmrakramaḥ |
atha saubhāgyakramastatraiva |
saubhāgyārcākrameṇaiva vagalā śīghrasiddhidā || 9-1272 ||
pītāmbaradharo mantrī pītabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | pītamālyāmbaradharaḥ pītagehe samāsthitaḥ || 9-1273 ||
pītadravyopabhogī ca pītāsanasamanvitaḥ | pītahomo pītapuṣpī pītasaktisamanvitaḥ || 9-1274 ||
rocanāṃ bhruvi saṃdadyāt kuṅkumaṃ munipatrakam | haridrayā tripuṇḍraṃ ca tanmadhye khādiraṃ śive || 9-1275 ||
haricandanadhūpena dhūpitaḥ parameśvari | sarvāṅgasundarīṃ ramyāṃ sarvāvayavaśobhitām || 9-1276 ||
naboḍhāṃ puṣpiṇīṃ caiva prārthayedviprakanyakām | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kumārikām || 9-1277 ||
atha vā bhaumavāre vā niśāyāṃ bhṛguvāsare | suvāsitena tailena kuryādabhyañjanaṃ tathā || 9-1278 ||
tūlikātalpamānīya āstīryodaṅmukhastadā | tasyopari samāstīrya samantrairjāticampakaiḥ || 9-1279 ||
karpūraṃ caiva kastūrīmiśritaṃ candanaṃ tathā | sarvāṅge lepanaṃ kuryāllakṣmīsūktena buddhimān || 9-1280 ||
paryaṅkopari tāṃ kanyā candanena vilepitām | dhruvādyairiti mantreṇa kanyāṃ dakṣiṇato mukhī || 9-1281 ||
unmukhīṃ śayane kuryācchrīsūktena kumārikām |
tasyāḥ pādau prasāryātha guptenārcanamācaret || 9-1282 ||
nyastvā ṣoḍhādvayaṃ caiva vagalāpañcakaṃ nyaset | kanyāṃ caiva nyaseddevaṃ tattadaṅgāni saṃsmaret || 9-1283 ||
ananyajapuraṃ caiva mārjayenmūlavidyayā | gandhadvāreti mantreṇa kuryāt kastūrilepanam || 9-1284 ||
mūlamantreṇa caitanyapuṣpamālāṃ samarpayet | nivedayeddravyaśuddhiṃ tataśca japamācaret || 9-1285 ||
prayogaḥ siddhidaḥ puṃsāṃ mantrasiddhikaraḥ paraḥ | etatkramaṃ vinā devi prayogo na bhavet kvacit || 9-1286 ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena siddhyarthī devi bhūtale | abhimānāṣṭakaṃ tyaktvā tyaktvā vai dūṣaṇatrayam || 9-1287 ||
tyaktvā pañcendriyāsaktiṃ saubhāgyakramamācaret |
iti saubhāgyakramaḥ |
atha divyavīrapaśubhāvāḥ |
(bhāvacūḍāmaṇau)
devyuvāca |
bhāvastu trividho deva divyavīrapaśukramāt || 9-1288 ||
guravastrividhāścātra tathaiva mantradevatāḥ | śaktimantro mahādeva viśeṣānmantrasiddhidaḥ || 9-1289 ||
ādyabhāvo mahādeva śreyān sarvasamṛddhidaḥ | dvitīyo madhyamaścaiva tṛtīyaḥ sarvaninditaḥ || 9-1290 ||
sarvanindita iti brāhmaṇetaraviṣayaḥ | brāhmaṇasya tu paśubhāvānyabhāvaśrayaṇe nindāśravaṇāt |
tathā |
lakṣajāpāt tathā homāt kāyakleśādivistaraiḥ |
na bhāvena vinā deva tantramantrāḥ phalapradāḥ || 9-1291 ||
kiṃ vīrasādhanenaiva viśvadṛṣṭikulākulaiḥ | kiṃ pīṭhapūjanenaiva kiṃ kanyābhojanādibhiḥ || 9-1292 ||
svayoṣitprītidānena kiṃ pareṣāṃ tathaiva ca | kiṃ jitendriyabhāvena kiṃ kulācārakarmaṇā || 9-1293 ||
yadi bhāvaviśuddhātmā na syāt kulaparāyaṇaḥ | bhāvena labhate muktiṃ bhāvena kulavardhanam || 9-1294 ||
bhāvena kulavṛddhiḥ syādbhāvena kulaśobhanam | kiṃ nyāsavistareṇaiva kiṃ tattacchuddhivistaraiḥ || 9-1295 ||
kiṃ tathā pūjanenaiva yadi bhāvo na jāyate | kena vā pūjyate vidyā na cet kena na japyate || 9-1296 ||
phalābhāvaśca deveśa bhāvābhāvāt prajāyate |
tathā |
prathamo divyabhāvastu kathyate śṛṇu sādaram || 9-1297 ||
yadvarṇadevatā yatra tattejaḥpuñjapūritam | tejomayaṃ jagat sarvaṃ vibhāvya mūrtikalpanam || 9-1298 ||
tattanmūrtimaye mantre svena svenaiva vā punaḥ | ātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhāvaṃ tathaiva ca || 9-1299 ||
tatsarvaṃ yoṣiti dhyātvā cintayedyatamānasaḥ | aśeṣakulasaṃpannā nānājātisamudbhavā || 9-1300 ||
nānādeśodbhavā vā'pi guṇalāvaṇyasaṃyutā | dvitīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ yāvat syādaṣṭamābdakam || 9-1301 ||
tāvat kumārī vijñeyā mantrayantraphalapradā | kumārīpajanāccaiva kumārībhojanādapi || 9-1302 ||
ekadvitryādibījānāṃ phaladā nātra saṃśayaḥ | tābhyaḥ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vā'pi anulepādikaṃ tathā || 9-1303 ||
valipriyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ datvā tadbhāvapūritaḥ | datvā tadaṅga ātmānaṃ valibhāve viceṣṭitam || 9-1304 ||
tābhiḥ prāyaḥ kathālāpaṃ krīḍākautūhalādikam | yathātathaṃ tatpriyakṛt kṛtvā siddhīśvaro bhavet || 9-1305 ||
tasmāt ṣoḍaśaparyantaṃ yuvatīti pravakṣyate | tatra bhāvaprakāśaścet sadbhāvaḥ paramo mataḥ || 9-1306 ||
rakṣitavyāḥ prayatnena akṣatāstā na kārayet | eṣa te kathito deva divyabhāvaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || 9-1307 ||
na deyo yasya kasyāpi paśorgopyaḥ prayatnataḥ |
iti divyabhāvaḥ |
atha vīrabhāvastatraiva |
devyuvāca |
vīrabhāvo mahādeva kathyate śṛṇu bhairava || 9-1308 ||
nirdvandvamānaso bhūtvā hṛdā kāmakalā tanuḥ | niśāsu pūjā pravarā hetuyuktā tathaiva hi || 9-1309 ||
nijaṃ kulaṃ samādhāya svayaṃ bhairavarūpadhṛk | kulaṃ ca bhairavīrūpaṃ tadgātre nyāsavistaram || 9-1310 ||
vinyaset kevalaṃ nyāsaṃ navayonyātmakaṃ tathā |
navayonyatmakamiti śrīvidyāparam |
prasūnatūlikāmadhye puṣpaprakarasaṃyute || 9-1311 ||
nānāgandhasamākīrṇe kuladravyeṇa yantrakam | likhitvā pūjayecchaktau ghaṭasthāpanapūrvakam || 9-1312 ||
svavāmabhāge ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye brahmarandhrakam | likhitvā tatra kumbhaṃ vai sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā || 9-1313 ||
tāmraṃ bhūmimayaṃ vā'pi mahālohavivarjitam | sthāpayet kalaśādhāraṃ kumbhaṃ sugandhivāsitam || 9-1314 ||
hetudravyaṃ brāhmaṇādibhedataḥ saṃprapūrayet |
brāhmaṇādibhedata iti kṣīrājyamadhvāsavarūpaṃ brāhmaṇādibhiḥ pūraṇīyamityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca vīrabrāhmaṇasya hetusthāne kṣīrameva ca | paśostu tadapi neti bodhyam |
tatra yantraṃ vilikhyādau yadyat kulasamudbhavam || 9-1315 ||
dhyātveṣṭadevatāṃ tatra japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | dhenuyonī pradarśyātha prasṛtaṃ tadviceṣṭitam || 9-1316 ||
dṛṣṭvā'mṛtaṃ svapātraṃ vai nṛtyanti yoginīgaṇāḥ | nṛtyanti bhairavāḥ sarve nṛtyanti mātaro'pi ca || 9-1317 ||
indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve nṛtyanti madhulolupāḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā nṛtyanti harṣatatparāḥ || 9-1318 ||
arghabhāṇḍaṃ tridhā kṛtvā gurave caikabhāgakam | evaṃ kulāya vai dattvā ekena devatarpaṇam || 9-1319 ||
pītvā kularasaṃ nānāvastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇam | sākṣādyadi gururna syāt tadā toye visarjayet || 9-1320 ||
ānandarūpavān bhūtvā pūjayet parameśvarīm | tattatkalpavidhānena tattadyatnena pūjayet || 9-1321 ||
visarjanaṃ vidhāyānte svakule yojayet tataḥ | tadvimbarasapānena amṛtaṃ bhakṣyate mayā || 9-1322 ||
taccakorarasāsvāde sammado mama jāyate | tatphalagrahaṇādeva meruśṛṅgāvarohaṇam || 9-1323 ||
latāliṅganamātreṇa sudhādhautakalevaraḥ | mūlayoge kṛte tatra japedaṣṭasahasrakam || 9-1324 ||
nityajāpye ca home ca yatra saṅkhyā na coditā | tatreyaṃ gaṇanā proktā aṣṭottarasahasrakam || 9-1325 ||
jalapūtaṃ havirdravyaṃ gṛhītvā tarpayet tataḥ | vidhāya tarpaṇaṃ deva pradakṣiṇamanuvrajet || 9-1326 ||
stutvā praṇamya kalpoktastavena stāvayet tataḥ | iti vīrakulaṃ deva devavandyaṃ manoharam || 9-1327 ||
(kālīkalpe)
rātrau paryaṭanaṃ caiva rātrau śaktiṃ prapūjayet | akṛtvā kathamīśāna madbhaktaḥ kauliko bhavet || 9- 1328 ||
(merutantre)
kulaṃ tu gopayeddevi nārikelarasāmbuvat | guruṃ prakāśayeddhīmān mantraṃ yatnena gopayet || 9-1329 ||
(kulārṇāve)
vedaśāstrapurāṇāni spaṣṭā veśyāṅganā iva | iyaṃ tu śāmbhavī vidyā guptā kulavadhūriva || 9-1330 ||
suguptaṃ kaulikācāramanugṛhṇanti devatāḥ | vāñchāsiddhiṃ prayacchanti nāśayanti prakāśanāt || 9-1331 ||
(merau)
na divā sevayennārīṃ tadyoniṃ na nirīkṣayet | striyaṃ śatāparādhāṃ vā puṣpeṇāpi na tāḍayet || 9-1332 ||
doṣān na gaṇayet strīṇāṃ guṇāneva prakāśayet |
tathā |
kanyāḥ kumārikā nagnā unmattā api yoṣitaḥ || 9-1333 ||
na nindeta jugupseta na hasennāvamānayet | ekavṛkṣaṃ śmaśānaṃ ca samūhaṃ yoṣitāmapi || 9-1334 ||
nārīṃ ca raktavasanāṃ dṛṣṭvā vandeta bhaktitaḥ |
tathā |
tiṣṭhanti kulayoginyaḥ kulavṛkṣeṣu sarvadā || 9-1335 ||
tatpatreṣu na bhoktavyamarkapatre viśeṣataḥ | na svapet kulavṛkṣādho na copadravamācaret || 9-1336 ||
dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā namaskuryācchedayenna kadācana | śleṣmāntakakarañjārkanimbāśvatthakadambakāḥ || 9-1337 ||
vilvo vaṭo'dumbaraśca ciñcā ceti daśa smṛtāḥ | prāyaścittaṃ bhṛgoḥ pātaṃ sanyāsaṃ vratadhāraṇam || 9-1338 ||
tīrthayātrābhigamanaṃ kaulaḥ pañca vivarjayet |
prāyaścittādikaṃ tantroktabhinnam |
(raudre)
vīrabhāvaṃ maheśāni sarvathā na prakāśayet || 9-1339 ||
(vīracūḍāmaṇau)
pūjākāle maheśāni yadi ko'pyatra gacchati | darśayedveṣṇāvīṃ mudrāṃ viṣṇunyāsaṃ tathā stavam || 9-1340 ||
antaḥ śāktā bahiḥ śaivāḥ sabhāyāṃ vaiṣṇavā matāḥ | nānārūpadharā vīrā vicaranti mahītale || 9-1341 ||
(bhāvacūḍāmaṇau)
yaddeśe vidyate vīrastatkulaṃ vā'pi bhairava | na ca mārībhayaṃ tatra na ca rājabhayādikam || 9-1342 ||
sumaṅgalaṃ sadā tatra dhanaputravivardhanam | lakṣmīstatra mahādeva susthirā bhavati dhruvam || 9-1343 ||
mantraḥ svapnaprabodhinyā avaśyaṃ vṛkṣamūlake | yojanīyaḥ prayatnena na ca vighnaḥ prajāyate || 9-1344 ||
nānyavīrasya tadyogyaṃ grahaṇairdaivatairapi | yoginībhirna luptaṃ ca tanna pāpena lipyate || 9-1345 ||
yatra tatra kuje vāre śmaśānagamane kṛte | pūjāphalaṃ bhavet tatra saptavāsarasammitam || 9-1346 ||
caturdaśyāṃ gate tatra pakṣapūjāphalaṃ bhavet | na gacchennāryataḥ sthāne paśureva na saṃśayaḥ || 9-1347 ||
nāstyasmādadhikaṃ deva iti cintāparāyaṇaḥ | madena dravyabhoktā ca bhavet kulaparāyaṇaḥ || 9-1348 ||
sādhake kṣobhamāpanne mama kṣobhaḥ prajāyate | tasmādyatnādvīravaro bhavedbhogayutaḥ sukhī || 9-1349 ||
bhogena mokṣamāproti bhogena kulasādhanam | vinā hetumanāsvādya kṣobhayukto maheśvara || 9-1350 ||
na pūjā mama saṃparkaṃ na dhyānamanucintanam | tasmādbhuktvā ca pītvā ca pūjayet parameśvarīm || 9-1351 ||
nātra pracyutidoṣo'sti nāparaṃ doṣabhūṣaṇam | yadyadvadati nidrāti yat karoti yadarcati || 9-1352 ||
tatsarvaṃ kularūpaṃ ca dhyātvā ca viharet sukhī | ekākī nirjane deśe śmaśāne parvate vane || 9-1353 ||
śūnyagehe nadītīre niḥsaṅgo viharenmudā | vīrāṇāṃ japakālastu sarvakālaḥ praśasyate || 9-1354 ||
sarvadeśe sarvapīṭhe kartavyaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ |
yadi vipro bhavedbhraṣṭaḥ kuladharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 9-1355 ||
tadā tena vidhānena kartavyaṃ kulatoṣaṇam | aparāpuṣpagarbhe tu kulasthānaṃ manoharam || 9-1356 ||
sarvadevamukhaṃ tatra mahākāmakalātmakam | hayārikusume devaḥ svayamasti sadāśivaḥ || 9-1357 ||
tanmadhye laghumādāya puṣpamadhye tu candanam | raktaṃ vā kusumaṃ datvā dhyātvā'tmānaṃ śivātmakam || 9-1358 ||
yojayecchivaśaktyostu aikyaṃ saṃbhāvayeddhiyā | kṣaṇaṃ vicintya tatraiva saṃpūjya parameśvarīm || 9-1359 ||
japtvā tadeva kuṇḍākhyaṃ dravyaṃ paramadurlabham | yatrāparājitāpuṣpaṃ japāpuṣpaṃ ca bhairava || 9-1360 ||
karavīre raktaśukle droṇapuṣpaṃ ca tiṣṭhati | tatra devī vasennityaṃ tadyantre pūjayenmama || 9-1361 ||
datte caiva japāpuṣpe paṭṭavastraphalaṃ labhet | brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ kṣaṇānnaśyati niścitam || 9-1362 ||
aparāyāstu māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ na hi maheśvara | vīrasādhanakāryaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vīrapūruṣaiḥ || 9-1363 ||
divyairapi ca kartavyaṃ paśubhirna ca pāmaraiḥ | varaṃ pāmarakāryaṃ ca na paśoriti niścitam || 9-1364 ||
yadyanna mat purā proktaṃ saṃketaṃ mantrasādhane | añjanaṃ guṭikādiṃ ca kuryādvīro mahābalaḥ || 9-1365 ||
divye vīre na bhedo'sti yadbhedaṃ tat tu kathyate | śānto vinīto madhuraḥ kalālāvaṇyasaṃyutaḥ || 9-1366 ||
divyastu devavat prāyo vīraścoddhatamānasaḥ |
(kularatnāvalyām)
divyavīrau sureśāni śaktisevāparāyaṇau || 9-1367 ||
vāmikaulikabhedābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ dvividhau smṛtau |
(bhāvacūḍāmaṇau)
vibhūtibhūṣaṇairvā'pi candanairvā vilepitaḥ || 9-1368 ||
ākāragopano vā'pi tyakto vā kulabhairava | raktacandanadigdho vā vaiṣṇavo vā'pyavaiṣṇavaḥ || 9-1369 ||
apamāne tu pūjāyāṃ hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ sadā bhavet | devanindāparo vā'pi tatra pūjāparo'pi vā || 9-1370 ||
pūjā ca tattadrahitaḥ kulākulamate sthitaḥ | nijabhāvasamāyukto devavadvirahet kṣitau || 9-1371 ||
svakulānte puraścaryā kāryā rātrau na cānyathā | vedahīne dvije deva yathā na śrutisaṃkathā || 9-1372 ||
viṣṇubhaktiṃ vinā devībhaktirna prabhavedyathā | śāktajñānaṃ vinā muktau yathā hāsyāya kalpate || 9-1373 ||
guruṃ vinā yathā tantre nādhikāraḥ kathaṃ cana | patihīnā yathā nārī sarvakarmavivarjitā || 9-1374 ||
kulaṃ vinā devavidhau kadā'pi mama sādhane | nādhikārīti kauleya tasmādbhāvaparo bhavet || 9-1375 ||
avinītaṃ kulaṃ yasya sa ka kathaṃ mama pūjakaḥ | tasmādyatnāt tathā kāryaṃ yathā syādvinayānvitam || 9-1376 ||
bhāvābhāve kule śāstre nādhikāraḥ kathaṃ cana | tena bhāvaviśuddhaśca sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavet || 9-1377 ||
iti vīrabhāvakramaḥ |
devyuvāca |
paśubhāvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu vatsa samāhitaḥ | yathāvidhi paśorvidyāṃ gṛhītvā bhāvatatparaḥ || 9-1378 ||
prathamaṃ pūrvasevārthaṃ yatnataḥ śuddhimācaret | namasya bhojanaṃ kuryān na striyaṃ manasā smaret || 9-1379 ||
na paradravyalobhī syānna bhoge mānasaṃ bhajet | sindhutīre parvate vā kānane ca surālaye || 9-1380 ||
vilvamūle vivikte ca puṇyakṣetre ca śobhane | na śūdradarśanaṃ kuryāt kauṭilyaṃ yatnatastyajet || 9-1381 ||
devatā śubhavarṇā tu dhyātavyā susamāhitaiḥ | trisandhyaṃ devapūjā tu trisandhyaṃ japamācaret || 9-1382 ||
rātrau mantraṃ ca mālāśca spṛśennaiva kadā cana | na mantramuccaredbhuktvā maunī syāt sarvakarmasu || 9-1383 ||
parvakāle striyaṃ naiva gacchet sādhakasattamaḥ | puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ jalaṃ caiva svayamānīpa pūjayet || 9-1384 ||
maithunaṃ tatkathālāpaṃ tadgoṣṭhīṃ parivarjayet | ṛtukālaṃ vinā cāpi na gacchet striyamādarāt || 9-1385 ||
purāṇaśravaṇe śraddhā vedavedārthatatparaḥ | na rātrau bhojayedvidvān tāmbūlaṃ parameśvara || 9-1386 ||
guruṇā yadyadādiṣṭaṃ tatsarvaṃ yatnataścaret | svajātakusumaṃ caiva hetudravyaṃ ca bhairava || 9-1387 ||
spṛṣṭvā tathā samāghrāya pañcagavyena śudhyati | raktavastraṃ na gṛhṇīyāddevībhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 9-1388 ||
viṣṇutantreṣu kalyāṇi tadanuṣṭhānameva ca | kāryaṃ vīrakathālāpaṃ na kuryādvīravandite || 9-1389 ||
nityaśrāddhaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ sandhyāvandanameva ca | tīrthasnānaṃ pīṭhadeśagamanaṃ dharmatatparaḥ || 9-1390 ||
(merutantre)
devasthāne gurusthāne śmaśāne ca catuṣpathe | pādukāsanaviṇmūtramaithunāni vivarjayet || 9-1391 ||
pramattāmantyajāṃ kanyāṃ puṣpitāṃ patitastanīm | virūpāṃ vā muktakeśīṃ kāmārtāṃ ca na nindayet || 9-1392 ||
kanyāyonau paśukrīḍāṃ digvastrāṃ prakaṭastanīm | nālokayet paradravyaṃ paradārā(/)śca varjayet || 9-1393 ||
dhānyagogurudevāgnikuśapustakasaṃmukham | naiva prasārayet pādau na caitāni vilaṅghayet || 9-1394 ||
ālasyamadasaṃmohaśāpapaiśūnyavigrahān | asūyāmātmasanmānaṃ parinindāśca varjayet || 9-1395 ||
(bhāvacūḍāmaṇau)
bhāvastu mānaso dharmaḥ śābdaḥ sa hi kathaṃ bhavet | tasmādbhāvo na vaktavyo diṅmātraṃ samudāhṛtam || 9-1396 ||
yathekṣuguḍamādhuryamaśanairjñāyate prabho | tathā bhāvavibhāvastu manasā paribhāvyate || 9-1397 ||
tantrāntare |
uttamo divyabhāvaḥ syādvīrabhāvastu madhyamaḥ | paśubhāvo'varaḥ prokto bhāvamekaṃ samāśrayet || 9-1398 ||
iti paśubhāvakramaḥ |
(siddhāntasaṃgrahe)
saṃpradāyānatho vacmi gauḍakāśmīrakeralān | sarvārthasiddhisaṃkalpapūjāpuṣpārpaṇādanu || 9-1399 ||
naivedyānte ca havanaṃ tāmbūlānte valirmataḥ | pūjanaṃ vāmahastena dakṣahastena tarpaṇam || 9-1400 ||
sākṣāddānaṃ makāraṇe hṛdi devyā visarjanam | gauḍākṣasapradāyo'yaṃ sevito vāmibhiḥ sadā || 9-1401 ||
viniyogādarcanārthaṃ valiḥ pīṭhārcanādanu | homaḥ pañcopacārānte dakṣiṇārcanatarpaṇe || 9-1402 ||
gavyaṃ tu tāmrapātrasthaṃ vāruṇī syādghṛtaṃ vinā | lavaṇārdrakapiṇyākapalāṇḍumāṣapañcakam || 9-1403 ||
laśunaṃ ca mahādevi māṃsapratinidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | matsyābhāve tu kramukaṃ tāmbūlaṃ yadyadāmiṣam || 9-1404 ||
guḍābhāve taṇḍulaṃ vā bharjitaṃ caṇakādikam | vilikhet pañcamābhāve śaktibījaṃ trikoṇakam || 9-1405 ||
vāmorau sādhako raktaṃ candanena vidhānavit | śaktiṃ saṃpūjya tatraiva tadgāyatrīṃ śataṃ japet || 9-1406 ||
svayambhūkusumābhāve raktacandanakaṃ kṣipet | hayārikusumaṃ śambhuḥ śaktiḥ proktā'parājitā || 9-1407 ||
tayoḥ samelanotpannaṃ gṛhṇīyācca kulāmṛtam |
tathā |
tāmre gavyādipiṇyākaṃ gṛñjanaṃ pāyasaṃ payaḥ || 9-1408 ||
ete tattvānukalpāśca sahasrāre visarjanam |
kāśmīrasaṃpradāyo'sau vijñeyaḥ kaulikapriyaḥ || 9-1409 ||
piṇyākaṃ tilakalkaḥ | gṛñjanaṃ laśunam | tathā |
saṅkalpo devatāprītyai tattvānāṃ bhāvanaiva hi | ātmā vidyā śivaḥ sarvaḥ pūrṇaśceti krameṇa ca || 9-1410 ||
pūjā pañcopacārānte pūjānte ca valirbhavet | pūjanaṃ dakṣahastena vāmahastena tarpaṇam || 9-1411 ||
homaḥ samastakarmānte hṛdyevodvāsanaṃ smṛtam | keralāravyaḥ saṃpradāyo munibhiḥ samupāsitaḥ || 9-1412 ||
iti saṃpradāyakramaḥ |
bibhratyadbhutabhūtibhūtapavacovaicitracitrāmṛta (-) srotaḥśālini saṃnibandhanasaritsaṃbhedamabhyarhitam | sanmuktopamayuktibhāji navamo ramyastaraṅgo'gamat sarvorvīpatināthanirmitapuraścaryārṇave'smin nave || 9-1413 ||
[iti śrīmanmahārājadhirājaśrīpratāpasiṃhasāhaviracite puraścaryārṇave daśamahāvidyāpuraścaraṇanirūpaṇaṃ nāma navamastaraṅgaḥ] || 9 ||
atha sarasvatyādimantrāstatpuraścara(-) ṇaviśeṣāśca pradarśyante |
tathā ca (śāradāyām)
adrirvaruṇasaṃruddho davāgvādini ṭhadvayam | vāgīśvaryā daśārṇo'yaṃ mantro vāgvibhavapradaḥ || 10-1 ||
ṛṣiḥ kaṇvo virāṭchando devatā vāk samīritā | śiraḥśravaṇadṛṅnāsāvadanāndhugudeṣvimān || 10-2 ||
nyāsārṇān prāgvadaṅgāni mātṛkoktāni kalpayet |
atha dhyānam |
taruṇaśakalamindorbibhratī śubhrakāntiḥ kucabharanamitāṅgī saṃniṣaṇṇā sitābje || 10-3 ||
nijakarakamalodyallekhanīpustakaśrīḥ sakalavibhavasiddhyai pātu vāgdevatā naḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
daśalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt tataḥ || 10-4 ||
puṇḍarīkaiḥ payo'bhyaktaistilirvā madhurāplutaiḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
hṛdayānte bhagavati vadaśabdayugaṃ tataḥ || 10-5 ||
vāgdevi vahnijāyāntaṃ vāgbhavādyaṃ samuddharet | manuṃ ṣoḍaśavarṇāḍhyaṃ vāgaiśvaryaphalapradam || 10-6 ||
manoḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ padaiḥ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgaṃ jātisaṃyutaiḥ |
atha dhyānam |
śubhrāṃ śubhravilepamālyavasanāṃ śītāṃśukhaṇḍojjvalāṃ
vyākhyāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhyakalaśaṃ vidyāṃ ca hastāmbujaiḥ || 10-7 ||
bibhrāṇāṃ kamalāsanāṃ kucanatāṃ vāgdevatāṃ susmitāṃ vande vāgvibhavapradāṃ trinayanāṃ saubhāgyasampatkarīm |
atha puraścaraṇam |
haviṣyāśī japet samyagvasulakṣamananyadhīḥ || 10-8 ||
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādante tilairājyapariplutaiḥ |
athamantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
tāro māyā dharo vinduḥ śaktistāraṃ sarasvatī || 10-9 ||
ṅentā natyantiko mantraḥ prokta ekādaśākṣaraḥ | brahmarandhre bhruvormadhye navarandhreṣu ca kramāt || 10-10 ||
mantravarṇān nyasenmantrī vāgbhavenāṅgakalpanā |
atha dhyānam |
vāṇīṃ pūrṇaniśākarojjvalamukhīṃ karpūrakundaprabhāṃ candrārdhāṅkitamastakāṃ nijakaraiḥ sambibhratīmādarāt || 10-11 ||
vīṇāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāṭyakalaśaṃ vidyāṃ ca tuṅgastanīṃ divyairābharaṇairvibhūṣitatanuṃ haṃsādhirūḍhāṃ bhaje |
atha puraścaraṇam |
japeddvādaśalakṣāṇi tatsahasraṃ sitāmbujaiḥ || 10-12 ||
nāgacampakapuṣpairvā juhuyāt sādhakottamaḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
vācaspate'mṛte bhūyaḥ pluvaḥ pluveti kīrtayet || 10-13 ||
vāgāḍhyo munibhiḥ prokto rudrasaṅkhyākṣaro manuḥ | kuryādaṅgāni vidhivadvāgādyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ || 10-14 ||
atha dhyānam |
āsīnā kamale karairjapavaṭīṃ padmadvayaṃ pustakaṃ
bibhrāṇā taruṇendubaddhamukuṭā muktendukundaprabhā | bhālonmīlitalocanā kucabharākrāntā bhavadbhūtaye bhūyādvāgadhidevatā munigaṇairāsevyamānā'niśam || 10-15 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
rudralakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥ | mātṛkākalpite pīṭhe pūjayet tāṃ yathā purā || 10-16 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
toyasthaṃ śayanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sakevalacaturmukham | vindvarghīśayuto vahnivindusadyo'mbumān bhṛguḥ || 10-17 ||
uktāni trīṇi bījāni sadbhiḥ sārasvatārthinām | aṅgāni kalpayedvījaidviruktairjātisaṃyutaiḥ || 10-18 ||
atha dhyānam |
muktāhārāvadātāṃ śarasi śaśikalālaṅkṛtāṃ bāhubhiḥ svai (-) rvyākhyāṃ varṇākṣamālāṃ maṇimayakalaśaṃ pustakaṃ codvahantīm | apīnottuṅgavakṣoruhabharavinamanmadhyadeśāmadhīśāṃ vācāmīḍe cirāya tribhuvananamitāṃ puṇḍarīke niṣaṇṇām || 10-19 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
trilakṣaṃ prajapenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ | pāyasenājyasiktena saṃskṛte havyavāhane || 10-20 ||
atha cintāmaṇisarasvatīmantro (merutantre)
athādau saṃpravakṣyāmi cintāmaṇisarasvatīm | tāraṃ māyā ca hasarānaikārāḍhyān savindukān || 10-21 ||
punarmāyāṃ ca tāraṃ ca vadet ṅentāṃ sarasvatīm | hṛdayānto bhavārṇo'yaṃ mantrastu parikīrtitaḥ || 10-22 ||
triṣṭupcchando muniḥ kaṇvaścintāmaṇisarasvatī |
devatā hsai(/) ca bījaṃ syāt hrī(/) śaktistvaṅgakalpane || 10-23 ||
svarasaṃpuṭitaiḥ kādivargaiḥ syādaṅgakalpanam |
atha dhyānam |
haṃsārūḍhāṃ mauktikābhāṃ mandahāsyenduśekharām || 10-24 ||
vīṇāmṛtaghaṭākṣasragdīptahastāṃ kajasthijām |
atha puraścaraṇam | japeddvādaśalakṣaka mityuktvā (-)
sitābjai ravisāhasraṃ hunedvā'tha ca campakaiḥ || 10-25 ||
atha pārijātasarasvatīmantraḥ (dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām)
