saṃpatpradāyā bhairavyā vāgbhavaṃ bījamālikhet | tāreṇa parayā devī saṃpuṭīkṛtya mantravit || 10-26 ||
sarasvatyai hṛdanto'yaṃ rudrārṇo manurīritaḥ | ṛṣistaddakṣiṇāmūrtirgāyatrī chanda īritam || 10-27 ||
pārijāteśvarī vāṇī devatā parikīrtitā | tṛtīyaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ ca bījaṃ śaktiśca tārakam || 10-28 ||
kīlakaṃ parameśāni mahāsārasvatapradam | ṣaḍdīrghasvarasaṃbhinnabījenāṅgāni vinyaset || 10-29 ||
atha dhyānam |
haṃsārūḍhā varrahasitahārendukundāvadātā vāṇī mandasmitataramukhī maulibaddhendurekhā | vidyāvīṇāmṛtamayaghaṭākṣasrajādīptahastā śudhrā(?)bjasthā bhavadabhimataprāptaye bhāratī syāt || 10-30 ||
atha puraścaraṇaṃ tantrāntare |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ tato hunet | kiṃśukaiścampakairvā'pi tilājyamadhulolitaiḥ || 10-31 ||
navākṣaro'pi yo mantrastatrādau praṇavastataḥ |
saṃpatpradādhāgbhavastato lajjābījamiti | (śāradāyām)
evamukteṣu mantreṣu dīkṣito yatamānasaḥ || 10-32 ||
ekaṃ yo bhajate bhaktyā sa bhavedbhuktimuktibhāk | susitairgandhakusumaiḥ pūjā sārasvate vidhau || 10-33 ||
dūrvābījāṅkuraṃ puṣpaṃ rājavṛkṣasamudbhavam | utpalāni praśastāni sindhuvārāṅkurāṇi ca || 10-34 ||
bhajan sarasvatīṃ nityametāni parivarjayet | āmrātaṃ gṛñjanaṃ vimbaṃ karañjaṃ laśunaṃ tathā || 10-35 ||
tailaṃ palāṇḍuṃ piṇyākaṃ sāṅgāṣṭamapi bhojane | sarvaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tyājyaṃ sadā sārasvatārthinā || 10-36 ||
nācarenniśi tāmbūlaṃ striyaṃ gaccheddivā na ca | na sandhyayoḥ svapejjātu nāśuciḥ kiñciduccaret || 10-37 ||
pradoṣe tu bhavenmaunī digvastrāṃ na vilokayet | na puṣpitāṃ striyaṃ gacchenna nindedvāmalocanām || 10-38 ||
na mṛṣā vacanaṃ brūyānnākramet pustakaṃ sudhīḥ | akṣarāḍhyāni patrāṇi nopekṣeta na laṅghayet || 10-39 ||
caturdaśyaṣṭamīparvapratipadgrahaṇeṣu ca | saṃkrameṣu ca sarveṣu vidyāṃ naiva paṭhennaraḥ || 10-40 ||
vyākhyāne saṃtyajennidrāmālasyaṃ jṛmbhaṇāṃ budhaḥ | krodhaṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ tadvannīcāṅgasparśanaṃ tathā || 10-41 ||
manuṣyasarpamārjāramaṇḍūkanakulādayaḥ | antarā yadi gaccheyustadā vyākhyāṃ parityajet || 10-42 ||
niśāsu dīpabhraṃśe ca pāṭhaṃ sadyaḥ parityajet |
jñātvā doṣānimān samyagbhaktyā yo bhāratoṃ bhajet || 10-43 ||
vācāṃ siddhimavāptoti vācaspatirivāparaḥ |
iti sarasvatīprakaraṇam |
atha tvaritāmantraḥ | tatraiva |
tato'bhidhāsye tvaritāṃ tvaritaṃ phaladāyinīm || 10-44 ||
tāro māyā varmabījamṛddhirīśasvaranvitā | kūrmastadanto bhagavān kṣastrī(/) dīrghatanucchadam || 10-45 ||
saṃvarto bhagavān māyā phaḍanto dvādaśākṣaraḥ | munirarjuna ākhyāto virāṭ chandaḥ samīritam || 10-46 ||
tvaritā devatā proktā puruṣārthaphalapradā |
tathā |
kūrmādyaiḥ pañcabhirvarṇaiḥ pūrvapūrvavivarjitaiḥ || 10-47 ||
dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni kalpayet sādhakottamaḥ |
atha dhyānam |
śyāmāṃ varhikalāpaśekharayutāmābaddhaparṇāṃśukāṃ guñjāhāralasatpayodharabharāmaṣṭāhipān bibhratīm || 10-48 ||
tāṭaṅkāṅgadamekhalāṃ guṇaraṇanmañjīratāṃ prāpitāṃ kairītīṃ varadābhayodyatakarāṃ devīṃ trinetrāṃ bhaje |
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ saṃjapya mantrajño mantramenaṃ jitentriyaḥ || 10-49 ||
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādvailvairmadhurāktaiḥ samidvaraiḥ |
tathā |
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī nārīnaranareśvaraiḥ || 10-50 ||
mānyate vatsarādarvāglakṣmyā jitaghaneśvaraḥ |
iti tvaritāmantraḥ |
atha nityaklinnāmantrastatraiva |
tāro māyā vāgbhavānte nityaklinne madadrave || 10-51 ||
vāṅmāyā vahnijāyānto mantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ | dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ punardvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pañcabhirakṣaraiḥ || 10-52 ||
vācaṃ vinā samastenāpyaṅgaṣaṭkamathācaret |
atha dhyānam |
dvīpaṃ trikoṇavipulaṃ suradrumamanoharam || 10-53 ||
kūjatkokilanādāḍhyaṃ mandamārutasevitam | bhṛṅgapuṣpalatākīrṇamudyaccandradivākaram || 10-54 ||
smṛtvā sudhābdhimadhyasthaṃ tasmin māṇikyamaṇḍape | ratnasiṃhāsane nyastatrikoṇojjvalakarṇike || 10-55 ||
padme saṃcintayeddevīṃ sākṣāt trailokyamohinīm | nityāṃ bhaje bālaśaśāṅkacūḍāṃ pāśāṅkuśau kalpalatāṃ kapālam || 10-56 ||
hastairbahantīmaruṇāṃ trinetrā (-) māsphālayantīṃ kalavallakīṃ tām |
atha puraścaraṇam |
trilakṣaṃ prajapenmantramājyena juhuyāt tataḥ || 10-57 ||
daśāṃśamiti śeṣaḥ |
iti nityaklinnāmantraḥ |
athānnapūrṇāmantraḥ |
(merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi annapūrṇāmahāmanum | oṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) klī(/) namaḥ proktvā bhagavati padaṃ vadet || 10-58 ||
māheśvari cānnapurṇe svāhā viṃśativarṇakaḥ |
chando'nuṣṭabmunirbrahmā hyannapūrṇā ca devatā || 10-59 ||
hrī(/) bījaṃ cāpi śaktiḥ śrī(/) kīlakaṃ klī(/) prakīrtitam | ṣaḍdīrghayuktahṛllekhā ṣaḍaṅgeṣu prakīrtitā || 10-60 ||
atha dhyānam |
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśāṃ bālendukṛtaśekharām | navaratnaprabhādīptamukuṭāṃ kuṅkumāruṇām || 10-61 ||
citravastraparīdhānāṃ mīnākṣīṃ kalaśastanīm | nṛtyantamīśamaniśaṃ dṛṣṭvā'nandamayīṃ parām || 10-62 ||
sānandamukhalolākṣīṃ mekhalāḍhyanitambinīm | annadānaratāṃ nityāṃ bhūmiśrībhyāṃ namaskṛtām || 10-63 ||
dugdhānnabharitaṃ pātraṃ saratnaṃ vāmahastake | dakṣiṇe tu kare devyā darvīṃ dhyāyet suvarṇajām || 10-64 ||
puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ japet saniyamastaddaśāṃśena homayet | ramyapāyasarpirbhyāmevaṃ bhavati siddhidā || 10-65 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ (śāradāyām )
māyā hṛdbhagavatyante māheśvari padaṃ tataḥ | annapūrṇe ṭhayugalaṃ manuḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ || 10-66 ||
aṅgāni māyayā kuryāt tato devīṃ vicintayet |
atha dhyānam |
raktāṃ vicitravasanāṃ navacandracūḍ ā(-) mannapradānaniratāṃ stanabhāranamrām || 10-67 ||
nṛtyantaminduśakalābharaṇaṃ vilokya hṛṣṭāṃ bhaje bhagavatīṃ bhavaduḥkhahartrīm |
atha puraścaraṇam |
yathāvidhi japenmantraṃ vasuyugmasahasrakam || 10-68 ||
sājyenānnena juhuyāt taddaśāṃśamanantaraiḥ |
ityannapūrṇāmantraḥ |
atha pratyaṅgirāmantraḥ | (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi parakṛtyānivāriṇīm || 10-69 ||
devīṃ pratyaṅgirāṃ nāma sarvāpadvinivāriṇīm | oṃ a(/) ka(/) ca(/) tathā ṭa(/) ta(/) pa(/) hma(/) bho(/) hrī(/) samuccaret || 10-70 ||
hu(/)sa uktvā hu(/) tathā'straṃ svāhāntaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ | munirvidhātā chandoṣṇigdevatāḥ ṣaṭ prakīrtitāḥ || 10-71 ||
mahāvāyurmahāpṛthvī mahākāśastathaiva ca | mahāsamudranāmā ca mahāparvata eva ca || 10-72 ||
mahāgniśceti hu(/) bījaṃ hrī(/) śaktiḥ parikīrtitā | lajjayā tu ṣaḍaṅgāni ṣaḍdīrghānvitayā'caret || 10-73 ||
mantradevī(/)stato mantrī dhyāyet susthiramānasaḥ |
atha dhyānam |
nānāratnārcirākrāntaṃ vṛkṣāmbhaḥsravaṇairyutam || 10-74 ||
vyāghrādipaśubhirvyāptaṃ sānuyuktaṃ giriṃ smaret | matsyakūrmādibījāḍhyaṃ navaratnasamanvitam || 10-75 ||
ghanacchāyaṃ sakallolamakūpāraṃ vicintayet | jvālāvalīsamākrāntaṃ jagattritayamadbhutam || 10-76 ||
pītavarṇaṃ mahāvahniṃ saṃsmarecchatruśāntaye | tvarā samuttharāvaughamalinaṃ ruddhabhūdivam || 10-77 ||
pavanaṃ saṃsmaredviśvajīvanaṃ prāṇarūpataḥ | nadīparvatavṛkṣādikalitāgrāsasaṃkulā || 10-78 ||
ādhārabhūtā jagato dhyeyā pṛthvīha mantriṇā | sūryādigrahanakṣatrakālacakrasamanvitam || 10-79 ||
nirmalaṃ gaganaṃ dhyāyet prāṇināmāśrayaḥ padam |
puraścaraṇamāha |
evaṃ ṣaḍdevatā dhyātvā sahasrāṇi tu ṣoḍaśa || 10-80 ||
japenmantraṃ daśāṃśena ṣaḍdravyairhomamācaret | vrīhayastaṇḍulā ājyaṃ sarṣapāśca yavāstilāḥ || 10-81 ||
etairhutvā yathābhāgaṃ pīṭhe pūrvodite yajet |
atha mālāmantrastatraiva |
atha pratyaṅgirāmālāmantraḥ siddhaḥ prakīrttyate || 10-82 ||
oṃ hrī(/) namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsaseśateviśvasahasrahim | sini sahasravadane mahābale parājite || 10-83 ||
pratyaṅgire parasainyaparakarmapadaṃ vadet | vidhvaṃsini paramantrotsādinīti tato vadet || 10-84 ||
sarvabhūteti damani sarvadevān vadet tataḥ | bandhayugmaṃ sarvavidyā dviścchindhi kṣobhayadvayam || 10-85 ||
parayantrāṇīti vadet sphoṭayadvitayaṃ tataḥ | sarvaśṛṅkhalā(/)stroṭaya troṭaya jvala coccaret || 10-86 ||
jvālājihve karāleti vadane pratyamuccaret | gire hrī(/) nama ityeṣa sapādaśatavarṇavān || 10-87 ||
brahmā'nuṣṭubmuniśchando devī pratyaṅgirā matā | bījaśaktī tāramāye kṛtyānāśeti yojanam || 10-88 ||
ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ vidhiścātra ṣaḍdīrghānvitamāyayā |
atha dhyānam |
siṃhārūḍhātikṛṣṇāṅgīṃ jvālāvaktrāṃ bhayaṅkarām || 10-89 ||
śūlakhaḍgakarāṃ vastre dadhatīṃ nūtane bhaje |
atha puraścaraṇam |
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ sahasraṃ tilarājikāḥ || 10-90 ||
hutvā siddhamanurmantrī prayogeṣu śataṃ japet | grahabhūtādikāriṣṭaṃ siñcenmantraṃ japan jalaiḥ || 10-91 ||
vināśayet parakṛtaṃ yantramantrādisādhanam |
(etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ 4 pu0 adhiko dṛśyate |) atha mantrāntaraṃ (siddhāntasaṃgrahe)
oṃ yāṃ kalpayanti no'rayaḥ krūrāṃ kṛtyāṃ vadhūmiva || 10-92 ||
tāṃ brahmaṇā'panirnudmapratyak karttāramicchatu | hro(/) munyādyā viniyogāntā malāmantravadasya tu || 10-93 ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni ca pādena pādārdhaiścaraṇena ca | kuryādvedādiṣaḍdīrghahṛllekhāpuṭitena ca || 10-94 ||
śirobhrūmadhyavadanagalabāhudvayeṣvatha | hṛnnābhipārśvakaṭyandhupādeṣu padaśo nyaset || 10-95 ||
vyāpakantaṃ samastena kṛtvā dhyāyenmaheśvarīm | khaḍgacarmadharāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ muktakeśīṃ vivāsasam || 10-96 ||
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ bhīṣābhāṃ sarvabhūṣaṇām | grasantīṃ vairiṇaṃ dhyāyet preritāṃ śivatejasā || 10-97 ||
puraścaraṇamāha |
ayutaṃ prajapedenaṃ mantrī prayatamānasaḥ |
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt paścādapāmārgedhmarājikām || 10-98 ||
sarpiṣā ca samāyuktāṃ tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ | prayogeṣu japenmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ budhaḥ || 10-99 ||
tāvataiva tu homena parakṛtyā vinaśyati |
iti pratyaṅgirāmantraḥ |
atha kubjikāmantraḥ |
(kulālikāmnāyatantre)
śrīkubjikovāca |
kathaṃ tu laghvikānātha vada mantrapadānvitām || 10-100 ||
sarvajñāṃ sarvadā deva lakṣaṇena samanvitām | uvāca bhairavo hyevaṃ laghvikāṃ śṛṇu laghvike || 10-101 ||
kintu tvayā na vaktavyā yāvannādeśitaḥ śiśuḥ | ccevīti prathamaṃ padaṃ ṇikiṇiki dvitīyakam || 10-102 ||
chī(/) chā(/) padaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca khimuragh o(-)acaturthakam | menaṇañaṅeti pañcamaṃ hrau(/) hrā(/) hrī(/) ṣaṣṭhakaṃ padam || 10-103 ||
yai kābjikuśro saptamaṃ tyaivagabha monāṣṭamam | eṣā sā samayā devī dvātriṃśākṣaramālinī || 10-104 ||
pañcapraṇavamādyantaniyuktā lakṣaṇānvitā | ādikūṭāvasāne ca dvicatvāriṃśamālinī || 10-105 ||
vilomenoccareddevi guruvaktropadeśataḥ | rephasahamidaṃ kūṭaṃ vidyāyāḥ saptamaṃ smṛtam || 10-106 ||
śrīlope sanniyoktavyaṃ jīvitaṃ kubjike mama | svamanīṣikāto'nyathā saviddhiṣṭomarīcibhiḥ || 10-107 ||
gupta guptataraṃ kāryaṃ yoginīhṛdayanandanam |
yasmādbhasmāramityevaṃ sarvasvaṃ yoginīkule || 10-108 ||
atha cet sarvapīṭheṣu māteyaṃ samayātmikā | asyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa vihvalaṃ tu jagattrayam || 10-109 ||
jāyate nātra saṃdeha iti mātā surakṣitā | hṛdayādyastraparyantamekoccāreṇa suvrate || 10-110 ||
siddhimārge yathā brūmi vilomena vilomataḥ |
yastr ā(-)a yairvāṇākakko ccevi ṇikiṇiki yayātratrane keritāhaṃmajalaku chā(/) chī(/) yacāvakayaipārūhubakhīmuragh o(-)a me naṇañaṅa yaikhāśi kheśirarvava hrī(/) hrā(/) hrau(/) seraśi yaipādīlaku yaikābjikuśrī yayādahṛ yailāmatkahṛtyaivagabha mona |
pañcādaśākṣaraṃ hṛdayaṃ śiraścaiva trayodaśa || 10-111 ||
śikhārudrakṣarā jñeyā kavacaikonaviṃśati | tithisaṅkhyā bhavennetramastraṃ caiva caturdaśa || 10-112 ||
pañcapraṇava ādyanto yathā vidyā tathā'ntimā | etatkaulikabhāṣāyāṃ kathitaṃ te sapratyayam || 10-113 ||
sasphuṭaṃ guruvakkrasthaṃ vilomasthaṃ na sidhyati | kaulike'daḥ samākhyātaṃ siddhamārge sudurlabham || 10-114 ||
atha dhyānaṃ (parātantre)
vṛṣabhe saṃsthitaṃ devaṃ khavarṇarūpaśobhitam | ekavaktraṃ trinetraṃ ca bhujāṣṭādaśadhāriṇam || 10-115 ||
paraśuṃ ḍamaruṃ bāṇaṃ khaḍgamaṅkuśavajrakam | śaṅkhaṃ ca veṇuvādyaṃ ca varadaṃ dakṣiṇe kare || 10-116 ||
vāme khaṭvāṅgaśūlaṃ ca dhanuḥ phalakapāśakam |
ghaṇṭāṃ kapālaṃ veṇuṃ ca abhayaṃ bhayanāśanam || 10-117 ||
paṭṭena bandhitaṃ jānuvāmorusthā ca kubjikā | ekavaktrā trinetrā ca karuṇāvaravarṇitā || 10-118 ||
dvibhujā varadā devī siṃhasthā'bhayasavyasu | nānābharaṇabhūṣāṅgī khaṇḍendukṛtaśekharā || 10-119 ||
varvarā keśapāśena cārupīnaghanastanī | evaṃ yedhyā kujā mātā paścimāmnāyanāyikā || 10-120 ||
atha puraścaraṇam | (kulālikāmnāyatantre)
akṣarākṣarasantānaṃ yojayellakṣasaṅkhyayā | laghvīśaguṇatulyo'sau hartā kartā svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 10-121 ||
khecarīṇāṃ padaṃ so hi paśyati hyavicārataḥ | nirācāreṇa yogena cintayanto maheśvarīm || 10-122 ||
iti kubjikāmantraḥ |
atha gaṅgāmantraḥ | (merutantre)
atha vakṣye rudraśīrṣanivāsinyāḥ parān manūn | tāro namaḥ śivāyai ca nārāyaṇyai padaṃ vadet || 10-123 ||
daśaharāyai gaṅgāyai svāhānto viṃśadarṇakaḥ | vyāso muniḥ kṛtiśchando gaṅgā devī prakīrtitā || 10-124 ||
trivahnivedabāṇāgninetravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
atha dhyānam |
caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 10-125 ||
ratnakumbhasitāmbhojavaradābhayasatkarām | cāmarairbījamānāṃ ca śvetacchatropaśobhitām || 10-126 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ japeddaśāṃśena juhuyāt saghṛtaistilaiḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vāmācārāghanāśanam || 10-127 ||
bahiryajanakartāraḥ śiddhāḥ syuryatprabhāvataḥ | tāro namo bhagavati vāgbhavaṃ ca hilidvayam || 10-128 ||
milidvayaṃ ca gaṅge māṃ pāvayadvitayaṃ vadet | svāhāntastārako varṇo manuḥ pāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 10-129 ||
īśvaro'sya muniśchando'mitaṃ gaṅgā ca devatā | rāmavedāṅgavahnyaṅganetrārṇairaṅgakalpanam || 10-130 ||
atha dhyānam |
raktāmbarāṃ raktavarṇāṃ śūlakumbhavarābhayān | karaiḥ saṃdadhatīṃ smerāṃ kacchapasthāṃ surādibhiḥ || 10-131 ||
tadrūpābhiḥ svapāpasya nāśāya suniṣevitām |
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japeddhomaḥ proktaḥ padmairdaśāṃśataḥ || 10-132 ||
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī marudādikanirjale | deśe gatvā jalārthaṃ tu puraścaryāṃ samācaret || 10-133 ||
homādisarvaṃ nirvṛtya gaṅgāmāvāhayet tataḥ | tatra kūpādikaṃ kṛtvā bhavet tadamṛtopamam || 10-134 ||
kalpasthāyitayā'gādhaṃ samastagadanāśanam |
tathā |
iyamādimasaptārṇaṃ tyaktvoktā tu nakhākṣarī || 10-135 ||
prāgvanmunyādikaṃ bāṇavedatritritribāhubhiḥ | mantrārṇaiḥ syuḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni puraścaryārṇalakṣakam || 10-136 ||
homadravyādikaṃ prāgvat siddhamantraḥ samācaret | prayogaṃ jalamadhye tu sthitvā japtvā'yutaṃ manum || 10-137 ||
tryahādavarṣākāle'pi vṛṣṭirbhavati bhūyasī |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
tāro hilimilidvandve gaṅge devi namo manuḥ || 10-138 ||
tithivarṇo'yasya munyādiḥ pūjā pūrvavadīritā | tridvitryakṣikṛtābdhyarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ || 10-139 ||
etasya bhajanājjantornātīrthe maraṇaṃ bhavet |
punarmantrāntaramāha |
tāro lajjā ramā hārdaṃ tato bhagavatī padam || 10-140 ||
sambudhyantaṃ gaṅgadayite namo hu(/) tathā'strakam | aṣṭādaśārṇamantro'yaṃ munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatam || 10-141 ||
iti gaṅgāmantraḥ |
atha maṇikarṇikāmantraḥ |
tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi maṇikarṇīmanudvayam | taro vāk hrī(/) ramā kāmastāro'yaṃ maṇikarṇike || 10-142 ||
nama oṃ tithivarṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ paramadurlabhaḥ | munirvyāso'tiśakvarī chandaḥ syānmaṇikarṇikā || 10-143 ||
devatā candranentrākṣidvīṣutryarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
atha dhyānam |
bījapūraṃ dakṣahaste vāmendīvaramālikā || 10-144 ||
baddhāñjaliḥ śvetavastrā tryakṣā candranibhānanā | paścimābhimukhī smerā padmasthā padmamālikā || 10-145 ||
nānālaṅkārabhūṣāḍhyā dhyeyā śrīmaṇikarṇikā |
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ || 10-146 ||
puṇḍarīkaistrimadhvaktairyajet tāṃ gaṅgayā samam |
iti maṇikarṇikāmantraḥ |
atha vāgmatīmantraḥ | tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vāgmatyāśca manudvayam || 10-147 ||
vāgbījaṃ prathamo mantro nārado'sya mato muniḥ | chando'nuṣṭubdevatā tu vāgmatī parikīrtitā || 10-148 ||
atha dhyānam |
śvetambarāṃ śvetavarṇāṃ śvetagandhānulepanām | sudhākumbhaṃ ca padmaṃ ca vīṇāṃ pustakameva ca || 10-149 ||
karairdadhantīṃ mīnasthāṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣitām | evaṃ dhyātvā karṇikāyāṃ yajeddevīṃ ṣaḍasrake || 10-150 ||
rudradhārāṃ maṇimatīṃ phalguṃ viṣṇumatīṃ tathā | prabhāvatīṃ bhānumatīṃ bhūpure tu digīśvarān || 10-151 ||
atha puraścaraṇan |
lakṣatrayaṃjapenmantraṃ pañcakhādyaistathā hūnet | tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā siddho mantraḥ prajāyate || 10-152 ||
sadyojātasya bālasya jihvāyāṃ bījamālikhet | madhunā svarṇalekhanyā so'ṣṭavarṣaḥ kavirbhavet || 10-153 ||
vāgmatyāṃ vā'tha gaṅgāyāṃ puraścaryāṃ karoti yaḥ | dvitīyāmapratigrāhī bhikṣāśī cātha maunavān || 10-154 ||
brahmacārī bhūmiśāyī śvetāmbadharaḥ śuciḥ | vāk siddhiṃ labhate'vaśyaṃ dātā bhoktā tvayācakaḥ || 10-155 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
ramātrapāvāgbījāni vadedṅe'ntā ca vāgmatī | namo mameti ca pade dhāraṇāṃ ca tato dhiyam || 10-156 ||
vācamadbhutāṃ pradehi svāhāntastattvavarṇakaḥ | munyādikaṃ tathā pūjā puraścaryā ca pūrvavat || 10-157 ||
iti vāgmatīmantraḥ |
atha candramantraḥ |
(śāradāyām)
athocyate candramaso manuḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥ | khaḍgīśastho bhṛgurvindumanuḥ svarasamanvitaḥ || 10-158 ||
somāya hṛdayānto'yaṃ mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | ṛṣirukto bhṛguśchandaḥ paṅktiḥ somo'sya devatā || 10-159 ||
dīrghabhājā svabījena manoraṅgakriyā matā |
atha dhyānam |
karpūrasphaṭikāvadātamaniśaṃ pūrṇenduvimbānanaṃ muktādāmavibhūṣitena vapuṣā nirmūlayantaṃ tamaḥ || 10-160 ||
hastābhyāṃ kumudaṃ varaṃ ca dadhataṃ nīlālakodbhāsitaṃ svasthāṅkasthamṛgoditāśrayaguṇaṃ somaṃ sudhābdhiṃ bhaje |
atha puraścaraṇam |
rasalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ sādhako vijitendriyaḥ || 10-161 ||
tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyāt pāyasena sasarpiṣā |
atha mantrāntaraṃ (merutantre)
oṃ ā(/) śrī(/) śru(/) savinduḥ sa somāyetyagnigehinī || 10-162 ||
daśākṣaraścandramantro japyaścāyaṃ nṛpāyutam | homādikaprayogā(/)śca sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 10-163 ||
iti candramantraḥ |
atha bhaumamantraḥ |
tatraiva |
atha bhaumamanuṃ vakṣye sarvaroganivāraṇam | a(/) ca aṅgārako ṅe'nto hṛdantaścāṣṭavarṇakaḥ || 10-164 ||
ṛṣyādyā brahmagāyatrī bhūmiputrāḥ prakartitāḥ | aṅgaṣaṭkaṃ tvasya manornijabījena saṃmatam || 10-165 ||
atha dhyānam |
namāmyaṅgārakaṃ raktaṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣaṇam | jānusthavāmahastāḍhyaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikam || 10-166 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣāṣṭakaṃ japaḥ proktaḥ khadirodbhavakairhunet | sājyaiḥ saṃtarpaṇaṃ raktacandanādyaiḥ samācaret || 10-167 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye bhūmimantrasya siddhidam | oṃ hā(/) ha(/)saḥ kha(/) kha iti mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 10-168 ||
munirvirūpo gāyatrī chando devo dharātmajaḥ | ṣaḍbhirvaṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni manoḥ kurvīta sādhakaḥ || 10-169 ||
atha dhyānam |
javākusumasaṃkāśaṃ śaktiṃ śūlaṃ gadāṃ varam | meṣasaṃsthaṃ raktavastraṃ taṃ vande'haṃ dharātmajam || 10-170 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṃ ṣaḍlakṣajapaḥ |
rasalakṣaṃ japeddhomaṃ samidbhiḥ khadirasya ca |
iti tatraivoktatvāt |
oṃ krā(/) krī(/) krau(/) savinduḥ sakujāyetyagnigehinī || 10-171 ||
daśākṣaro bhaumamantro japyaścāyaṃ navāyutaḥ |
punarmantrāntaramāha |
oṃ śrī(/) klī(/) hrī(/) samuccārya ṅe'nto bhaumo hṛdantakaḥ || 10-172 ||
daśākṣarī manuḥ prokto virūpākṣo munirmataḥ | gāyatrī chanda uditaṃ devatā maṅgalo bhavet || 10-173 ||
hrī(/) bīja(/) śrī(/) ca śaktiḥ syāt kīlakaṃ klī(/) prakartitam | kālādikaṃ samuccārya niyoga ṛṇanāśane || 10-174 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena aṅgulyādiṣaḍaṅgakam |
atha dhyānam |
tato dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ raktamālyāṃśukāvṛtam || 10-175 ||
kaṇṭhe kamalamālāḍhyaṃ karayoḥ śaktiśūlakam | maṅgalānāṃ maṅgalaṃ ca sarvakāmaphalapradam || 10-176 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ juhuyāt karavīrajaiḥ | javāprasūnaiḥ purubhirmadhuratritayānvitaiḥ || 10-177 ||
raktacandanagandhāḍhyairyajedaruṇabhūṣaṇam | vidhinā bhūmitanayaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam || 10-178 ||
iti kujamantraḥ |
atha bhaumamantraḥ | tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi budhamantraṃ mahādbhutam | buṃ ṅe'ntaṃ budhaśabdaṃ ca hṛdayāntaḥ ṣaḍarṇakaḥ || 10-179 ||
budhamantro'sya munyādyā brahmapaṅktibudhā matāḥ |
ṣaḍaṅgāni svabījena vinyasyaivaṃ vicintayet || 10-180 ||
atha dhyānam |
vande budhaṃ sadā devaṃ pītāmbarasubhūṣaṇam | jānusthavāmahastābjaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikam || 10-181 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
prajapedvarṇasāhasraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
oṃ brā(/) brī(/) brū(/) savinduḥ sabudhāyetyagnigehinī || 10-182 ||
daśākṣaraḥ saumyamantro japo lakṣaikasaṅkhyayā |
iti budhamantraḥ |
atha bṛhaspatimantraḥ |
tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi gurumantraṃ gurutvakṛt || 10-183 ||
bṛ(/) bṛhaspataye hṛcca mantraścāṣṭākṣaro mataḥ | chando'nuṣṭubmunirbrahmā devaḥ prokto bṛhaspatiḥ || 10-184 ||
bṛ(/) bījaṃ pataye śaktirbījenaivāṅgakalpanam |
atha dhyānam |
suvarṇābhaṃ pītavastraṃ raktasvarṇāmbarādikam || 10-185 ||
kirantaṃ dakṣahastena tadrāśiṃ vāmapāṇinā | spṛśantaṃ samyagaparaṃ vipaṇau kanakādikam || 10-186 ||
nānālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ vidyāsāgarapāragam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
japitvā'śītisāhasraṃ hutvā dhenughṛtena vā || 10-187 ||
dharmādharmādipīṭhe taṃ pūjayedaṅgadiśyakaiḥ |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
oṃ jrā(/) jrī(/) jrū(/) savinduḥ sacaturthyanto bṛhaspatiḥ || 10-188 ||
vahnistrīviśvavarṇo'yaṃ japyaḥ pañcadaśāyutam |
iti bṛhaspatimantraḥ |
atha śukramantraḥ |
tatraiva |
vastraṃ me dehi śukrāya hṛdayāntaḥ śumādikaḥ || 10-189 ||
ekādaśākṣaro mantro virāṭ chanda udāhṛtam | brahmā munirdevatā tu śukro daityādipūjitaḥ || 10-190 ||
ṣaḍbhiḥ padaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tato devaṃ vicintayet |
atha dhyānam |
śukraṃ namāmyāpaṇasthaṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣiṇam || 10-191 ||
svarṇavāsoratnadhārāvimugdhāntaḥkaradvayam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ sahasraṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥ || 10-192 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
oṃ hrā(/) hrī(/) hrau(/) savinduḥ saśukrāyetyagnigehinī | daśākṣaraḥ śukramantro japyo'yaṃ dvādaśāyutam || 10-193 ||
udumbarasamidbhiśca homayet sakalāpadaḥ | bhūpaiḥ kṛtā vinaśyanti strīsaukhyamupajāyate || 10-194 ||
iti śukramantraḥ |
atha śanaiścaramantraḥ | tatraiva |
śanaiścarāya hṛdayaṃ śamādyaścāṣṭavarṇakaḥ | munyādyā brahmagāyatraśanaiścarasamāhvayāḥ || 10-195 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret |
atha dhyānam |
vande śanaiścaraṃ vakradaṃṣṭraṃ nīlavibhūṣaṇam || 10-196 ||
vāmajānusthitaṃ vāmakaraṃ dakṣe varaṃ dadhat |
(etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ 5 pustaka evopalabhyate |) (mārtaṇḍabhairavatantre)
nīlādriśobhāñcitadivyamūrtiḥ khaḍgī tridaṇḍī śaracāpahastaḥ || 10-197 ||
śambhurmahākālaśaniḥ purārirjayatyaśeṣāsuranāśakārī |
iti dhyānāntaramuktam | atha puraścaraṇaṃ (merau)
japedakṣarasāhasraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunedghṛtaiḥ || 10-198 ||
ṣaḍaṅgagrahadikpālasāyudhaiḥ paripūjanam | na śanaiścarabhaktānāmāpado na daridratā || 10-199 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
oṃ prā(/) prī(/) prau(/) sa ityuktvā śanaiścarapadaṃ vadet | ṅe'ntaṃ svāhā dvādaśārṇo japaḥ prayutasaṃmataḥ || 10-200 ||
hunecchamīsamidbhiśca klīvāḥ sarve'sya vaśyagāḥ |
iti śanaiścaramantraḥ |
atha rāhumantraḥ |
tatraiva |
aparaṃ tu manuṃ vakṣye rāhave nama uccaret || 10-201 ||
rā(/) pūrvakaḥ ṣaḍarṇo'yaṃ varṇairevāṅgakalpanam | munyādyā brahmagāyatrarāhavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 10-202 ||
atha dhyānam |
vande rāhuṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ sarvakāyaṃ kṛtāñjalim | vikṛtāsyaṃ raktanetraṃ dhūmrālaṅkāra(maṇḍitam - iti 2-3-4pu0 pā0|) manvaham || 10-203 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
japedvarṇasahasraṃ tu homayedgoghṛtena ca |
grahāśādhipaśastraiśca pūjāvṛttirudīritā || 10-204 ||
rāhorupāsako bhūpaḥ saṃgrāme vijayī bhavet |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
oṃ sā(/) sī(/) sau(/) savinduḥ sarāhave tvagnigehinī || 10-205 ||
daśākṣaro rāhumantro japyaścāyaṃ daśāyutaḥ | dūrvābhirhomayitvā ca dvijān saṃtarpya sidhyate || 10-206 ||
iti rāhumantraḥ |
atha ketumantraḥ | tatraiva |
ke(/) ketave hṛdityevaṃ ketumantraḥ ṣaḍarṇakaḥ | brahmā munirmataśchandaḥ paṅktiḥ ketuśca devatā || 10-207 ||
ke(/) bījaṃ ve(/) tu śaktiḥ syādbījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam |
atha dhyānam |
vande kutuṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇavastravibhūṣitam || 10-208 ||
vāmorunyastataddhastaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
japedakṣarasāhasraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunedghṛtaiḥ || 10-209 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
oṃ prā(/) prī(/) prau(/) savinduḥ saketave vahnigehinī | daśākṣaraḥ ketumantro japyo'yaṃ dvādaśāyutam || 10-210 ||
homaḥ kuśaiḥ prakartavyo ghṛtāktaistarpaṇādi ca | upāsakānāmetasya ketavo'gre calanti hi || 10-211 ||
iti ketumantraḥ |
atha grahamātṛkāmantrāḥ |
tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi grahamātṛsusādhanam |
grahamātari tuṣṭāyāṃ kiṃ grahairduritairapi || 10-212 ||
grahamātari tuṣṭāyāṃ sugrahaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam | maṅgalā piṅgalā dhanyā bhrāmarī bhadrikā tathā || 10-213 ||
ulkā siddhā saṃkaṭā ca vikaṭā garbhapālikā | rudranakṣatrataścāṣṭau janmadhiṣṇyakramāddaśāḥ || 10-214 ||
phalaṃ nāmānurūpaṃ syādekopacayato dvayoḥ | piṅgalā sūryajananī mahādhivyādhikāriṇī || 10-215 ||
tuṣṭā cecchatruvargasya ruṣṭā kuryācca sādhake | bje(/) bījaṃ tu samuccārya piṅgale vairivārṇiṇi || 10-216 ||
prasīda phaḍiti proktastrayo'gniśaktivarṇakaḥ | dīrghaṣaṭkayujā pūrvabījena ca ṣaḍaṅgakam || 10-217 ||
atha dhyānam |
piṅgavarṇāṃ piṅgakeśīṃ piṅganetrāṃ dhanuḥśarān | hastābhyāṃ dadhatīṃ padmayugalaṃ tāṃ bhajāmyaham || 10-218 ||
atha pūjāvidhiṃ vakṣye sarvāsāmeva tantrataḥ | javāpuṣpāṇi śastāni dhūpo guggulusambhavaḥ || 10-219 ||
ghṛtapradīpo madhurā naivedyāḥ pāyasādayaḥ | alaṅkārāstathā raktāstathā vastrāṇi candanam || 10-220 ||
svarṇālaṅkaraṇaiścāpi saddravyairbahupañcakaiḥ | tarpayet parameśāni tattanmantraiḥ sahasradhā || 10-221 ||
suvarṇapatre nicchidre hastāyāme manorame | kṛtvā yantraṃ tathoktaṃ tu yoginīṃ tatra pūjayet || 10-222 ||
tattanmantravaraṃ japtvā vighnaśāntyai sahasraśaḥ |
saptāhena prajāyeta trividhotpātavāraṇam || 10-223 ||
tataśca kuṇḍaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā ca caturasrakam | atha vā sthaṇḍile śuddhe sulipte gomayāmbubhiḥ || 10-224 ||
caturhastapramāṇena yojayet sthiramānasaḥ | yoginyagniṃ tu saṃsthāpya kṛtvā pūrvoditāḥ kriyāḥ || 10-225 ||
anyāsāṃ daśavāraṃ tu viruddhāyāḥ sahasradhā | vilvapatraistatphalaiśca kamalairnāgakeśaraiḥ || 10-226 ||
juhuyāt pāyasānneva tathaiva kulavastunā | sahasramayutaṃ vā'pi lakṣaṃ vā kāmanākramāt || 10-227 ||
atha pūjām pravakṣyāmi madhye devīṃ prapūjayet | icchāṃ jñānaṃ kriyāṃ śaktiṃ triṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet || 10-228 ||
manmathān pañca tadadhaḥ pañcakoṇeṣu pūjayet | ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pūjayet paścādaṣṭapatre'nyayoginīḥ || 10-229 ||
tadvāhyabhūpure lokapālānastrāṇi pūjayet | pūjāprakāro homaśca sarvāsāmayameva hi || 10-230 ||
viśeṣaḥ punaratrāsti śatrūcchedābhicārake | khaḍgacarmadharāmugrāṃ dhyāyet ṣaḍbhujadhāriṇīm || 10-231 ||
garuḍāsanamāsīnāṃ vairinigrahakārikām | lakṣamekaṃ prajapyādau japellakṣaṃ hi tarpayet || 10-232 ||
sarvaśatruvināśaḥ syādduḥkhaṃ nāpnoti kutracit | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi candramātuśca sādhanam || 10-233 ||
māyādyo vahnijāyānto maṅgale maṅgalālaye | ekādaśākṣaro mantro maṅgalāyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 10-234 ||
kṛtvā'yena ṣaḍaṅgāni dīrghaṣaṭkayujā tathā | dhyāyedenāṃ trinayanāmudyadādityasannibhām || 10-235 ||
darasmeramukhāmbhojāṃ sindūrasundurādharām | padmadvayaṃ dhanurbāṇān dadhatīṃ bhujapallavaiḥ || 10-236 ||
suguñjanmañjumañjīrakāñcīguṇavirājitām | evaṃ dhyātvā maheśāni pūrvavat paripūjayet || 10-237 ||
tato labdhamanuṃ japtvā tāramāyāpuraḥsaram | yoginīkṣetravaṭukagaṇādhipavaliṃ haret || 10-238 ||
sarvāsāmeva pūjānte maṅgalaiva prasīdati |
atha puraścaraṇamāha |
yoginyāstu prasādārthaṃ varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum || 10-239 ||
duryoginyanukūlārthaṃ japet tatsaṅkhyakāyutam | adṛṣṭapratibaddhasya śubhāyāstu phalasya ca || 10-240 ||
prāptaye prajapet tāvatsahasraṃ pratyahaṃ japam | prakartavyo varṇaśataṃ yāvadduṣṭā tu yoginī || 10-241 ||
tuṣṭāyā varṇadaśakaṃ rogiṇaṃ cābhimantrayet | varṇatulyena mantreṇa yasyāḥ sevāparo bhavet || 10-242 ||
tasyāḥ pīḍānivṛttiḥ syādvarṇābhyantargatairdineḥ | evaṃ vidhirnavānāṃ tu vijñeyaḥ surasattamāḥ || 10-243 ||
yoginī tulyaphaladā vāmamārge ca dakṣiṇe | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhrāmarīṃ bhaumamātaram || 10-244 ||
kṣī(/) bhrāmari padaṃ coktvā jaya tānme adhīśvari | bhrāmaya klī(/) ṣoḍaśārṇo mantro'syāḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 10-245 ||
piṅgalāvat sarvamasyāḥ siddhaye śarkarān daśa | mantrayitvā'nayā mārge daśadikṣu ca saṃtyajet || 10-246 ||
prātastato vrajenmārgaṃ mārgasthāḥ sarva eva hi | sarve mohaṃ samāyānti vyāghrāḥ sarpāśca taskarāḥ || 10-247 ||
śulkino duṣṭabhūpāśca nityamevaṃ samācaret | upānatkatale yasya likhitvā nāma ca vrajet || 10-248 ||
yojanaikaṃ japenmantraṃ sa bhramecca vasundharām | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhadrikāṃ budhamātaram || 10-249 ||
plū(/) bījaṃ toyabhūyogājjātamādau samuccaret | bhadrike me mama bhadraṃ dehīti ca padaṃ punaḥ || 10-250 ||
vadecca parabhadrāṇi nāśaya dvitayaṃ tataḥ | svāhānto jinavarṇo'yaṃ bhadrikāyā manurmataḥ || 10-251 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ | maṅgalāvacchubhānāṃ syāddhyānaṃ duṣphaladāyinī || 10-252 ||
piṅgalāvat samuddiṣṭaṃ japādyaṃ proktavartmanā | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhanyākhyāṃ gurumātaram || 10-253 ||
śrīdhanade samuccārya dhanye svāhā'ṣṭavarṇakaḥ | ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyādyabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥ || 10-254 ||
nāsti dhanyāsamā kā cidiha loke phalapradā | puraścaryātrayaṃ kṛtvā prāgjanmārjitapātakam || 10-255 ||
saṃstambhya dhanyā dadate dhanyatvaṃ sādhakāya tu | bṛhaspatīśvarāt paścāt kāśyāṃ dhanyāṃ vilokayet || 10-256 ||
puraścaryāṃ tatra kṛtvā vaiśyo dhanyaḥ prajāyate |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi siddhāṃ śukrasya mātaram || 10-257 ||
hrī(/) siddhe me sarvamānaṃ samuktvā sādhayadvayam | hṛdayānto mitravarṇaḥ siddhāyā manurīritaḥ || 10-258 ||
bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni japādyam proktavaccaret | nāsti siddhopāsakānāṃ karmāsiddhistu kutracit || 10-259 ||
upāsakā ye siddhāyāḥ yenāmnāyena jāyate | tadāmnāyakadevānāṃ pāke'syāḥ sarvameva hi || 10-260 ||
ṣaṭkarma sidhyate tasya manorārādhanaṃ vinā | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi coktvā mandasya mātaram || 10-261 ||
oṃ mama rogaṃ nāśaya bhañjayaikādaśākṣaraḥ | sarvarogāpaho mantro mārjanāt saptaghasrataḥ || 10-262 ||
ulkāmantro yasya siddho na gadāstasya mandire | śītalāyāṃ mahāmāryāṃ mahiṣaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam || 10-263 ||
ulkāprītyai tamutsṛjya nagare bhrāmayet punaḥ | nānāvādyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ vastrādibhiralaṅkṛtam || 10-264 ||
utsṛjet taṃ yamāśāyāmupadravaśamo bhavet | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi saṃkaṭāṃ rāhumātaram || 10-265 ||
hrī(/) saṃkaṭe ca rogaṃ me paramaṃ nāśayadvayam | ṣoḍaśārṇastu mantro'yaṃ sarvaduḥkhāpanodanaḥ || 10-266 ||
kārāgṛhe japellakṣaṃ bandhamokṣaḥ prajāyate | vīreśvarādudak kāśyāṃ saṃkaṭā yatra saṃsthitā || 10-267 ||
tatra ṣoḍaśalakṣāṇi japtvā homastu dūrvayā | tasya siddho bhavenmantrastanmukhādyadi niḥsaret || 10-268 ||
amukasyāmukaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gataṃ taddhatameva hi | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vikaṭāṃ ketumātaram || 10-269 ||
tāro namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīrapālike | prasīdayugalaṃ mantraḥ prakṛtyarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 10-270 ||
kāśyāṃ vīreśvarāsannā paścime vikaṭā sthitā | tatra mantramimaṃ japtvā grahataptāśca bālakāḥ || 10-271 ||
udaraṃ cāpi bandhyāyāḥ prasavatyāstathā śiraḥ | pitrādibhistyaktabālāstathā mātṛvivarjitāḥ || 10-272 ||
sādhakasya karaspṛṣṭvā nīrogāścirajīvinaḥ |
iti grahamātṛkāmantrāḥ |
atha dikpālamantrāḥ | tatrādau śakramantra uktastraiva |
jñmindrāya namaśceti śakramantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 10-273 ||
paṅktiśchando munirbrahmā deva indraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | māyeti śakti(/) ri(/) bījaṃ bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam || 10-274 ||
atha dhyānam |
pītavarṇaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ vajrapdmakaraṃ vibhum | sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ naumīndraṃ dikpatīśvaram || 10-275 ||
asya puraścaraṇaṇaṃ tatraiva |
prajapellakṣamekaṃ tu tilājyābhyāṃ hunet tataḥ | evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogaṃ karttumarhati || 10-276 ||
athāgnimantraḥ (śāradāyām)
vyāhṛtitrayamagneḥ syājjātaveda ihāvaha | sarvakarmāṇi saṃbhāṣya sādhayāgnipriyā tataḥ || 10-277 ||
tārādyo'yaṃ manuḥ proktaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṇavān |
ṛṣirbhṛgurbhavecchando gāyatraṃ devatā'nalaḥ || 10-278 ||
vibhaktaḥ pañcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiścaturbhiḥ pañcabhistribhiḥ | dvābhyāmaṅgakriyā proktā varṇairmūlamanoḥ kramāt || 10-279 ||
atha dhyānam |
aṃsāsaktasuvarṇamālyamaruṇasrakcandanālaṅkṛtaṃ jvālāpuñjajaṭākalāpavilasanmauliṃ sumuktāmbaram | śaktisvastikadarbhamuṣṭikajapasraksruksruvābhīvarān tadorbhirbibhratamañcitatrinayanaṃ raktābhamagniṃ bhaje || 10-280 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
gurorlabdhamanurmantrī caturdaśyāmupoṣitaḥ | japedbhānusahasrāṇi śuddhācāro jitendriyaḥ || 10-281 ||
amāvāsyādine viprān bhojayenmadhurottaraiḥ | bhakṣyairbhojyairyathāśakti dadyāt tebhyo'tra dakṣiṇām || 10-282 ||
bhuktvā bhogaṃ samānīya homadravyāṇi śodhayet | aparaṃ dinamārabhya homaṃ kuryadatandritaḥ || 10-283 ||
kramādvaṭasamidbrīhitilarājīhavirghṛtaiḥ | pratyekamaṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyādaniśaṃ sudhīḥ || 10-284 ||
daśāhamevaṃ nirvarttya vidhānena vidhānavit | datvā pūrṇāhutiṃ samyagekādaśyāṃ dvijotamān || 10-285 ||
saṃpūjya tarpayedvittairyathāvibhavamādarāt | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādaruṇāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm || 10-286 ||
vāsāṃsi dhanadhānyādi datvā saṃprīṇayedgurum |
atha yamantro(merutantre)
oṃ kro(/) hrī(/) ā(/) ca tadbījaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ vaivasvataṃ vadet || 10-287 ||
dharmarājāya bhaktānugrahakṛte namo vadet | caturviṃśativarṇo'yaṃ yamamantro'khileṣṭadaḥ || 10-288 ||
siddhīṣvisvaṅgayugmārṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni smaredyamam | meghaśyāmaṃ prasannāsyaṃ nānālaṅkārasaṃyutam || 10-289 ||
mahiṣasthaṃ daṇḍadharaṃ saṃstutaṃ pitṛbhirvṛtam | nānārūpadharairdūtaiḥ śvetavastraṃ bhajedyamam || 10-290 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ hunedājyānvitaistilaiḥ |
atha nairṛtamantrastatraiva |
oṃ kṣa(/) nir(-)ṛtaye rakṣādhipataye padaṃ vadet || 10-291 ||
dhūmravarṇāya khaḍgeti hastāya pretavāhanaḥ | ṅe'ntastataśca hṛdayaṃ triṃśadarṇo manurmataḥ || 10-292 ||
oṃ kṣamādyairhṛdantaiśca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ |
dhyānam |
kirīṭinaṃ ca piṅgākṣaṃ dhūmrābhaṃ pretavāhanam || 10-293 ||
nānārakṣogaṇaiḥ sevyaḥ khaḍgacarmadharaṃ bhaje |
puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
japet triṃśatsahasrāṇi guñjājyābhyāṃ hunet punaḥ || 10-294 ||
atha varuṇamantrastraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantraṃ varuṇadaivatam | tāraṃ va(/) varuṇāyeti jalādhipataye vadet || 10-295 ||
vadecca śuklavarṇāya pāśahastāya saṃvadet | makareti vāhanāya nama ekatrivarṇakaḥ || 10-296 ||
triṣṭupchando vaśiṣṭharṣirdevatā varuṇo mataḥ | oṃ vamādyairnamo'ntaiśca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ || 10-297 ||
dhyānam |
śvetāṃśukaṃ dadhaddhastaiḥ pāśāṅkuśavarābhayān | svacchāravindavasatirmuktābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 10-298 ||
tundilaśca prasannāsyo varuṇo nidhido'stu me |
puraścaraṇam |
japedvarṇasahasraṃ tu homaḥ padmākṣakairmataḥ || 10-299 ||
atha vāyumantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vāyumantraṃ mahādbhutam | tāraṃ ya(/) vāyave prāṇādhipataye padaṃ vadet || 10-300 ||
kṛṣṇavarṇāyāṅkuśeti hastāya mṛgavāhanā (-) | ya namo godvivarṇo'yaṃ vāyormantra udīritaḥ || 10-301 ||
gaṇako'sya muniśchando nivṛdvāyuśca devatā | pañcāṅgāni manorasya oṃ ya(/) bījādikaiḥ padaiḥ || 10-302 ||
dhyānam |
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ dhāvamānaṃ mṛgasthaṃ vegavattaram | pāśāṅkuśakaraṃ pretakṛtyāparimalānvitam || 10-303 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
japedvarṇasahasrāṇi lājājyābhyāṃ ca homayet | siddhamantrastu tatkālaṃ bhavedbhūmau balādhikaḥ || 10-304 ||
atha kuveramantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rājarājamanūn śubhān | yakṣāya ca kuverāya vadedvaiśravaṇāya ca || 10-305 ||
dhanadhānyādhipataye dhanadhānyapadaṃ vadet | samṛddhiṃ me dehi vadeddāpayāgnipriyāntakaḥ || 10-306 ||
pañcatriṃśadvarṇamito viśravā munirīritaḥ |
chandastu bṛhatī tryabdhīṣvaṣṭāṣṭāṅgaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 10-307 ||
dhyānam |
gārutmatanibhaṃ śāntaṃ mukuṭādivibhūṣitam | varaṃ gadāṃ ca dadhataṃ tundilaṃ yakṣasevitam || 10-308 ||
puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt tilaiḥ | dharmādipīṭhe prayajedaṅgalokeśahetibhiḥ || 10-309 ||
śivālaye lapenmantramayutaṃ dhanavṛddhaye | vilvamūlopaviṣṭena japto lakṣaṃ dhanarddhidaḥ || 10-310 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye oṃ śrī(/) oṃ hrī(/) samuccaret | śrī(/) hrī(/) klī(/) śrī(/) klī(/) ca vitteśvarāya nama ityapi || 10-311 ||
ṣoḍaśārṇo'sya munyādi prāgvat tridvidvinetrakaiḥ | pañcākṣibhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ syāddhyānapūjādi pūrvavat || 10-312 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye kuverasya gajākṣaram | tāro vaiśravaṇāyeti svāhā pañcāṅgamatra tu || 10-313 ||
svāhāntaiḥ praṇavādyaistu pañcabhirmantravarṇakaiḥ |
dhyānamāha |
dhanapūrṇaṃ svarṇakumbhaṃ tathā ratnakaraṇḍakam || 10-314 ||
hastābhyāṃ bibhrataṃ kharvakarapādaṃ ca tundilam | dharādhastādratnapīṭhopaviṣṭaṃ sasmitānanam || 10-315 ||
puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japeddhomaḥ pūjā prāgvanmahādhanī | sevanādasya bhavati yakṣiṇyādyāstathā vaśāḥ || 10-316 ||
atheśānamantrastatraiva |
praṇavaṃ haṃsamuccārya īśānāya vadet tataḥ |
vidyādhipataye ceti sphaṭiketi vadet tataḥ || 10-317 ||
varṇāya śūlahastāya ṅe'ntaśca vṛṣavāhanaḥ | namo'nta ekatriṃśadbhirvarṇairmantra udāhṛtaḥ || 10-318 ||
oṃ hamādyairnamo'ntaiśca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ | śaktīnāṃ manavo ye ca tā vidyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 10-319 ||
puruṣāṇāṃ ca te mantrā vidyāstu puruṣaṃ vinā | bhavanti naiva phaladā yathā nārī naraṃ vinā || 10-320 ||
pusāṃ yogo yatra noktastatreśānaṃ prayojayet |
asya puraścaraṇamaṣṭasahasrajapastantrāntare proktaḥ | atha brahmamantro (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi brahmaṇo mantramuttamam || 10-321 ||
tāraṃ pāśaṃ brahmaṇe ca lokādhipataye vadet | raktavarṇāyordhvalokapālakāya vadet tataḥ || 10-322 ||
padmahastāya ca padaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ syārddhasavāhanaḥ | namo'nto bāṇarāmārṇo mantro'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ || 10-323 ||
tārapāśādikaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ padairaṅgahṛdantakaiḥ | nāsya pūjā tu macchāpājjapo'sya parikīrtitaḥ || 10-324 ||
varṇalakṣajapādeva nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ | daśapatre yajedenaṃ prāgīśāntardale surāḥ || 10-325 ||
na tatra mama śāpo'sti śāpaḥ kevalapūjane |
athānantamantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śeṣasya manumadbhutam || 10-326 ||
tāraṃ māyāmanantāya nāgādhipataye vadet | gauravarṇāyātalādisaptalokeśvarāya ca || 10-327 ||
cakrahastāya garuḍavāhanāya namo'ntakaḥ | evaṃ catvāriṃśadarṇo mantro'nantasya kīrtitaḥ || 10-328 ||
mantraṃ praticaturdaśyāṃ caturdaśaśataṃ japet | dugdhaṃ hunedindraviprān bhojayecca caturdaśa || 10-329 ||
kuryāccaturdaśīṃ bhaktyā dhanadhānyayuto bhavet | rājyabhraṣṭo labhedrājyaṃ vidyākāmastu paṇḍitaḥ || 10-330 ||
bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ viśeṣāt pūjanaṃ matam |
iti dikpālaprakaraṇam |
atha gāyatrīpuraścaraṇādi |
(merutantre)
atha vakṣyāmi mantreśīṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram || 10-331 ||
yayā tu saguṇaṃ brahma gīyate pratipādyate | nirguṇaṃ yāṃ vinā muktirna kasyāpi prajāyate || 10-332 ||
mahāmāyāsvarūpāyāṃ mahākālaḥ svayaṃ yajet | yatprabhāvādahaṃ tvaṃ ca jātakāla ivāparaḥ || 10-333 ||
saguṇabrahmeti | sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthaguṇatrayātmakatejorūpamityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ (bṛhatsiddhāntasāre)
adityamaṇḍalagataṃ yat tejastriguṇātmakam | tadetat saguṇaṃ brahma brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam (-) iti || 10-334 ||
nirguṇamiti | guṇatrayopādhirahitamityarthaḥ | yāṃ vineti | guṇabrahmābhidhānadvārā nirguṇabrahmapratipādikāyā asyā eva muktihetutvāditi bhāvaḥ | (śāradāyām)
praṇavādyā vyāhṛtayaḥ sapta syustatpadādikāḥ | caturviṃśatyakṣarātmā gāyatrī śirasā'nvitā || 10-335 ||
sarvavedoddhṛtaḥ sāro mantro'yaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ |
brahmā devyādigāyatrī paramātmā samīritāḥ || 10-336 ||
ṛṣyādyāḥ praṇavasyaite munibhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ | yamadagnibharadvājabhṛgugautamakāśyapān || 10-337 ||
viśvāmitravaśiṣṭhākhyau vyāhṛtīnāmṛṣīn viduḥ | gāyatryuṣṇigathānuṣṭubbṛhatīpaṅktyaḥ punaḥ || 10-338 ||
triṣṭubjagatyau chandāṃsi kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ | saptārciranilaṃ sūryo vākpatirvaruṇo vṛṣaḥ || 10-339 ||
viśve devāḥ kramādāsāṃ devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
(merutantre)
gāyatryā munirākhyāto viśvāmitro'titāpasaḥ || 10-340 ||
gāyatrī chanda ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtā |
tantrāntare |
agnirmukhaṃ śiro brahmā hṛdviṣṇuralikaṃ śivaḥ || 10-341 ||
sāṅkhyāyanaśca gotraṃ syāt trailokyaṃ caraṇatrayam |
(śāradāyām)
śiraso'syā munirbrahmā chando devyādikā smṛtā || 10-342 ||
gāyatrī paramātmā tu devatā kathitā budhaiḥ |
(merutantre)
vyāhṛtiḥ saptabhūrāḍhyā hṛnmukhāṃsoruyugmake || 10-343 ||
jaṭhare ca kramāt nyasennyāso'yaṃ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ | pādāṅgulyādyasandhau ca sandhau syādgulphapādayoḥ || 10-344 ||
gulphajānvostathā sandhau tathā jānūrusandhiṣu | liṅge nābhau ca hṛdaye kaṇṭhe varṇānnyaset kramāt || 10-345 ||
karāṅgulīmūlasandhau maṇibandhe ca kūrpare | bhujamūle mukhe nāsikāyāṃ cāpi kapolayoḥ || 10-346 ||
netrakarṇabhrūśirasi cūḍādhovāmakarṇake | dakṣakarṇe mukhe mastake ca varṇān kramān nyaset || 10-347 ||
gāyatryā akṣaranyāso dvitīyaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ | padāni daśa gāyatryāḥ śirobhrūmadhyadṛṅmukhe || 10-348 ||
kaṇṭhahṛnnābhiguhyeṣu jānvoraṅghryoratha nyeset | śirodeśe tu gāyatryāḥ śironyāsastṛtīyakaḥ || 10-349 ||
hṛdayaṃ brahmaṇe proktaṃ viṣṇve śira īritam | śikhā rudrāya kavacamīśvarāya samīritam || 10-350 ||
netraṃ sadāśivāyoktamastraṃ sarvātmane smṛtam | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsastu caturthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 10-351 ||
pajjānukaṭinābhau ca hṛdaye kaṇṭhabhālayoḥ | kramādvyāhṛtayo nyasyāḥ parabrahmeti śīrṣakam || 10-352 ||
punarvyāhṛtinyāso'yaṃ pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | tatsaviturhṛdayāya vareṇyaṃ śirase tathā || 10-353 ||
bhargo devasya ca śikhā dhīmahi kavacaṃ smṛtam | dhiyo yo no netramuktamastraṃ śeṣeṇa kīrtitam || 10-354 ||
ayaṃ nyāsastu ṣaṣṭhaḥ syāt ṣaḍete pāpahārakāḥ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā tato dhyānaṃ samācaret || 10-355 ||
dhyānaṃ yathā |
muktāvidrumahemanīladhavalacchāyairmukhaistrīkṣaṇai (-) ryuktāmindinibaddharatnamukuṭāṃ tattvātmavarṇātmikām | gāyatrīṃ varadābhayāṅkuśakuśāñchubhraṃ kapālaṃ guṇaṃ śaṃkhaṃ cakramathāravindayugalaṃ hastairvahantīṃ bhaje || 10-356 ||
dhyānāntaramuktaṃ tantrāntare |
brahmāṇī caturānanā'kṣavalayaṃ kumbhaṃ karaiḥ sruksruvau vibhrāṇāruṇakāntirinduvadanā ṛgrūpiṇī bālikā | haṃsārohaṇakelirambaramaṇervimbāñcitābhūṣitā gāyatrī hṛdi bhāvitā bhavatu naḥ sampatsamṛddhyai sadā || 10-357 ||
madhyāhne cāntyasandhyāyāṃ dhyānabhedamatha bruve |
tathā |
rudrāṇo navayauvanā trinayanā vaiyāghracarmāmbarā khaṭvāṅgatriśikhākṣasūtravalayābhītirdadhānā'mbikā || 10-358 ||
vidyutpuñjajaṭākalāpavilasadbālendumauliḥ sadā sāvitrī vṛṣavāhanāsitatanurdhyeyā yajūrūpiṇī | vṛddhā nīlaghanaprabhāparilasatpītāmbarābhūṣitā divyairābharaṇairathāṅgakamale śaṅkhaṃ gadāṃ bibhratī || 10-359 ||
tārkṣaskandhagatāsamastajagadārādhyā parā vaiṣṇavī dhyeyā caiva sarasvatī bhagavatī sāmasvarūpā sadā |
asyā pūjāyantramuktaṃ (merutantre)
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ lekhyaṃ hrī(/) kāraṃ karṇikāsthitam || 10-360 ||
dvau dvau svarau digvidiśaṃ pratipatre samālikhet | kiñjalkeṣu tadagreṣu gāyatryarṇā(/) striśastriśaḥ || 10-361 ||
tadbahirvṛttayugalāntarāle tu samālikhet | kakārādyā(/)stathomāpojyotīraso'mṛtaṃ brahma || 10-362 ||
bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaromiti yantre sarvārthasiddhidam |
(śāradāyām)
prāṇāyāmaṃ purā kṛtvā gāyatrīṃ sandhyayorjapet || 10-363 ||
saptavyāhṛtisaṃyuktāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā'nvitām | triruccaran dhiyā prāṇān dhārayedyamānasaḥ || 10-364 ||
prāṇāyāmo'yamākhyātaḥ samastaduritāpahaḥ | vyāhṛtitrayasaṃyuktāṃ gāyatrīṃ dīkṣito japet || 10-365 ||
athāsyāḥ pūjāvidhiḥ (merutantre)
tatastu pūjayeddevīṃ daśāvaraṇasaṃyutām | ādau saṃpūjya deveśīṃ koṇāgre pūjayet tataḥ || 10-366 ||
trikoṇasyāgnikoṇāt tu prādakṣiṇyena devatāḥ | brāhmīṃ māheśvarīṃ vaiṣṇavīmiti prathamāvṛtiḥ || 10-367 ||
tasyāgratastvaṣṭadikṣu kramādaṣṭau prapūjayet | ādityamukhā(/)śca raviṃ prajñāṃ bhānuṃ prabhāṃ tathā || 10-368 ||
bhāskaraṃ cāpi sandhyāṃ ca dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ tvidam | tato'rcayedaṣṭadalakeśareṣvaṅgaṣaṭkakam || 10-369 ||
gāyatryāśca tṛtīyoktaṃ dalamadhye yajedimāḥ | prahlādinīṃ prabhāṃ nityāṃ viśvambharāṃ vilāsinīm || 10-370 ||
prabhāvatīṃ jayāṃ śāntāṃ caturthāvaraṇaṃ tvidam | tato yajeddalāgreṣu kāntiṃ durgāṃ sarasvatīm || 10-371 ||
viśvarūpāṃ viśālāṃ ca īśānīṃ vyāpinīṃ kramāt | vimalāṃ ca proktamidaṃ pañcamāvṛttipūjanam || 10-372 ||
tadagrime tvaṣṭadale etāḥ pūjyāśca śaktayaḥ | tamo'pahāriṇīṃ sūkṣmāṃ viśvayoniṃ jayāvahām || 10-373 ||
padmālayāṃ parāṃ śobhāṃ padmarūpāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhakam | bhavedāvaraṇaṃ cāgre brāhmyādyāḥ sapta mātaraḥ || 10-374 ||
aṣṭamā tvaruṇā proktā saptamāvaraṇaṃ tvidam |
raviḥ sitaḥ kujo rāhuḥ śaniścandro budho guruḥ || 10-375 ||
aṣṭamāvaraṇaṃ caitaccaturasre digaṣṭake | dikpālā navame proktāstadastrāṇi ca diṅmite || 10-376 ||
evaṃ sapūjayeddevīṃ tasyā mudrāḥ pradarśayet |
mudrāstu tatraivoktāḥ |
gāyatryā atha vakṣyante caturviṃśatimudrikāḥ || 10-377 ||
japādau darśayet tāsāṃ devatāśca tathā phalam | sumukhaṃ saṃhatau hastāvuttanākuñcitāṅgulī || 10-378 ||
pralhādinī tatra śaktiḥ sādhakānandadāyinī | saṃpuṭau padmakośābhau karāvanyonyasaṃhatau || 10-379 ||
tasya śaktirnityaviśvā viśvasyāpi priyaṅkarī | vitataṃ saṃhatau hastāvuttānāvāyatāṅguī || 10-380 ||
hṛdayā nāma tacchaktiḥ sarveṣāṃ hṛdayaṅgmā | vistīrṇaṃ saṃhatau pāṇī mitho muktāṅgulidvayam || 10-381 ||
śaktistu vimalā tasyāḥ prabhāvādanagho bhavet | dvimukhākhyā hastayostu sammukhaṃ saktayordvayoḥ || 10-382 ||
kaniṣṭhayoreva yogaḥ śaktistasyāḥ sadā vidhā | trimukhāravyā hastayugmaṃ saṃsaktānāmikādvayam || 10-383 ||
saṃyuktaṃ śeṣamaṅgulyo bhinnāḥ śaktiḥ prabhātī | caturmukhā hastayugmaṃ saṃsaktaṃ madhyamāyutiḥ || 10-384 ||
śeṣāṅgulyastu saṃbhinnā lolā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā | mudrā pañcamukhī tadvat tarjanyoryatra saṃyutiḥ || 10-385 ||
aparāṅgulayo bhinnāḥ śaktiḥ śāntiśca śāntikṛt | bhavet ṣaṇmukhamudrā sā saṃpūrṇāṅguliyojanam || 10-386 ||
kaniṣṭhādvitayaṃ hitvā śaktirdurgā prakīrtitā | adhomukhaṃ nāma mudrā nyubjau hastāvadhomukhau || 10-387 ||
ākuñcitāgrau saṃyuktau śaktirasyāḥ sarasvatī | vyāpikāñjalikaṃ nāma mudrā hastau tu tādṛśau || 10-388 ||
viśeṣo'tra tu cottānau viśvarūpā'tra devatā | śakaṭaṃ nāma mudrā sā baddhāgrāṅgulikau karau || 10-389 ||
adhomukhau baddhamuṣṭī viśākhā śaktiratra tu | yamapāśaṃ baddhamuṣṭyoḥ karayorgranthite yadā || 10-390 ||
tarjanyau tatra talage vāmā jñeyā'tra devatā | granthitākhyā'nyonyasandhilagnāścāṅgulayo yadi || 10-391 ||
uttānau cocchritāṅguṣṭhā vāmā śaktiḥ samīritā | sammukhonmukhamudrā tu sambaddhordhvāṅgulī karau || 10-392 ||
dakṣiṇādhomukho vāma ūrdhvamāpyāyanī bhavet | vilambā nāma sā mudrā cottānonnatakoṭikau || 10-393 ||
yasyāṃ karau tu vimalā tasyāḥ śaktiḥ prakīrtitā | muṣṭikaṃ tu yadā muṣṭī bhavato'nyonyasaṃyute || 10-394 ||
uttānau tu karau tatra śaktiḥ proktā tamomayī | matsyastu sammukhībhūtau yuktānāmakaniṣṭhikau || 10-395 ||
ūrdhvasaṃyuktavakrāṅgyaḥ śeṣāḥ śaktirhiraṇmayī | kūrmastbadhomukho vāmastādṛgdakṣeṇa pṛṣṭhake || 10-396 ||
samākrāntastasya śaktiḥ sūkṣmā sūkṣmārthasādhinī | vārāhī dakṣiṇasyordhve vāmamuttānakaṃ karam || 10-397 ||
sthāpayitvā'dhomukhaṃ tannāmayedviśvayonikā |
siṃhākrāntaṃ nāma mudrā hastau cedāyatāṅgulī || 10-398 ||
dattau śravaṇayorūrdhvaṃ śaktirasyā jayāvahā | mahākrāntaṃ nāma mudrā prāgvadākuñcitāgrakau || 10-399 ||
karau karṇasthitau śaktiḥ proktā padmālayābhidhā | mudgaraṃ kiṃ cidūrdhvaṃ tu gatayorvāmatarjanī || 10-400 ||
dhṛtā dakṣiṇahastena parā śobhā'tra devatā | pallavākhyā bhavenmudrā tvaṅgulyaḥ pallavīkṛtāḥ || 10-401 ||
devyagre darśayecchaktirgadārūpīti kīrtyate |
atha puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
caturviṃśatilakṣāṇi puraścaraṇamucyate || 10-402 ||
kṣīraudanatilān dūrvāḥ siddhaudanasamidvarāḥ | pṛthak sahasratritayaṃ juhuyānmantrasiddhaye || 10-403 ||
tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā gurūn saṃtoṣya yatnataḥ | prayogānācaredvidvā(/)stadanujñāpuraḥsaram || 10-404 ||
iti gāyatrīpuraścaraṇavidhiḥ |
atha vyāhṛtīnāṃ vyākhyā | (prapañcasāre)
bhūḥpadādyā vyāhṛtayo bhūśabdastadi varttate | tatpadaṃ saditi proktaṃ ṣaṇmātratvāt tu bhūrataḥ || 10-405 ||
bhūtattvāt kāraṇatvācca bhuvaḥśabdasya saṅgatiḥ | sarvaśrīkaraṇāt svārthatayā ca svaritīritam || 10-406 ||
mahattvācca mahaḥśabdo mahastena samīritaḥ | tadeva sarvajananāt tasmāt tu vyāhṛtirjanaḥ || 10-407 ||
tapo jñānatayā caiva tathā tāpatayā smṛtam |
satyaṃ paratvādātmatvādanantajñānataḥ svayam || 10-408 ||
vyāhṛtīnāṃ praṇavaikyamuktaṃ tatraiva |
praṇavasya vyāhṛtonāmantaḥsambandha ucyate | akāro bhūrukārastu bhuvo mārṇaḥ svarīritaḥ || 10-409 ||
vindurmahastathā nādo janaḥ śaktistapaḥ smṛtam | śāntiḥ satyamiti proktaṃ sat tat parataraṃ padam || 10-410 ||
atha gāyatrīvyākhyā pūrvakaṃ praṇavasyāhṛṣoṇāṃ gāyatryaikyamuktaṃ tatraiva |
praṇavasya vyāhṛtīnāṃ gāyatryaikyamathocyate | atrāpi tatpadaṃ pūrvaṃ proktaṃ tadanuvarṇyate || 10-411 ||
taddvitīyaikavacanamanenākhilavastunaḥ | sṛṣṭyādikāraṇaṃ tejorūpamādityamaṇḍale || 10-412 ||
abhidheyaṃ sadānandaṃ paraṃ brahmābhidhīyate | yat tat saviturityuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhyekavacanātmakam || 10-413 ||
dhātoriti samutpannaṃ prāṇiprasavavācakāt | sarvāsāṃ prāṇijātānāmiti prasavituḥ sadā || 10-414 ||
vareṇyaṃ varaṇīyatvāt sevanīyatayā tathā | bhajanīyatayā sarvaiḥ prārthanīyatayā smṛtam || 10-415 ||
pūrvasyāṣṭākṣarasyaivaṃ vyāhṛtirbhūriti smṛtā | pāpasya bharjanādbhargo bhaktasnigdhatayā tathā || 10-416 ||
devasya vṛṣṭidānādiguṇayuktasya nityaśaḥ | prabhutvena prakāśena dīpyamānasya vā tathā || 10-417 ||
dhyai (-) cintāyāmato dhātorniṣpannaṃ dhīmahītyadaḥ | nigamādyena (deveśi iti 4 pu0 pā0|) divyena vidyārūpeṇa cakṣuṣā || 10-418 ||
dṛśyo hiraṇmayo deva āditye nityasaṃsthitaḥ | hīnatārahitaṃ tejo yasya syāt sa hiraṇmayaḥ || 10-419 ||
yaḥ sūkṣmaḥ so'hamityevaṃ cintayāmaḥ sadaiva hi | dvitīyāṣṭākṣarasyaiva vyāhṛtirbhuva īritā || 10-420 ||
dhiyo buddhirmanorasya cchāndasatvāt samīritam | kṛtaśca liṅgavyatyāsaḥ sūtrāt suptiṅupagrahāt || 10-421 ||
yat tu tejonirupamaṃ sarvadevamayātmakam | bhajatāṃ pāpanāśasya hetubhūtatayocyate || 10-422 ||
na iti prokta ādeśaḥ ṣaṣṭhyasau yuṣmadasmadoḥ | tasmādasmākamityarthaḥ prārthanāyāṃ pracodayāt || 10-423 ||
tṛtīyāṣṭākṣarasyāpi vyāhṛtiḥ svaritīritā | evaṃ daśa padānyasyāstrayaścāṣṭākṣarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10-424 ||
ṣaḍakṣarāśca catvāraḥ syuścaturviṃśadakṣarāḥ | itthambhūtaṃ yadetasya devasya saviturvibhoḥ || 10-425 ||
vareṇyaṃ bhajatāṃ pāpavināśanakaraṃ param | bhargo'smābhirabhidhyātaṃ dhiyastannaḥ pracodayāt || 10-426 ||
uktaivamatra gāyatrī punastacchira ucyate | āpo jyotī rasa iti somāgnyosteja ucyate || 10-427 ||
tadātmakaṃ jagat sarvaṃ rasastejodvayaṃ smṛtam | amṛtaṃ tadanāśitvādbṛhatvādbrahma gadyate || 10-428 ||
yadānandātmakaṃ brahma satyajñānādilakṣaṇam | tadbhūrbhuvaḥ svarityuktaṃ so'hamityomudāhṛtam || 10-429 ||
etat tu vedavat syāt tu vedasya śira ucyate |
p 913> lakṣaṇairiti nirdiṣṭo vedasāreṣu niṣṭhitaḥ || 10-430 ||
phalārthī phalamāpnoti mokṣārthī mokṣamṛcchati |
iti vyāhṛtīnāṃ vyākhyā |
atha praṇavamantraḥ |
(prapañcasāre)
atha praṇavasaṃjñakaṃ prativadāmi mantraṃ varaṃ sajāpamapi sārcanaṃ sahutakḷpti sopāsanam || 10-431 ||
aśeṣaduritāpahaṃ vividhakāmakalpadrumaṃ vimuktiphalasiddhidaṃ vimalamānasaiḥ sevitam | ādyaḥ svaraḥ sameto'mareṇa sadhasaptamaśca vinduyutaḥ || 10-432 ||
proktaḥ syāt praṇavo'tra trimātrikaḥ sarvamantrasamavāyī | mantrasyāsya muniḥ prajāpatiratha cchandaśca devyādikā gāyatrī gaditā jagatsu paramātmākhyastathā devatā || 10-433 ||
aklīvairyugamadhyagadhruvayutairaṅgāni kuryāt svara i(-) rmantrī jātiyutaiśca satyarahitairvā vyāhṛtībhiḥ kramāt |
atha dhyānam |
viṣṇuṃ bhāsvatkirīṭā(bhāsvatkalāpā - iti0 4 pu0 pā0|)ṅgadavalayagalākalpahārodarāṅghri (-) śroṇībhūṣaṃ surājanmaṇimakaramahākuṇḍalāmaṇḍitāṅgam || 10-434 ||
hastodyaccakraśaṅkhāmbujagadamamalaṃ pītakauśeyavāso (-) vidyotadbhāsamudyaddinakarasadṛśaṃ padmasaṃsthaṃ namāmi |
asya puraścaraṇaṃ koṭijapaḥ | taduktaṃ tatraiva |
dīkṣito manumimaṃ śatalakṣaṃ saṃjapet pratihunecca daśāṃśam || 10-435 ||
pāyasairghṛtayutaiśca tadante viprabhūruhabhavāḥ samidho vā |
sarpiḥpāyasaśālītilasamidhājyai hi yo'nale juhuyāt || 10-436 ||
aihikapāratrikamapi sa tu labhate vāñchitaṃ phalaṃ na cirāt |
pūjāvidhimuktvā (-)
itthaṃ mantrī tāramanurjāpyahutārcā (-) bhedairaṅgīkṛtya ca yuñjyādapi yogān || 10-437 ||
yaiḥ saṃlabdhvā ceha samagrāṃ śriyamante viṣṇordhāma prāpya sa yogī labhate sat |
iti praṇavapuraścaraṇam |
atha vaidikamṛtyuñjayamantraḥ |
(merutantre)
mṛtyorbhayaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sarvadā sarvakarmasu || 10-438 ||
tasmin jite tu devādimokṣāntaṃ sādhayejjanaḥ | tadarthaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mantraṃ mṛtyuñjayābhidham || 10-439 ||
upāsanā tasya na syādvaṃśe'lpāyuśca rogabhāk | tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam || 10-440 ||
urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt | vaśiṣṭho'sya muniścchando'nuṣṭubdevastriyambakaḥ || 10-441 ||
tricaturvasugopañcatribhirvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
dhyānamāha |
hastābhyāṃ kalaśadvayāmṛtarasairāplāvayantaṃ śiro dvābhyāṃ tau dadhataṃ mṛtākṣavalaye dvābhyāṃ vahantaṃ param || 10-442 ||
aṅkanyastakaradvayāmṛtaghaṭaṃ kailāśasaṃsthaṃ śivaṃ svacchāmbhojagataṃ navendumakuṭaṃ devaṃ trinetraṃ bhaje |
puraścaraṇam |
japellakṣamimaṃ mantramevaṃ dhyāyejjitendriyaḥ || 10-443 ||
juhuyāddaśabhirdravyairayutaṃ ghṛtasaṃplutaiḥ |
daśadravyāṇi tatraivoktāni |
vilvaṃ palāśaṃ khadiraṃ vaṭaṃ ca tilasarṣapau || 10-444 ||
pāyasaṃ dadhi dūrvāṃ ca tathaikena sahasrakam | tarpayitvā'bhiṣiñcyātha brāhmaṇā(/)stoṣayedgurum || 10-445 ||
evaṃ kṛte prayogārho jāyate'yaṃ mahāmanuḥ |
iti vaidikamṛtyuñjayapuraścaraṇam |
atha rudrādhyāyapuraścaraṇavidhiḥ |
tatraiva |
śrīviṣṇuruvāca |
devadeva mahādeva bhaktānugrahakāraka || 10-446 ||
kālastvamasi lokānāṃ mahāmāyā tviyaṃ parā | āvayoḥ ke tuṣṭikarā mantrāḥ sūktāni tadvada || 10-447 ||
yena bhuktiśca muktiśca kleśo naiva ca naiva ca |
śrīśiva uvāca
viṣṇo gopyaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ na vācyaṃ tāntrike dvije || 10-448 ||
tantre me tāmasaṃ rūpaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tu sāttvike | bhogamokṣaikanilayaṃ caturvedottamottamam || 10-449 ||
mantraṃ stotreśvaraṃ tanme jānīhi śatarudriyam | chandāṃsyanuṣṭubādīni aghoro'sya munirmataḥ || 10-450 ||
devatā'sya bhavedrudra ādityaḥ parapūruṣaḥ |
(paddhatau)
śrīrudrapritaye śatarudriyajape viniyogaḥ || 10-451 ||
atha karāṅganyāsau tatraiva |
oṃ agnihotrātmane aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ darśapaurṇamāsātmane tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ cāturmāsyātmane madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ nirūḍhapaśubandhātmane anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ jyotiṣṭomātmane kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ catvāriṃśacchatasahasrātmane karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ |
evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ | mahānyāsastu vistarabhayādupekṣitaḥ | atha dhyānam |
āpātālanabhaḥsthalāntabhuvanabrahmāṇḍapāvisphura (-) jjyotisphāṭikaliṅgamaulivilasatpūrṇenduvāntāmṛtaiḥ | āstokāplutamekamīśamaniśaṃ rudrānuvākān japan dhyāyedīpsitasiddhaye'dbhutapadaṃ vipro'bhiṣiñcecchivam || 10-452 ||
(merutantre)
pārthivoktaprakāreṇa liṅgapūjāṃ tataścaret | ārādhito manuṣyaistvaṃ siddhairdevāsurādibhiḥ || 10-453 ||
ārādhayāmi bhaktyā tvāṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa maheśvara | ātvāvahantu harayaḥ sacetasaścetairaśvaiḥ saha ketumadbhiḥ || 10-454 ||
vātājalairbalavadbhirmanojavairāyāhi śīghraṃ mama havyāya śarvo namaḥ |
et te rudrabhāvasaṃ tena paro mūjavato'tīhi avatatadhanvā pinākavasaḥ kṛttivāsā ahi(citra)sannaḥ śivo'tīhi | catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe saptahastāso asya tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti mahodevo marttyā(/) āviveśa |
prasanno bhava deveśe sumukho bhava śaṅkara || 10-455 ||
śānto bhavasva cātra tvaṃ mama cābhimukho bhava |
svāmin sarvajagannātha yāvat pūjāvasānakam || 10-456 ||
tāvat tvaṃ prītibhāvena liṅge'smin sannidho bhava | abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryādamṛtaiḥ pañcabhiḥ kramāt || 10-457 ||
paścācchuddhodakenātha tataḥ pūjanamācaret | raudrīṃ dhārāṃ tataḥ kuryāt pracyate tadvidhānakam || 10-458 ||
namaste rudrāgnāviṣṇu ityadhyāyadvayena ca | āvartanamiti proktaṃ gaṅgāsnānaphalapradam || 10-459 ||
āvartanābhiṣekaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt pratyahaṃ naraḥ | tasya dainandinaṃ pāpaṃ daivajaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt || 10-460 ||
sandhyāvandanataḥ kṣīṇaṃ taccet prāgjanmajaṃ haret | ekaḥ pāṭho namastasya anuvākaḥ parasya ca || 10-461 ||
evaṃ bhavā namaste syuragnāviṣṇustathaikakam | iyaṃ rudrī samākhyātā raudrapāpanikṛntanī || 10-462 ||
anayā pratyahaṃ yastu kuryālliṅge'bhiṣecanam | janmajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ varṣe varṣe praṇaśyati || 10-463 ||
saptajanmakṛte pāpe naṣṭe lakṣmīrvivardhate | vaṃśaśca sthiratāmeti yaśo yāti digantaram || 10-464 ||
sūte cāsya yathā rūpaṃ tathā toye praṇaśyati | rudrībhirekādaśabhirlaghurudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 10-465 ||
anena siktaṃ yairliṅgaṃ te na paśyanti bhāskarim | ekādaśabhiretaistu mahārudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 10-466 ||
nirdhanānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca mahāpātakanāśanaḥ | anena vihito homaḥ somayāgaphalaṃ smṛtam || 10-467 ||
anadhikārāddīkṣāyāṃ kalau pakṣastvayaṃ mataḥ | ekādaśamahārudrairatirudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 10-468 ||
tathā |
śākhāyāṃ yasya tu yathā svādhyāyau paṭhitāvubhau | paṭhanīyau tathā tena śākhābhedaṃ na kārayet || 10-469 ||
na rudro yasya śākhāyāṃ taittirīyaṃ paṭhet sa tu | śākhā tu yajamānasya brāhmaṇadvārataḥ kṛte || 10-470 ||
atha vā taittirīyā syānnānyā śākhā prayujyate | śākhāmiśraṃ kṛtaṃ karma yajamānaṃ vināśayet || 10-471 ||
dhanalobhāt parārthaṃ yo vipro māmabhiṣiñcati | sa tu cāṇḍālavajjñeyo nirdhanaḥ saptajanmasu || 10-472 ||
kuṭumbinā tu yatnena dhānārthaṃ yacca pūjanam | kṛte cejjapadānābhyāṃ taddaśāṃśo'sya niṣkṛtiḥ || 10-473 ||
tathā |
rudro na yasya śākhāyāṃ pariśiṣṭānvitaṃ sa tu | paṭhedrudaṃ tettirīyaṃ luptaśākhastameva hi || 10-474 ||
mantraḥ prayogasahito rudrādhyāyo'tha vakṣyate | asaṃskṛtāya no vācyaṃ tāntrikāya kadācana || 10-475 ||
tatrādau |
oṃ namaste rudramanyava(-)ityārabhya māhi(citra)sīḥ puruṣaṃ jagat (-) ityantānāṃ puraścaraṇaprayogaḥ |
daśalakṣaṃ japedvidvānṛca etā jitendriyaḥ | lakṣamekaṃ prajuhuyāt pratyṛcaṃ yo'ñjaliprabham || 10-476 ||
yavagodhūmakaṃ kṣaudratilājyadadhisaṃyutam | yatkiñcit kāryamuddiśya tasya siddhiḥ prajāyate || 10-477 ||
evameva sahasraṃ cedekādaśadinaṃ hunet | grāmagaṃ bālamarakaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 10-478 ||
kumāramarakaṃ grāme dvādaśāhena naśyati | homaḥ pañcadaśāhaṃ tu rāṣṭropadravanāśanaḥ || 10-479 ||
homādviṃśatirātreṇa deśopadravanāśanam | pṛthivyupadravo naśyenmāsamātreṇa homataḥ || 10-480 ||
gavāmupadrave jāte goṣṭhamadhye tadā hunet | vaikaṅkatasamidbhirvā'yutaṃ śāntiḥ prajāyate || 10-481 ||
ayutadvayahomena mahāśāntirbhaveddhruvam |
śivena vacasā (-) ityādi |
japedayutasaṅkhyākaṃ śāpamokṣaḥ prajāyate || 10-482 ||
śiśire tu jale prātarlakṣaṃ japtvā sukhī bhavet |
adhyavocat (-) iti |
lakṣamekaṃ puraścaryā homaḥ syācchvetasarṣapaiḥ || 10-483 ||
vyādhisaṃkrāmaṇīceyaṃ prayogāntaramucyate | saptābhimantritān kṛtvā sarṣapānāturasya tu || 10-484 ||
caturdikṣu kṣipedrakṣā daśadigbhyaḥ prajāyate | saptābhimantritān kṛtvā pathi gaccha(/)stu sarṣapān || 10-485 ||
daśadikṣu kṣipennityaṃ pathi kṣemaḥ prajāyate | brahmarākṣasayakṣādyaiḥ piśācapretabhūtakaiḥ || 10-486 ||
āviṣṭasarṣapaistāḍyaḥ saptavārābhimantritaiḥ | punaḥ punarmantrapāṭhapūrvakaṃ te dhanārthinaḥ || 10-487 ||
dhanaṃ gṛhītvā gacchanti kare taṃ drutameva ca |
śikhāmākramya ca yajet tāḍayedgaurasarṣapaiḥ || 10-488 ||
rātriṃ samastāṃ skandādigrahapīḍā vinaśyati | anena mantrayitvā tu dadyācchāstroktamauṣadham || 10-489 ||
tatkālaṃ tadguṇāya syādanyathā'sau yathāvidhi | abhimantrya jalaṃ dadyāt sarvasattvabhavāṃ rujam || 10-490 ||
haret sarvagrahāṇāṃ ca sarṣapaistāḍanāt tathā | sarvabhūtodbhavāṃ pīḍāṃ bhasmadhāraṇato jayet || 10-491 ||
