tathā ca tvarito rudra etannamakamucyate |
agnāviṣṇū (-) ityādi |
nityaṃ sandhyāvandanānte tiṣṭhan kālatraye japet || 10-615 ||
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu ṣaṇmāsaṃ satyavāgbhavet |
vājaśca me prasavaśca me (-) ityādi |
etaiḥ saptānuvākaistu evamānādipañcabhiḥ || 10-616 ||
ājyāhutisahasraṃ tu hutvā toye praviśya ca | śataṃ japedakṣirogaḥ kadā cinnaiva jāyate || 10-617 ||
jātasya ca praśāntiḥ syānnetratejo'bhivardhate |
idhmaśca me barhiśca ma (-) ityādi |
etāvānrudra ākhyātaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 10-618 ||
visvaro'nakṣaraḥ pāṭhaḥ kṛtastaddoṣaśāntaye |
iḍādebahūḥ (-) ityādi |
pariśiṣṭaṃ japedetadeṣa rudravidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 10-619 ||
abhiṣiñcet pauṣṭikārthaṃ śāntikāmastu homayet | siddhikāmo japedevamakṣarāṇāṃ tu saṅkhyayā || 10-620 ||
ihaiva vajradeho'sau śiva eva na cāparaḥ | pada tulyāvṛttijapādvāksiddhirupajāyate || 10-621 ||
vākyatulyāvṛttijapāt pāpaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati | ṛcāṃ saṅkhyājapāt sarvaṃ kṣudrapāpaṃ vinaśyati || 10-622 ||
anuvākasamaṃ japtvā duṣṭagraharujaṃ jayet |
iti rudrādhyāyapuraścaraṇaprayogaḥ |
atha gaṇeśasūktapuraścaraṇam |
tatraiva |
atha viṣṇo pravakṣyāmi sūktaṃ gaṇapateḥ param || 10-623 ||
yat sādhanaṃ vinā sarvamantrā vighnaistu vighnitāḥ | tasmādādau gaṇeśānaṃ prasādya punarācaret || 10-624 ||
nidrā'lasyaṃ kṣudhā krodho lobho moho manobhavaḥ | gaṇanāthānarcakānāmete vighnakarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10-625 ||
vidhānapūrvakaṃ tasmāt tatsūktamupadiśyate | tajjāpakānāṃ kāryāṇi syurapratihatāni ca || 10-626 ||
dvādaśārcasya sūktasya gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ | ṛṣirgṛtsamadākhyo hi gaṇakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 10-627 ||
ādyānāṃ tri (-) ṛcānāṃ tu chandastriṣṭup prakīrtitam | uttarāṇāṃ navānāṃ ca gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate || 10-628 ||
mahāgaṇapatiścāsya daivataṃ parikīrtitam | viniyogaḥ kīrttanīyo yathākāryānusārataḥ || 10-629 ||
gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapati(citra) (-) ityādi |
gaṇānāṃ tvā niṣusīda tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ tathaiva ca | anūna indra vidmahi na hitvā śūlameva ca || 10-630 ||
aṅguṣṭhāgrāt samārabhya karapṛṣṭhādiṣu nyaset | gaṇānāṃ tveti ṣaḍbhiśca hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakam || 10-631 ||
evaṃ nyāsadvayaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍḍagbhirvyāpakaṃ caret |
nyāsāntarāṇi pūjāvidhānaṃ coktvā puraścaraṇamāha |
ekaviṃtsahasraṃ tu sūktasyaiṣā puraskriyā || 10-632 ||
japāddaśāṃśahomastu pāyasena ghṛtena tu | śarkarāpañcakhādyaiśca kusumaiḥ karabījaiḥ || 10-633 ||
vilvapatrairikṣudaṇḍairdāḍimīkadalīphalaiḥ | modakairlaḍḍukaiścaiva ghṛtapakvairmanoharaiḥ || 10-634 ||
alābhe sarvadravyāṇāṃ juhuyāt tilasarpiṣā | homasya daśamāṃśena gopayobhiśca tarpayet || 10-635 ||
atha vekṣurasenaiva tadabhāve guḍodakam | tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena mārjayecchuddhavāribhiḥ || 10-636 ||
mārjanasya daśāṃśena brāhmaṇān bhojayedbahūn | pāyasaiḥ pañcakhādyaiśca modakaiḥ siddhalaḍḍukaiḥ || 10-637 ||
apūpamaṇḍakādyaiśca saghṛtaiḥ śarkarānvitaiḥ | sahakārarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ tathā ca kadalīphalaiḥ || 10-638 ||
evaṃ siddhe tu sūkte tu yat phalaṃ tannigadyate | mahadaiśvaryamatulaṃ prajñāṃ vidyāṃ yaśo balam || 10-639 ||
vāksiddhiṃ samavāpnoti cānte brahmapadaṃ vrajet |
iti gaṇeśasūktapuraścaraṇavidhiḥ |
atha puruṣasūktavidhiḥ |
(merutantre)
vakṣye puruṣasūktasya vidhiṃ tatraiva gopitam || 10-640 ||
ānuṣṭubasya sūktasya triṣṭubaṃ tasya daivatam | puruṣo yo jagadbījamṛṣirnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 10-641 ||
snātvā yathoktavidhinā prāṅmukhaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ | prathamāṃ vinyasedvāme dvitīyāṃ dakṣiṇe kare || 10-642 ||
tṛtīyāṃ vāmapāde tu caturthīṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset | vāmajānau pañcamīṃ ca ṣaṣṭhīṃ jānuni dakṣiṇe || 10-643 ||
saptamīṃ vāmakadyāṃ tu aṣṭamīṃ dakṣiṇe kaṭau | navamīṃ nābhideśe tu daśamīṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 10-644 ||
ekādaśīṃ kaṇṭhadeśe dvādaśīṃ vāmabāhuke | trayodaśīṃ dakṣabhuje mukhadeśe caturdaśīm || 10-645 ||
akṣṇoḥ pañcadaśīṃ caiva ṣoḍaśīṃ mūrdhni vinyaset | evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā paścāt pūjāṃ samācaret || 10-646 ||
apsvagnau hṛdaye sūrye sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca | ṣaṭsveteṣu hareḥ samyagarcane yogyatocyate || 10-647 ||
āpo hyāyatanaṃ tasya tasmāt tāsu sadā hariḥ | agnau kriyāvatāṃ virṣṇuyogināṃ hṛdaye hariḥ || 10-648 ||
paṇḍitānāṃ hariḥ sūryaḥ sthaṇḍile bhāvitātmanām | pratimāsvalpabuddhīnāṃ ṣaṭprakārāśca tāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10-649 ||
akṛtrimāḥ kṛtrimāśca acalāśca calācalāḥ | nirjīvāśca sajīvāśca tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || 10-650 ||
akṛtrimā ca dvividhā śālagrāmo'tipāvanaḥ |
tadabhāve dvārakāyāścakraṃ tadvacca pāvanam || 10-651 ||
kṛtrimā daśadha proktā śreṣṭhāstāḥ pūrvapūrvataḥ | syādratnakhacitā tvādyā svarṇajā rūpyajā'pi ca || 10-652 ||
tāmrajā pīttalojātā sphāṭikā raktaśītajā | koṣṭhajā mṛttikājātā citrarūpeti ca kramāt || 10-653 ||
acalāḥ kṣetrarūpāstu haridvāraṃ yathā gayā | devatābhiḥ kṛtvā yāstu mūrttayastāścalācalāḥ || 10-654 ||
jagannātho veṅghaṭeśaḥ pāṇḍuraṅgādayastu te | sajīvā brāhmaṇā gāvo nirjīvaḥ pippalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 10-655 ||
mantranyāsaṃ purā kuryāt svadehe devatāsu ca | gāyatryoṅkāranyastāṅgaḥ pūjayedviṣṇumavyayam || 10-656 ||
ādyayā'vāhayeddevamṛcā tu puruṣottamam | dvitīyayā'sanaṃ dādyāt pādyaṃ dadyāt tṛtīyayā || 10-657 ||
arghyaṃ caturthyā dātavyaṃ pañcamyā'camanīyakam | ṣaṣṭhyā snānaṃ prakurvīta saptamyā vastrameva ca || 10-658 ||
yajñopavītamaṣṭamyā navamyā cānulepanam | puṣpaṃ daśamyā dātavyamekādaśyā tu dhūpakam || 10-659 ||
dvādaśyā dīpikaṃ dadyāt trayodaśyā nivedanam | caturdaśyā namaskāraṃ pañcadaśyā pradakṣiṇam || 10-660 ||
snāne vastre ca naivedye dadyādācamanīyakam | dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā ṣoḍaśyā tu pradāpayet || 10-661 ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ kurvan samāhitaḥ | yathāśaktiṃ japitvā tu sūktaṃ tasmai nivedayet || 10-662 ||
devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve kuṇḍaṃ sthaṇḍilameva ca | kārayet prathamenaiva dvitīyena tu prokṣaṇam || 10-663 ||
tṛtīyenāgnimādadyāccaturthena samindhanam | pañcamenājyaśrayaṇaṃ carośca śrayaṇaṃ tathā || 10-664 ||
ṣaṣṭhenaivāgnimadhye tu kalpayet padmamāsanam | cintayeddevadeveśaṃ kālānalasamaprabham || 10-665 ||
tato gandhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca dhūpadīpanivedanam | anujñāpya tataḥ kuryāt saptamyādi yathākramam || 10-666 ||
samidhastāvatīḥ pūrvaṃ juhuyādabhighāritāḥ | tato ghṛtena juhuyāccaruṇā ca tataḥ punaḥ || 10-667 ||
evaṃ hutvā tataścainamanujñāpya yathākramam | agnerbhagavatastasya samīpe stotramuccaret || 10-668 ||
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana | namo'stu te hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣapūrvaja || 10-669 ||
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sāmanyamadhidaivatam | sarvadā caraṇadvandvaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ tava || 10-670 ||
ekastvamasi lokasya sraṣṭā saṃhārakastathā | avyaktaścānumantā ca guṇamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ || 10-671 ||
saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoramanantakleśabhājanam | tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ prāpya nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ || 10-672 ||
na te rūpaṃ na cākāro nāyudhāni ca nāspadam | tathā'pi puruṣākāro bhaktānāṃ ca prakāśane || 10-673 ||
naiva kiñcit parokṣaṃ te na pratyakṣo'si kasyacit |
na ca kiñcidasādhyaṃ te na ca sādhyo'si kasya cit || 10-674 ||
kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ vacasāṃ vācyamuttamam | yogināṃ paramā siddhiḥ paramaṃ te padaṃ viduḥ || 10-675 ||
ahaṃ bhūto'smi deveśa saṃsāre'smin mahābhaye | trāhi māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa na jāne paramaṃ padam || 10-676 ||
kāleṣvapi ca sarveṣu dikṣu sarvāsu cācyuta | śarīre ca gataścāsi varttate me mahadbhayam ||| 10-677 ||
tvatpādakamalādanyanna me janmāntareṣvapi | vijñānaṃ yadidaṃ prāpya yadidaṃ sthānamarjitam || 10-678 ||
janmāntare'pi me deva mābhūdasya parīkṣayaḥ | durgatāvapi jātasya tvaṃ gato me manorathaḥ || 10-679 ||
yadi nāśaṃ na vindeta tāvatā'smi kṛtī sadā | kāmaye viṣṇupādau tu sarvajanmasu kevalam || 10-680 ||
puruṣasya hareḥ sūktaṃ svargyaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśaskaram | ātmajñānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yogajñānamidaṃ param || 10-681 ||
evaṃ stutvā havyavāhaṃ tataḥ paścādvisarjayet | anenaiva na niṣpāpo jāyate manujo yadā || 10-682 ||
prāgvaddhutvā pāvayeta prayogānārabhet tataḥ | śuklapakṣe śubhe vāre sunakṣatre sugocare || 10-683 ||
dampatyorupavāsaḥ syādekādaśyāṃ surālaye | dvādaśyāṃ putrakāmāya caruṃ kurvīta vaiṣṇavam || 10-684 ||
ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ samyagarcayitvā janārdanam | caruṃ puruṣasūktena prāśayet putrakāmyayā || 10-685 ||
prāpnuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ putramacirāt santatikṣamam | dvādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ samyak payasā nirvapeccarum || 10-686 ||
yo juhoti sahasraṃ sa yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam | mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu kramāt pūjyaścatu(?)keśavaḥ || 10-687 ||
nārāyaṇo mādhavaśca govindo viṣṇureva ca | madhusūdana uktastrivikramo dāmanastathā || 10-688 ||
śrīdharaśca hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābho janārdanaḥ | pūjayitvā japet sūktaṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ tataḥ || 10-689 ||
homaṃ ca pūrvat kuryāt sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt | aputrā mṛtaputrā yā yā ca kanyāprasūrbhavet || 10-690 ||
tasyā yathā supatraḥ syāt tamupāyaṃ bravīmyaham | samidho'śvatthavṛkṣasya pratyarcaṃ juhuyācchatam || 10-691 ||
aṣṭādhikaṃ ca saghṛtamupatiṣṭheddhutāśanam | punarviṣṇuṃ pūjayitvā ghṛtahomaṃ samācaret || 10-692 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryāt pratyarcaṃ vāgyataḥ śuciḥ | saṃpātājyaṃ sthāpayitvā tannāryai prāśanāya ca || 10-693 ||
dadyāt sā ca patiṃ viṣṇuṃ namaskṛtya prabhakṣayet | tarpayecca dvijān samyaglaghvāśī saṃviśet kṣapām || 10-694 ||
paraṃ saptapravartenāvaśyaṃ garbhavatī bhavet |
atha puraścaraṇam |
araṇye nivasennityaṃ trikālaṃ snānamācaret || 10-695 ||
japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sūktametat trikālakam | māsamekaṃ phalāhāro māsamadbhiśca tarpayet || 10-696 ||
ādityamupatiṣṭheta mūlenānena nityaśaḥ | ājyaṃ hutvā daśaśataṃ trirbhirvarṣairjapeddine || 10-697 ||
tadbhaktastanmanā yukto daśavarṣāṇyananyabhāk | sākṣāt paśyati devaṃ taṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || 10-698 ||
iti puruṣasūktapuraścaraṇam |
atha śrīsūktavidhiḥ |
tatraiva |
atha sarvottamaṃ vakṣye śrīsūktaṃ savidhānakam | kalau dāridryanāśāya nānyat kiñcinnṛṇāṃ tathā || 10-699 ||
hiraṇyavarṇām (-) ityādi |
hiraṇyavarṇāmityasya ṛco lakṣmīmunirmataḥ | caturdaśānāṃ śeṣāṇāmānandaḥ kardamastathā || 10-700 ||
ciklītalakṣmītanayāścatvāro munayo matāḥ | hṛdayāditisṛṇāṃ ca chando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam || 10-701 ||
kāṃso'smitarco bṛhatī candrāvādityavarṇayoḥ | triṣṭupchanda upaitu māṃ devādyaṣṭa (-) ṛcāmapi || 10-702 ||
chando'nuṣṭup samākhyātaṃ tāmma āhava ityṛcaḥ | prastāraḥ paṅktiruddiṣṭo devate śrīvibhāvasū || 10-703 ||
vyañjanāni tu bījāni svarāḥ śaktaya īritāḥ | vindavaḥ kīlakaṃ proktamaṅguṣṭhādiṣaḍaṅkam || 10-704 ||
hiraṇyā ca tathā tandrā tṛtīyā rajataprabhā | hiraṇyasrak hiraṇyākṣā tathā hiraṇyavarṇikā || 10-705 ||
etābhirṅenamo'ntābhiḥ prakuryādaṅgakalpanam |
atha dhyānam |
aruṇanalinasaṃsthā tadrajaḥpuñjavarṇā karakamaladhṛteṣṭābhītiyugmāmbujā ca || 10-706 ||
maṇimukuṭavicitrālaṅkṛtākalpajālai (-) rbhavatu bhuvanamātā santataṃ śrīḥ śriye naḥ |
atha puraścaraṇam |
pariṣiñcet triśo nityaṃ sūktaistaiḥ snānakarmaṇi || 10-707 ||
ādityābhimukho japyādyāvat tāvacca tarpayet | śuklādyāṃ tithimārabhya yāvadekādaśī bhavet || 10-708 ||
tāvaddvādaśasāhasraṃ japenniścalamānasaḥ | brahmacaryarataḥ śuddhavastradantādikaḥ sudhīḥ || 10-709 ||
padmaistrimadhuropetairghṛtāktena payo'ndhasā | śrīsamidbhiḥ sarpiṣā ca pratyekaṃ triśataṃ hunet || 10-710 ||
dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśaivā'tha sadviprā(/)ścāpi bhojayet | tena siddho bhavenmantro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 10-711 ||
kundamandārakumudamālatīpadmaketakam | nandyāvarttāhvayaṃ jātī kalhāraṃ campakaṃ tathā || 10-712 ||
raktotpalādipuṣpāṇi lakṣmyāścātipriyāṇi hi | trivāramanvahaṃ mantrī juhuyācca yathāvidhi || 10-713 ||
ṣaṇmāsaṃ yaḥ karotyevaṃ sa syāllakṣmīpatiḥ svayam |
iti śrīsūktapuraścaraṇam |
atha navagrahāṇāṃ vaidikamantrāḥ |
tatraiva |
tatra bhāskaramantrasya hiraṇyastūyako muniḥ || 10-714 ||
triṣṭup chando devatā ca savitā parikīrtitaḥ |
ākṛṣṇena rajasā varttamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca hiraṇyayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan |
aṅguṣṭhādiṣaḍaṅgāni ṣaḍdīrghānvitayoccaret || 10-715 ||
bhuvaneśyā'tha mantrasya padanyāsaṃ samācaret | śrīsūktokta (-) ṛcāsthāne tato dhyāyeddivākaram || 10-716 ||
dhyānaṃ yathā |
padmāsanaṃ padmakaraṃ padmagarbhasamudyutim | kirīṭinaṃ sakeyūraṃ maṇḍitaṃ raktacchatriṇam || 10-717 ||
rathārūḍhaṃ tasya savye tvadhidevāgnyadhiṣṭhitam | pratyadhideveśvareṇa savye yuktaṃ ca prāṅmukham || 10-718 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ | homatulyo japaḥ kāryastvadhipratyadhidaivataḥ || 10-719 ||
karavīrādikusumai raktacandanamiśritaiḥ | dūrvāṅkurairakṣataiśca tarpaṇaṃ syāddineśituḥ || 10-720 ||
atha candramantraḥ |
atha vakṣye candramantraṃ gautamo'sya munirmataḥ | gāyatrīchanda ityuktaṃ somo devaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 10-721 ||
athāyasva sametu viśvataḥ somavṛṣṇiyaṃ bhavāvājasya saṅgathe | ṣaḍdīrghaṃ vinduyuktena sakāreṇa ṣaḍaṅgakam | 722 ||
atha dhyānam |
kirīṭinaṃ śvetavastraṃ daśāśvaṃ śvetabhūṣaṇam | pāśapāṇiṃ dvibāhuṃ tamatrigotrasamudbhavam || 10-723 ||
jātaṃ yavanadeśe ca śvetagandhānulepanam | anuṣṭup chandasaṃ cātreyarṣaṃ śvetātapatrakam || 10-724 ||
śvetadhvajapatākāḍhyaṃ keyūramaṇiśobhitam | sthirīkṛtaṃ rathārūḍhamadhidaivatatoyayuk || 10-725 ||
umāpratyadhidevena vāyavyābhimukhasthitam |
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ sarvaśveteṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 10-726 ||
atha bhaumamantraḥ |
bhaumamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi virūpo'sya munirmataḥ | aṅgārako devatā'tra gāyatrī chanda īritam || 10-727 ||
agnirmūrdhādivaḥ kukutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ | apā(citra)retā(citra)sijinvati || 10-728 ||
a(/) bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni cāṅgulīnyāsa eva ca | rudrasthāneṣu kartavyaḥ padanyāso dvitīyakaḥ || 10-729 ||
atha dhyānam |
raktāmbaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ raktagandhānulepanam | raktapuṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 10-730 ||
varābhayagadāśūlahastaṃ meṣoparisthitam | vaśiṣṭhagotrasambhūtaṃ yamadagnyārṣakaṃ kujam || 10-731 ||
jagatīchandasaṃ raktaṃ raktadhvajapatākinam | avantodeśasambhūtaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ prapūjayet || 10-732 ||
raktacandanasaṃmiśrataṇḍulaistryasrake kṛte | aṅgule kṣmādhidevena yukte ṣāṇmātureṇa ca || 10-733 ||
yute pratyadhidevena tatrāvāhya prapūjayet |
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ madhuratrayasaṃyutāḥ || 10-734 ||
svādiryaḥ samidho home tarpaṇādyaṃ ca sūryavat |
atha budhamantraḥ |
budhamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bauddhastasya munirmataḥ || 10-735 ||
triṣṭupchando devatā'sya budho buddhiprado mataḥ | udbuvyasvāgne pratijāgṛhyena miṣṭyāpūrtte sa sṛjecāmayaṃ ca || 10-736 ||
punaḥkṛṇva(citra)stvā pitaraṃ yuvānamanvā tā(citra)sītvayitantumetam | bu(/)bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānamasya nirūpyate || 10-737 ||
pītāmbaraṃ pītavarṇaṃ pītagandhānulepanam | pītapuṣpaiḥ pujyamānaṃ khaḍgacarmagadāvarān || 10-738 ||
hastairdadhantaṃ siṃhasthaṃ cātrigotrasamudbhavam | bhāradvājārṣakaṃ jātaṃ magadhe ca kirīṭinam || 10-739 ||
bṛhatīchandasaṃ pītacchatradhvajapatākinam | keyūramaṇiśobhāḍhyamadhidevena viṣṇunā || 10-740 ||
tena pratyadhidevena yuktaṃ jñaṃ cintayāmyaham |
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ hunet tasya daśāṃśataḥ || 10-741 ||
apāmārgasamidbhiśca tarpaṇādi tataścaret |
atha bṛhaspatimantraḥ |
mantraṃ bṛhaspatervakṣye munirbṛtsamado mataḥ || 10-742 ||
triṣṭupchando devapativanditastasya devatā |
bṛhaspate atiyadaryo arhādyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajātatadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram |
bṛ(/) bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni nyāsamantraṃ samācaret || 10-743 ||
dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi varadaṇḍākṣasūtrakam | kamaṇḍaluṃ dadhaddhastaiḥ pītavarṇaṃ kirīṭinam || 10-744 ||
vaśiṣṭhārṣaṃ sindhudeśabhavaṃ pītāmbarāvṛtam | anuṣṭupchandasaṃ cāṅgirasagotraṃ kirīṭinam || 10-745 ||
pītadhvajapatākāḍhyaṃ pītacchatrānulepanam | keyūrāṅgadaśobhaṭyamadhidevendrasaṃyutam || 10-746 ||
brahmapratyadhidevena yutaṃ saṃcintya cāhvayet |
puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ homastrimadhurānvitaiḥ || 10-747 ||
pippalasya samidbhiḥ syāt tarpaṇaṃ pītapañcabhiḥ |
atha śukramantraḥ |
śukramantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhāradvājo munirmataḥ || 10-748 ||
triṣṭupchando nigaditaṃ daityācāryastu devatā | śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyadyupurūṣe ahanī dyaurivāsi || 10-749 ||
viśvāhi māyā avasi svadhāvo bhadrā te pūṣanniharātirastu | śu(/) bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā dhyānaṃ samācaret || 10-750 ||
dhyānamāha |
śuklāmbaraṃ śuklavarṇaṃ śuklagandhānulepanam | śuklapuṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ śaunakāṛṣaṃ kirīṭinam || 10-751 ||
caturbhujaṃ daṇḍadharaṃ ca sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalum | paṅktiśchandaśca varadaṃ tathā kīkaradeśajam || 10-752 ||
śvetacchatradhvajapatākinaṃ bhārgavagotrajam | sakeyūraṃ rathārūḍhaṃ śvetābharaṇabhūṣitam || 10-753 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ hunet trimadhurānvitaiḥ | udumbarasamidbhiśca tarpaṇādi tu candravat || 10-754 ||
atha śanimantraḥ |
śanimantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sindhudvīpo munirmataḥ | gāyatrīchanda ityuktaṃ devatā tu śanaiścaraḥ || 10-755 ||
śanno devīrabhīṣṭaye āpo bhavantu potaye śannorabhisravantu naḥ |
śa(/) bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryāddhyānaṃ tataścaret | bāṇāśanaṃ śūladharamindranīlasamadyutim || 10-756 ||
saurāṣṭradeśajaṃ proktaṃ varadaṃ gṛdhravāhanam | bhṛgvarṣaṃ kāśyape gotre jātaṃ cāpi kirīṭinam || 10-757 ||
kṛṣṇāmbaraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇagandhānulepanam | gāyatrīchandasaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇābharaṇabhūṣitam || 10-758 ||
keyūriṇaṃ mukuṭinaṃ kṛṣṇadhvajapatākinam | prajāpatyadhidevena sahitaṃ rathamāsthitam || 10-759 ||
padmapratyadhidevena yuktaṃ dhyātvā samarcayet |
atha puraścaraṇam |
sakastūryatha taiścāyaḥkāladvyaṅgulamaṇḍale || 10-760 ||
homaḥ samīsamidbhiḥ syādāyasārghena tarpaṇam | kṛṣṇapuṣpaiścandanaṃ tu kālīyaṃ cāgururbhavet || 10-761 ||
atha rāhumantraḥ |
rāhormantraṃ pravakṣyāmi vāmadevo munirmataḥ | gāyatrī chanda ityuktaṃ saiṃhikeyaśca devatā || 10-762 ||
kayānaścitra ābhuvadutī sadā vṛdhaḥ sakhākayā saciṣṭhayā vṛtā |
rā(/) bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānamasya nirūpyate | karālavadanaṃ khaḍgacarmaśūladharaṃ vahan || 10-763 ||
kṛṣṇāmbaraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇagandhānulepanam | kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ keyūramukuṭānvitam || 10-764 ||
pūrvadeśe samutpannaṃ krūramāṅgirasārṣakam | pāṭalāgotrasambhūtamauṣṭupchandasaṃ graham || 10-765 ||
kṛṣṇacchatraṃ rathārūḍhaṃ kṛṣṇadhvajapatākinam | sarpādhidaivataṃ paitrakālapratyadhidaivatam || 10-766 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
itthaṃ saṃcintya nairṛtye sūrpākāre tu maṇḍale | dvādaśāṅgulavistīrṇe cāhvayecchyāmalākṣataiḥ || 10-767 ||
dūrvābhirmadhurāktābhistasya homo vidhīyate | tarpaṇīyādibhirdravyaiḥ kaulikā(/)starpayeddvijān || 10-768 ||
atha ketumantraḥ | tatraiva |
ketumantraṃ pravakṣyāmi madhucchando munirmataḥ | devatāḥ ketavaḥ proktā gāyatraṃ chanda īritam || 10-769 ||
ketu kṛṇvannaketave peśomaryā apeśase samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ |
ka(/) bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānamasya nirūpyate | dhūmrākṣibāhavaḥ pāśadharāśca vikṛtānanāḥ || 10-780 ||
kiroṭino gṛdhravāhā madhyadeśodbhavā dṛḍhāḥ | citrāmbarāścitravarṇāścitragandhānulepanāḥ || 10-781 ||
nānāchandaskakā gautamārṣā jaiminigotrajāḥ | kṛṣṇapiṅgadhvajapatākino mukuṭinastathā || 10-782 ||
keyūriṇo rathārūḍhāḥ śūrā brahmādidevatāḥ | citraguptapratyadhidevatāścātra vicintayet || 10-783 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ kuśā home prakīrtitāḥ | madhuratrayasaṃyuktāścitradravyaiḥ pratarpayet || 10-784 ||
iti navagrahāṇāṃ vaidikamantrāḥ |
athāgnidurgāmantraḥ |
tatraiva |
sarvārthasādhakaṃ vakṣye saṃgrāmavijayapradam | jalandharavadhāyāhaṃ yat smarāmi śṛṇuṣva tat || 10-785 ||
jātavedase sūnavāmasomama rātīyato nidahāti vedaḥ sa naḥ pariṣadati durgāṇi viśvānāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ |
triṣṭup chando muniścāsya marīciḥ kāśyapo mataḥ | devatā jātavedo'gniḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret || 10-786 ||
navāgaṣaṭsaptanāgasaptabhirmantravarṇakaiḥ |
atha dhyānam |
vidyuddāmasamaprabhāṃ mṛgapatiskandhasthitāṃ bhīṣaṇāṃ kanyābhiḥ karavālakheṭakalasaddhastābhirāsevitām || 10-787 ||
hastaiścakradarāsikheṭaviśikhān pāśāṅkuśau tarjanīṃ bibhrāṇāmanalātmikāṃ śaśidharāṃ durgāṃ trinetrāṃ smaret |
atha puraścaraṇam |
mantravarṇasahasrāṇi japeddhomaṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 10-788 ||
vedavedābdhisaṅkhyākaṃ tilasiddhārthacitrajaiḥ | mūlaiśca samidhābhiśca vaṭodumbarapippalaiḥ || 10-789 ||
arkaplakṣodbhavaiścāpi ghṛtena haviṣā'nnakaiḥ |
sarvairghṛtāktairjuhuyāt tilaiścānte ghṛtāhutiḥ || 10-790 ||
tataḥ saṃtarpya satilaiḥ kṛtvā cātmābhiṣecanam | samārādhya varān devā(/)stīṣayedgurumātmanaḥ || 10-791 ||
ityagnidurgāmantrapuraścaraṇam | vaidikamantrapuraścaraṇopayuktavaidikahomavidhistu vistarabhayānneha likhyate |
atha homadravyapramāṇāni |
(śāradāyām)
athātra homadravyāṇāṃ pramāṇamabhidhīyate | karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam || 10-792 ||
uktāni pañca dravyāṇi tatsamāni manīṣibhiḥ | tatsamaṃ madhudugdhānnamakṣamātramudāhṛtam || 10-793 ||
dadhi prasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭisammitāḥ | pṛthukāstatpramāṇāḥ syuḥ saktavo'pi tathā matāḥ || 10-794 ||
guḍaṃ palārdhamānaṃ syaccharkarā'pi tathā matā | grāsārdhaṃ carumānaṃ syādikṣuḥ parvāvadhirmataḥ || 10-795 ||
ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathā'pūpāni kalpayet | kadalīphalanāraṅgaphalānyekaikaśo viduḥ || 10-796 ||
mātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā kṛtam | aṣṭadhā nārikelāni khaṇḍitāni vidurbudhāḥ || 10-797 ||
tridhā kṛttaṃ phalaṃ vailvaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tridhā | phalānyanyānyakhaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṅgulāḥ || 10-798 ||
dūrvātrayaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ guḍucī caturaṅgulā | vrīhayo muṣṭimānāḥ syurmudgamāṣayavā api || 10-799 ||
tāṇḍulāḥ syuścaturthāṃśāḥ kodravā muṣṭisammitāḥ |
godhūmaraktakalamā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥ || 10-800 ||
tilāśculukamānāḥ syuḥ sarṣapāstatpramāṇataḥ | śuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ marīcānyapi viṃśatiḥ || 10-801 ||
puraṃ vadaramānaṃ syādrāmaṭhaṃ tatsamaṃ smṛtam | candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṅkumāni ca || 10-802 ||
tintiḍī bījamānāni samuddiṣṭāni deśikaiḥ |
karṣādilakṣaṇānyuktāni (skānde)
guñjābhirdaśabhirmāṣaḥ śāṇo māṣacatuṣṭayam | dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolo vadaraṃ kṣudravastathā || 10-803 ||
tau dvau pāṇitalaṃ karṣaḥ suvarṇaḥ kevalaṃ grahaḥ | picurviḍālapadakaṃ tindo'kṣaśca taddvayam || 10-804 ||
śuktiraṣṭamikā te dve palaṃ niṣkacaturthikā | muṣṭimātraṃ prakuñco'tha dve pale prasṛtistathā (-) iti || 10-805 ||
agasye(?)na tu |
guñjābhiḥ pañcabhiścaiko māṣakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | bhavet ṣodaśabhirmāṣaiḥ suvarṇa karṣa eva ca || 10-806 ||
palaṃ suvarṇāścatvāraḥ pañca vā'pi prakīrtitam (-) ityuktam |
etanmate'śītiguñjābhirekaḥ karṣaḥ sa eva suvarṇo'pi | pṛthukāścipīṭakāḥ | guḍucī latāviśeṣaḥ | puraṃ gugguluḥ | rāmaṭhaṃ hiṅgu | somaḥ śambhuḥ |
anukte tu havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyate || 10-807 ||
anukte cāñjatadravye ghṛtamevāñjanaṃ viduḥ | saṅkhyānuktau sahasraṃ syādravyānuktau ghṛtaṃ tathā || 10-808 ||
samidhānuktaviṣaye pālāśyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
tathā |
lājādihomo hastena sāṅgulena vidhīyate || 10-809 ||
samitpuṣpaphalādīnāṃ homaḥ syānmṛgamudrayā | dravadravyaiḥ śruvaḥ prokto mantratantraviśāradaiḥ || 10-810 ||
iti homadravyapramāṇāni |
bibhratyadbhutabhūtibhūtapavacovaicitryacitrāmṛta (-) srotaḥśālini saṃnibandhanasaritsaṃbhedamabhyarhitam | sanmuktopamayuktibhāji daśamo ramyastaraṅgo'gamat sarvorvīpatinetṛnirmitapuraścaryārṇave'smin nave || 10-811 ||
[iti śrīmanmahārājadhirājaśrīpratāpasiṃhasāhaviracite puraścaryārṇave sarasvatyādi mantrapuraścaraṇapūrvakagāyatryādivaidikamantrapuraścaraṇanir ū(-)paṇaṃ nāma daśamastaraṅgaḥ] || 10 ||
atha dūrgāmantrabhedāstatpuraścaraṇaviśeṣāśca nirūpyante |
tathā ca (śāradātilake)
tato durgāmanuṃ vakṣye dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam | māyā triḥ karṇabījāḍhyo bhūyo'sau sargavān bhavet || 11-1 ||
pañcāntakaḥ pratiṣṭhāvān māruto bhautikāsanaḥ | tārādihṛdayānto'yaṃ mantro vasvakṣarātmakaḥ || 11-2 ||
ṛṣiśca nāradaśchando gāyatraṃ devatā manoḥ | durgā samīritā sadbhirduritāpannivāriṇī || 11-3 ||
namaskāraviyuktena mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ | drāmādyaiḥ saha kurvīta ṣaḍaṅgāni yathāvidhi || 11-4 ||
atha dhyānam |
siṃhasthā śaśiśekharāmarakataprakhyaiścaturbhirbhujaiḥ śaṅkhaṃ cakradhanuḥśarā(/)śca dadhatī netraistribhiḥ śobhitā | āmuktāṅgadahārakaṅkaṇaraṇatkāñcīraṇannūpurā durgādurgatihāriṇī bhavatu vo ratnollasatkuṇḍalā || 11-5 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
vasulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tilairmadhuralolitaiḥ | payo'ndhasā vā juhuyāt tatsahasraṃ jitendriyaḥ || 11-6 ||
iti durgāmantraḥ |
atha mahiṣamardinīmantraḥ |
tatraiva |
bhāntaṃ viyatsanayanaṃ śveto mardini ṭhadvayam |
aṣṭākṣarī samākhyātā vidyā mahiṣamardinī || 11-7 ||
ayaṃ mantro māyāpraṇavādyanyatamabījāḍhyo navākṣaro bhavati | taduktaṃ (kulacūḍāmaṇiviśvasārādau)
trailokyabījabhūtānte sambodhanapadaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭisaṃhārakau varṇau vidyāmahiṣamardinī || 11-8 ||
praṇavādyāṃ japedvidyāṃ māyāḍhyāṃ vā japet sudhīḥ | badhūbījādikāṃ vā'pi kavacāḍhyāṃ japet tathā || 11-9 ||
(śāradāyām)
mahiṣahiṃsike hu(/) phaṭ hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam | mahiṣaśatro sārṣi hu(/) phaṭ śiro'ṅgaṃ samudāhṛtam || 11-10 ||
mahiṣaṃ dveṣaya dvandvaṃ hu(/) phaḍantaḥ śikhāmanuḥ | mahiṣaṃ hanayugmānte devi hu(/) phaṭ tanucchadam || 11-11 ||
mahiṣānte sūdini huṃ phaḍantaṃ śastramīritam | mantrairetairjātiyuktaiḥ pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet || 11-12 ||
atha dhyānam |
gāruḍopalasannibhāṃ maṇimaulikuṇḍalamaṇḍitāṃ naumi bhālavilocanāṃ mahiṣottamāṅganiṣeduṣīm | cakraśaṅkhakṛpāṇakheṭakabāṇakārmukaśūlakā(/) (-) starjanīmapi bibhratīṃ nijabāhubhiḥ śaśiśekharām || 11-13 ||
puraścaraṇam |
aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraistilaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
juhuyāditi śeṣaḥ |
iti mahiṣamardinīmantraḥ |
atha śūlinīmantraḥ |
tatraiva |
jvalajvalapadasyānte śūlinīti padaṃ vadet || 11-14 ||
duṣṭagrahaṃ humastrānte vahnijāyāvadhirmanuḥ | pañcabhirdaśabhiḥ prokto grahaśatruvināśanaḥ || 11-15 ||
ṛṣirdīrghatayā proktaḥ kakucchanda udāhṛtam | śūlinī devatā proktā samastasuravanditā || 11-16 ||
durge hṛdvarade śīṛṣaṃ vindhyavāsini tacchikhā | asurānte mardinī syādyuddhapūrvapriye punaḥ || 11-17 ||
trāśayadvitayaṃ varma devasiddhasupūjite | nandinī syādrakṣayugaṃ mahāyogeśvarī kramāt || 11-18 ||
śūlinyādyā hu(/) phaḍantāḥ pañcāṅgamanavaḥ smṛtāḥ |
atha dhyānam |
adhyārūḍhāṃ mṛgendraṃ sajalajaladharaśyāmalāṃ hastapadmaiḥ śūlaṃ bāṇaṃ kṛpāṇīmarijalajagadācāpapāśān vahantīm || 11-19 ||
candrottaṃsāṃ trinetrāṃ catasṛbhirasinā kheṭakān bibhratībhiḥ kanyābhiḥ sevyamānāṃ pratibhaṭabhayadāṃ śūlinīṃ bhāvayāmi |
atha puraścaraṇam |
manumenaṃ japenmantrī varṇalakṣaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 11-20 ||
sarpiṣā'jyena homastu taddaśāṃśamito bhavet |
iti śūlinīmantraḥ |
atha prāyaḥ sarveṣu pustakeṣu vanadurgetyatra navadurgetyupalabhyate | vanadurgāmantraḥ |
uttiṣṭhapadamābhāṣya puruṣi syāt padaṃ tataḥ || 11-21 ||
pitāmahaḥ sanetre naḥ svapiṣi syādbhayaṃ ca me | samupasthitamuccārya yadi śakyamanantaram || 11-22 ||
aśakyaṃ vā punastanme vadedbhagavatiṃ tataḥ |
śamayāgnivadhūḥ saptatriṃśadvarṇātmako manuḥ || 11-23 ||
ṛṣirāraṇyakaścchando'pyatyanuṣṭubudāhṛtam | devatā vanadurgā syāt sarvadurgavimocanī || 11-24 ||
ṣaḍbhiścaturbhiraṣṭābhiraṣṭābhiḥ ṣaḍbhirindriyaiḥ | mantrārṇairaṅgakḷptiḥ syājjātiyuktairyathākramam || 11-25 ||
atha dhyānam |
sauvarṇāmbujamadhyagāṃ trinayanāṃ saudāminosannibhāṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakravarābhayāni dadhatīmindoḥ kalāṃ bibhratīm | graiveyāṅgadahārakuṇḍaladharāmākhaṇḍalādyaiḥ stutāṃ dhyāyedvindhyanivāsinīṃ śaśimukhīṃ pārśvasthapañcānanām || 11-26 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣacatuṣkaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ | juhuyāddhaviṣā mantrī śālibhiḥ sarpiṣā tilaiḥ || 11-27 ||
iti vanadurgāmantraḥ |
atha navadurgātmakacāmuṇḍāmantraḥ |
(merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi cāmuṇḍāyā mahāmanum | navadurgātmakaṃ yasya sevanādbhuktimuktayaḥ || 11-28 ||
suratho yatprasādena rājyaṃ prāpyābhavanmanuḥ | saṃsārabandhanirṇāśi jñānamāptaṃ samādhinā || 11-29 ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇoktaṃ caritatritayaṃ stavaḥ | japādyasya phalaṃ dadyāt taṃ manuṃ vacmi sāmpratam || 11-30 ||
vāglajjākāmabījāni cāmuṇḍāyai padaṃ vadet | vicce navārṇamantro'yaṃ śaktimantrottamottamaḥ || 11-31 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāstu munuyo'sya prakīrtitāḥ |
gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭup ca chandastrayamudīritam || 11-32 ||
devatā'sya mahākālī mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | nandā śākambharī bhīmā śaktitrayamudāhṛtam || 11-33 ||
tisro'sya śaktayo durgā bhrāmarī raktadantikā | agnivāyubhagāstattvaṃ prāgvadṛṣyādikaṃ nyaset || 11-34 ||
tathā |
tataḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kurvīta vibhaktairmūlavarṇakaiḥ | ekenaikena caikena caturbhiyugmakena ca || 11-35 ||
namastenaiva mantreṇa kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt |
atha dhyānam |
tato devītrayaṃ dhyāyet kālikādhyānamucyate || 11-36 ||
daśāsyāṃ daśapādāṃ ca daśahastāṃ vidhistutām | idranīladyutiṃ khaḍgaṃ cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ śiraḥ śarān || 11-37 ||
dakṣahasteṣu dadhatīṃ gadāṃ śūlaṃ bhuśuṇḍikām | parighaṃ ca dhanurvāme dadhatīṃ brahmasaṃstutām || 11-38 ||
madhukaiṭabhanāśārthaṃ sālaṅkārāṃ trivīkṣaṇām |
tantrāntare'pi |
khaḍgaṃ cakragadeṣucāpaparighān śūlaṃ bhuśuṇḍīṃ śiraḥ śaṅkhaṃ saṃdadhatīṃ karaistrinayanāṃ sarvāṅgabhūṣāvṛtām || 11-39 ||
nīlāśmadyutimāsyapādadaśakāṃ seve mahākālikāṃ yāmastaucchayite harau kamalajo hantuṃ madhuṃ kaiṭabham |
iti cāmuṇḍāmantraḥ |
atha mahālakṣmīdhyānam |
(merutantre)
tato dhyāyenmahālakṣmīṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm || 11-40 ||
samastadevatātejojātāṃ padmāsanasthitām | aṣṭādaśabhujāmakṣamālāṃ padmaṃ ca śāyakān || 11-41 ||
khaḍgaṃ vajraṃ gadāṃ cakraṃ dakṣahaste kamaṇḍalum | śaṅkhaṃ ca dadhatīṃ vāme śaktiṃ ca paraśuṃ dhanuḥ || 11-42 ||
carmadaṇḍau surāpātraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ pāśaṃ triśūlakam |
anyatrāpi |
akṣasrakparaśū gadeṣukuliśān padmaṃ dhanuḥ kuṇḍikāṃ daṇḍaṃ śaktimasiṃ ca carma jalajaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ surābhājanam || 11-43 ||
śūlaṃ pāśasudarśane ca dadhatīṃ hastaiḥ pravālaprabhāṃ seve śairibhamardinīmiha mahālakṣmīṃ sarojasthitām |
atha sarasvatīdhyānam |
(merutantre)
sarasvatīṃ tato dhyāyeccharaccandrasamaprabhām || 11-44 ||
śaṅkhaṃ ca muśalaṃ cakraṃ bāṇān dakṣeṣu bibhratīm | ghaṇṭāṃ śūlaṃ halaṃ cāpaṃ vāmahasteṣu bibhratīm || 11-45 ||
gaurīdehasamudbhūtāṃ nṛṇāmānandadāyinīm | ādhārabhūtāṃ jagataḥ śumbhādikavimardinīm || 11-46 ||
adhiṣṭhātrīṃ tṛtīyasya caritrasya smaret sadā |
tantrāntare'pi |
ghaṇṭāśūlahalāni śaṅkhamuśale cakraṃ dhanuḥ śāyakaṃ hastābjairdadhatīṃ ghanāntavilasacchītāṃśuśuklaprabhām || 11-47 ||
gaurīdehasamudbhavāṃ trijagatāmādhārabhūtāṃ mahā (-) pūrvāmatra sarasvatīmanubhaje śumbhādidaityārdinīm |
atha puraścaraṇam |
sitapakṣatimārabhya cāṣṭamyantamiṣasya yaḥ || 11-48 ||
japellakṣaṃ manuṃ homaṃ khādyaistrimadhurāplutaiḥ | pratyahaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ caṇḍīmādyantayoḥ paṭhet || 11-49 ||
viprān gurun samārādhya vāñchitaṃ labhate drutam |
atha jayadurgāmantraḥ |
(śāradāyām)
tāro durgeyugaṃ raktamantyaḍhāntau salocanau || 11-50 ||
dviṭhāntā jayadurgeyaṃ vidyā vedyā daśākṣarī | tārādidurge hṛdayaṃ durge śira itīritam || 11-51 ||
durgāyai syācchikhā varma bhūtarakṣiṇi kīrtitam | tārādidurgeyugalaṃ rakṣiṇyastramudīritam || 11-52 ||
atha dhyānam |
kālābhrāmāṃ kaṭākṣairarikulabhayadāṃ maulibaddhendurekhāṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ kṛpāṇaṃ triśikhamapi karairudvahantīṃ trinetrām | siṃhaskandhādhirūḍhāṃ tribhuvanamakhilaṃ tejasā pūrayantīṃ dhyāyeddurgāṃ jayākhyāṃ tridaśaparivṛtāṃ sevitāṃ siddhikāmaiḥ || 11-53 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
(varṇalakṣamiti kvacit pāṭhaḥ |)bāṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ ghṛtena juhuyāt tataḥ | daśāṃśaṃ saṃskṛte vahnau brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet || 11-54 ||
iti durgāprakaraṇam |
atha durgotsavavidhiḥ pradarśyate |
(bṛhatsiddhāntasāre)
āśvinasya site pakṣe nānāvidhamahotsavaiḥ | prasādayeyuḥ śrīdurgāṃ caturvargaphalārthinaḥ || 11-55 ||
(kālikāpurāṇe)
durgātantreṇa mantreṇa kuyurdurgāmahotsavam |
mahānavamyāṃ śaradi validānaṃ nṛpādayaḥ || 11-56 ||
āśvinasya tu yā śuklā bhaveddurgāṣṭamī tithiḥ | mūrtibhedairmahādevī pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti bhūtaye || 11-57 ||
kanyāsaṃsthe ravau vatsa śuklāmārabhya nandakām | ayācī tvatha naktāśī ekāśī tvatha(tvatha vā'nnada iti vā0 pā0 |)vāyvadaḥ || 11-58 ||
prātaḥsnāyī jitadvandvastrikālaṃ śivapūjakaḥ |
mahānavamyāmiti | taduktaṃ (devīpurāṇe)
āśvine śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāditithitraye || 11-59 ||
mahāśabdaḥ prayoktavyo nānyatreti viniścayaḥ |
ārabhyeti | śuklāṃ pratipadamārabhyetyarthaḥ | annada iti | brāhmaṇān bhojayitvetyarthaḥ | vāyvada iti pāṭhe tu vāyubhakṣa ityarthaḥ | jitadvandva iti | śītoṣṇādisahiṣṇurityarthaḥ | śivapūjaka ityatra ekaśeṣo boddhavyaḥ | (rudrayāmale)
ekottarābhivṛddhyā tu navamī yāvadeva hi || 11-60 ||
caṇḍīpāṭhaṃ japeccaiva jāpayedvā vidhānataḥ |
tathā |
evaṃ caturvedavido viprān sarvān prasādayet || 11-61 ||
teṣāṃ ca varaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vedapārāyaṇāya vai |
tantrāntare |
vīrarātryādiṣu śreṣṭhā mahārātrirmaheśvari || 11-62 ||
upoṣya pūjayet teṣāṃ durgāṃ durgārtināśinīm |
vīrarātryādayaṃ proktāḥ (śaktisaṅgame)
vīrarātrirmahārātriḥ kālarātristathaiva ca || 11-63 ||
mahārātrirghorarātriḥ krodharātristathaiva ca |
tathaiva cācalā rātristārārātristathaiva ca || 11-64 ||
śivarātrirdivyarātrirdāruṇā ca yathākramāt | kathyate parameśāni śṛṇu sāvahitā bhava || 11-65 ||
caturdaśyāṃ saṃkrame ca kularkṣe kulavāsaraiḥ | ardharātre yathāyogo vīrarātriḥ prakīrtitā || 11-65 ||
śuklāṣṭamī cāśvinasya navarātraṃ tu tasya vai | mahārātrirmaheśāni kālarātriṃ śṛṇu priye || 11-66 ||
dīpotsavacaturdaśyāṃ tvamāyā yoga eva tu | kālarātrirmaheśāni tārākālīpriyaṅkarī || 11-67 ||
janmāṣṭamī maheśāni moharātriḥ prakīrtitā |
tathā |
caitre māsi navamyāṃ ca śuklapakṣe tu bhūsute || 11-68 ||
krodharātrirmaheśāni tārārūpā bhaviṣyati | māsi mārgaśire prāpte kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ maheśvari || 11-69 ||
mahākālasvarūpā ca ghorarātriḥ prakīrtitā | prāpte phālgunake māse kṛṣṇaikādaśikā tu yā || 11-70 ||
bhṛgubhaumayutā cet syādacalārātrirīritā | jyaiṣṭhī yā daśamī śuddhā bhṛguvāsarasaṃyutā || 11-71 ||
daśayogasamāyuktā tārā caikādaśī yadi | sā tithirdivyarātriśca kīrtitā parameśvari || 11-72 ||
jyaiṣṭho yā daśamī śuddhā daśayogasamanvitā | vaṭukasya tithiḥ proktā vaṭukotpattikāriṇī || 11-73 ||
amā bhaumasamāyuktā saṃkrameṇa samanvitā | kula (-) ṛkṣasamāyuktā grahaṇaṃ yadi cedbhavet || 11-74 ||
tārārātristu saṃproktā bhāgyādeva tu labhyate | phālgune kṛṣṇapakṣe tu hyardharātre bhṛgoḥ śive || 11-75 ||
śivarātristu saṃjātā sarvasiddhipradāyinī | amā bhṛgusamāyuktā sūryagrahaṇayugyadi || 11-76 ||
aparāhṇe yadā yogo mṛtasaṃjīvinī tithiḥ | snānadānādihomāntamanantaphaladaṃ bhavet || 11-77 ||
aṣṭamī caitramāsīyā saṃkrameṇa samanvitā | siddhirātririti khyātā tārākālīsamā kalau || 11-78 ||
tṛtīyā mādhave śuddhā kulavārarkṣasaṃyutā | dāruṇā kīrtitā devī sarvasiddhīśvarī parā || 11-79 ||
kulavārādayaśca |
raviścandro guruḥ sauriścatvāraste'kulā matāḥ | bhaumaśukrau kulākhyau tu budhavāraḥ kulākulaḥ || 11-80 ||
dvitīyā daśamī ṣaṣṭhī kulākulamudāhṛtam | viṣamaścākulāḥ sarvāḥ śeṣāśca tithayaḥ kulāḥ || 11-81 ||
vāruṇārdrābhijinmūlaṃ kulākulamudāhṛtam | kulāni samadhiṣṇyāni śeṣabhānyakulāni ca || 11-82 ||
iti (rudrayāmale) proktāḥ tathā |
aṣṭamī pratimāsaṃ tu kṛṣṇapakṣasya pārvati | bhaumayuktā tathā ṛkṣayuktā vā kevalā ca vā || 11-83 ||
devīrātririti khyātā sarvasiddhipradāyinī |
ṛkṣayuktā kularkṣayuktā | tathā |
budhāṣṭamī maheśāni pratimāsaṃ tu yā bhavet || 11-84 ||
viṣṇurātririti khyātā bhādre māsi viśeṣataḥ |
tatraiva (navarātranirṇaye)
navaśaktisamāyuktaṃ navarātraṃ taducyate || 11-85 ||
ekaiva devadeveśi navadhā pariniṣṭhitā | śayanaṃ bodhanākhyaṃ ca navarātraṃ dvidhā bhavet || 11-86 ||
śayanaṃ caitramāsīyamāśvinasthaṃ ca bodhanam | dvayostu samupoṣyaiva sarvasiddhiṃ labhennaraḥ || 11-87 ||
nirāhārī phalāhārī tvekabhakto jalavrataḥ | naktabhojī haviṣyāśī yathāśakti samācaret || 11-88 ||
atha devīpūjopayuktamaṇḍapalakṣaṇaṃ (devīpurāṇe)
aiśāne pūrvabhāge vā siddhyardhaṃ manasaḥ priyam | devīgṛhaṃ prakartavyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 11-89 ||
daśa dvādaśa vā'rabhya yāvaddhastaśataṃ bhavet |
(bhaviṣyottare)
durgāgṛhaṃ prakartavyaṃ caturasraṃ suśobhanam || 11-90 ||
rahasyaṃ svastikādyaiśca carcitaṃ vastramaṇḍitam | dīpamālāparikṣiptaṃ dvāradāmopaśobhitam || 11-91 ||
gauramṛdgomayābhyāṃ ca liptaṃ śastaṃ samīritam | tanmadhye vedikā kāryā caturhastā samā śubhā || 11-92 ||
tasyāṃ siṃhāsanaṃ saumyaṃ kambalājinasaṃyutam | tatra durgāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām || 11-93 ||
sarvadevamayīṃ prauḍhayauvanonmādaśālinīm | bhujaiścaturbhī rucirairdaśabhirvā vibhūṣitām || 11-94 ||
taptahāṭakavarṇāṅgīṃ trinetrāṃ śaśiśekharām |
pītāmbaraparidhānāṃ nīlakauśeyasaṃyutām || 11-95 ||
graiveyahārakeyūranūpurābharaṇānvitām | nānāratnavicitreṇa mukuṭena virājitām || 11-96 ||
anekakusumākīrṇakapardena virājitām | nitambabimbasannaddhakiṅkiṇīkvaṇanādinīm || 11-97 ||
śūlacakradaṇḍaśaktivajracāpāsidhāriṇīm | ghaṇṭākṣamālākarakapānapātralasatkarām || 11-98 ||
tadagre chinnaśirasaṃ mahiṣaṃ rudhirāplutam | niḥsṛtārdhatanuṃ kaṇṭhanālāccarmāsidhāriṇam || 11-99 ||
devīkaradhṛtagrīvaṃ śūlenorasi tāḍitam | daityaṃ karāladaṃṣṭrāsyaṃ vidyutkapiśamūrdhajam || 11-100 ||
nāgapāśena vikṣiptaṃ haryakṣeṇābhividrutam | vamadrudhiravaktreṇa dhunvato'rdhaṃ śaṭāruṣā || 11-101 ||
ūrdhalāṅgūladaṇḍena devyadhiṣṭhānaśobhinā | sarvato mātṛcakreṇa sevyamānāṃ suraistathā || 11-102 ||
pūjayet prayato devīṃ naro niyamamāsthitaḥ |
sthāpane viśeṣa ukto (devīpurāṇe)
yāmyāsyā śubhadā durgā pūrvāsyā jayavardhinī | paścimābhimukho nityaṃ na sthāpyā saumyadiṅmukhī (-) iti || 11-103 ||
(matsyapurāṇo-)ktadaśabhujādhyānaṃ yathā |
kātyāyanyāḥ pravakṣyāmi mūrtiṃ daśabhujāṃ tathā | trayāṇāmapi devānāṃ dharmakāmārthakāriṇīm || 11-104 ||
jaṭājūṭasamāyuktāmardhendukṛtalakṣaṇām | netratrayasamāyuktāṃ padmendusadṛśānanām || 11-105 ||
atasīpuṣpavarṇābhāṃ supratiṣṭhāṃ sulocanām | navayauvanasampannāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 11-106 ||
sucārudaśanāṃ tadvatpīnonnatapayodharām | tribhaṅgasthānasaṃsthānāṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm || 11-107 ||
triśūlaṃ dakṣiṇe dadyāt khaḍgaṃ cakraṃ kramādadhaḥ | tīkṣṇaṃ bāṇaṃ tathā śaktiṃ vāmato'pi nibodhata || 11-108 ||
kheṭakaṃ pūrṇacāpaṃ ca pāśamaṅkuśamūrdhvataḥ | ghaṇṭāṃ vā paraśuṃ cāpi vāmataḥ sanniveśayet || 11-109 ||
adhastānmahiṣaṃ tadvadviśiraskaṃ pradarśayet | śiraścedodbhavaṃ tadvaddānavaṃ khaḍgapāṇinam(khaḍgapāṇikamityatra khaḍgapāṇinapriti sarvapustakeṣupalabhyate |) || 11-110 ||
sapāśaṃ vāmahastena dhṛtakeśaṃ ca durgayā | vamadrudhiravaktraṃ ca devyāḥ siṃhaṃ pradarśayet || 11-111 ||
devyāstu dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ samaṃ siṃhoparisthitam | kiñcidūrdhvaṃ tathā vāmamaṅguṣṭhaṃ mahiṣopari || 11-112 ||
stūyamānṃ ca tadrūpamamaraiḥ sanniveśayet |
atha ṣoḍaśabhujādhyānam (kālikāpurāṇe)
yoganidrā mahāmāyā jagaddhātrī jaganmayī || 11-113 ||
bhujaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktā bhadrakālīti viśrutā | kṣīrodasyottare tīre bibhratī vipulāṃ tanum || 11-114 ||
atasīpuṣpavarṇābhā jvalatkāñcanakuṇḍalā | jaṭājūṭamakhaṇḍendumukuṭatrayabhūṣitā || 11-115 ||
nāgahāreṇa sahitā svarṇahāravibhūṣitā |
śūlaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca cakraṃ bāṇaṃ tathaiva ca || 11-116 ||
śaktiṃ vajraṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca nityaṃ dakṣiṇabāhubhiḥ | bibhratī satataṃ devī vikāśinayanojjvalā || 11-117 ||
kheṭakaṃ carma cāpaṃ ca pāśaṃ cāṅkuśameva ca | ghaṇṭāṃ paraśuṃ muśalaṃ bibhrato vāmapāṇibhiḥ || 11-118 ||
siṃhasthā nayanai raktavarṇaistribhirabhijjvajā | śūlena mahiṣaṃ bhittvā tiṣṭhantī parameśvarī || 11-119 ||
vāmapādena cākramya tatra devī jaganmayī |
aṣṭādaśabhujādhyānaṃ prāgevoktam | atha caṇḍikādhyānaṃ tatraiva |
dhammillasaṃyatakacā vidhoścādhomukhīṃ kalām || 11-120 ||
keśānte tilakasyordhve dadhatī sumanoharā | maṇikuṇḍalasaṃghṛṣṭagaṇḍā mukuṭamaṇḍitā || 11-121 ||
sajjyotiḥkarṇapūrābhyāṃ karṇāvāpūrya saṅgatā | suvarṇamaṇimāṇikyanāgahāravirājitā || 11-122 ||
sadā sugandhibhiḥ padmairamlānairatisundarī | mālāṃ bibharti grīvāyāṃ ratnakeyūradhāriṇī || 11-123 ||
mṛṇālāyatavṛttaistu bāhubhiḥ komalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | rājantī kañjukopetā pīnonnatapayodharā || 11-124 ||
kṣīṇamadhyā pītavastrā trivalīmadhyabhūṣitā | śūlaṃ vajraṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ śaktiṃ tathaiva ca || 11-125 ||
ūrdhvādikramato devī dadhatī vāmapāṇibhīḥ | siṃhasyopari tiṣṭhantī vyāghracarmaṇi kauśikī || 11-126 ||
bibhratī rūpamatulaṃ sasurāsuramohanam |
atha sarvamaṅgalādhyānaṃ (devīpurāṇe)
brahmovāca |
avatāre samāsena kathitā sarvamaṅgalā || 11-127 ||
pratimālakṣaṇaṃ samyak kathayāmi yathā bhavet | siṃhapadmāsanā saumyā jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitā || 11-128 ||
śūlākṣasūtravaradā kamaṇḍalukarā śubhā | caturbhūjā samākhyātā tathā cāṣṭabhujāṃ śṛṇu || 11-129 ||
varadaṃ cābhayaṃ khaḍgamakṣasūtraṃ ca dakṣiṇe | darpaṇaṃ śūlacāpaṃ ca caturthaṃ kheṭakaṃ bhavet || 11-130 ||
evaṃ cāṣṭabhujā devī maṅgalā sarvamaṅgalā |
atha devībodhanakālanirṇayaḥ | tatraikasyā eva mahiṣamardinyā aṣṭādaśabhujādidhyānabhedena bodhanakāla ukto (mahātharvaṇasaṃhitāyām)
aṣṭādaśabhujā durgā ugracaṇḍeti yā smṛtā || 11-131 ||
saiveyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhujā bhadrakālīti gīyate | daśabhirbāhubhiryuktā saiva kātyāyanī smṛtā || 11-132 ||
bhinnadhyānā kalpabhedānmahiṣāsuramardinī | kālabhede bodhanīyā sā durgotsavakarmaṇi || 11-133 ||
āśvināsitapakṣe tu divā sampūjya bhaktitaḥ | khaḍge navamyāmārdrāyāmugracaṇḍāṃ prabodhayet || 11-134 ||
āśvināsitapakṣa iti paurṇamāsvantāśvinakṛṣṇapakṣa ityarthaḥ | tathā ca | ārdrānakṣatrayuktāyāṃ pūrṇamāsyantāśvinakṛṣṇanavamyāmugracaṇḍāṃ divā khaḍge saṃpūjya prabodhayediti vākyārthaḥ | (liṅgapurāṇe devopurāṇe'pi)
yadā tvaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ mahāmāyāṃ prapūjayet | kanyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu pūjayitvā'rdrabhe divā || 11-135 ||
navamyāṃ bodhayeddevīṃ gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ | śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ tu devīkeśavimocanam || 11-136 ||
prātareva tu pañcamyāṃ snāpayeyuḥ śubhairjalaiḥ | saptamyāṃ patrikāpūjā aṣṭamyāṃ cābhyupoṣaṇam || 11-137 ||
pūjā ca jāgaraścaiva navamyāṃ vidhivadvaliḥ | saṃpreṣaṇaṃ daśamyāṃ tu krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ || 11-138 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyāmapi)
ye'ṣṭādaśabhujāṃ devīmugracaṇḍābhidhāṃ priye | pipūjayiṣavo marttyāstadupāsakatāmitāḥ || 11-139 ||
tathā'śvinanavamyāṃ vai kṛṣṇāyāṃ susamāhitāḥ | karavāle bodhayeyurmadhyāhne śaṅkhaniḥ svanaiḥ (-) iti || 11-140 ||
madhyāhnastu pañcadhā vibhaktadinatṛtīyāśaḥ |
ahnastu prathamo bhāgaḥ prātaḥkāla iti smṛtaḥ | dvitīyaḥ saṅgavaḥ prokto madhyāhnastu tṛtīyakaḥ || 11-141 ||
aparāhṇaścaturthaḥ syāt sāyāhnaḥ pañcamaḥ smṛtaḥ (-) iti vacanāt |
śaṅkhaniḥsvanairityupalakṣaṇam | śaṅkhādinānāvidhavādyaniḥsvanairityarthaḥ | atra yasmin dine navamyāṃ divārdrālābhastatraiva bodhanaṃ kāryam | dinadvaye navamyāṃ divārdrālābhe tu yugmavidhivākyabalādaṣṭamīviddhāyāmeva navamyāṃ bodhanaṃ kāryam | evamārdrāyā alābhe'pi yugmādareṇaiva vyavastheti varṣakriyākaumudīkṛtaḥ | vastutastu (-) madhyāhne śaṅkhaniḥsvanaiḥ (-) iti mahākālavacanānmadhyāhnasya bodhanakālatvapratītestadvyāptyaiva nirṇayaḥ |
karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālastatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ (-) iti bṛhadyājñavalkyokteḥ | dinadvaye madhyāhnavyāto tadavyāpto nakṣatreṇa | nakṣatrasya yugmavākyānyuktāni (nigame)
yugmāgniyugabhūtānāṃ ṣaṇmunyorvasurandhrayoḥ |
rudreṇa dvādaśīyuktā caturdaśyā ca pūrṇimā || 11-142 ||
pratipadā tvamāvāsyā tithyoryugmaṃ mahāphalam |
vyastametanmahādoṣaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ (-) iti | atra yugmādirandhrāmtāḥ śabdā dvitīyādinavamyantatithivācakāḥ | rudra ekavaśī | śeṣaṃ spaṣṭam | yadyapi yugmāgnityādivākyāni śuklapakṣaparatayoktāni (nirṇayāmṛtādau) pūrṇimāyā amāpratipadyugmasya ca kṛṣṇapakṣe'sambhavāditi | tathā'pi pūrvaviddhaiva navamī pakṣayorubhayorapīti mādhavokteḥ | kṛṣṇapakṣe'pi navamyaṣṭamīyutaiva grāhyā | nibandhavyākhyākṛtastu | caturdaśyā ca pūrṇimā (-) ityatra trayodaśyā caturdaśī (-) iti pāṭhasya smṛtyantare śravaṇādetāni yugmavākyāni pakṣadvayaparāṇīyāhuḥ | nirṇayasindhukṛto'pi amā pratipadyugmāt kṛṣṇapakṣaliṅgāt pakṣadvayaparamidaṃ tattadviśeṣavākyaiḥ kṛṣṇe tithiviśeṣe'pīḍyata iti vyājahruḥ | pūjayitvā'drabhe divā (-) ityārdrānakṣatrayogābhidhānaṃ tu nakṣatrayogasya praśastatayā sambhavābhiprāyam | tathā ca madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ navamyāṃ sati sambhave ārdrānakṣatrayuktānāṃ bodhanaṃ kuryāditi niṣkarṣaḥ |
tithinakṣatrayoryoge dvayorevānupālanam || 11-143 ||
yogābhāve tithirgrāhyā devyāḥ pūjanakarmaṇi (-) iti nirṇayasindhudhṛtadevalokteḥ |
tattannakṣatrayogastu phaladhikyāya kalpate |
bhānāmalābhe tu punaḥ praśastā kevalā tithiḥ (-) iti mahākālavacanācca | nirṇayāmṛtakṛtastu (-) pūjayitveti pūjanakriyāyāḥ samānakarttṛkayoḥ pūrvakāla iti ktvāpratyasya navamyāṃ bodhayediti bodhanakriyākālānnavamīrūpāt pūrvakāle'ṣṭamīrūpe vidhānāt ktvāpratyayasāmarthyādevāṣṭamyāṃ pūjanaṃ navamyāṃ bodhanamityāhuḥ | pūjayitvā'ṣṭamīdine (-) iti (kvācitkaḥ pāṭha - iti 4 pu0 pā0)nirṇayasindhau sthitam |
yat tu ārdrānakṣatrayuktāyāyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pūjanaṃ navamyāṃ prabodha iti mataṃ tat tuccham |
āśvināsitapakṣasya navamī yā śivarkṣayuk || 11-144 ||
bodhayitveśvarīṃ tasyāṃ śaradarcanamārabhet (-) iti navamyāmevārdrānakṣatrayogasya mahākālenābhihitatvāt | evamāśvinakṛṣṇanavamīmārabhyāśvinaśuklanavamīparyantamutsavo'ṣṭādaśabhujāpakṣaḥ | atha ṣoḍaśabhujāpakṣaḥ | (mahātharvaṇasaṃhitāyām)
iṣe śuklapratipadi bhujaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutām | bodhayitvā bhadrakālīṃ navamyantaṃ prapūjayet || 11-145 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyāmapi)
pratipadyeva śuklāyāṃ bodhayitvā sureśvarīm | abhyarcayennavāhāni tantrapaurāṇikakramaiḥ || 11-146 ||
kevalapaurāṇikakrameṇotsave kartavye tu āśvinakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmeva ṣoḍaśabhujāyā bhodhanaṃ kāryam | taduktaṃ (kaumudyāṃ liṅgapurāṇe ca) |
yadā tu ṣoḍaśabhujāṃ mahāmāyāṃ prapūjayet | durgātantreṇa mantreṇa viśeṣaṃ tatra vai śṛṇu || 11-147 ||
kanyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ | dvādaśyāmekabhaktaṃ ca naktaṃ kuryāt pare'hani || 11-148 ||
caturdaśyāṃ mahāmāyāṃ bodhayitvā vidhānataḥ | gītavāditranirghoṣairnānānaivedyavedanaiḥ || 11-149 ||
ayācitaṃ budhaḥ kuryādupavāsaṃ pare'hani | evameva vrataṃ kuryādyāvadvai navamī bhavet (-) iti || 11-150 ||
kalaśasthāpanaṃ tu pratipadyevoktaṃ (yāmale)
pratipadyeva kartavyaṃ kalaśasthāpanaṃ tathā (-) iti |
tṛtīyapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ kalaśasthāpanaṃ vakṣyate | athāśvinaśuklapratipannirṇīyate | sā ca durgotsavopapāsādiṣu paraviddhā grāhyā |
yā cāśvayuji māse syāt pratipadbhadrayā'nvitā | śuklā mamārcanaṃ tasyāṃ śatayajñaphalapradam || 11-151 ||
iti (devīpurāṇe)paraviddhāyāḥ prāśastyavidhānāt |
pūrvaviddhā tu yā śuklā bhavet pratipadāśvinī | navarātravrataṃ tasyāṃ na kāryaṃ śubhamicchatā || 11-152 ||
deśabhaṅgo bhavet tatra durbhikṣaṃ copajāyate | nandāyāṃ darśayuktāyāṃ yatra syānmama pūjanam || 11-153 ||
iti (mārkaṇḍeyadevīpurāṇayoḥ) pūrvaviddhāniṣedhācca | (rudrayāmale)
amāyuktā sadā caiva pratipanninditā matā | tatra na sthāpayet kumbhaṃ durbhikṣaṃ jāyate dhruvam || 11-154 ||
pratipat sadvitoyā tu kumbhāropanakarmaṇi |
(kalpataruḥ)
kuhūkāṣṭhopasaṃyuktāṃ varjayet pratipattithim || 11-155 ||
rājyanāśāya sā proktā nindataṃ tatra pūjanam |
(devīpurāṇe)
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi caṇḍikāpūjanakramam || 11-156 ||
āśvinasya site pakṣe pratipat suśubhe dine (-) ityupakramya | śuddhe tithau prakartavyaṃ pratipaccordhvagāminī || 11-157 ||
ādyāstu nāḍikāstyaktvā ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāpi vā | aparāhṇe ca kartavyaṃ śuddhasantatikāṅkṣibhiḥ || 11-158 ||
aparāhṇe yoginyāḥ prāśastyaṃ tu dvitīyadine pratipado'bhāve bodhyam | tatraiva (uḍḍāmaratantre) ca devīvacanam |
amāyuktā na kartavyā pratipat pūjane mama | muhūrtamātrā kartavyā dvitīyādiguṇānvitā || 11-159 ||
ādyāḥ ṣoḍaśa nāḍīṣtu labdhvā yaḥ kurute naraḥ | kalaśasthāpanaṃ tatra ariṣṭaṃ jāyate dhruvam || 11-160 ||
(śaktisaṅgame)
ghaṭikāḥ ṣoḍaśa tyājyā ādyāḥ pratipadastu yāḥ | kalaśasthāpanaṃ kuryāt kalyāṇaṃ jāyate tadā || 11-161 ||
tathā |
amāyuktā na kartavyā pratipat kālikārcane |
(skānde)
varjanīyā prayatnena amāyuktā tu pārthiva || 11-162 ||
dvitīyādiguṇairyuktā pratipat sarvakāmadā |
(devīpurāṇe) devīvacaḥ |
yo māṃ pūjayate bhaktyā dvitīyādiguṇānvitām || 11-163 ||
śaratpratipadaṃ jñatvā so'śnute sukhamavyayam | yadi kuryādamāyuktapratipatsthāpanaṃ mama || 11-164 ||
tasya śāpāyutaṃ datvā vaṃśanāśaṃ karomyaham | āgrahāt kurute yastu prathame sthāpanaṃ mama || 11-165 ||
tasya sampadvināśaḥ syājjyeṣṭhaputraśca naśyati | amāyuktā na kartavyā pratipaccaṇḍikārcane || 11-166 ||
dhanārthibhirviśeṣeṇa vaṃśahāniśca jāyate | na darśakalayā yuktā pratipaccaṇḍikārcane || 11-167 ||
udaye dvimuhūrtā'pi grāhyā sodayagāminī |
anyatrāpi |
paraviddhā ca yā śuddhā bhavet pratipadāśvinī || 11-168 ||
tatra durgotsavaṃ kuryādamāyuktāṃ vivarjayet (-) iti |
nanvetāni vākyāni (-)
pratipadā tvamāvasyā tithyoryugmaṃ mahāphalam (-) iti || 11-169 ||
etadyugmavākyaviruddhānīti cenna | yugmavāvayasthaitatpratipadabhinnapratipadviṣayatvāt | (taduktaṃ nandikeśvarapurāṇe iti 4 pu0 pā0 |) ata evoktaṃ (devīpurāṇe)
śaratkāle mahāpūjā kriyate yā ca vārṣikī | sā kāryodayagāminyāṃ na tatra tithiyugmatā (-) iti || 11-170 ||
na ca (-)
saṃpūjya navadurgāṃ ca naktaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ | navarātrābhidhaṃ karma naktavratamidaṃ smṛtam || 11-171 ||
iti (skāndāt ) asya navarātravratasya naktavratatve siddhe (-)
naktavrateṣu sarveṣu rātriyogaḥ praśasyate |
iti vacanāt pūrvaviddhaiva grāhyeti vācyam | amāyuktā na kartavyā ityādiviśeṣavacanairniṣedhāt | kiñca na kevalaṃ naktavratametat |
evaṃ ca vindhyavāsinyāṃ navarātropavāsataḥ || 11-172 ||
ekabhaktena naktena (svaśaktyāyācitaṃ naraḥ iti 4 pu0 pā0 |)tathaivāyācitena ca | pūjanīyā janairdevī sthāne sthāne pure pure || 11-173 ||
(hemādrau bhaviṣye) vratacatuṣṭayasyoktatvāt(nānāvratābhidhānāt iti 4 pu0 pā0 |) | ata evoktaṃ kamalākarabhaṭṭaiḥ pākṣikanaktānuvādo'yamiti (atropavāsādibahukarmābhidhāne'pi devīpūjanameva pradhānamiti rahasyavidaḥ iti 4 pu0 pā0 |) | atra kecid (rudrayāmaladevīpurāṇādi-)vacaneṣu kalaśasthāpanaśrutestadeva prathamadine niṣiddhaṃ na tūpavāsādi tasya pratipadā tvamāvāsyā (-) iti yugmavākyāt | śuklapakṣe darśaviddhā iti mādhavokteśca pūrvadine prāpte'sya bādhe pramāṇābhāvādityāhuḥ | vastutastu (-)
atra devīpūjāyāḥ prādhānyena pūrvadine tasyā niṣedhāt tadaṅgopavāsādāvapi paraiva grāhyeti yuktam | ata evoktaṃ devalena |
vratopasaniyame ghaṭikaikā'pi yā bhavet | sā tithistaddine pūjyā viparītā tu paitṛke (-) iti || 11-174 ||
atra ghaṭikāśabdo muhūrttapara iti gauḍāḥ | kamalākarabhaṭṭāstu (-) ghaṭikaiketi muhūrtamātrā kartavyeti ca dvimuhūrtastutiḥ | tenaudayikī pratipaddhimuhūrttā grāhyā | anyathā dvimuhūrttavidherveyarthyāpatteḥ | yadā tu pūrvadine saṃpūrṇā śuddhā bhūtvā paradine vadhate tadā saṃpūrṇatvādamāyogābhāṣācca pūrvaiva grāhyā | yāni ca dvitīyāyoganiṣedhakāni vacanāni kecit paṭhanti tānyapi śudhādhikaniṣedhaparāṇītyāhuḥ | dvimuhūrttavacaso'pi trimuhūrtastāvakatvāt paradine yadi pratipanmuhūrtatrayānnyūnā tadā darśayuktā'pi pūrvaiva brāhyeti samayaprakāśakṛtaḥ | vastutastu (-) trimuhūrttavidhirmukhyaḥ | dvimuhūrttavidhistvanukalpaḥ | dvimuhūrttā'pi kartavyeti dakṣeṇāpi (-) śabdasyoktatvāt (evaṃ prakṛte'pi udaye dvimurtā'pītyapi (-) śabdokterdvimurtavidhiranukalpo vodhyaḥ iti 4 pu0 pā0 |) | paradine pratipado'bhāve tvamāyktā'pi sā grāhyā |
amāyuktā'pi kartavyā yadi na syāt pare'hani |
iti nibandhavyākhyālikhitavacanāt (granthāntarodāhṛtāni daśaṃyuktapratipadvidhāyakāni vacanānyetadviṣayāṇyeva iti 4 pu0 pā0 |) | atra kecit |
vṛddhau samāptiraṣṭamyāṃ hrāse'māpratipanniśi || 11-175 ||
prārambho (navarātrasya 4 pu0 pā0 |) navacaṇḍyāstu navarātramato'rthavat |
iti (nirṇayasindhu-) dhṛta (devīpurāṇokta-) vacanānnavarātraśabdo navāhoratraparaḥ (iti (nirṇayasindhu-) dhṛta(-) (devīpurāṇo-)ktavacanāt | titheḥ kṣaye tathā vṛddhau pūrvavedho na dūṣyati | iti tāntrikavacanācca iti pu0 pā0 |) | amāyuktapratipanniṣedhakāni vākyāni tu tithihrāsābhāvaviṣayāṇītyāhuḥ | ayaṃ ca nepāladeśasampradāyaḥ | vastutastu (-)
na rātrau sthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ na ca kumbhābhiṣecanam || 11-176 ||
iti (matsya-)purāṇīyavacanīya rātrau kalaśasthāpanādiniṣedhāt prārambho navacaṇḍyāstviti pūjanāderapūrvakatvābhidhānācca navabhirdinairnavāvṛtticaṇḍīpāṭhaviṣayametadvacanam | navarātraśabdastu navatithipara eva | prārambho navarātrasya ityādau tu karmaṇi lākṣaṇikaḥ | tasya navāhorātraparatve tu tithihrāsavṛddhyornyūnādhikatvāpatteḥ | ata evoktaṃ (nirṇayāmṛte devīpurāṇe ca)
tithivṛddhau tithihrāse navarātramapārthakam | aṣṭarātreṇa doṣo'yaṃ navarātratithikṣaye || 11-177 ||
aṣṭarātreṇa doṣo hi pūrṇāṃ muktvā tu pūjanam | tithihrāse'pi karttavyaṃ pratipadyāśvine site (-) iti || 11-178 ||
pratipadi citrāvaidhṛtiyogāniṣedha uktastatraiva |
tvāṣṭravaidhṛtiyuktā cet pratipaccaṇḍikārcane | tayorantarvidhātavyaṃ kalaśāropaṇaṃ gṛhe (-) iti || 11-179 ||
tathā |
āśvine pratipat pūrṇā śuddhā yā tu bhavennṛpa | ārabhyaṃ navarātraṃ syāddhitvā citrāṃ ca vaidhṛtim || 11-180 ||
yadā tu citrāvaidhṛtyoḥ parihāreṇa pratipanna labhyate tadā kātyāyanaḥ |
pratipadyāśvine māsi naro vaidhṛticitrayoḥ |
ādyapādau parityajya prārabhennavarātrakam || 11-181 ||
(rudrayāmale'pi)
vaidhṛtau putranāśaḥ syāccitrāyāṃ dhananāśanam | tasmānna sthāpayet kumbhaṃ citrāyāṃ vaidhṛtau tathā || 11-182 ||
sampūrṇā pratipaddevi citrāyuktā yadā bhavet | vaidhṛtyā vā'pi yuktā syāt tadā madhyandine ravau || 11-183 ||
abhijit tu muhūrtaṃ yat tatra sthāpanamiṣyate |
(bhaviṣye)
citrāvaidhṛtisaṃpūrṇā pratipaccedbhavennṛpa || 11-184 ||
tyājyā hyaṃśāstrayastvādyāsturīyāṃśe tu pūjanam |
citrādiyuktā'pi dvitīyāyutā cenna duṣṭetyuktaṃ (durgotsave)
bhadrānvitā cet pratipat tu labhyate viruddhayogairapi saṅgatā satī || 11-185 ||
sā vai parāhṇe vibudhairvidheyā śrīputrarājyādivivṛddhihetuḥ (-) iti |
atha yavavapanavidhiḥ (rudrayāmale)
snānaṃ māṅgalikaṃ kṛtvā tato devīṃ prapūjayet || 11-186 ||
śubhābhirmṛttikābhiśca pūrvaṃ kṛtvā tu vedikām | yavān vai vāpayet tatra godhūmaiścāpi saṃyutān || 11-187 ||
tantrāntare |
vālukā gṛhya yatnena nadīnadasamudbhavāḥ | vedīṃ kuryāt prayatnena caturasrāṃ śubhāvahām || 11-188 ||
dvihastā cottamā vedī madhyamā sārdhahastakā | adhamā hastamātrā ca nyūnādhikyaṃ na kārayet || 11-189 ||
bhūrasīti paṭhenmantraṃ devīṃ saṃspṛśya mānavaḥ | apāmagniṃ samuccārya prokṣayeccandāmbhasā || 11-190 ||
tanmadhye vilikhenmantraṃ jayadurgākhyamuttamam |
tatrāvāhya yajeddevīmaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ parām || 11-191 ||
pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya dikpālā(/)ścāpi pūjayet | paścānnavārṇamanunā pūjayedastramātṛkām || 11-192 ||
saṃśodhya yavarāśiṃ ca yavo'sīti manuṃ paṭhan | prakṣipedvedikāmadhye vakṣyamāṇamanuṃ japan || 11-193 ||
oṃ yava tvaṃ yavarūpo'si yajñārthe nirmito vidheḥ | devānāṃ tṛptikṛdyasmāt tasmāt tvaṃ varado bhava || 11-194 ||
jayantī maṅgalākālī bhadrakālī kapālinī | durgā kṣamā śivā dhātrī svāhā svadhā namoṣtute || 11-195 ||
tathā |
bheromṛdaṅgaḍamarūghaṇṭāpaṭahaniḥsvanaiḥ | mahotsavaṃ prakurvīta yavāropaṇakarmaṇi || 11-196 ||
prasṛte ca daśamyāṃ vai bhadrābhadraṃ vicārayet |
vicārastvanyatra |
samyak samudgatā dīrghā ṛjavaścāṅkurāḥ śubhāḥ || 11-197 ||
anudgatāḥ kuṇṭhitāgrā hrasvāḥ śuṣkāśca bhaṅgurāḥ | kīṭākhubhuktāḥ śaṭitāḥ viṣamāścāśubhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 11-198 ||
saṃgrahāntaralikhitavicārāntaraṃ tu pramāṇābhāsamūlakatvādupekṣitam | (rudrayāmale)
tatra saṃsthāpayet kumbhaṃ vidhinā mantrapūrvakam | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vā'pi tāmraṃ mṛṇmayameva vā || 11-199 ||
(mātsye)
na rātrau sthāpayet kumbhaṃ na ca kumbhābhiṣecanam |
viṣṇuḥ |
bhāskarodayamārabhya yāvat tu daśa nāḍikāḥ || 11-200 ||
prātaḥkāla iti proktaḥ sthāpanāropaṇādiṣu |
kalaśasthāpanavidhistu daśabhujāpakṣe vakṣyate (vaiṣṇavīkalpe)
naimittikoktavidhinā navāhāni prapūjayet || 11-201 ||
upoṣaṇaṃ tathā'ṣṭamyāṃ prabhūtavalidānakam | navamyāmācareddhīmān daśamyāṃ tu visarjayet || 11-202 ||
putriṇā tu mahāṣṭamyāmupavāso na kāryaḥ |
upavāsaṃ mahāṣṭamyāṃ putravān na samācaret | yathā tathā saṃyatātmā vratī devīṃ prapūjayet || 11-203 ||
iti (kālikāpurāṇāt)navamyāṃ prabhūtavalidānamityanenāṣṭamyādau pūjāṅgavalidānamāyāti |
aṣṭamyāṃ validānena putranāśo bhaveddhruvam |
iti nāmaśūnyaṃ vacanaṃ kecit paṭhanti | tatra mūlaṃ mṛgyam | samūlatvābhidhāne tu prabhūtavalidānaniṣedhakamiti mantavyam | pūjāvalidānavisarjanādividhistvagre vyaktībhaviṣyati | atha daśabhujāpakṣaḥ (kālikāpurāṇe)
bodhayedvilvaśākhāsu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ devīṃ phaleṣu ca || 11-204 ||
saptamyāṃ vilvaśākhāṃ tāmāhṛtya pratipūjayet | punaḥ pūjāṃ tathā'ṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa samācaret || 11-205 ||
jāgaraṃ ca svayaṃ kuryādvalidānaṃ mahāniśi | prabhūtavalidānaṃ ca navamyāṃ vidhivaccaret || 11-206 ||
japahomasamāyukto bhojayedvai kumārikāḥ | dhyāyeddaśabhujāṃ devīṃ durgātantreṇa pūjayet || 11-207 ||
visarjana daśamyāṃ tu kuryādvai śāvarotsavaiḥ |
phaleṣu iti | phalayuktāsu śākhāsvityarthaḥ | durgātantreṇeti durgātantrasaṃjñakena pūrvoktajayadurgāmantreṇetyarthaḥ | śāvarotsavairiti | śavarocitaveśabhāṣādhūlikardamavikṣepādibhirityagre sphuṭībhaviṣyati | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca sāyāhne sandhyāyāṃ vā bodhanaṃ kāryam |
sāyāhne vilvaśākhāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ devīṃ prabodhayet || 11-208 ||
iti mahākālokteḥ |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vilvatarau bodhaṃ sāyaṃsandhyāsu kārayet |
iti (bhaviṣyapurāṇācca) pañcadhā vibhaktidinapañcamāṃśaḥ sāyāhnaḥ | sandhyā tu dinarātryoḥ sandhau muhūrtaḥ | (devīpurāṇe)
jyeṣṭhānakṣatrayuktāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vilvābhimantraṇam || 11-208 ||
saptamyāṃ mūlayuktāyāṃ patrikāyāḥ praveśanam |
iti nakṣatrayoge phalātiśayaḥ |
mūlābhāve'pi saptamyāṃ kevalāyāṃ praveśayet || 11-209 ||
iti (nandikeśvarapurāṇāt) evaṃ ca |
jyaiṣṭhāyāmeva sambodhya mūlenaiva praveśayet | pūrvottarābhyāṃ sampūjya śravaṇānte visarjayet || 11-210 ||
ityādau sarvatrāpi tithinakṣatrayoge phalabhūyastvaṃ veditavyam | pūrvottarābhyāmiti | pūrvāṣāḍhānvitāyāmaṣṭamyāmuttarāṣāḍhānvitāyāṃ navamyāmityarthaḥ | nakṣatrānurodhena patrikāpraveśanaṃ visarjanaṃ ca rātrau na kartavyam |
ṛkṣayogānurodhena rātrau patrīpraveśanam | visarjanaṃ caredyastu sarāṣṭraḥ sa vinaśyati || 11-211 ||
iti (durgābhaktitaraṅgiṇī-)likhitavacanāt | tathā ca |
antyapādo niśābhāge śravaṇasya yadā bhavet | tadā devyāḥ samutthānaṃ daśamyāṃ dinabhāgataḥ || 11-212 ||
iti vacanāt śravaṇānte visarjayet ityādivacanānurodhena rātrau visarjanaṃ na kāryamiti tatraivoktam | atra dinatraye tithitrayavihitapūjātrayaṃ prāyikaṃ kadā cit tithihrāsavaśāddvābhyāṃ pūjātrayaṃ kadā cit tithivṛddhivaśāddinacatuṣṭayena pūjātrayaṃ tithitrayalābhe tu nirvivādaiva vyavasthā |
vratī prapūjayeddevīṃ saptamyādidinatraye | dvābhyāṃ caturahobhirvā hrāsavṛddhivaśāt titheḥ || 11-213 ||
iti (bhaviṣya-) vacanāt
asmin pakṣe'pi pratipadādidinakṛtyānyuktāni (bhaviṣye)
keśasaṃskāradravyāṇi pradadyāt pratipattithau | paṭṭaḍoraṃ dvitīyāyāṃ keśasaṃyamahetave || 11-214 ||
darpaṇaṃ ca tṛtīyāyāṃ sindūrālaktakaṃ tathā | madhuparkaṃ caturthyāṃ tu tilakaṃ netramaṇḍanam || 11-215 ||
pañcamyāmaṅgarāgaṃ ca śaktyā'laṅkaraṇāni ca | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vilvatarau bodhaṃ sāyaṃsandhyāsu kārayet (-) iti || 11-216 ||
atraṃ ca patrikāpraveśāt pūrvedyuḥ sāyaṃkāle ṣaṣṭhyabhāve tatpūrvadine'dhivāsanaṃ kāryam | ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sāyaṃkāle'tyantāsattve tvadhivāsanalopaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sāyaṃ prakurvīta vilvavṛkṣe'dhivāsanam |
iti (kalpataru-) vacanāditi | evaṃ devībodhane'pi vyavasthā | vastutastu (-) anekatantravodhitakarttavyatākasya devībodhanasyāvaśyakatayā yasmin dine sāyaṃsamaye ṣaṣṭhīlābhastatraiva bodhanam | ubhayadine sandhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīlābhe tu yugmādareṇa vyavasthā | dinadvayaṃ sandhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyabhāve tu pradoṣādisamaye ṣaṣṭhyamiti kaumudīkṛnmatamevādaraṇīyam | gauṇakālavyāpteḥ sattvāt | taduktam |
svakālāduttaraḥ kālo gauṇaḥ syāt pūrvakarmaṇaḥ (-) iti |
ata eva sāyaṃ śrutiḥ phalārthātiśayārthā na tu karmalopaḥ kāryaṃ ityācāryacūḍāmaṇiḥ | pradoṣastu (-)
trimūhūrtaḥ pradoṣaḥ syādbhānāvastaṃ gate sati || 11-217 ||
iti (madanaratne) vyāsenoktaḥ | vatsena tu (-) pradoṣo'stamayādūrdhvaṃ ghaṭikādvayamiṣyate (-) ityuktam |
evaṃ ca patrikāpraveśādau saptabhyudayavyāpinyeva grāhyā na tu ṣaṇmunyoriti yugmavākyāt pūrvaviddhā |
yugādyā varṣavṛddhiśca saptamī pārvatīpriyā | raverudayamicchantī na tatra tithiyugmatā || 11-218 ||
iti (kṛtyatattvārṇava -) likhitavacanāt |
bhagavatyāḥ praveśādivisargāntāśca yāḥ kriyāḥ | tithāvudayagāminyāṃ sarvāstāḥ kārayedbudhaḥ || 11-219 ||
iti (tithitattva-)likhita(-)(nandikeśvarapurāṇācca) adhivāsanaṃ tu patrikāpraveśāvyavahitapūrvadina eva sāyaṃkāle ṣaṣṭhyabhāve'pi kāryam |
jyeṣṭhā vā yadi vā ṣaṣṭhī sāyaṃkāle na cedbhavet | sāyameva tathā'pi syādvilvavṛkṣe'dhivāsanam || 11-220 ||
pūrvāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ sanakṣatrāṃ sāyaṃ prāptāmapi tyajet (-) iti | tathā ca jyotiḥśāstram | pūrvāhṇe navapatrikā śubhakarī sarvārthasiddhipradā ārogyaṃ dhanadā karoti vijayaṃ caṇḍīpraveśe śubhā | madhyāhne na ca pīḍanaṃ kṣayakarī nṝṇāmaghorāvahā sāyāhne vadhabandhamādikalahaṃ sarvakṣatiṃ dāsyati || 11-221 ||
saptamyāmastagāyāṃ yadi viśati gṛhaṃ patrikā śrīphalādyā rājñaḥ saptāṅgarājyaṃ janasukhasahitaṃ hanti mūlānurodhāt | tasmāt sūryodayasthāṃ narapatiśubhadāṃ saptamīṃ prāpya devīṃ bhūpālo veśayet tāṃ sakalajanahitāṃ rākṣasarkṣaṃ vihāya || 11-222 ||
matsyasūktavacanāt |
patrīpraveśāt pūrvedyuḥ sāyāhne vilvavāsinīm | caṇḍīmāmantrayedvidvānnātra ṣaṣṭhīpuraskriyā || 11-223 ||
iti (brahmāṇḍapurāṇācca) vilvanimantraṇapatrikāpraveśādividhiragre vakṣyate | ekāhapakṣo'pi (kālikāpurāṇe)
yastvekasyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāmatha sādhakaḥ |
pūjayedvaradāṃ devīṃ mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ (-) iti ||
(rudrayāmale)
mūlanakṣatramārabhya pūjanīyā sarasvatī || 11-224 ||
pūjayet pratyahaṃ devīṃ yāvadvaiṣṇavamṛkṣakam | nādhyāpayenna ca likhennādhīyīta kadācana || 11-225 ||
pustake sthāpite devi vidyākāmo dvijottamaḥ |
(saṃgrahe)
āśvinasya site pakṣe medhākāmaḥ sarasvatīm || 11-226 ||
mūlenāvāhayeddevīṃ śravaṇena visarjayet |
atha mahāṣṭamī nirṇīyate | sā ca pūjopavāsādiṣu parayutā grāhyā | vasurandhrayoriti yugmavākyāt |
śuklapakṣe'ṣṭamī caiva śuklapakṣe caturdaśī || 11-227 ||
pūrvaviddhā na karttavyā karttavyā'parasaṃyutā |
iti (brahmavaivarttācca) tathā ca (smṛtisaṃgrahe)
śaranmahāṣṭamī pūjyā navamīsaṃyutā sadā || 11-228 ||
saptamīsaṃyutā nityaṃ śokasantāpakāriṇī | jambhena saptamīyuktā pūjitā tu mahāṣṭamī || 11-229 ||
indreṇa nihato jambhastasmāddānavapuṅgavaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saptamīmiśritā'ṣṭamī || 11-230 ||
varjanīyā pravijñāya manujaiḥ śubhakāṅkṣibhiḥ | saptamīṃ śalyasaṃyuktāṃ mohādajñānato'pi vā || 11-231 ||
mahāṣṭamīṃ prakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate | saptamī kalayā yatra parataścāṣṭamī bhavet || 11-232 ||
tena śalyamidaṃ proktaṃ putrapautrakṣayapradam |
tathā |
putrān hanti paśūn hanti hanti rāṣṭraṃ sarājakam || 11-233 ||
hanti jātānajātā(/)śca saptamīsahitā'ṣṭamī |
(nirṇayāmṛte) smṛtyantaravacanam |
nāṣṭamī saptamīyuktā saptamī nāṣṭamīyutā || 11-234 ||
navamyā saha kāryā syādaṣṭamī sarvathā budhaiḥ |
tatraiva |
aṣṭamī navamīyuktā mahotsāho mahotsavaḥ || 11-235 ||
iti (devīpurāṇe)
saptamī vedhasaṃyuktā yaiḥ kṛtā tu mahāṣṭamī | putradāradhanairhīnā bhramantīha piśācavat || 11-236 ||
(bhojarājīye)
umāyā navamī proktā harasya tithiraṣṭamī | dvayoraikye mahāpuṇyā umāmāheśvarī tithiḥ || 11-237 ||
(madanaratne smṛtisamuccaye)
saptamī śalyasaṃviddhā varjanīyā mahāṣṭamī | stokā'pi sā mahāpuṇyā yasyāṃ sūryodayo bhavet || 11-238 ||
stokā'pīti ghaṭikāmātrā'pītyarthaḥ | ata eva ghaṭikāmātrā'pyaṣṭamyaudayikī grāhyā |
vratopavāsaniyame ghaṭikaikā'pi yā bhavet |
iti devalokteriti nirṇayasindhukṛtaḥ | gauḍā apyevamevāhuḥ | evaṃ ca saptamīvedhaḥ kalārūpo'pyaṣṭamīvarjanaprayojako na tu trimuhūrtteti draṣṭavyam |
samayaprakāśādigranthakārāstu trimuhūrtā'ṣṭamyeva saptamī varjanaprayojikā na tu tato nyūnā | stokā'pītyādīni vacanānyavayavadvārā trimuhūrtaṃ stuvanti tenāṣṭamī paradine yadi muhūrttatrayānnyunā tadā saptamīyutā pūrvaiva grāhyetyāhuḥ | kalākāṣṭhā ghaṭikāmuhūrttadvimūrttavacāṃsi trimuhūrttapraśaṃsāparāṇīti nibandhavyākhyākāro'pi babhāṇa | yat tu (-)
mahāṣṭamyāśvine māsi śuklā kalyāṇakāriṇī || 11-239 ||
saptamyā'pi yutā kāryā mūlena tu viśeṣataḥ |
iti vacanaṃ tat paradine'ṣṭamyabhāvaviṣayam | taduktaṃ (nirṇayāmṛte devīpurāṇe)
uttarāstithayo yatra kṣayaṃ yānti narādhipa || 11-240 ||
tadā pūrvāṣṭamīṃ kuryādanyathā tvaśubhaṃ bhavet (-) iti ||
yacca (-)
yadā'ṣṭamīṃ tu samprāpya hyastaṃ yāti divākāraḥ | tatra durgotsavaṃ kuryānna kuryādapare'hani || 11-241 ||
durbhikṣaṃ tatra jānīyānnavamyāṃ yatra pūjyate |
iti paradine'ṣṭamīsattve'pi pūrvaviddhāvidhāyakaṃ vacanaṃ tat paradine navamyabhāvaviṣayam |
yadā sūryodaye na syānnavamī cāpare'hani || 11-242 ||
tadāṣṭamīṃ prakurvīta saptamyā sahitāṃ nṛpa |
iti (smṛtisaṃgrahāt) yat tu (-)
saptamyāmudite sūrye parato yā'ṣṭamī bhavet || 11-243 ||
tatra durgotsavaṃ kuryānna kuryādapare'hani |
iti paraviddhāṣṭamīniṣedhakaviśvarūpanibandhavacanaṃ tadāśvinakṛṣṇapakṣanavamyāṃ vihite devībodhane tadaṅgatvena kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ kriyamāṇadevīpūjāviṣayam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe'ṣṭamī caiva kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī || 11-244 ||
pūrvaviddhā tu karttavyā paraviddhā na kutracit | upavasādikāryeṣu eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 11-245 ||
iti kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāḥ paraviddhāyā eva prāśastyavidhānāditi nibandhavyākhyākṛtaḥ | yāni ca (-)
ahaṃ bhadrā ca bhadrā'haṃ nāvayorantara kvacit | sarvasiddhiṃ pradāsyāmi bhadrāyāmarcitā'pyaham || 11-246 ||
tathā |
mahāṣṭamyāṃ bhagavatī bhadrāyāmapi pūjitā | dadāti cāyurārogyaṃ yato bhadrāsvarūpiṇī || 11-247 ||
ityādīni (devīpurāṇa -) vacanāni tāni tu viṣṭikaraṇamadhye pūjāvidhānārthāni |
viṣṭiṃ tyaktvā mahāṣṭamyāṃ mama pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ | tasya pūjāphalaṃ na syāt tenāhamavamānitā || 11-248 ||
iti devīvākyāt |
bhadrāyāṃ bhadrakālyāśca madhye syādarcanakriyā | tasmādvai saptamīviddhā kāryā durgāṣṭamī budhaiḥ || 11-249 ||
iti vacanaṃ tu pūrvadine'ṣṭamyabhāvaviṣayamiti sarvasammatam | mahāṣṭamī bhaumavārānvitā cedatipraśastā | taduktaṃ (madanaratne)
aṣṭamyāmudite sūrye dinānte navamī bhavet |
kujavāro bhavet tatra pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ (-) iti ||
mūlayukteyamatipraśastetyuktaṃ (skānde)
mahāṣṭamī mūlayuktā trailokye'pi sudurlabhā (-) iti |
mūlayuktā'pi saptamīviddhā cet tyājyaivetyuktaṃ (durgotsave)
mūlenāpi hi saṃyuktā sadā tyājyā'ṣṭamī budhaiḥ || 11-250 ||
leśamātreṇa saptamyā api syādyadi dūṣitā (-) iti ||
yadā tu pūrvadine sampūrṇā satī paradine vardhate tadā saṃpūrṇatvāt saptamī yogābhāvācca pūrvaiva grāhyā na tūttarā |
ṣaṣṭidaṇḍātmikāyāśca titherniṣkramaṇe pare |
akarmaṇyaṃ tithimalaṃ bhavedekādaśīṃ vinā (-) iti smārttavacanāt || evaṃ ca |
saptamī kalayā yuktā varjanīyā mahāṣṭamī || 11-251 ||
ityādivākyaiḥ pūrvaviddhāyā niṣedhāt paraviddhaiva mahāṣṭamiti siddham | śuddhāyāṃ tu na kaścit saṃdehaḥ | kecit tu (-)
tatrāṣṭamyāṃ bhadrakālī dakṣayajñavināśinī | prādurbhūtā mahāghorā yoginīkoṭibhiḥ saha || 11-252 ||
ato'rthaṃ pūjanīyā sā tasminnahani mānavaiḥ | trisandhyaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ japastotraparāyaṇaḥ || 11-253 ||
ityādivākyavihitāyāṃ divātanapūjāyāṃ paraviddhā'ṣṭamī grāhyā |
āśvinasya site pakṣe yā tu syāt tithiraṣṭamī | tasyāṃ rātrau pūjanīyā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ || 11-254 ||
ityādivacanaprāptāyāṃ rātripūjāyāṃ tvaṣṭamyāṃ rātriyoga evādaraṇīyaḥ |
karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālastatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ | tayā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam || 11-255 ||
iti vacanādityāhuḥ | mahāṣṭamīkṛtyamagre vakṣyate | atha mahānavamī nirṇīyate | sā ca pūrvayutā grāhyā vasurandhrayoriti yugmavākyāt |
aṣṭamyā sahitā kāryā sā mahānavamī tithiḥ |
iti (bṛhatsiddhāntasārācca)
aṣṭamyā sahitā riktā na kadācit parāyutā || 11-256 ||
iti (*) (laghutithinirṇaye matsyapurāṇācca) paiṭhīnasirapi |
pratipannavamī caiva karttavyā saṃmukhī tithiḥ |
saṃmukhī sāyāhnavyāpinī | (brahmavaivartte)
aṣṭamyā navamī viddhā karttavyā phalakāṅkṣibhiḥ || 11-257 ||
(padme)
aṣṭamī navamīyuktā navamī cāṣṭamīyutā |
(mātsye)
aṣṭamyā sahitā riktā prakarttavyā sadā budhaiḥ || 11-258 ||
pūrṇāyuktāṃ tadā kuryāt kā cinnāstyaṣṭamīyutā |
(* hemādrau pādme)
śrāvaṇī durganavamī dūrvā caiva hutāśanī || 11-259 ||
pūrvaviddhā ca karttavyā śivarātrī valerdinam |
(bhaviṣye)
aśvayuk śuklapakṣe tu yā'ṣṭamī mūlasaṃyutā || 11-260 ||
sā mahānavamī nāma triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā |
aṣṭamīmūlābhyāṃ yuktetyarthaḥ | mūletyupalakṣaṇam | tathā ca (madanaratne laiṅge)
durgāpūjāsu navamī mūlādyṛkṣatrayānvitā || 11-261 ||
mahatī kīrttitā tasyāṃ durgāṃ mahiṣamardinīm |
pūjayediti śeṣaḥ |
aṣṭamyā navamī viddhā navamyā cāṣṭamī tathā || 11-262 ||
mūlādimatrayeṇādyā trailokye'pi prapūjitā (-) iti ||
atra muhūrttatrayātmako vedho veditavyaḥ | tadāha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
pakṣadvaye'pi tithayastithiṃ pūrvāṃ tathottarām |
tribhirmuhūrtairvidhyanti sāmānyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ (-) iti ||
yadyapi (-)
udite daivataṃ bhānau pitryaṃ cāstamite ravau || 263 ||
dvistrirmuhūrttamahno yaḥ sā tithirhavyakavyayoḥ |
iti (hemādrau viṣṇudharme ) muhūrttadvayātmā'pi vedha uktastathā'pi prātareva saḥ sāyaṃ tu trimuhūrtta eva vedhaḥ |
taduktaṃ (skānde)
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya yātyastaṃ padminīpatiḥ || 11-264 ||
sā tithistaddine proktā trimuhūrtaiva yā bhavet (-) iti ||
sūryodaye'pi dvimuhūrttatvamanukalpa eva |
dvimuhūrttā'pi karttavyā yā tithirvṛddhigāminī |
iti dakṣoṇāpi (-) śabdagrahaṇāt | nirṇayasindhukṛto'pi trimuhūrttayoge pūrvā navamī pūrvoktavacanāt |
na kuryānnavamīṃ tāta daśamyā tu kadācana || 11-265 ||
iti (skānde) parāniṣedhācca | trimuhūrttayogābhāve tu niṣiddhā'pi parava grāhyā |
vratopavāsaniyame ghaṭikaikā'pi yā bhavet | sā kāryodayagāminyām (-----------) || 11-266 ||
ityādivacanāni navamībhinnatithiparāṇi navamyāṃ viśeṣokterityāhuḥ | yadyapyevaṃ nirṇayaḥ prāmāṇikaiḥ kṛtastathā'pi |
tatrāśvayuktanavamī muhūrttaṃ vā kalā yadi | sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā lakṣmīvidyājayārthibhiḥ || 11-267 ||
iti (saurapurāṇāt)
aṣṭamyāmudite sūrye dinānte navamī bhavet | prabhāte balidāne tu kiyanmātrā'pi labhyate || 11-268 ||
navamyāṃ tatra sampūjya durgāṃ durgārttināśinīm |
iti (siddhāntasaṃgraho-) dāhṛtavacanāt |
sūryodaye paraṃ riktā pūrṇā syāt parato yadi || 11-269 ||
validānaṃ prakarttavyaṃ tasmin deśe śubhāvaham | validāne kṛte'ṣṭamyāṃ (*) putrabhaṅgo bhavennṛpa || 11-270 ||
iti (devīpurāṇācca) validāne paraviddhāyāḥ prāśastyamevāvagantavyam | upavāse tu pūrvaiva pūrvoktavacananicayāt |
ekādaśī ca navamī diśā viddhā bhavedyadi | tadā varjyā prayatnena gaṅgāmbhaḥ surayā yathā || 11-271 ||
navamī daśamī caiva nopoṣyā parasaṃyutā |

iti viṣṇūkteḥ | ārabdhe svayameva devīpūjādi kuryāt | anārabdhe tvagnihotrādivat kārayitavyamiti sarvamatam | rajasvalā'nyena kārayediti viśeṣavacanābhāvāt | taduktaṃ (mātsye)
antarā tu rajoyoge pūjāmanyena kārayet (-) iti | tatra pūjādikaṃ pravṛttirūpaṃ karma putrādidvārā nirvāhyam | upavāsādikaṃ svayameva karttavya nivṛttāvaśaucasyākiñcitkaratvāt | tatrāhāṅgirāḥ |
niyamasthā yadā nārī prapaśyedantarā rajaḥ || 11-300 ||
upoṣyaiva tu tā rātrīḥ snātvā śeṣaṃ caredvratam (-) iti || atra pāraṇāhe sūtakādiprāptau tadatikramya pāraṇaṃ kuryāditi kecit tadasat |
sūtake pāraṇaṃ kuryānnavamyāṃ homapūrvakam | tadante bhojayedviprān dānaṃ dadyācca śaktitaḥ || 11-301 ||
iti (rudrayāmalo-)ktavacanena sūtake'pi pāraṇavidhānāt | gauḍākhyasampradāyamabhipretya navamyāmityukteḥ | taduktaṃ (prakaṭayoginīmate)

keralākhye sampradāye daśamyāmeva pāraṇamiti (śaktisaṅgame-)'pyevam | saiva śobhaneti kāśmīrasampradāye daśamīviddhaiva navamī praśastetyarthaḥ | gauḍasampradāyibhistu navamyāṃ daśamīyuktāyāṃ pāraṇaṃ na kāryam |
yo mohāddaśamīvedhe navamyāṃ caṇḍikāṃ yajet |
pāraṇaṃ ca prakuryādvai tasya puṇyaṃ nirarthakam (-) iti tatraivoktam ||
yajananiṣedhastu pūrvadine karmārhanavamīlābhe veditavyaḥ | daśamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāt (-) iti muṇḍamālāvacanaṃ tu puraścaraṇaviṣayam | sampradāyaprabhedaprayuktetikarttavyatābhedāstu navamataraṅge sphuṭīkṛtāḥ (*) | nirṇayasindhukṛtastu navamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ vidhāyakānyetadādivacanāni nirmūlānyeva samūlatvābhimāne tu lohābhisārikaparāṇi tasyāṣṭamīparyantamevokteḥ | navarātravratasya navamīparyantakarttavyatākatayā daśamyāmeva niyamapāraṇā kāryetyāhuḥ | atheyaṃ śāradī pūjā nityā | akaraṇe pratyavāyaśravaṇāditi kecit | śaradāgamanimittakatvānnaimittikītyanye | nānāvidhaphalaśruteḥ kāmyetyapare | vastutastu (-) nityakāmyarūpeyaṃ na tu naimittikī | anyathā kāryamātraṃ prati kālasya hetutayā nityasyāpi karmaṇo naimittikatvāpatterityuktaṃ (mahākālasaṃhitāyām) yathā |
adhunā kathayiṣyāmi sarahasyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 11-303 ||
śāradīyāṃ ca vāsantīmarcāṃ nānāphalapradām | manīṣiṇo vidadhati vicārānatra bhūyaśaḥ || 11-303 ||
smṛtyadhvacāriṇaḥ sarve kaulikāḥ sarva eva ca | traividhyamadhye kiṃrūpāḥ bhavatīyaṃ samarhaṇā || 11-304 ||
yasyākaraṇataḥ pāpaṃ jāyate nityameva tat | vidhānādyasya ca phalaṃ jāyate kāmyameva tat || 11-304 ||
ananuṣṭhānato yasya pāpamutpadyate param | vidhānācca phalaṃ vā'pi tannaimittikamucyate || 11-305 ||
iyaṃ yā śāradī pūjā kathyate sā kimātmikā | kecit kāmyāṃ vadantyenāṃ ke cinnaimittikīmapi || 11-306 ||
pūrvaṃ phalaśravaṇataḥ śaradāgamanāt pare | nityāmenāmeva kecidvadanti kulamārgagāḥ || 11-307 ||
tathā |
tripuraghnāya yadvākyaṃ purovāca sureśvarī | śāradīyāmimāṃ pūjāṃ na kariṣyanti ye narāḥ || 11-308 ||
te patiṣyanti niraye pāpāḥ pūjāpahārakāḥ | ityādivākyānnityatvamabhidhānādatha śruteḥ || 11-309 ||

āsīt pūrvaṃ mahāpūjā vāsantyeva jagattraye || 11-318 ||

evamabhyarthitā devī akāle bodhitā tathā | jagāma brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ laṅkāṃ draṣṭuṃ raṇaṃ tayoḥ || 11-322 ||

saṃtuṣṭāva stavairdivyairbhaktyā praṇatakandharaḥ | kākūktyā praṇipātaiśca namaskāraiḥ stavairapi || 11-327 ||
tuṣṭā brahmāṇamūce sā hṛtsthaṃ vatsa varaṃ vṛṇu | varaṃ vavre tataḥ sārdhaṃ tridaśaiśca caturmukhaḥ || 11-328 ||
tvatpādayorbhaktamapi tyajainaṃ duṣṭarākṣasam | mayyanugrahaleśena viṣṇormānyatayā'pi ca || 11-329 ||
kṛpādṛṣṭyā ca deveṣu dharmasaṃsthāpanāya ca | trilokī jāyatāṃ susthā devāḥ santu makhāśinaḥ || 11-330 ||
tapastapantu munayaścāturvarṇyaṃ pravarttatām | eṣa vīrajitā(/)lokāñchastrapūtaśca gacchatu || 11-331 ||
pūjāṃ pravarttayiṣyāmi tava devyamaraiḥ saha | tithimādyāṃ samārabhya yāvadrakṣovadho bhavet || 11-332 ||

prītimutpādayiṣyāmaḥ prabhūtavalibhistava | apare'hni daśamyāṃ te nīrājanamahotsavam || 11-334 ||
gītairnṛtyaistathā vādyairjalakardamakelibhiḥ | aślīlaveśavacanaiḥ śāstrāstraracanairapi || 11-335 ||

udīrito dvitīyo'yaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kathayāmyatha | sāyāhne vilvaśākhāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ devīṃ prabodhayet || 11-345 ||
prātaḥ pravarttate pūjā saptamyādidinatraye | traividhya īdṛśyarcāyā vivadante mitho budhāḥ || 11-346 ||
bravīmi tatra siddhāntaṃ chinnaṃ yena tamo bhavet | rambhakalpe purā devī rambhāsuratanūdbhavam || 11-347 ||
aṣṭādaśabhujā bhūtvā mahāghoratarākṛtiḥ | ugracaṇḍā svarūpeṇa jaghāna mahiṣāsuram || 11-348 ||
sitena karavālena mṛtamenaṃ jahau tathā | patitaṃ ca kṣitāvasya vyaśīryata kalevaram || 11-349 ||
nīlalohitakalpe tu punareva vyajāyata | udvegakṛddevatānāṃ tathā yañavināśakṛt || 11-350 ||
iti kṛtvā mahāmāyā bhadrakālī vapurdharā | sambhūya ṣoḍaśabhujā viśiṣeṇa śitena hi || 11-351 ||
avadhīt taṃ punaścāpi tatyāja galitaṃ bhuvi | śvetavārāhakalpādāvajāyata punaḥ sa hi || 11-352 ||
jaigoṣavyaprasādena pūrvajātismaro'bhavat | vāradvayaṃ hataṃ jñātvā devyātmānaṃ purā'suraḥ || 11-353 ||
strīvadhyatāṃ ca vijñāya svasyāmuṣyāṃ janāvapi | kātyāyanamuneḥ śāpāt svapnadarśanato'pi ca || 11-354 ||
ekānte bhaktimāsthāya trividhāṃ mahiṣāsuraḥ | ārādhayāmāsa kāloṃ svodarkapariśuddhaye || 11-355 ||
divyadvādaśasāhasravarṣānantaramīśvarī | pratyakṣamāgatā tasya varaṃ vṛṇviti cābravīt || 11-356 ||
tato'suraḥ sa ūce tāṃ nirīkṣya purataḥ sthitām | varaṃ paścādgrahīṣyāmi devi tvatto manogatam || 11-357 ||
ādau me saṃśayaṃ chindhi jāgarūkaṃ hṛdi sthitam | vāradvayaṃ māmavadhīḥ surāriraṇamūrdhani || 11-358 ||
dhṛtvā kāṃ kāmākṛtiṃ tvamaghorāmatha bhīṣaṇām | janmanyasminnapi punaḥ kenākāreṇa kālike || 11-359 ||
māṃ haniṣyasi durvṛttaṃ nikhilāmarakaṇṭakam | niśamyedṛgvacastasya vihasya jagadambikā || 11-360 ||
cālayantī śiraḥ kiñciduvāca madhurākṣaram | madīyatādṛśākāradarśanena phalaṃ tava || 11-361 ||
kiṃ bhaviṣyati daityendra kintu trāsamavāpsyasi | didṛkṣase cedatha tāṃ karālāmākṛtiṃ mama || 11-362 ||
paśyetyuktvā jagaddhātrī vihāya lalitaṃ vapuḥ | ugracaṇḍā tanūrūpaṃ darśayāmāsa dānavam || 11-363 ||
jvālākarālavadanamaṣṭādaśabhujānvitam | divyaśastrāstrakalitaṃ muṇḍamālābhayaṅkaram || 11-364 ||
vidīrṇasṛkkvayugalaṃ ghoradaṃṣṭrātibhīṣaṇam | calatsaudāminītulyarasanaṃ nādadāruṇam || 11-365 ||
tadrūpaṃ ditijo vīkṣya nyamīlayata locane | kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā pratyuvāca ca kālikām || 11-366 ||
ghoramodṛśamākāraṃ na śaknomi tavekṣitum | trailokyatrāsanaṃ rūpaṃ devi saṃhara saṃhara || 11-367 ||
ityuktvā'surarājena punaḥ sā prākṛtaṃ vapuḥ | kṛtvā taṃ darśayāmāsa tataḥ sustho babhūva saḥ || 11-368 ||
bhadrakālī vapurbhūtvā punaḥ sā parameśvarī | nirīkṣayāmāsa rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ jīvanāpaham || 11-369 ||
tadrūpadarśane'pyeṣa punastrāsamupeyivān | tasyāpi parivṛttau sa prākṛtaḥ sambabhūva ha || 11-370 ||
gatamīratha tāṃ devīmuvāca ditijādhipaḥ | īdṛśākāradhāriṇyā kathaṃ devi tvayā saha || 11-371 ||
samare yoddhumaśakamahaṃ varamadoddhataḥ | garutmatā saha yathā ḍuṇḍubhasya raṇasmṛhā || 11-372 ||
dāvāgninā pataṅgānāṃ timirasya ca bhāsvatā | mṛgāṇāṃ hariṇā caiva drumāṇāṃ vāyunā tathā || 11-373 ||
bhekānāmahinā cāpi prāṇināṃ śamanena ca | tadvadbhavatyā samaṃ me kathamāsīnmahānraṇaḥ || 11-374 ||
yadatītamatītaṃ tadidānīṃ te varatrayam | vṛṇe'haṃ mama taddehi manorathapadātigam || 11-375 ||
ekaṃ saumyākāradharā bhūtvā'smin janmanīśvari | tvaṃ māṃ vadhiṣyasi trāṇa hetoradhvarabhojinām || 11-376 ||
dvitīyaṃ te macchirasi vāmapādāmbujaṃ sadā | sthāsyati prāṇayuktasya paśyatastvanmukhacchavim || 11-377 ||
tṛtīyaṃ devi yajñasya bhāgaṃ prāpnomi kaṃcana | ityevamukte mahiṣe vacanena surāriṇā || 11-378 ||
uvāca sasmitaṃ devī bhaktipraṇatakandharam | daityendra śṛṇu madvākyaṃ yathārthaṃ madhurākṣaram || 11-379 ||
rambhāsuraste janakastapastaptvā sudāruṇam | śaṅkaraṃ toṣayāmāsa ramkalpe himālaye || 11-380 ||
vaca ūce harastuṭo mahābhāga varaṃ vṛṇu | hitvā so'nyavaraṃ vavre bhavān putro bhavatviti || 11-381 ||
bhaktyā niyantritaḥ kāryagatitvāt sa maheśvaraḥ | varaṃ dadau sa ātmānaṃ putrākṛtamanuṣṭhya hi || 11-382 ||
tasmājjāto hi mahiṣīgarbhe tvaṃ kāmamohitāt | sākṣāt tvaṃ rudra evāsi na sāmānyā harākṛtiḥ || 11-383 ||
tathā |
śivastvaṃ varadānena rambhasya sutatāṃ gataḥ | manvantaratrayaṃ sāgraṃ bhuktavā(/)śca jagattrayam || 11-384 ||
ataḥ paraṃ na vastavyaṃ tvayā ditijadehinā | svapuraṃ prati gantavyaṃ mama lokādadhaḥ sthitam || 11-385 ||
kātyāyanasya śāpācca śiraśchedanahetukāt | yuktakāle sthāsyati no bhaktiretādṛśī tava || 11-386 ||
kapotaśāpādīdṛkṣādityuktāḥ pañca hetavaḥ | mahiṣāyedṛśaṃ datvā varamuktvā purā kathām || 11-387 ||
sapadyantardadhe kālī varṣāsu capalā yathā | devyāmantarhitāyāṃ sa sarvaṃ vismṛtavān kṣaṇāt || 11-388 ||
babhūva pūrvavadduṣṭo yajñadevadvijanmanām | praṇaṣṭā bhaktirasyāpi devyāmavyabhicāriṇī || 11-389 ||
pūrvadattamatirbhraṣṭā jñānamantarhitaṃ caret | iti te kathito devi vṛtāntaḥ pūrvasambhavaḥ || 11-390 ||
siddhāntamanayorboddhuṃ rītyā śaktyā vicakṣaṇāt | siddhāntanirṇayakṛte kathitā'khyāyikā'pyasau || 11-391 ||
iyaṃ hi śāradī pūjā mūrttibhedāt tridhā matā | tattaddravyamadhiṣṭhāya nṛṇāṃ gṛhṇāti sārcanam || 11-392 ||
ye'ṣṭādaśabhujāṃ devīmugracaṇḍābhidhāṃ priye | pipūjayiṣavo marttyāstadupāsakatāmitāḥ || 11-393 ||
tathā'śvinanavamyāṃ vai kṛṣṇāyāṃ susamāhitāḥ | karavāle bodhayeyurmadhyāhne śaṅkhaniḥsvanaiḥ || 11-394 ||
khagānajān vā mahiṣāneṇān vā'nyavalīnapi | rītiṃ saṃkalitāṃ kṛtvā dadyuḥ ṣoḍaśavāsarān || 11-395 ||
eṣā'dyā mahiṣālambhakarttṛpūjāvidhirmataḥ | atha mādhyamikaḥ pakṣa iṣasyādyatithau site || 11-396 ||
prātaḥ paṭahaniḥsvānaiḥ saḍhakkānakagomukhaiḥ | īśvarīṃ ṣoḍaśabhujāṃ bhadrakālīti nāmikām || 11-397 ||
sambodhya ye pūjayeyurdināni nava vai priye | apūpamodakaprāyavalisaṃkalitakramaiḥ || 11-398 ||
tṛtīyaḥ pakṣa īdṛkṣa uditastripurāriṇā | aśvayuksitaṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai śākhāyāṃ vilvaśākhinaḥ || 11-399 ||
sāyaṃkāle bodhayitvā vādyairuccāvacoddhataiḥ | durgādevīmarcayīta saptamyādidinatraye || 11-400 ||
daśabāhudharāṃ devīṃ mahāsaundaryaśālinīm | rītisaṃkalite pātre vilvapatrasya kīrttitā || 11-401 ||
athavā karavīrasya śaktyā ca mahiṣājayoḥ | svasvaśaktyanusāreṇa sarvamanyat prakīrttitam || 11-402 ||
homo japaḥ kumāryarcā sādhakānāṃ ca bhojanam | upoṣaṇamatho maunaṃ prabhūtaphalahetave || 11-403 ||
hananāt khaḍgabāṇābhyāṃ tatra tatra tu bodhanam | āvirbhāvo vilvataroratra bodhanamācaret || 11-404 ||
tattannakṣatralābhe tu phalabhūmā prajāyate | nakṣatrāṇāmalābhe tu kevalāyāṃ tithau caret || 11-405 ||
satyāṃ śaktau caturthyāṃ vai devyāḥ keśaṃ vimocayet | tatra pūjā vidhātavyā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ || 11-406 ||
udvarttanaṃ kaṇṭakikaṃ keśabandhanaḍorakam | nakharañjaṃ śalākāṃ ca sindūrālaktakajjalam || 11-407 ||
sugandhitailoṣṇajalapiṣṭātāmalakādikam | dadyāddevyai viśeṣeṇa bhaktibhāvena pārvati || 11-408 ||
pūjāyāḥ kathitaṃ cātra dvaividhyaṃ munipuṅgavaiḥ | paurāṇikaṃ tāntrikaṃ ca kālikāprītisiddhaye || 11-409 ||
śrutadhvajāya prāṅnandikeśvareṇa yadīritam | tadvai bahulavistāraṃ śāradīyārcanaṃ matam || 11-410 ||
yaddevyā svayamākhyātaṃ kapilāya maharṣaye | tannātibahulaṃ nātisvalpaṃ madhyamamucyate || 11-411 ||
yadaurveṇa samākhyātaṃ sagarāya mahībhṛte | tadvijñeyaṃ sureśāni kanīyaḥ śaradarcanam || 11-412 ||
tāntrikaṃ bahutantroktaṃ sarvaiḥ svasvamatāgatam | yo yenaiva krameṇaitāṃ śaradarcāṃ varānane || 11-413 ||
vidhatte sa samāpnoti phalaṃ tattatkrameṇa hi | iyaṃ hi pūjā dvividhā paurāṇī tāntrikī tathā || 11-414 ||
tāntrike kaulikī rītiḥ purāṇe vaidikī matā | yadyebhyo rocate devi pratinandati te hi tat || 11-415 ||
atha pūjā prakarttavyā keṣu keṣu sthaleṣu hi | tatrottaraṃ te vadāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā satī || 11-416 ||
taijase pratimā yantre'tha vā moheyadārave | śaileya athavā devi dhātave girisambhave || 11-417 ||
vilvavṛkṣapatrikā ca ghaṭaḥ pūrvavadīritaḥ | gomayenopaliptaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ jagadīśvari || 11-418 ||
sindūrāṅke maṇḍalaṃ vā śūlakhaḍgaśarāstathā | pustakaṃ vā citrapaṭaṃ sarvatobhadra eva vā || 11-419 ||
anādipīṭhaṃ ca tathā śivaliṅgaṃ tathaiva ca | jalamagnistathā khātanṛkaroṭisthalaṃ śubham || 11-420 ||
evamādīni cānyāni sthānānyarcanahetave | patrikāśca parijñeyāḥ kadalīvilvadāḍimāḥ || 11-421 ||
haridrāśokakacyau ca jayantī dhānyamālinī |
(bhaviṣye'pi)
rambhā kacī haridrā ca jayantī vilvadāḍimau || 11-422 ||
āśoko mānakaścaiva dhānyāni nava patrikāḥ |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
ekāśītipadaṃ cakraṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 11-423 ||
bhittau citrīkṛtā devī pūjitā phaladāyinī | aṣṭamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa pūjā kāryā'tra pārvati || 11-424 ||
prabhūtavalidānaṃ tu navamyāṃ homa eva ca | aṣṭamīnavamīsandhau viśeṣāt pūjanaṃ caret || 11-425 ||
navamyāṃ validānānu kumārīpūjanaṃ tathā | dinatraye'pi ca mahādevyāḥ snānaṃ prakalpayet || 11-426 ||
tathā |
upavāsaṃ tathā kuryādaṣṭamyāṃ kālikāmude | siddhyarthaṃ svābhilāṣāṇāṃ tathā'nyeṣāṃ ca śarmaṇām || 11-427 ||
kintu putrī na kurvīta kṛte putro vinaśyati | stryupayogīni vastūni racanādīni yāni hi || 11-428 ||
tāni devyai pradeyāni vibhavādyanurūpataḥ | tithau śuklapratipadi kṛtvopakramamīśvari || 11-429 ||
ṣaṣṭhe'hni sāyaṃsamaye kṛtanityakriyo divā | bodhayedvilvaśākhāyāṃ deśikaḥ parameśvarīm || 11-430 ||
saṅkalpaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā svastivācanapūrvakam | sarāśimāsapakṣasya titherullikhanakramāt || 11-431 ||
sagotranāmoccaraṇaṃ yajamāno vidhāya hi | durgābodhanakarmāhaṃ kariṣye iti kīrttayet || 11-432 ||
bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgaṃ sarṣi tatparam | āvāhya vilvaśākhāyāmatha vā mūrttipīṭhayoḥ || 11-433 ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ | pūjayitvā jagaddhātrīmardhamastamite ravau || 11-434 ||
