vilvavṛkṣaṃ ca sampūjya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | śaṅkhatūryaninādaiśca murajadhvanigītibhiḥ || 11-435 ||
bodhayet stutisaṃlāpairvandīva vasudhādhipam | procyamānaṃ samuccārya mantraṃ saṃcālayecchivām || 11-436 ||
tāramaidhe śākinī ca kūṭaṃ svapnāvataṃ tathā | visandhibhagavatyuktvottiṣṭha dvayamudīrayet || 11-437 ||
nidrāṃ jahi yugaṃ cāpi pratibuddhyasva ca dvayam | mama śatrūn hana dvandvaṃ pātaya dvitayaṃ tathā || 11-438 ||
lajjā ramā ḍākinī ca phaṭsvāhā tadanantaram |
tāraḥ praṇavaḥ | maidhaṃ vāgbhavam | śākinī phre(/) | svapnāvatīkūṭam khshkṣvlī(/) | ḍākinī khphre(/) | tatrāntrare tu ślokarūpā mantrā uktāḥ | yathā |
rāvaṇasya vadhārthāya rāmasyānugrahāya ca || 11-439 ||
akāle brahmaṇā bodho devyāstvayi kṛtaḥ purā | ahamapyāśvine ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sāyāhne bodhayāmi vai || 11-440 ||
śakreṇāpi ca sambodhya rājyaṃ prāptaṃ surālaye |
tasmādahaṃ tvāṃ prati bodhayāmi vibhūtirājyapratipattihetoḥ | yathaiva rāmeṇa hato daśāsyastathaiva śatruṃ vinipātayāmi (-) iti ||
tathā | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sāyaṃ prakurvīta vilvavṛkṣe'dhivāsanam || 11-441 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
rajanyādye muhūrtte tu caṇḍikāmadhivāsayet | sugandhitailapātābhyāṃ pañcabhirgandhajātibhiḥ || 11-442 ||
puṣpajātiviśeṣaiśca tāvadbhiradhivāsayet | sarvamāṅgalyavastūni vidhāyaikatra bhājane || 11-443 ||
praśastavadanaṃ devyāḥ kārayet tadanantaram | samāṃsamīnasiddhānnavaliṃ bhūtebhya utsṛjet || 11-444 ||
gītavādyaiśca nādyaiśca namaskāraiśca jāgaraiḥ | devīṃ santoṣya vacanairvyājastutyādyanindanaiḥ || 11-445 ||
siddhārthakairmantrapāṭhapūrvaṃ rakṣāṃ vidhāya ca | pūrvavat sarvamābhāṣya māsapakṣatithikramaiḥ || 11-446 ||
śaratkālīnapūjāṅgaṃ tataśca kṛtyapatrikāḥ | athavā pratimāpīṭhayantrasthāpanakarmaṇi || 11-447 ||
durgādevyā gandhapuṣpapaṭṭavāsasragādibhiḥ | adhivāsanakarmāhaṃ kurvīyetyabhijalpya vai || 11-448 ||
pūrvavadbhūtaśuddhiṃ ca sarṣiṃ karaṣaḍaṅgakam | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ cāpi kṛtvā'rghasthāpanaṃ caret || 11-449 ||
gaṇeśamatha dikpālān mātṛgrāhā(/)stathaiva ca | vaṭukān kṣetrapālā(/)śca dvārādhyakṣā(/)śca yoginīḥ || 11-450 ||
śaktyopacāraiḥ sampūjya patrikāpīṭhamūrttiṣu | āvāhya devīmiṣṭāṃ ca mūlamantropacārakaiḥ || 11-451 ||
śatāharidrātailāni ekīkṛtya samāni hi | caitanyakamalālajjāgandhacāreruḍastrakam || 11-452 ||
uccārya dadyādalike śirasyapi ca pādayoḥ | tataḥ kuṅkumakarpūrakastūrīmalayodbhavaiḥ || 11-453 ||
ekīkṛtairḍākinīhṛnmantraistānyeva bhūṣayet | vilvapatrajavāpadmakaravīrāparājitāḥ || 11-454 ||
ekīkṛtyārpayenmūrdhni vadanmadanamastake | mālyairāpūrayedyantraṃ pratimāṃ patrikāmapi || 11-455 ||
śaṅkhonosavadau krauḍau mṛttikāmalayodbhavaḥ | gorocanādhānyadūrvādṛṣatsindūrakajjalam || 11-456 ||
haridrāsvastikālaktadadhyakṣataphalāmbujam | dhūpadīpau madhughṛtaṃ kumārīkaratantavaḥ || 11-457 ||
ghanasāro mṛgamadaṃ kakkolaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā | mahauṣadhigaṇāḥ siddhārthaphalaṃ svarṇamaṇī tathā || 11-458 ||
raupyaṃ vyāghranakho'mbhojaṃ viṣṇukrāntā'parājitā | evamādīni māṅgalyadravyāṇyuktāni yāni vai || 11-459 ||
ekasmin bhājane tāni ekīkṛtya pṛthak pṛthak | devyāḥ śiro vakṣasi ca tāramaidhatrapāśiraḥ || 11-460 ||
proccaran samanuttolya trivāraṃ sparśayecchanaiḥ | bhūtādibhyo valiṃ dadyāt tattadbījaṃ puraḥ smaran || 11-461 ||
tattannāmābhyasantaṃ ca sandhinaiṣa valirnamaḥ | daśadikṣu kṣipeccāpi rājikāśvetasarṣapau || 11-462 ||
tārādrakṣayugaṃ cāstraṃ śiraḥ kūrco'ntime tathā | (*) varṇaiścaturbhiḥ saṃveṣṭya tā(/)śca kalmāṣatantubhiḥ || 11-463 ||
astrāṇyasyāḥ puraḥ kṛtvā jāgṛyāt sakalāṃ niśām |
iti ṣaṣṭhīkṛtyam | atha saptamīkṛtyaṃ tatraiva |
atho uṣasi saptamyāṃ kṛtanityakriyo budhaḥ || 11-464 ||
pūrvavadvilvaśākhāyāṃ devīmabhyarcya mānavaḥ | śitāṃ gṛhītvā churikāṃ mantramenaṃ samuccaret || 11-465 ||
phaladvayayutāṃ śākhāṃ chindyādvilvasya sadhakaḥ | caitanyaṃ praṇavaṃ māyā roṣarāvau ca ḍākinī || 11-466 ||
imāṃ śākhāṃ chindhi yugaṃ chedaya dvitayaṃ tathā | astrayugmaṃ śiraścāpi gṛhītvā tāṃ karadvaye || 11-467 ||
baddhāñjaliścaturmantrān paṭhet paurāṇikān priye | merumaṇḍalakailāśahimavacchikhare girau || 11-468 ||
jātaḥ śrīphalavṛkṣastvamambikāyāḥ sadā priyaḥ | śrīśaile śikhare jātaḥ śrīphalaḥ śrīniketanaḥ || 11-469 ||
netavyo'si mayā gaccha pūjyo durgāsvarūpataḥ | vilvavṛkṣa mahābhāga sadā tvaṃ śaṅkarapriya || 11-470 ||
gṛhītvā tava śākhāṃ hi devīpūjāṃ karomyaham | śākhāchedodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ na ca kāryaṃ tvayā taro || 11-471 ||
devairgṛhītvā śākhāṃ te pūjitā'mbeti viśrutiḥ | punaranyat padyarūpaṃ mantraṃ brūyācca sādhakaḥ || 11-472 ||
putrāyurdhanavṛddhyarthaṃ neṣyāmi tvāmumāpriyām | vilvaśākhāṃ samāśritya rājyaṃ devi prayaccha me || 11-473 ||
āgaccha caṇḍike devi sarvakalyāṇahetave | kātyāyani gṛhāṇārcāṃ namaste śaṅkarapriye || 11-474 ||
tataḥ pūrvoditāścānyā āharedaṣṭa patrikāḥ |
tantrāntare |
patrikāstāḥ samānīya gītavādyapuraḥsaram || 11-475 ||
brahmaghoṣādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ nītvā'nyasyedgṛhāṅgaṇe |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
tā ekīkṛtya latayā'parājitasamāhvayā || 11-476 ||
saṃveṣṭya vasanenāpi pūjāsaṅkalpamācaret | pūrvavat sarvamuccārya patrikāpīṭhamūrttitaḥ || 11-477 ||
tataśca sthāpanamahaṃ kiraṣye iti kīrttayet | patrikāyāṃ tathā mūrtau khaḍge vā (*) yantramūrttayoḥ || 11-478 ||
devīmāvāhya sampūjya vilvapatrāñjalītrayam | datvā śaktau prakurvīta devyāḥ snānaṃ mahottaram || 11-479 ||
tadvai paurāṇavaidikyamapi saṃkīrttayāmi te | śaktau dinatrayaṃ kuryādaśaktau tu dinadvayam || 11-480 ||
sarvābhāve navamyāṃ tu snānamāvaśyakaṃ matam | kuryādatrāpi saṅkalpaṃ kāmyametadyataḥ priye || 11-481 ||
śatajanmakṛtāt pāpānmocane prathamaṃ smṛtam | tathā cāṣṭasahasrābdāvacchinnapadataḥ khalu || 11-482 ||
durgālokasthitiriti śatayajñaphalāptiyuk | navā'pi patrikā śuddhatoyena snāpayet tataḥ || 11-483 ||
pratyekaṃ tattadākhyābhirmūrtau nāmnā dhiyā'pi ca | mantrāṇāṃ padyarūpāṇāmādau tārastrapā smaraḥ || 11-484 ||
ramā maidhaṃ rāvarauṣau ḍākinyaṣṭa ca vai nava | pratyekaṃ devi deyāni tāntrikasnāpanakrame || 11-485 ||
kadalītarusaṃsthā'si śambhuvakṣaḥsthalasthite | snāpayāmyadya patri tvāṃ namaste haravallabhe || 11-486 ||
kaccit tvaṃ sthāvarībhūtā sadyaḥ siddhividhāyinī | durgārūpeṇa sarvatra snānena vijayaṃ kuru || 11-487 ||
haridre hara duḥkhāni śaṅkarasya sadā priye | rudrarūpā'si devi tvaṃ sarvaśāntiṃ prayaccha me || 11-488 ||
jayantī jayarūpā'si jagatāṃ jayakāriṇī | sthāpayāmīha devi tvāṃ jayaṃ dehi gṛhe mama || 11-489 ||
śrīphala śrīnikato'si sadā vijayavardhana | dehi me dharmakāmārthān prasanno bhava sarvadā || 11-490 ||
dāḍimyaghapraṇāśāya kṣunnāśāya tathā nṛṇām | nirmitā'si purā dhātrā prasīda tvamumāpriye || 11-491 ||
sthirā bhava sadā loke durgeśokavināśini | mayā tvaṃ pūjitā niyaṃ sthirā bhava harapriye || 11-492 ||
brāhmeṣu māno māneṣu mānanīyaḥ surāsuraiḥ | snāpayāmi mahādevīṃ mānaṃ dehi namo'stu te || 11-492 ||
lakṣmīstvaṃ dhānyarūpā'si prāṇināṃ prāṇadāyinī | sthirā'tyantaṃ hi no bhūtvā gṛhe kāmapradā bhava || 11-493 ||
tato dvitrinadītoyaṃ kṛtvā kalaśagarbhagam | candanāloḍitaṃ cāpi snāpayet tena caṇḍikām || 11-494 ||
śītā cālakanandā ca cakṣurbhadrādṛṣadvatī | tuṅgabhadrā kṛṣṇavarṇā payoṣṇī narmadā tathā || 11-495 ||
tāpī bhīmarathī siprā (*) vitastairāvatī tathā | godāvarī vipāsā ca śatadruḥ sindhureva || 11-496 ||
carmaṇvatī ca kāvero tāmraparṇī mahānadī | karatoyā bahudā ca śoṇā vetravatī tathā || 11-497 ||
devikā bhairavaḥ kokā gomatī cotpalāvatī | ātreyī bhāratī gaṅgā yamunā ca sarasvatī || 11-498 ||
sarayūrgaṇḍakī cāpi śvetagandhā ca kauśikī | bhogavatī ca pātāle svarge mandākinī tathā || 11-499 ||
etāścānyāśca yā nadyo bhāṣitā yāśca neritāḥ | devakhātāni tīrthāni kūpā nirjharasaṃjñakāḥ || 11-500 ||
sarāṃsi sindhavaścāpi sambhedā ye ca bhūtale | sarve tvāmabhiṣiñcantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 11-501 ||
vāsudevo jagannāthastathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca bhavatīṃ snāpayantvime || 11-502 ||
khyātā ye dvādaśādityā rudrā ekādaśāpi ca | marutaśconapañcāśadvasavo'ṣṭarttavaśca ṣaṭ || 11-503 ||
ākhaṇḍalo'gnirbhagavān yamo vai nir(-)ṛtistathā | varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣastathā śivaḥ || 11-504 ||
brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śeṣo dikpālāḥ snāpayantvamī | kīrttirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kṣamā ratiḥ || 11-505 ||
buddhirlajjā kriyā śāntistuṣṭiḥ kāntiśca mātaraḥ | etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu śaktirūpadharāstava || 11-506 ||
ādityaścandramā bhaumabudhajīvasitārkajāḥ | rāhuḥ ketuśca bhavatīṃ snāpayantu grahā nava || 11-507 ||
ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca | devapatnyo'dhvarā nāgā daityāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 11-508 ||
triśūlackracāparṣṭibhuśuṇḍī parigho gadā | kuntamudgarakhaṭvāṅgaśaktitomaraparśavaḥ || 11-509 ||
paṭṭiśo mudgalaḥ prāsabhindipālakaṭaṅkakāḥ | hūtā śataghnī kuliśapāśakarttṛhalāni ca || 11-510 ||
catvāra ṛgyajuḥsāmārtharvaṇo nigamā hi ye | aṅgāni śikṣā kalpaśca chando vyākaraṇaṃ tathā || 11-511 ||
niruktaṃ jyautiṣaṃ cāpi purāṇānyakhilāni ca | mīmāṃsānyāyavedāntākṣapatsāṅkhyapatañjalāḥ || 11-512 ||
smṛtiśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi daṇḍanītirvidhā'pi ca | gandharvāyurdhanurvedāścatuḥṣaṣṭiśca yāḥ kalāḥ || 11-513 ||
astrāṇi sarvaśastrāṇi vāhanāni nṛpāstathā | auṣadhāni ca sarvāṇi śilpavidyādikāni vā || 11-514 ||
muktāmāṇikyavaidūryavajrendramaṇayastathā | gomedapadmarāgau ca pravālaḥ śyāma eva ca || 11-515 ||
ratnāni yāni cānyāni kālasyāvayavāśca ye | manvantarāṇi sarvāṇi catvāryapi yugāni hi || 11-516 ||
abdamāsarttupakṣāhorātrāyanakalālavāḥ | rāśinakṣatrayogāśca kalāṃśāścāpi sūkṣmakāḥ || 11-517 ||
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailastīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ | devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ || 11-518 ||
ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu dharmakāmārthasiddhaye | sindhuraivataśoṇādyā ye hradā bhuvi viśrutāḥ || 11-519 ||
sarve sumanaso bhūtvā bhṛṅgāraiḥ snāpayantu te | takṣakādyāśca ye nāgāḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ || 11-520 ||
snāpayantu jagaddhātri bhṛṅgāraistvāṃ suvāsitaiḥ | atha dravyaviśiṣeṇa mantrabhedān bravīmi te || 11-521 ||
paurāṇānapi tāntrīyānmahāsnāpanakarmaṇi | sarveṣāmadhipo deva īśāno nāma nāmataḥ || 11-522 ||
śūlapāṇirmahādevaḥ sa tvāṃ saṃsnāpayet prahuḥ | snāpayecchaṅkhatoyena mantramenamudīrayet || 11-523 ||
mandākinyāstu yadvāri sarvapāpaharaṃ param | svargasrotaḥsamudbhūtaṃ snānaṃ bhavatu tena te || 11-524 ||
gāṅgena vāriṇā devīṃ snāpayenmanunā'munā | uṣṇaṃ sukhasparśakaraṃ jyotirvahnisamanvitam || 11-525 ||
malāpahārakaṃ kalyaṃ tena snānaṃ samācara | snāpayet pāthasoṣṇena paṭhanmantramamuṃ priye || 11-526 ||
gandhāḍhyaṃ śobhanaṃ caiva śītalaṃ sumanoharam | sarvapāpaharaṃ toyaṃ tat te snānāya kalpatām || 11-527 ||
amunā'modisalilakumbhena snāpayecchivām | puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ svacchaṃ ca śītalaṃ svādu yajjalam || 11-528 ||
snānāya kalpatāṃ tat te tathaiva śramaśāntaye | medhyācchaśītalāmbhobhiḥ snāpayedamuneśvarīm || 11-529 ||
gāvaḥ pavitrā hyanaghā gāvo viśvasya mātaraḥ | gāvo'dhvarāṇāṃ dhātryaśca goṣu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 11-530 ||
tadaṅgaprasṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaistvāṃ snāpayāmyaham | iti sāmānyato mantraṃ paṭhitvā tadanu priye || 11-531 ||
pratyekaṃ pañcagavyena snāpayejjagadambikām | gāvaṃ mūtreṇa puṇyena sarvāghaparimoṣiṇā || 11-532 ||
snāpayāmi jagaddhātrīṃ putrāyurdhanavṛddhaye | etena snāpayedevīṃ gomūtreṇa śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 11-533 ||
pavitratākaraṃ bhūmervibhūteḥ kāraṇaṃ param | gomayaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ tena tvāṃ snāpayāmyaham || 11-534 ||
mantramenaṃ paṭheddevīṃ snapāyedgomayāmbhasā | yadgavāmaṅgasambhūtaṃ haviṣaḥ kāraṇaṃ hi yat || 11-535 ||
dadhi tat te'ṅgalāvaṇyakaraṇāya bhavatvidam | dadhnā'munā bhagavatīṃ snāpayeddeśikottamaḥ || 11-536 ||
yajñakriyākalāpo'yam sarvo yasmin pratiṣṭhitaḥ | payasā tādṛśena tvāṃ snāpayāmi harapriyām || 11-537 ||
gṛṇannamuṃ gavyadugdhaiḥ snāpayejjagadambikām | yaddhomasādhanatvena prathitaṃ nigamādiṣu || 11-538 ||
yaccāpyagnimukhenaiva bhuñjate nikhilāḥ surāḥ | yasmāt pavitraṃ naivāsti balavīryakaraṃ ca yat || 11-539 ||
tena tvāṃ snāpayāmyadya gavyena haviṣeśvarīm | kālīmamūbhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ ghṛtena snāpayedbudhaḥ || 11-540 ||
ekīkṛtya tataḥ pañcagavyāni sakalāni hi | tathā'nāmikayā'loḍya kuśamūlena vā priye || 11-541 ||
yasmāt paraṃ nāparamasti medhyaṃ dehe gataṃ yadvṛjinaṃ nihanti | nāste paraṃ hṛdyamatastadetatsnānāya bhūyāt tava pañcagavyam || 11-542 ||
snāpayet pañcagavyena mantreṇānena kālikām | gavyaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ mādhvīkaṃ sitaśarkarāḥ || 11-543 ||
pañcāmṛtamidaṃ proktamamunā snāpayedumām | sāraṃ gṛhītvā jagatāṃ trayāṇāṃ yannirmitaṃ yajñakṛte vidhātrā || 11-544 ||
pañcāmṛtaṃ tanmadhuraṃ manojñaṃ saṃsnāpakaṃ te jagadamba bhūyāt | manunaivāmunā pañcāmṛtena snāpayecchivām || 11-545 ||
tathā |
oṃ kātyāyanyai vidmahe bhagavatyai dhīmahi tanno durgā pracodayāt |
etenekṣurasenaiva snāpayīta sureśvarīm |
tantrāntare |
mahauṣadhībhiḥ sarvābhiḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 11-546 ||
yā auṣadhīti mantreṇa snāpayejjagadambikām |
(mahauṣadhya uktā mātsye)
sahadevī tathā vyāghrī valā cātivalā tathā || 11-547 ||
śaṅkhapuṣpī ca siṃhī ca vacā caiva suvarcasā | mahauṣadhyaṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ mahāsnāne niyojayet || 11-548 ||
vyāghrī kaṇṭakārikā | valā vāṭyalakaḥ | savauṣadhayastu prāgevoktāḥ | tathā |
sahasradhārakumbhena snāpayejjagadambikām |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
sāgarāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ svargasroto nadāstathā || 11-549 ||
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca tīrthāni pṛthivītale | kūpāḥ saraḥ prasravaṇā devakhātāḥ sagartakāḥ || 11-550 ||
kulyāśca nirjharī vāpyo yāvantaśca jalāśayāḥ | lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalātmikāḥ || 11-551 ||
samudrāḥ sapta taddvīpā ye ca sapta prakīrttitāḥ | jambūplakṣakuśakrauñcaśākaśālmalipuṣkalāḥ || 11-552 ||
abhiṣiñcantu sarve tvāṃ mantrapāṭhavaśīkṛtāḥ | agnimīleti mantreṇa ṛgvedasyādyayā ṛcā || 11-553 ||
tvāṃ snāpayatu gavyena payaḥ kumbhena caṇḍikām | iṣe tvākhyena mantreṇa snāpayatvikṣujadravaiḥ || 11-554 ||
ṣaḍaśītibhidā yukto yajurvedaḥ sureśvarīm | sahasraśākhāsaṃyuktaḥ sāmavedo madhudravaiḥ || 11-555 ||
agna āyāhi mantreṇa tvāṃ snāpayatu caṇḍikām | atharvavedo haviṣā bahuśākhāsamanvitaḥ || 11-556 ||
śanno devīti mantreṇa devi tvāmabhiṣiñcatu | aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni vyāsenoktāni yāni hi || 11-557 ||
yāni copapurāṇāni dadhnā tvāṃ snāpayantu hi | maharṣibhiḥ praṇītāni dharmaśāstrāṇi yāni ca || 11-558 ||
śataṃ cāśītirūpāṇi snāpayantu maheśvarīm | surāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 11-559 ||
svarganadyambupūrṇena ādyena kalaśena tu | amunā gāṅgatoyena snāpayet parameśvarīm || 11-560 ||
marutaścābhiṣiñcantu bhaktimantaḥ sureśvarīm | meghatoyāmbupūrṇena dvitīyakalaśena ca || 11-561 ||
etena vṛṣṭinīrāḍhyakumbhena snāpayecchivām | sārasvatena toyena svacchamedhyena caṇḍike || 11-562 ||
vidyādharāḥ snāpayantu tṛtīyakalaśena tu | sarasvatyambusampūrṇaghaṭenāplāvayecchivām || 11-563 ||
tvāṃ snāpayantu śakrādyā lokapālāḥ samāgatāḥ | sāgarodakapūrṇena turyeṇa kalaśena hi || 11-564 ||
abhāvenāmbunā devīṃ snāpayenmanunā'munā | vāriṇā paripūrṇena padmareṇusugandhinā || 11-565 ||
pañcamenābhiṣiñcantu nāgāstvāṃ kalaśena hi | padmapuṣpasamāyuktajalakumbhamanustvasau || 11-566 ||
himavanmerukailāśā abhiṣiñcantu parvatāḥ | nirjharodakapūrṇena ṣaṣṭhena kalaśena hi || 11-567 ||
amunā nirjharāmbhobhiḥ snāpayet parameśvarīm | sarvatīrthāmbupūrṇena kalaśena sureśvarīm || 11-568 ||
saptamenābhiṣiñcantu ṛṣayaḥ sapta khecarāḥ | mantreṇaitena tīrthāmbukumbhena snāpanaṃ caret || 11-569 ||
vasavastvā'bhiṣiñcantu kalaśenāṣṭamena tu | sārasenaiva toyena durge devi namo'stu te || 11-570 ||
devīmanena mantreṇa siñcet kāsāravāriṇā | dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ || 11-571 ||
yaśo viveko niyamo brahmacaryaṃ dayā damaḥ | śāntirmaunaṃ tathā śaucaṃ santoṣo mitabhāṣitā || 11-572 ||
yavatyaścopaniṣadaḥ kaivalyapratipādakāḥ | sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ cāpi trailokye yat pratiṣṭhitam || 11-573 ||
yadbrahmasṛṣṭāvutpannaṃ mūrttaṃ cāmūrttameva ca | acaraṃ yaccaraṃ cāpi yadvāṅmayamavāṅmayam || 11-574 ||
te sarve snāpayantu tvāṃ navamena ghaṭena hi | snāpayecchuddhatoyena caṇḍikāṃ manunā'munā || 11-574 ||
ityuktaṃ te mahāsnānaṃ śaradarcāvidhau priye | dināntare'pi kurvīta bhaktaścedbhaktibhāvitaḥ || 11-575 ||
anena vidhinā yastu snāpayejjagadambikām | saptajanmakṛtāt pāpānmuktaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 11-572 ||
divyāṣṭābdasahasrāṇi devīloke vaset tathā | navamyāṃ tu mahāsnānaṃ dhanaputravivardhanam || 11-573 ||
sahasrayajñasya phalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | rājā rājyamavāpnoti śatrunāśaṃ tathaiva ca || 11-574 ||
svābhīṣṭamāpnuvantyanye mahāsnānena pārvati | mahāsnānādanu tato bhūtebhyo valimutsṛjet || 11-575 ||
sa kaulānāṃ māṃsamadye māṣānnaṃ smṛtivarttinām | gṛhītvā tamamūbhyāṃ vai manubhyāmutsṛjedvalim || 11-576 ||
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca ye vasantyatra bhūtale | te gṛhṇantu mayā dattaṃ valimenam prasādhitam || 11-577 ||
pūjitā gandhapuṣpādyairvalibhistarpitāstathā | deśādasmādviniḥsṛtya pūjāṃ paśyantu matkṛtām || 11-578 ||
tārarāvau kūrcabhūtau bhyasanto bhūta eva ca | sasandhyeṣa valirhṛcca mantrāvetāvudāhṛtau || 11-579 ||
rāvaḥ phre(/) | bhūtaḥ sphro(/) | tathā |
akṛte balidāne tu mahāsnānādanantaram | aphalaṃ tadbhaveddevi pūjāṅgaṃ hīyate tathā || 11-580 ||
vilumpanti sadā lubdhā na ca gṛhṇanti devatāḥ | tasmādyatnena karttavyaṃ bhūtānāmapasāraṇam || 11-581 ||
lājacandanasiddhārthabhasmadūrvākṣatādikam | gṛhītvā tāraroṣānuniḥśreṇyastramudīrayet || 11-582 ||
apasarpantu bhūtāste ye bhūtāḥ śāradārcikāḥ | bhūtānāmavirodhena devīpūjāṃ karomyaham || 11-583 ||
vetālāśca piśācāśca rākṣasāśca sarīsṛpāḥ | apasarpantu sarvatra mantrarūpāstratāḍitāḥ || 11-584 ||
ante manūnāme teṣāṃ hū(/) aḥ phaḍiti kīrttayet | bhūtādīnapasāryātha dvārapālebhya eva ca || 11-585 ||
trapāhṛdvilvaśākhānte vāsinyai tadanantaram | durgāyai kūrcamastraṃ ca mantreṇānena pārvati || 11-586 ||
pādyādibhiḥ samabhyarcya kuryānnīrājanāvidhim |
nīrājanaṃ nirmañchanam |
dvāradeśaḥ samānīya kuryānnirmañchanaṃ tataḥ || 11-587 ||
iti tantrāntaravacanāt tathā |
dhṛtvā'sanaṃ tato devīṃ patrikāṃ mṛnmayīmapi | saṃcālya gītavadyādīnimaṃ mantraṃ samuccaret || 11-588 ||
sthāpayet susthirākārāṃ tataḥ kalpita āsane | tāratrapārāvalakṣmīyoginīkāmayoṣitaḥ || 11-589 ||
ḍākinī cāpi phetkārīṃ caṇḍike bhagavatyapi | caladvayaṃ cālaya dvirvarjrakāpālinītyapi || 11-590 ||
pūjālayaṃ dviḥ praviśa hū(/) phaṭ svāhā tataḥ param | āgaccha madgṛhe devi saha śaktibhiraṣṭabhiḥ || 11-591 ||
pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa vidhivat sarvakalyāṇahetave | anena sthāpayeddevīṃ sarvakalyāṇadāyinīm || 11-592 ||
dinatrayasya pūjārthaṃ vedikādyāsanādiṣu |
trapā hrī(/) | rāvaḥ phre(/) | yoginī chrī(/) | kāmaḥ klī(/) | yoṣit strī(/) | ḍākinī khphre(/) | phetkārī hskhphre(/) | tathā |
tāracidrāvaḍākinyaḥ sthā(/) sthī(/) tvamambike tathā || 11-593 ||
sthirībhava śiraścati sthirīkuryāt tataḥ param |
cidvāgbhavam | kalaśasthāpanamāha |
tataḥ punarviracite sarvatobhadramaṇḍale || 11-594 ||
citritaṃ pañcavarṇena dadhyakṣataphalānvitam | pañcaratnena hemnā ca garbhagena vibhūṣitam || 11-595 ||
paṭṭācchādanasaṃvītagrīvaṃ pallavaśobhitam | vrīhīnāṃ vā yavānāṃ vā sthāpayitvopari priye || 11-596 ||
vaidikena vidhānena kalaśasthāpanaṃ caret | bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ bhūrasīti varānane || 11-597 ||
atha dhānyamasītyuktvā vrīhine vā'bhimantrayet | ājighretyuccaranmantraṃ kalaśaṃ tatra vinyaset || 11-598 ||
varuṇasyeti mantreṇa pāthobhiḥ paripūrayet | kāṇḍāt kāṇḍāditi procya pallavaṃ vinyaset tataḥ || 11-599 ||
phalaṃ vā phalinītyuktvā śrīścetyuktvā prasūnakam | gandhadvāretyatho gandhaṃ sahasretyakṣataṃ nyaset || 11-600 ||
sthirībhaveti mantreṇa sthirīkaraṇamācaret | valmīkakuñjararadanadīsaṅgamaparvatāt || 11-601 ||
gokulāddevanṛpatidvārādapi ca mṛttikāḥ | āhṛtya hārdamantreṇa pratyekaṃ niḥkṣipedghaṭe || 11-602 ||
hārdamantreṇa nama iti mantreṇa |
pūrvavat sarvavastvādiśodhanaṃ vidadhīta vai | prāgudīritamantreṇa tathaivālokanena ca || 11-603 ||
yadātmanā'navajñātaṃ pūjādravyādidūṣaṇam | aspṛśyasparśanaṃ vā'pi yadanyāyārjitaṃ ca vā || 11-604 ||
tathā nirmālyasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ kīṭārohaṇadūṣitam | naśyanti tāni sarvāṇi dūṣaṇānyavalokanāt || 11-605 ||
bhūtāpasāraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca | sampūjyāsanamātmīyaṃ gaṇeśagurudevatāḥ || 11-606 ||
natvā vidadhyāt tadanu prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ budhaḥ | patrikāyāstataḥ kuryādṛṣyādi yatamānasaḥ || 11-607 ||
śaratkālīnadurgārcāvidherasya hi nārada | ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī śrīdurgā devatā matā || 11-608 ||
bījaṃ hrīmiti nirdiṣṭaṃ śaktiḥ śrīmapi pārvati | kīlakaṃ klīmīti proktaṃ pūjāyāṃ viniyogatā || 11-609 ||
asminneva hyavasare saṅkalpaṃ ke'pi kurvate | kāmyatvānnetare cāsya ninyatvānnityakṛtyavat || 11-610 ||
kriyate yadi saṅkalpastryahasyāpyeka eva hi | eka prayogasaṃhārāt phalaikyācca visarjanāt || 11-611 ||
pīṭhe mūrtau ca nityaṃ tamṛṣiṃ tattanmanoścaret | mṛnmūrtipatrikāpakṣe mantraṃ sarṣiṃ niśāmaya || 11-612 ||
ādau vedādimālekhya dvivāraṃ durga īrayet | sambuddhiratha rakṣiṇyāḥ śirasā saha kīrttayet || 11-613 ||
patrikārcopacārādipradānārthaṃ manustvamau | ekaṃ dve dve trīṇi ca dve sakalo mantra eva ca || 11-614 ||
karāṅgulīhṛdādiṣvamī nyasyā mantravarṇakāḥ |
tathā |
nityapīṭhe purodīrṇaṃ svaṃ svaṃ dhyānaṃ samācaret || 11-615 ||
māheyapīṭhikāpakṣe dhyānamākalaya priye | nistaptasvarṇavarṇābhāṃ navatāruṇyaśālinīm || 11-616 ||
pūrṇacandrābhavadanāṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitām | loladīrghāsitatryakṣāṃ khaṇḍendvābaddhaśekharām || 11-617 ||
dāḍimīkusumākāradantapaṅktivirājitām | uttuṅgapīnavakṣojāṃ valitrayavirājitām || 11-618 ||
atikṣāmodarīṃ devīṃ nitambābhogabhāsurām | tribhaṅgasthānakatayā bhajyanmadhyāmiva sthitām || 11-618 ||
bāhubhirdaśabhiryuktāṃ sarvālaṅkaraṇānvitām | śūlaṃ kṛpāṇaṃ cakraṃ ca bāṇaṃ śaktiṃ ca dakṣiṇe | 619 ||
dhārayantīmatho vāme pāśacarmāṅkuśaṃ dhanuḥ | kaṇṭhīravoparinyastadakṣiṇāṅghrīsaroruhām || 11-620 ||
saṃmukhasthitasaṃchinnamahiṣāsuramastakām | kaṇṭhanālotthaditijasakirīṭakacoccayām || 11-621 ||
pāśaṃ vāmakareṇaiva bibhratīṃ parameśvarīm | śūlena hṛdi nirbhinnaṃ paśyantīṃ dānavaṃ ruṣā || 11-622 ||
pāśākāramahānāgaveṣṭitodarabāhukam | bhrūkuṭībhīṣaṇākāraṃ śoṇitārdrakalevaram || 11-623 ||
ākṛṣṭāsinigalitakaphoṇiṃ hariṇā haṭhāt | sravadrudhirasaṃdohavadanena mahātmanā || 11-624 ||
stūyamānāṃ suraiḥ sarvairbrahmājeśamukhādibhiḥ | līlayā dānavaṃ hatvā kiñcit kiñciddhasanmukhīm || 11-625 ||
ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā | caṇḍā caṇḍavatī caiva caṇḍarūpā ca caṇḍikā || 11-626 ||
ābhiḥ śaktibhiraṣṭābhiḥ satataṃ pariveṣṭitām | cintayedīdṛśīṃ durgāṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadām || 11-627 ||
dhyātvetthaṃ mānasairevopacāraiḥ paripūjya ca | pūrvoktenaiva vidhinā vidadhyādarghasaṃsthitim || 11-628 ||
naimittikavidhānena vistāro yatra kīrttitaḥ | satyāṃ śaktau tu pādyādīn pṛthaktvena pravinyaset || 11-629 ||
arghasyottarataḥ kāryaṃ pādyamācamanīyakam | snānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca upacārāstathā mayā || 11-630 ||
asminneva kṣaṇe devīpañcāyatanapūjakaḥ | gaṇeśārkaharīśānāṃ sambhāraiḥ kalpitairyajet || 11-631 ||
pīṭhārcanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sāmānyaṃ prathamaṃ budhaḥ | sarvaśeṣe yogaratnaṃ śeṣamantropabṛṃhitam || 11-632 ||
vidhāya ca punardhyānamāvāhanamathācaret | mudrāvibhaktikalitaṃ sādhako mīlitekṣaṇaḥ || 11-633 ||
mūlamantreṇātha sāvayavīkṛtya vibhāvanaiḥ | manvakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyaset tadupaspṛśan || 11-634 ||
mūlapīṭhapratiṣthāyāṃ yo manuḥ prāgudīritaḥ | yantramūrtyostu tenaiva pratiṣṭhāṃ sthirayoścaret || 11-635 ||
mṛnmūrtipatrikākumbhaśūlāsyādiṣvapi priye | ke canecchanti tanmantraṃ naiva kāpālikādayaḥ || 11-636 ||
anyān pauriṇikān mantrān vaidikānapi kā(/)ścana | īrayet pīṭhikākumbhamāheyapratimādiṣu || 11-637 ||
tā(/)ste vadāmi sutanu nandikeśvarabhāṣitāt | hastaṃ datvā patrikāyāṃ tārādi tatsadityapi || 11-638 ||
trirudīrya paṭhenmantrānevaitān sthirapīṭhayoḥ | āgaccha madgṛhe devi aṣṭābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ saha || 11-639 ||
pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa vidhivat sarvakalyāṇakāriṇi | ehyehi bhagavatyamba śatrukṣayajayaprade || 11-640 ||
bhaktitaḥ pūjayāmi tvāṃ navadurge surārcite | durge devi samāgaccha sānnidhyaṃ cāpi kalpaya || 11-641 ||
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇa tvamaṣṭābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ sahaḥ | śāradīyāmimāṃ pūjāṃ karomi tridaśārcite || 11-642 ||
ājñāpaya mahādevi daityadarpaniṣudani | duṣpāre ghorasaṃsāre sāgare patitaṃ sadā || 11-643 ||
trāyasva varade devi namaste śaṅkarapriye | ye devā yāśca devyaśca calitāyāṃ calanti hi || 11-644 ||
āvāhayāmi tān sarvā(/)ścaṇḍike parameśvari | prāṇān rakṣa yaśo rakṣa rakṣa dārān sutaṃ dhanam || 11-645 ||
sarvarakṣākarī yasmāt tvaṃ hi devi jagatpriye | praviśya tiṣṭha yajñe'smin yāvat pūjāṃ karomyaham || 11-646 ||
menānandakare devi sarvasiddhiṃ ca dehi me | āgaccha caṇḍike devi sarvakalyāṇahetave || 11-647 ||
pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa sumukhi namaste śaṅkarapriye | āvāhayāmi devi tvāṃ mṛnmaye śrīphale tathā || 11-648 ||
triśūle kalaśe khaḍge maṇḍale citra eva ca | kailāśaśikharāddevi vindhyādrerhimaparvatāt || 11-649 ||
āgatya vilvaśākhāyāṃ caṇḍike kuru sannidhīm | sthāpitā'si mayā devi pūjaye tvāṃ prasīda me || 11-650 ||
caṇḍe caṇḍātmike caṇḍi caṇḍavigrahadhāriṇi | vilvaśākhāṃ samāśritya tiṣṭha devi gaṇaiḥ saha || 11-651 ||
athavā mṛnmaye kumbhe triśūle khaḍga eva ca | tathā citrapaṭe vā'rinṛmuṇḍe vahnimaṇḍale || 11-652 ||
sarvagā tvaṃ samāgatya sānnidhyamiha kalpaya | devi tvaṃ jagatāṃ mātaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇi || 11-653 ||
maṇḍaleṣu samasteṣu sānnidhyamanukalpaya | caturviṃśatisaṅkhyeṣu adhiṣṭheyeṣu caṇḍike || 11-654 ||
āgatya śāradīṃ pūjāṃ hṛhṇa devi prasīda me | āvāhitā'si devi tvaṃ nikhile maṇḍale tava || 11-655 ||
bhūtvā'traiva sthirātma tvaṃ madgehe kāmadā bhava | caṇḍi tvaṃ caṇḍarūpā'si suratejaḥsamudbhave || 11-656 ||
parivāraiḥ samāgatya sthitimatra kuru drutam | aṣṭādaśaitān prajapenmantrān paurāṇikān priye || 11-657 ||
tato haṃsaḥ śucītyevaṃ pratadviṣṇustavetyapi | tathā viṣṇuryonimiti tārttiyakatayoditam || 11-658 ||
tāravyāhṛtipūrvā ca gāyatrī tārapaścimā | tryambakaṃ ceti pañcaitān vaidikān prajapenmanūn || 11-659 ||
nemānapi sthire pīṭhe mūrttau vā parikalpayet | ataḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vai kurvīta manuvistaraiḥ || 11-660 ||
ādyena nityakhyātena nimittoktena tatparam | ākhyāsyamānatārttīyamanunā tadanantaram || 11-661 ||
tacca śāradapūjāyāṃ netarasyāṃ kadācana | pīṭhamūrttyorapi tathā maṇḍale netaratra ca || 11-662 ||
tāramaidhatrapārāvayoginyo ḍākinī tathā | phetkārīkūrcavanitā bījānīmāni vai nava || 11-663 ||
ehyehi bhagavatyevaṃ tato brūyāt padatrayam | trayastriṃśatkoṭipadāt tathā tridaśaśabdataḥ || 11-664 ||
tejaḥkalpitaśabdācca śarīre parikalpayet | padāt tathā ca mahiṣāsūrato mardinītyapi || 11-665 ||
tato jagattrayetyuktvā pālini pratikīrttayet | kāmaprasādapāśāśca nṛsiṃhakamale tataḥ || 11-666 ||
āgacchadvitayaṃ cāpi sānnidhyaṃ kalpayadvayam | pūjālayam praviśyoktvā tiṣṭhayugmamataḥ param || 11-667 ||
tato visandhyaṣṭaśaktipadāt parivṛte vadet | jvalayugmaṃ prajvalayugaṃ sphura prasphura cedṛśam || 11-668 ||
aṅkuśapretabhairavyo'māhārapralayāstataḥ | vidyunmahākrodhatārāḥ śiraḥ śeṣe tataḥ param || 11-669 ||
śatamaṣṭādaśopetaṃ varṇānāmatra vai manau | mantratrayeṇāmunaiva kuryāt prāṇapratiṣṭhitam || 11-670 ||
mṛnmūrtipatrikākumbhādiṣu sarvāntimaṃ manum | śrauta paṭhenmanojūtiriti kauletaro naraḥ || 11-671 ||
naimittikoktena tathā kuryādāvāhanaṃ tataḥ | mantreṇa trirudīrṇena na patryāṃ pīṭha eva hi || 11-672 ||
atha kaulādayaḥ kuryurasminnavasare priye | naimittikena vidhinā pātrasthāpanamuttamam || 11-673 ||
nyāsaughān purataḥ kṛtvā naimittikavidhīritān | śaktau tu pañcakān sarvān ṣoḍhātritayameva hi || 11-674 ||
māheyapatryornaitāṃ vai prakurvīta kadācana | pātrāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ cāpi kuryāt svena matena hi || 11-675 ||
vicārarītī eṣāṃ vai naimittika udīrite | sā kalpanā ca te mantrāḥ sa kramaḥ saṃsthitiśca sā || 11-676 ||
te nyāsāḥ śodhanaṃ tacca vastu vā tarpaṇaṃ ca tat | śaradarcāpīṭhamūrtyornaimittikasamarhaṇāt || 11-677 ||
kasyāpi mata īśāni naivāṇurapi bhidyate | viśiṣyāto mayā tantrapaurāṇikavidhidvayam || 11-679 ||
ucyate sa manuḥ prāyo buddhimadbuddhigocaraḥ | patrikādiṣu paurāṇaṃ tāntrikaṃ pīṭha eva hi || 11-680 ||
vastvarpaṇasya pratyekaṃ ye mantrāḥ pūrvamīritāḥ | naimittikārcanavidhau grāhyāste'trāpi pārvati || 11-681 ||
pratyekaṃ manavo ye vai patrikādiṣu saṃsthitāḥ | tānidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi tattadvastvarpaṇāvidhau || 11-682 ||
yathā tattanmanūccārādanumūlamanūditān | kathyate vastudānāya tathā'trāpi sureśvari || 11-683 ||
paurāṇikamanuṃ procya tadante parikīrttayet | dvātriṃśadvarṇakaṃ mantramathavā bhairavoditam || 11-684 ||
kātyāyanopāsitaṃ yajjayadurgādaśākṣaram | tābhyām paurāṇikārcāyāṃ vastudānasamuddhṛteḥ || 11-685 ||
dvayoraśaktāvekaṃ vā āvaśyakatayerayet | vakṣye tayoruddhṛtiṃ tadādyaṃ nandīśvarārcitam || 11-686 ||
tāratrapābhyāṃ ṅentā syāddakṣayajñavināśinī | mahāghorā'pi ca tathā yoginīkoṭiśabdataḥ || 11-687 ||
tadvat parivṛtā kāryā māyābījaṃ tataḥ param | pūrvavadbhadrakālī ca hṛnmantraḥ sarvaśeṣagaḥ || 11-688 ||
athavā tārato durgā iti vāradvayaṃ vadet | sambuddhyantāṃ rakṣaṇīṃ ca tarjanīmanurantyagaḥ || 11-689 ||
yadyapīmau manū devi tāntrikau samudīritau | tathā'pi paurāṇikānte niyojyau tattadarhaṇe || 11-690 ||
atha sarvopacārīyān vakṣye paurāṇikānmanūn | pūrvamevoditāḥ santi nimittārcāsu tāntrikāḥ || 11-691 ||
ta evātra niyoktavyāḥ pratyekaṃ tattadarpaṇe | patrikādiṣu paurāṇāḥ pīṭhamūrttyostu tāntrikāḥ || 11-692 ||
āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca tato'nvācamanīyakam | madhuparkaṃ snānajalaṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇacandane || 11-693 ||
puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca netrāñjanamataḥ param | alaktaṃ cāpi naivedyaṃ pradakṣiṇanamaskṛtī || 11-694 ||
upacārā ime proktā devītuṣṭividhāyakāḥ | yadyadvai dīyate dravyamalaṅkārādikāñcanam || 11-695 ||
teṣāṃ daivatamuccārya kṛtvā ca prokṣaṇārcane | utsṛjya tattanmantreṇa tattannāmnā nivedayet || 11-696 ||
sarvaśuddhiṃ tu paurāṇakrameṇa dharayā'caret | idaṃ ta āsanaṃ dattaṃ mayā suravarārcite || 11-697 ||
bhavaitasminniṣaṇṇā tvaṃ yāvat pūjāṃ karomyaham | dūrvāparājitāpadmaśyāmākasahitaṃ jalam || 11-698 ||
pādyāya kalpate devi viśeṣārcāsu nānyathā | pādyaṃ gṛhṇa mayā dattaṃ sarvaduḥkhāpahārakam || 11-699 ||
trāyasva varade devi ghorādasmādbhavārṇavāt | snāte vastre ca naivedye dadyādācamanīyakam || 11-700 ||
tacca svadhāpadairdadyānmadhuparkaṃ tathā priye | arghaṃ svāhāpadenaiva sarvamanyannamaḥ padaiḥ || 11-701 ||
gandhapuṣpākṣatayavakuśāgratilasarṣapān | vilvapatrakṣīradūrvāsahitaṃ salilaṃ śuci || 11-702 ||
śaṅkhapātragataṃ kṛtvā kālikāyai nivedayet | dūrvākṣatasamāyuktaṃ vilvapatrasamanvitam || 11-703 ||
śobhanaṃ śaṅkhapātrasthaṃ gṛhāṇārghaṃ harapriye | nānātīrthodbhavaṃ vāri sarvavastūpakalpitam || 11-704 ||
gṛhāṇārghamimaṃ devi jagaddhātri namo'stu te | candrajātīlavaṅgailākakkolasahitaṃ jalam || 11-705 ||
viśeṣācamanīyaṃ vai dadyāddevyai phalecchayā | āmodavastusurabhīkṛtametadanūttamam || 11-706 ||
gṛhāṇācamanīyaṃ tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā niveditam | imā āpo mayā bhaktyā tava pādatale'rpitāḥ || 11-707 ||
ācāmaya mahādevi prītā śāntiṃ prayaccha me | surābhāve ghṛtadadhi madhu kāṃsye nivedayet || 11-708 ||
madhuparkaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ prārthanīyaṃ divaukasām | madhuparkaṃ maheśāni brahmaṇā parikalpitam || 11-709 ||
mayā niveditaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhāṇa jagadīśvari | madhuparkapradānānte punarācamanīyakam || 11-710 ||
dātavyaṃ prāśanānte'sya yata ucchiṣṭatā bhavet | vārīdaṃ hi mamāmodi prasannaṃ medhyameva ca || 11-711 ||
mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā snāhyanena sureśvari | nānāvarṇasamāyuktapaṭṭasūtrādinirmitam || 11-712 ||
vāsaḥśuklaṃ tathā raktaṃ gṛhāṇa tridaśeśvari | dehaśobhākaraṃ pūtaṃ rañjitaṃ nāgavastubhiḥ || 11-713 ||
paridhatsva jagaddhātri vāso bhaktyā niveditam | vāsasaḥ paridhānānte punarācamanīyakam || 11-714 ||
dātavyaṃ bhaktibhāvena smṛtyuktatvānmanuṣyavat | divyaratnasamāyuktā vahnibhānusamaprabhāḥ || 11-715 ||
alaṅkārāstavāṅgāni śobhayantu sureśvari | anulepanametat te mahāsurabhi śītalam || 11-716 ||
mayā niveditaṃ devi gṛhītvā lepayāṅgakam | idaṃ kusumamāmodi grāmāraṇyasamudbhavam || 11-717 ||
prāṇasantarpaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ mayāṃ dattaṃ pragṛhyatām | karpūrāgurusaṃmiśro vanaspatirasodbhavaḥ || 11-718 ||
mayā nivedito dhūpo devadevi pragṛhyatām | agnijyotī ravijyotiścandrajyotistathaiva ca || 11-719 ||
jyotiṣāmuttamaṃ jyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām | tvaṃ candrasūryajyotīṃṣi vidyudagnyostathaiva ca || 11-720 ||
tvameva jagatāṃ jyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām | snigdhamuṣṇaṃ hṛdyatamaṃ dṛśāṃ śobhākaraṃ tava || 11-721 ||
gṛhītvā kajjalaṃ sadyo netrāṇyañjaya pārvati | tvatpādāmbhojanakharadyutikāri manoramam || 11-722 ||
alaktakamidaṃ devi mayā dattaṃ pragṛhyatām | nānāvidhāni ramyāṇi svādūni rasavanti ca || 11-723 ||
mayā dattāni gṛhyantāṃ naivedyāni surārcite | phalapūlāni sarvāṇi grāmakānanajāni ca || 11-724 ||
nānākārasugandhīni gṛhāṇa parameśvari | caturvidhamidaṃ bhojyaṃ devi ṣaḍbhī rasairyutam || 11-725 ||
sadā tṛptikaraṃ ramyamidamannaṃ pragṛhyatām | gavyasarpiḥpayoyuktaṃ nānāmadhuramiśritam || 11-726 ||
niveditaṃ devi mayā paramānnaṃ pragṛhyatām | amṛtai racitaṃ divyaṃ ghṛtakhaṇḍavinirmitam || 11-727 ||
piṣṭakaṃ vividhaṃ svādu gṛhāṇa haravallabhe | modakaṃ svādu ruciraṃ karpūrādibhiranvitam || 11-728 ||
miśraṃ nānāvidhairdravyaiḥ pratigṛhyāśu bhujyatām | tāmrapātre sthitaṃ sīdhuṃ payo gavyamathātra vā || 11-729 ||
nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye gṛhāṇa śaṅkarapriye | pānīyaṃ śītalaṃ svacchaṃ prasannaṃ ghanasārayuk || 11-730 ||
bhojane tṛptikṛddevi kṛpayā pratigṛhyatām | bhojanānte pradātavyaṃ punarācamanīyakam || 11-731 ||
pūrvoktenaiva mantreṇa sarvatraiva śucismite | phalapatrakasaṃyuktaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam || 11-732 ||
mukhakāntikaraṃ hṛdyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām | dūrvāṅkuraṃ tato devyai dadyāt sādhakasattamaḥ || 11-733 ||
namaste sarvage devi namaste bhuktimuktide | dūrvāṃ gṛhāṇa devi tvaṃ māṃ nistāraya saṅkaṭāt || 11-734 ||
vilvapatraṃ tato devyai pṛthaktvena nivedayet | amṛtodbhavaṃ śrīyuktaṃ mahādeva priyaṃ sadā || 11-735 ||
pavitraṃ te prayacchāmi patraṃ mālūraśākhinaḥ | nānāpuṣpeṇa racitāṃ stanabaddhāṃ sugandhinīm || 11-736 ||
prabhraṣṭāṃ lambanāṃ cāpi tava devi nivedaye | sarvaśeṣe pradātavyaṃ sindūraṃ patrikārcane || 11-737 ||
anulepanakāle tu pīṭhamūrttyorbhideyatī | alikādikaśobhāyāḥ kārakaṃ rāgasambhavam || 11-738 ||
atirāgi samutpiñjasindrūraṃ pratigṛhyatām | camarīpucchajaṃ śvetaṃ hemadaṇḍi suloma ca || 11-739 ||
mayā'rpitaṃ rājacihnaṃ cāmaraṃ pratigṛhyatām | varhivarhakṛtākāraṃ madhyadaṇḍasamanvitam || 11-740 ||
gṛhyatāṃ vyajanaṃ devi dehasvedāpanattaye | yena bhīṣayase daityān yena pūrayase'mbaram || 11-741 ||
tāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ te prayacchāmi mahiṣaghni pragṛhyatām | dīpairanekairvihitamārātrikamidaṃ śubham || 11-742 ||
nivedayāmi te devi saṃharājñānajaṃ tamaḥ | sarvaśeṣe pradātavyaṃ puṣpāṇāmañjalitrayam || 11-743 ||
tanmanustu varārohe durgāgāyatryudīritā |
oṃ caṇḍikāyai vidmahe bhagavatyai dhīmahi tanno gaurī pracodayāt |
anena vidhinā yastu mantrairebhiśca pārvati || 11-744 ||
mahiṣaghnīṃ mahāmāyāṃ patrikāsu prapūjayet | aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya sa gaccheccaṇḍikālayam || 11-745 ||
ihāpi ca bhavet sadyaḥ kalyāṇānāṃ sa bhājanam | pūjārītirvarārohe pīṭhamūrttyorapīdṛśī || 11-746 ||
mantrabhedaḥ paro jñeyaḥ pātrāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ tathā | pratyekaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt patrikāṇāṃ tu pūjanam || 11-747 ||
yāvacchakyopacāreṇa mantreṇāpi pṛthak pṛthak | ekā tattadadhiṣṭhātrī devatā parikīrttitā || 11-748 ||
tattannāmnā caturthyantāṃ samāvāhyārcayet priye | ādau tu rambhādhiṣṭhātrī brahmāṇī parikīrttitā || 11-749 ||
kālikā kaccyadhiṣṭhātrī tripuraghnena bhāṣitā | durgā haridrādhiṣṭhātrī jayantyāṃ kārttikī tathā || 11-750 ||
śivā ca vilvādhiṣṭhātrī dāḍimādhiṣṭhitā tatthā | śatrusaṅghakṣayakarī vijñeyā raktadantikā || 11-751 ||
munibhiḥ śokarahitā'śokādhiṣṭhātryudīritā | tathaiva mānādhiṣṭhātrī cāmuṇḍā parikīrttitā || 11-752 ||
lakṣmīśca dhānyādhiṣṭhātrī nandīśenopapāditā | navapatrikādhiṣṭhātrī kātyāyanyapyudīritā || 11-753 ||
yāthā'sāṃ kramato devi nāmānyuktāni te mayā | tathaiva mantramekaikaṃ kramena prabruve'dhunā || 11-754 ||
brahmāṇi tvaṃ sasāgaccha sānnidhyamiha kalpaya | rambhārūpeṇa sarvatra śāntiṃ kuru namo'stu te || 11-755 ||
mahiṣāsurayuddheṣu kaccībhūtā'si kālike | manuṣyānugrahārthāya lokamenamupāgatā || 11-756 ||
haridre varade devi durgārūpā'si śobhane | mama vighnavināśāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇa prasīda me || 11-757 ||
niśumbhaśumbhamathane sendrairdevagaṇaiḥ purā | jayantī pūjitā'si tvamasmākaṃ varadā bhava || 11-758 ||
mahādevapriyakaro vāsudevapriyaḥ sadā | sadā kālīprītikaro vilvavṛkṣa namo'stu te || 11-759 ||
dāḍimi tvaṃ purā yuddhe raktabījasya saṃmukhe | cāmuṇḍāprītimakarot tasmāt tvāṃ pūjayāmyaham || 11-760 ||
haraprītikaro vṛkṣo hyaśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ | durgāprītikaratvena māmaśokaṃ sadā kuru || 11-761 ||
yasya patre vaseddevī mānavṛkṣa śacīpriya | mamaivānugrahārthāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇa sureśvari || 11-762 ||
jagataḥ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā | umāprītīkaraṃ dhānyaṃ tasmāt tvaṃ rakṣa māṃ sadā || 11-761 ||
patrike navadurge tvaṃ mahādevamanohare | pūjāṃ samāstāṃ saṃgṛhya rakṣa māṃ tridaśeśvari || 11-762 ||
pratyekamitthaṃ saṃpūjya mantrairetairudīritaiḥ | nāmābhyāmapi ṅentābhyāmuktābhyāṃ pūrvameva te || 11-763 ||
sāmānyapīṭhanyāsoktanāmabhirṅentabṛṃhitaiḥ | dikpālānapi nityoktavāhanāyudhasaṃyutān || 11-764 ||
vastubhiḥ pīṭhamūrttyostu nityanaimittikoditaiḥ | prāvṛtyārcanavistārairyajet parameśvarīm || 11-765 ||
yāvatī kathitā nitya iti karttavyatā mayā | yathā naimittike cāpi dvayīmapi niyojayet || 11-766 ||
saṃprayogamamantrāṇāmavadannaityake vidhau | taṃ kevalaṃ vidhāyeśi sarvamanyamupācaret || 11-767 ||
naimittikīyaḥ saṃgrāhyo'nyaḥ sarva ubhayātmakaḥ | prayogo yādṛśīyastu tādṛśīyaṃ hi tarpaṇam || 11-768 ||
śaktau tu patrikārcāyāṃ daśāstrāṇi prapūjayet | ṅentaistārahṛdo madhye'dhiṣṭhitaistattadakṣaraiḥ || 11-769 ||
tato'nu sarvapūjānte pūjayenmahiṣāsuram | valiṃ dadyāt svaśaktyā ca paśūnapi khagānapi || 11-770 ||
naimittike tadvidhānaṃ prāgeva tava kīrttitam |
iti saptamīkṛtyam |
athāṣṭamīkṛtyam |
tatraiva |
etāvat saptamīkṛtyamathāṣṭamyarcanaṃ śṛṇu || 11-771 ||
saptamyuktavidhānaṃ hi pūrvamevānuvarttate | adhikaṃ yat tadākhyāsye sarvamanyat puroktavat || 11-772 ||
śodhanaṃ dravyajātānāmāsanādestathaiva ca | prāṇāyāmo bhūtaśuddhirmātṛkānyāsa eva ca || 11-773 ||
tathā pīṭhaṣaḍaṅgākhyanyāsau nyāsāntarāṇyapi | vidhāya pūrvoktarītyā ca mahāsnānaṃ tathaiva ca || 11-774 ||
darpaṇe pratibimbaṃ ca kārayitvā puroktavat | dantakāṣṭhaṃ nivedyātha saṃkalpaṃ viracayya ca || 11-775 ||
arghasaṃsthāpanādīni vidhāya ca puroktavat | samāpyātmārcanaṃ cāpi ghaṭe gaṇapatiṃ yajet || 11-776 ||
sūryādīnapi pañcāyatanān saṃpūjya yatnataḥ | dhyātvā'tha mānasairevopacāraiḥ paripūjya ca || 11-777 ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmahāmāyāṃ samarcayet | taistairmantraistadanukramataścāpi pārvati || 11-778 ||
mudrāpradarśanaistairupacāranivedanaiḥ | pīṭhamūrttyostāntrikoktarītyā pūjanamācaret || 11-779 ||
patrikāsu ca paurāṇakramato jagadīśvari | kṛtvā'varaṇapūjāṃ hi pīṭhe dvābhyāṃ samācaret || 11-780 ||
nityanaimittikoktābhyāṃ mahāṣṭamyarcanakrame | viśeṣaṃ kaṃ cidākhyāsye patrikāyāḥ prapūjane || 11-781 ||
pūrvādivasukoṇeṣu daśopacaraṇairyajet | devyāḥ śaktīḥ krameṇaivogracaṇḍādyā viśeṣataḥ || 11-782 ||
mantramālāmayīsaṃsthairmantrairāsāṃ tu kaulikaḥ | nandikeśapurāṇoktairmanubhiḥ padyarūpibhiḥ || 11-783 ||
śrutyadhvanyāḥ pūjayeyurugracaṇḍādikāḥ priye | manū(/)stadīyānadhunā bravīmi tava sundari || 11-784 ||
tārahnīkamalā ādau madhye ṅentābhidhā tathā | ante hṛnmanurevaṃ hi paripāṭī prakīrttitā || 11-785 ||
ugracaṇḍā tu bhayadā madhyāhnārkasamaprabhā | sā me sadā'stu varadā tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ || 11-786 ||
pracaṇḍe putrade nityaṃ pracaṇḍagaṇasaṃvṛte | jagadānandade devi prasannā bhava sarvadā || 11-787 ||
caṇḍogre bhūtarūpā'si sarvabhūtabhayapradā | saumyā bhūtā mayi sadā varadā bhava śobhane || 11-788 ||
yā siddhiriti nāmnā tu deveśena prakāśitā | śāsi tvaṃ sā'si deveśi namaste caṇḍanāyike || 11-789 ||
devi cāṇḍātmike caṇḍe caṇḍārivijayaprade | dharmamokṣapradā'si tvaṃ nityaṃ me varadā bhava || 11-790 ||
yā sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāraguṇatrayasamanvitā | yasyāḥ parā na cānyā'sti caṇḍavatyai namo namaḥ || 11-791 ||
caṇḍarūpā mahācaṇḍā caṇḍanāyakacaṇḍikā | sarvasiddhipradā devi tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ || 11-792 ||
bālārkāruṇanetrā yā sarvadā bhaktavatsalā | caṇḍāsurasya mathanī varadā sā'stu caṇḍikā || 11-793 ||
tato'ṣṭadalapadmasya aṣṭāvṛtyā daleṣu ca | yajeccatuḥṣaṣṭimitā yoginīgaṇarūpiṇīḥ || 11-794 ||
tāratrayaṃ puro datvā śeṣe nama idaṃ padam | ṅentaṃ tato nāma tāsāṃ madhye kṛtvā niyojayet || 11-795 ||
upacāraiḥ pañcabhirvā puṣpairvā kevalākṣataiḥ | brahmāṇī caṇḍikā raudrī gaurīndrāṇī tathaiva ca || 11-796 ||
kaumārī bhairavī durgā nārasiṃhī ca kālikā | cāmuṇḍā śivadūtī ca vārāhī kauśikī tathā || 11-797 ||
māheśvarī śaṅkarī ca jayantī sarvamaṅgalā | karālinī muktakeśī śivā śākambharī tathā || 11-798 ||
bhīmā śāntā bhrāmarī ca rudrāṇī caṇḍarūpiṇī | kṣamā dhātrī svadhā svāhā aparṇā ca mahodarī || 11-799 ||
ghorarūpā mahākālī vidyujjihvā kapālinī | kṣemaṅkarī mahāmāyā meghamālā balākinī || 11-800 ||
śuṣkodarī caṇḍaghaṇṭā mahāpretā priyaṅkarī | kharatuṇḍī ṛkṣakarṇī balapramathanī tathā || 11-801 ||
manomathanyapi tathā sarvabhūtadamanyapi | umā tārā mahānidrā vijayā ca jayā tathā || 11-802 ||
śailaputrī maholkā ca triśūlinyañjanaprabhā | kūṣmāṇḍī viśvasaṃtrāsā tathā kātyāyanī parā || 11-803 ||
kālarātrirmahāgaurī catuḥṣaṣṭirimā matāḥ | pūjayenmaṇḍalasyānte sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 11-804 ||
punaśca koṭiyoginyaḥ pūjyāḥ ekākhyayā priye | padmapatrāgrahāgreṣu pūrvavanmantrakalpanaiḥ || 11-805 ||
tato devīsannidhāne samyagdurgā phalapradā | aiśānyādikrame dve dve madhye vā nava pūjayet || 11-806 ||
āsāmapyugracaṇḍādivanmantraḥ parikīrttitaḥ | pādyādibhiḥ pūrvavacca tattanmantraiḥ prapūjayet || 11-807 ||
mṛtyuñjayaprāṇasaṃsthairatha paurāṇikairapi | pūrvapakṣaḥ kaulikānāmuttaraḥ śrutiśālinām || 11-808 ||
tanmantrāmadhunā vakṣye sāvadhānā niśāmaya | caturmukhīṃ jagaddhātrīṃ haṃsārūḍhāṃ varapradām || 11-809 ||
sṛṣṭikartrīṃ mahābhāgāṃ brahmaṇīṃ tāṃ namāmyaham | vṛṣārūḍhāṃ śivāṃ bhadrāṃ trinetrāṃ varadāṃ śivām || 11-810 ||
māheśvarīṃ namasyāmi jagatsaṃhārakāriṇīm | kaumārīṃ pītavasanāṃ mayūravaravāhinīm || 11-811 ||
śaktihastāṃ śoṇadehāṃ namāmi varadāṃ sadā | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇīṃ kṛṣṇavigrahām || 11-812 ||
sthitirūpāṃ khagendrasthāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ praṇamāmyaham | varāharūpiṇīṃ devīṃ daṃṣṭroddhṛtavasundharām || 11-813 ||
śubhadāṃ nīlavasanāṃ vārāhīṃ tāṃ namāmyaham | nṛsiṃharūpiṇīṃ bhīmāṃ daityadānavaghātinīm || 11-814 ||
vikarālanakhāṃ śubhrāṃ nārasiṃhīṃ namāmyaham | indrāṇīṃ gajakumbhasthāṃ sahasranayanāṃ śubhām || 11-815 ||
namāmi varadāṃ devīṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām | cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamathanīṃ muṇḍamālopaśobhitām || 11-816 ||
aṭṭāṭṭahāsamuditāṃ namāmyātmavibhūtaye | kātyāyanīṃ daśabhujāṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm || 11-817 ||
prasannavadanāṃ devīṃ varadāṃ praṇamāmyaham | caṇḍike navadurge tvaṃ mahādevapriye sadā || 11-818 ||
pūjāṃ samastāṃ saṃgṛhya rakṣa māṃ tridaśeśvari | kātyāyanyāśca durgāyā mantradvayamidaṃ matam || 11-819 ||
ime tenaiva mantreṇa pūjayet suravandite | punaḥ pūrvoktavidhinā devīrekādaśarcayet || 11-820 ||
jayantīṃ maṅgalāṃ kālīṃ bhadrakālīṃ kapālinīm | durgāṃ kṣamāṃ śivāṃ dhātrīṃ svadhāṃ svāhāṃ ca pūjayet || 11-821 ||
tato'strapūjāṃ kurvīta saptamyarcanato'dhikām | praṇavādyairnamo'ntaiśca mantraireva sureśvari || 11-822 ||
ādau tu dakṣiṇe bhāge tato vāme prapūjayet | pādyādibhistriśūlādīn kevalairakṣatairatha || 11-823 ||
sarvāyudhānāṃ prathamo nirmitastvaṃ pinākinā | śūlasāraṃ samākṛṣya kṛtvā muṣṭigrahaṃ śubham || 11-824 ||
asirviśasanaḥ khaḍgastīkṣṇadhāro durāsadaḥ | śrīgarbho vijayaścaiva dharmapāla namo'stu te || 11-825 ||
cakraṃ tvaṃ viṣṇurūpo'si viṣṇupāṇau sadā sthitaḥ | devīhastagataścāsi cakrarāja namo'stu te || 11-826 ||
sarvāyudhānāṃ śreṣṭhastvaṃ daityasenāniṣūdana | bhayebhyaḥ sarvadā rakṣa tīkṣṇabāṇa namo'stu te || 11-827 ||
śakte tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ guhasya ca viśeṣataḥ | śakti rūpeṇa sarvatra rakṣāṃ kuru namo'stu te || 11-828 ||
rakṣārūpeṇa kheṭa tvamarisaṃhārakārakaḥ | sadā devīkaragata māṃ rakṣa bahusaṅkaṭāt || 11-829 ||
sarvāyudhamahāmātra sarvāsuraniṣūdana | cāpa māṃ sarvato rakṣa sākaṃ sāyakasattamaiḥ || 11-830 ||
pāśa tvaṃ nāgarūpo'si viṣapūrṇo viṣodaraḥ | śatrūṇāṃ duḥsaho nityaṃ nāgapāśa namo'stu te || 11-831 ||
aṅkuśo'si namastubhyaṃ gajānāṃ tvaṃ niyāmakaḥ | devānāmapi rakṣārthaṃ pārvatyā'si dhṛtaḥ kare || 11-832 ||
yasyā ninādamākarṇya śakṛnmūtre prasusruvaḥ | daityasaṅghāḥ pāhi sā tvaṃ ghaṇṭe nānāvidhādbhayāt || 11-833 ||
paraśo tvamatikṣṇo'si sarvavairivimardana | devīhastagataścāsi sadā tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ || 11-834 ||
yāni yānīha mukhyāni prasiddhānyāyudhāni ca | kṣayakārīṇi śatrūṇāṃ vikhyātāni jagattraye || 11-835 ||
yāni yānyambikā dhatte kareṣu sveṣu sarvadā | bhuśuṇḍīpāśaparighabhindipālāstu lāguḍāḥ || 11-836 ||
ṛṣṭitomarakuntāśca paṭṭiśo muśalastathā | gadāśataghnīkuṇapacchurikākarttarīmukhāḥ || 11-837 ||
sarvā(/)stān pūjayāmyadya mahāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | sarve rakṣantu māṃ nityam sarvasiddhiṃ dadatvapi || 11-838 ||
tārāt kūrcācca durgāyai sarvāyudhapadānyapi | dhāriṇyai nama uccārya dadyāt puṣpāñjalitrayam || 11-839 ||
tato devyāḥ kirīṭādīnalaṅkārān prapūjayet | tārādyena namo'ntena nāmnā ṅentena tasya ca || 11-840 ||
tataḥ prapūjayeddevyāḥ siṃhāsanamanuttamam | tārādvajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya parikīrttya hi ||
mahāsiṃhāya hu(/) hṛcca siṃhametena pūjayet | yathopakalpitairevopacāraiḥ kusumākṣataiḥ || 11-841 ||
tadante manunaitena devyāḥ siṃhāsanaṃ yajet | āsanaṃ cāsi devyāstvaṃ ghoradaṃṣṭrotkaṭānvitaḥ | | 842 ||
himādriśikharākāra siṃharāja namo'stu te | devyā dattavaratvena viśeṣānmahiṣāsuram || 11-843 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca pūjayedbahuvistaraiḥ | yāvacchakyopacāraistu pādyādibhiranekadhā || 11-844 ||
namo'ntaḥ praṇavādiśca ṅento'ntarmahiṣāsuraḥ | etena manunā sarvopacārānasya cārpayet || 11-845 ||
na sāmānyāsuradhiyā sākṣādrudradhiyaiva hi | pūjānte kīrttayenmantrānamūn baddhāñjaliḥ priye || 11-846 ||
rudro'syasurarāja tvaṃ devānāṃ darpanāśakaḥ | piturvaraprārthanayā mahiṣīgarbhasambhavaḥ || 11-847 ||
kātyāyanyā samaṃ yoddhuṃ sāmarthyaṃ kasya vidyate | kenāsureṇa vidhṛtaḥ samare madhusūdanaḥ || 11-848 ||
kenānyena vijityājau tridaśāḥ sevakīkṛtāḥ | manvantaratrayaṃ kena bhuktaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam || 11-849 ||
babhūva kasya vā senā parārdhaśatasaṃmitā | rudrarūpadharāyāto mahiṣāsura te namaḥ || 11-850 ||
tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevi caturo vaṭukānapi | siddhaputraṃ jñānaputraṃ tathā sahajaputrakam || 11-851 ||
śeṣe samayaputraṃ ca mantrameṣāṃ niśāmaya | vedādikamalābīje purato'nte namo'pi ca || 11-852 ||
tattannāmnā saha tathā vaṭuko vigrahīkṛtaḥ | sa ṅenta iti mantrāḥ syureteṣāṃ jagadīśvari || 11-853 ||
samastairupacāraistu yathāvibhavakalpitaiḥ | pūjayedvaṭukānetāñchṛṇvanyāvṛttipūjanam || 11-854 ||
pūjayet kṣetrapālā(/)śca madhye kiñjalkapakṣayoḥ | hetukaṃ tripuraghnaṃ ca agnijihvaṃ tathaiva ca || 11-855 ||
agnivetālasaṃjñaṃ ca kālaṃ cātha karālakam | ekapādaṃ bhīmanāthamuttarādikrameṇa tu || 11-856 ||
adhunā mantrameteṣāṃ bravīmi śṛṇu pārvati | tārakūrcakṣetrapālabījatrayamidaṃ puraḥ || 11-857 ||
etannāmnā saha punaḥ kṣetrapālaḥ savigrahaḥ | ṅento mahābhīṣaṇaśca tadvadeva prakīrttitaḥ || 11-858 ||
krodho hṛcchirasī cāpi mantra eṣāṃ varānane | maṇḍalasya caturdikṣu dvau dvau madhye ca pūjayet || 11-859 ||
bhairavān nava deveśi śaradarcanakarmaṇi | asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodha unmatta eva ca || 11-860 ||
ānandaśca kapālī ca bhīṣaṇastadanantaram | saṃhārī sarvaśeṣe syāt kīrttitā nava bhairavāḥ || 11-861 ||
tāratrapāroṣabījaṃ tattannāma tataḥ param | bhairavāntaṃ vigrahi ca ṅentaṃ hṛnmantrasaṃyutam || 11-862 ||
dikṣvaṣṭasu bahiḥ padmāddigīśānaṣṭa pūjayet | indro'gniśca yamaścaiva nair(-)ṛto varuṇastathā || 11-863 ||
vāyuḥ somaśca īśāna etannāmnā paristhitā | vajraṃ śaktiśca daṇḍaśca khaḍgaḥ pāśo'ṅkuśastathā || 11-864 ||
dhvajaśūle amīṣāṃ tu śastrāṇi kathitāni te | nair(-)ṛto varuṇaścāpi madhye'nantaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 11-865 ||
tadastraṃ cakramuditaṃ yathendreśānamadhyataḥ | brahmā sapadma ityete digīśā daśa īritāḥ || 11-866 ||
mantrarītī idānīṃ tvaṃ samākalpaya bhāmini | praṇavaṃ purato datvā tattannāma tataḥ param || 11-867 ||
tataḥ paraṃ tattadastraṃ saśabdaparibṛ(/)hitam | savāhanaparīvāraṃ sāyudhaṃ tadanantaram || 11-868 ||
śabdāścatvāra ityete ṅentāḥ kāryā namastataḥ | tato dadyādvaliṃ devyai pūrvoditavidhānataḥ || 11-869 ||
aṣṭamyāmadhikaṃ dadyāt saptamīvalidānataḥ |
tantrāntare |
tato yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā stotramudīrayet || 11-870 ||
validānavidhiḥ stotraṃ cāgre vakṣyate | tathā |
sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamedbhūmau devīṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
(nirṇayāmṛte) purāṇāntare |
tataḥ khaḍgaṃ namaskṛtya śatrūṇāṃ vadhasiddhaye || 11-871 ||
iccheta vijayaṃ rājye subhikṣaṃ cātmano nṛpaḥ | punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyāryāṃ saṃsmareddhṛdaye śivām || 11-872 ||
sarvaṃ kṛtveti kauravya aṣṭamyāṃ jāgaraṃ niśi | naṭanāṭakaghoṣaiśca kārayecca mahotsavam || 11-873 ||
athāṣṭamīnavamyoḥ sandhau cāmuṇḍāpūjā |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
aṣṭamīnavamīsandhau kurvate ke cidarcanam | tatsandhipūjanamiti purāṇādiṣu kīrttitam || 11-874 ||
navamyāmardharātre vā tatpareṇāpi pūjanam | tāntrikāḥ ke cidicchanti siddhiṃ tūbhayathā'rcane || 11-875 ||
cāmuṇḍārūpadhāriṇyāstatra devyāstu pūjanam | vihitaṃ nānyarūpiṇyāḥ kṛta ityeṣa nirṇayaḥ || 11-876 ||
tanmantraṃ dhyānamasyāstu samākalpaya sāmpratam |
cāmuṇḍāyā mantradhyāne tantrāntaroktāṣṭamātṛkāprakaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ | tathā |
evaṃ dhyātvā ca sampūjya vividhopāyanādibhiḥ || 11-877 ||
śaktau tu mārttikīḥ sthālīḥ pūrayedannatemanaiḥ | pakvānnairāmamāṃsaiśca rudhirairdeyapakṣiṇām || 11-878 ||
tāśca saṃpūjayedgandhai raktapuṣpākṣatarapi | upariṣṭāddhūpadīpairaribalairmanubhiśca yaḥ || 11-879 ||
valiṃ samutsṛjet tena mahatīṃ śriyamaśnute | śaktiyāme tataḥ paścāt kecit kurvanti kaulikāḥ || 11-880 ||
tadvidhānaṃ puraivoktaṃ tenaivaitāṃ samāpayet |
atha navamīkṛtyam |
(bhaviṣyapurāṇe)
navamyāṃ śrīsamāyuktā devaiḥ sarvaiḥ supūjitā || 11-881 ||
jaghāna mahiṣaṃ duṣṭamavadhyaṃ devatābhiḥ | labdhvā'bhiṣekaṃ varadā śukle cāśvayujasya ca || 11-882 ||
tasmāt sā tatra sampūjyā navamyāṃ caṇḍikā budhaiḥ | mahattvaṃ hi yataḥ prāptā tatra devī sarasvatī || 11-883 ||
tadarthaṃ mahatī proktā navamīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ | pūjayitvā mahādevīṃ navamyāṃ mantracaṇḍikām || 11-884 ||
mahattvaṃ prāptavān vīra brahmā viṣṇustathā'marāḥ | tasmādiyaṃ mahāpuṇyā navamī pāpanāśinī || 11-885 ||
upoṣyā tu prayatnena satataṃ sarvapārthivaiḥ | pūrvottareṇa ṛkṣeṇa saṃyuktā vidhivannṛpa || 11-886 ||
viśeṣato nṛpādyaiśca bālairvṛddhaiḥ sayauvanaiḥ | brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdrairanyaiśca sevakaiḥ || 11-887 ||
ityādi (durgotsavapaddhatau) tantrāntare |
tato mahānavamyāṃ ca pūjayejjagadambikām | aṣṭamyāṃ yāvatī proktā vistareṇa samarhaṇā || 11-888 ||
navamyāmapi karttavyā tāvatyeva varānane | viśeṣastatra karttavyaṃ prabhūtavalidānakam || 11-889 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
naimittikakrameṇaiva pīṭhamūrttyarcanaṃ caret | śaktau nityoditāvṛtyarcanaṃ kurvīta sādhakaḥ || 11-890 ||
nānyāṃ pūjāṃ varārohe vyavastheyaṃ śivoditā | pīṭhamūrtī patrikāmṛnmūrttī yo bhaktibhāvitaḥ || 11-891 ||
kurute tasya vihitaṃ pūjanadvitayaṃ tadā | patrikāyāḥ puraḥ pūjā pīṭhamūrttyostataḥ param || 11-892 ||
sarvā'pi tāntrikī rītiḥ pīṭhamūrttyorudīritā | patrikādiṣu paurāṇī rītiruktā purāriṇā || 11-893 ||
asaṃsṛṣṭaṃ pṛthakkṛtya dvayametanmayoditam | tataḥ paraṃ sureśāni pāṭhayedatha vā paṭhet || 11-894 ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇāntargatāṃ bhagavatīstutim | samagrāṃ vā paṭhedāho vadhaṃ śumbhaniśumbhayoḥ || 11-895 ||
mahiṣāsurasyāpyatha vā madhukaiṭabhayorapi | kuryādubhayamevātra vidhiṃ saṃkalpapūrvakam || 11-896 ||
brāhmaṇān varayitvaiva vastrālaṅkaraṇāsanaiḥ | vidadhyāt kāmanollekhaṃ pūjāṃ śaktyā ca pustake || 11-897 ||
śanaiḥ paṭhet pāṭhako'pi varṇauccāraṇapūrvakam | suvyaktaṃ nātiviśliṣṭaṃ na śiraścālagītavat || 11-898 ||
tanu māndolayan nāpi na hasan na rudan vrajan | nāśnannānyairālapa(/)śca na madhye cchinnavat tathā || 11-899 ||
ācāntaḥ kṛtaśaucaśca padorudgamanīyavān | etena vidhinā'dhīte tuṣyate jagadambikā || 11-900 ||
yathoktaphaladātrī ca bhavati prāṇavallabhe | yathaitatpāṭhato devī prītā syāddrutamīśvarī || 11-901 ||
na tathā dhūpadīpasragvalinaivedyavistaraiḥ | paṭhanaṃ pāṭhanaṃ vā'pi tasmādetasya yatnataḥ || 11-902 ||
kāryaṃ śāradapūjāyāṃ kālikātuṣṭimicchatā | devīśāradapūjāyāṃ yathaitasya hi nityatā || 11-903 ||
homasyāpi tathā jñeyā mukhye aṅge ime mate | hastamātraṃ vidhāyādau sthaṇḍilaṃ śraddhayā mṛdā || 11-904 ||
tatrāgnisthāpanaṃ kṛtvā vaidikairmanubhiḥ priye | ghṛtāhutiṃ vā juhuyāt tilamiśrāmathāpi vā || 11-905 ||
vilvapatraṃ yavāṃ padmaṃ pāyasaṃ vā madhūkṣitam | mantrastatra tu vijñeyā bhāratī ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 11-906 ||
athavā jayadurgāyā mantro yaḥ pariniṣṭhitaḥ |
bhāratī ṣoḍaśākṣarīti prakṛtābhiprāyeṇa | jayadurgāmantrastu sakalasādhāraṇa iti bodhyam | tathā | saptaśatyāstathā devī ekaikaśloka eva vā || 11-907 ||
mantre sahasrasaṃkhyā syācchaktāvayutameva vā | ubhayatrāpi dātavyāḥ karmānte dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ || 11-908 ||
idaṃ karmadvayaṃ devi mūrteḥ purata ācaret | nāpyado dvitayaṃ kāryaṃ kṣapāyāṃ vāsarādṛte || 11-909 ||
tasyāṃ kṛtaṃ tu viphalaṃ jāyate vedaśāsanāt | devī saptaśatīpāṭhaṃ gṛhṇāti vidhivat kṛtam || 11-910 ||
vidhinā vā'pyavidhinā punarhomaṃ prayacchati | tasmādyatnena karttavyo homaḥ śāradapūjane || 11-911 ||
homaḥ saptaśatīpāṭho valirvāditravādanam | catuṣṭayamidaṃ śastaṃ māsīṣe kālikārcane || 11-912 ||
prabhūtavalidānaṃ ca kāryaṃ bhūtyanusārataḥ |
atha validānavidhistatraiva |
tato dadyājjīvavaliṃ yathālābhaṃ yathāvidhi || 11-913 ||
vidhistu dvividhaḥ proktaḥ śrauta āgamikastathā | śrautaḥ śrutyuktamantreṇāgamastantroktamantrakaiḥ || 11-914 ||
śrauto'pi svasvagṛhyoktavidhinā saṃpradīyate | paśujātiviśeṣeṇa tatrāpyasti bhidā'dhikā || 11-916 ||
(merutantre)
valistu trividho jñeyastāntrikaḥ smārtta eva ca | vaidikaśceti tatrādau tāntriko'ṣṭavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 11-917 ||
naraśca mahiṣaḥ kolaśchāgo'viḥ sārasastathā | kapotaḥ kukkuṭaśceti sāmānyāḥ pūrvapūrvataḥ || 11-918 ||
tathā |
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ nārikelaṃ vā śrīphalaṃ cekṣumeva ca | vastrasaṃveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā chedayecchurikādibhiḥ || 11-919 ||
evaṃ smārtto valiḥ prokto dharmaśāstrānugāminām |
tathā |
vadikaṃ tu valiṃ dadyādodanaṃ svinnamāṣavat || 11-920 ||
sarocanamatikrūradaivate vaṭakānvitam |
ityuktaṃ (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
śrautaḥ śrutiṣu sandheyo yo'dhvareṣu nirūpitaḥ || 11-921 ||
vakṣyāmyāgamikaṃ sarvaṃ yāgasthānakramāgatam | na sa devo na sā devī devayonibhidā na sā || 11-922 ||
na sa kālo na tadbhūtaṃ yo necchati valiṃ priye | amūrttā ye ca kālāśā māsasaṃvatsararttavaḥ || 11-923 ||
pakṣāyanāhorajanītithipraharasaṃkramāḥ | ete'pi valimicchanti kiṃ punardevayonayaḥ || 11-924 ||
vanaspatyoṣadhilatātarugulmanagādayaḥ | sthāvarā jaṅgamāścāpi valyākāṅkṣāṃ prakurvate || 11-925 ||
yasya yasya hi devasya yo yo valirudīritaḥ | etatprasaṅgena śive sa sa kaścana kathyate || 11-926 ||
svayambhuvo baliḥ siṃho viṣṇorvārdhrīṇasaḥ smṛtaḥ | aśva indrasya kathito gaṇḍakaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 11-927 ||
viṣṇvādinuddiśya vārghrīṇasāderutsargamātraṃ na tu hiṃseti vidhānamuktāvalīkṛtaḥ | vārghrīṇasalakṣaṇaṃ tvagre vakṣyate | tathā |
śūkaro bhairavasyāpi pramathānāṃ ca jambukaḥ | priyo dvīpī vedhasaśca citrako baliriṣyate || 11-928 ||
gaṇādhyakṣasya bhallūko yakṣāṇāṃ lohito mṛgaḥ | skandasya godhā viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ camaro'pi ca || 11-929 ||
vināyakānāṃ ca baliḥ kṛṣṇasāra udīritaḥ | vetālānāṃ ca mahiṣo guhyakānāṃ ca sambaraḥ || 11-930 ||
śacyāḥ śalyo rohiṣastu tuṣitānāṃ prakīrttitaḥ | kṛkalāśo dānavānāṃ daityānāṃ śyena ucyate || 11-931 ||
hiraṇyagarbhasya baliraṣṭāpada udīryate | īśānasya padasvarcā rurū rudrasya kīrtyate || 11-932 ||
balirmamāpi gokarṇaḥ sādhyānāṃ gavayastathā | sṛmaro bhāsurāṇāṃ ca vasūnāmṛkṣa iṣyate || 11-933 ||
bṛhaspatestu gavayo hastī caiva prajāpateḥ | kuraṅgo gaṇasādhyānāṃ takṣṇa uṣṭro nigadyate || 11-934 ||
śrāddhīyaviśvadevānāṃ vṛṣabhaḥ parikīrttitaḥ | agnestu kuṭaruḥ pakṣī cakravākaḥ pracetasaḥ || 11-935 ||
pāruṣṇo gārhapatyasya dakṣiṇāgnestu cīnakaḥ | camūrurāhavanīyasya śaśo'ryamṇa udīritaḥ || 11-936 ||
vāyorvalākā somasya haṃsaścandrasya vai lavaḥ | varuṇasya tathā nakro mitrasya ca kulīyakaḥ || 11-937 ||
cāṣo'gnīṣomayorjñeya indrāgnyoḥ krauñca eva ca | mitramitrasya madguḥ syāt kulīkastvaṣṭureva hi || 11-938 ||
ādityānāṃ tathā nyaṅkuḥ kṛṣṇo'pi hi yamasya ca syāt prājāpatyavāyvośca gomṛgau balirīśvari || 11-939 ||
nāsatyayormayūro'pi pūṣṇo jambuka ucyate | gardabho nir(-)ṛtermitrāvaruṇasyakapotakaḥ || 11-940 ||
godhādi devapatnīnāṃ mālikaḥ savitustathā | kulīko devayonīnāṃ rājajño'psarasāmapi || 11-941 ||
antarikṣasya yoktrastu bhūmerākhurdivaḥ kaśā | diśāṃ balistu nakulo vidiśāṃ babhrureva ca || 11-942 ||
apāṃ matsyastejasastu homīyākhyo bhujaṅgamaḥ | jalaḥ sāmānyakālasya tathā kālasya cillikā || 11-943 ||
suparṇaścāpi dātyūho balirvatsaramāsayoḥ | kapiñjalo vasantartorgrīṣmasya kalaviṅkakaḥ || 11-944 ||
varṣāṇāṃ tittirirjñeyaḥ śarado varttikā tathā | krakaraścāpi haimantaḥ śaiśiro vaikakaryapi || 11-945 ||
pakṣasya khañjarīṭaḥ syādayanasya tu sārasaḥ | pārāvato dinasyāpi rātreḥ sīrāyurucyate || 11-946 ||
proktā jalaukā sandhyāyā yaijñarājastitherapi | yāmasya sukhilīkastu saṃkrānteranyapāyakaḥ || 11-947 ||
kirīkako grahāṇāṃ ca nakṣatrānāṃ śaravyakaḥ | rāśīnāmapi sākalyo lagnānāmapi cuñcuṭaḥ || 11-948 ||
śiśumāraḥ samudrasya nadīnāṃ ca timiṅgilaḥ | āvarttānāṃ ca makaro vicīnāṃ śaṅkalo'pi ca || 11-949 ||
uṣṭraḥ pātāladevasya śaṅkurvai tāṇḍavasya ca | parjanyānāṃ ca maṇḍūko vṛṣṭerapi mahīlatāḥ || 11-950 ||
vidyutāmapi sambūko bhāradvājo'śane'rapi | sinīvālīkuhūrākānumatīnām krameṇa hi || 11-951 ||
śarādikaṅkahārītajīvañjīvāḥ prakīrttitāḥ | baliḥ kalañjaḥ pretānāṃ piśācānāṃ vako'pi ca || 11-952 ||
bhūtānāṃ kuraraścāpi kukkuṭo brahmarakṣasām | gandharvāṇāṃ kokilo'pi ghoṇakānāṃ ca vāyasaḥ || 11-953 ||
varttakaḥ kṣetrapālānāṃ vaṭukānāṃ ca kukkuṭaḥ | yāvatyo jātihāriṇyastāsāṃ bhāruṇḍa ucyate || 11-954 ||
chucchundarīrhyaśmanaḥ syājjalasya śarabho baliḥ | cillo balirḍākinīnāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ ca takṣakaḥ || 11-955 ||
bhūliṅgo yoginīnāṃ syānnidhīnāṃ ṭiṭṭibho baliḥ | indriyāṇāmatho vacmi cakṣuṣormaśako baliḥ || 11-956 ||
śrotrayorbhramaraścāpi ghrāṇasya saraghāstathā | rasanāyā baliścikkā makṣikā ca tvaco baliḥ || 11-957 ||
pataṅgo manasaścāpi pluṣirvāco balirmataḥ | jhillīkīṭo baliḥ pāṇyoḥ khadyotaḥ padayorapi || 11-958 ||
pāyoryūkā samuddiṣṭā upasthasya sinīpatiḥ | vanaspatīnāṃ madhuko latānāṃ tailapāyikā || 11-959 ||
matkuṇā auṣadhīnāṃ syustaruṇāṃ ca pipīlikā | gulmānāṃ gandhakīṭo'pi śailānāṃ vudgatāstathā || 11-960 ||
śavo baliḥ pūtanāyā rākṣasīnāmahirbaliḥ | jātamātraśiśuḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śaṅkho bālagrahasya ca || 11-961 ||
cakoro garuḍasyāpi mātṝṇāṃ tailapāyikā | vidyādharāṇāṃ ca kolo yajñānāṃ śuka eva ca || 11-962 ||
gṛdhro'ruṇasya ca balirnarakasya kareṭukaḥ | rājño balirmarkaṭo'pi kāntārasya plavaḥ khagaḥ || 11-963 ||
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | balitvena vinirdiṣṭā mahiṣacchāgalādayaḥ || 11-964 ||
jalajāḥ sthalajāścāpi grāmajāraṇyajāstathā | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭāstiryagyonaya eva ca || 11-965 ||
ime vidhātrā vihitā balitvena divaukasām | nānyairnaivedyasambhāraistathā tuṣyanti devatāḥ || 11-966 ||
yathā paśūnāṃ balibhirvihaṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca | ata eva hi deveśi mīmāṃsāvedayorapi || 11-967 ||
devānāṃ priyaśabdastu paśuparyāya ucyate | evaṃ vijñāya siddhāntaṃ devyāḥ santoṣahetave || 11-968 ||
paśūn dadyādbalitvena medhyānapi vihaṅgamān | krimikīṭādayaḥ sarve ye tiryañcaḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 11-969 ||
na te devībalitvena vidhātrā vihitāḥ priye | ālabheta vṛṣaṃ śvetaṃ yajñe gomedhanāmani || 11-970 ||
naramedhe naraṃ cāpi gajakrānte gajaṃ tathā | p 1055> aśvamedhe tathaivāśvaṃ śaṅkhacuḍe ca hastinam || 11-971 ||
bravīti yatra vedo'pi tatra kaiva vicāraṇā | tasmānnaimittikārcāyāṃ balirāvaśyakaḥ priye || 11-972 ||
viśeṣeṇa pradāttavyo devīsantoṣahetave | baliṃ vinā naiva devī pūjāmaṅgīkaroti hi || 11-973 ||
tatrāpyubhau praśasyete mahiṣaśchāga eva ca | anyadevocitabalirvicāraiḥ kiṃ prayojanam || 11-974 ||
yena santuṣyate kālī taṃ vicāraṃ bruve'dhunā | yāḥ kāścidguhyakālyāstu vihitāḥ paśujātayaḥ || 11-975 ||
āraṇyā atha vā grāmyā jalajānāṃ ca jātayaḥ | khagānāṃ jātayaścāpi tā evādau bravīmi te || 11-976 ||
matsyā mṛgā barāhāśca kacchapā mahiṣāstathā | gaṇḍakā godhikā grāhāḥ śārdulā harayo'pi ca || 11-977 ||
nakulāḥ śarabhaścāpi gavayāśchāgalāstathā | manuṣyāḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi teṣāṃ kośā api priye || 11-978 ||
bhagavatyā balitvena vidhātrā balikalpitāḥ | eteṣāṃ balidānena sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet || 11-979 ||
balidānaphalānyāha |
balibhirvardhate hyāyurbalibhiḥ śāmyate rujā | jayatyarātīn balibhiḥ prāpyate balibhirdhanam || 11-980 ||
siddhimāpnoti balibhirbalibhistridivaṃ vrajet | niṣkāmāṇāṃ balau datte prāpyo mokṣo'pi yajñavat || 11-981 ||
matsyādīnāṃ jātibhedānāha |
jātibhedānatho vakṣye samāsādavadhāraya | aṣṭādaśabhidhā matsyāścaturviṃśatidhā mṛgāḥ || 11-982 ||
varāhāḥ pañcadhā proktāstribhedāḥ kacchapā api | dvibhedā mahiṣāstadvadgaṇḍakāśca caturvidhāḥ || 11-983 ||
godhikā ca tribhedā syāddvibhedo grāha eva ca | trividhau vyāghrasiṃhau ca nakulo dvividho'pi ca || 11-984 ||
śarabhaścaikajātiḥ syānnāsya bhedo varānane | gavayastrividhaḥ proktaśchāgaḥ pañcavidho mataḥ || 11-985 ||
caturvidhā manuṣyāśca ṣaṭtriṃśajjātayaḥ khagāḥ | krameṇa nāmānyeteṣāṃ vyāharāmi tava priye || 11-986 ||
śaṅkulo rohitaḥ śālaḥ pāṭhino rāghavo'pi ca | proṣṭhī nālaśiśuddhyaṅgamereṭāṅgulicāmbaṭāḥ || 11-987 ||
timimākūṭarājīvagaḍakāḥ śastajātayaḥ | gokarṇakṛṣṇasāraiṇarururnyaṅkucamūravaḥ || 11-988 ||
priyavātapramīcīnasamūhasṛmarakraṣāḥ | raṅkuśambarakandalyaḥ sukharo rohiṣo vaṭaḥ || 11-989 ||
kadalyena visālākṣapataṅgollāṭarohitāḥ | varāhāstabdhakroḍakuśākṣīṇajalasvanāḥ || 11-990 ||
kūrmaścitrī citrakaṭo vāmanaśceti vai tridhā | akeraḥ kṣīrilaścāpi mahiṣo dvividho mataḥ || 11-991 ||
kauñjaro vārilaścārmī vaiśaḥ khaḍgāścaturvidhāḥ | hiraṇyā kilikā mīnā godhikā trividhā matā || 11-992 ||
dīrghagrīvaścarmapūro grāho dvividha eva ca | tarakṣustarugaścitro vyāghrastrividha ucyate || 11-993 ||
śaralaḥ kṛkayurmedī siṃho'pi trividho mataḥ | sthūlaḥ kaliṅgaśca tathā nakulo'pi dvidheritaḥ || 11-994 ||
ekajātiṃ vinā naiva śarabho'nyaḥ prajāyate | lāṭiko viṭcaraḥ sāsni gavayo'pi tridhocyate || 11-995 ||
tripivaḥ pālitaḥ kṣaurī varkaro māriṣastathā | pañcabhedo bhavecchāgo'virapi trividho mataḥ || 11-996 ||
urmikaḥ pāriśo bheṭo manuṣyānapi me śṛṇu | na manuṣyatvasāmānye cāturvidhyaṃ hi varttate || 11-997 ||
prakārabhedatastasyā bhinnatā parikalpate | caṇḍikānugṛhītasya vitṛṣṇasya bhavāmbudhau || 11-998 ||
tattallokāvāptiphalaśravaṇotkaṇṭhitasya ca | svataḥ pravṛttirdevyāstu balirūpo bhavāmyaham || 11-999 ||
āgatya ca svayaṃ brūte māṃ balitvena yojaya | pratyakṣameva sarveṣāṃ nṛpasya ca viśeṣataḥ || 11-1000 ||
sa eka udito devi dvitīyamavadhāraya | bahuvittasya ratnādesteno lokadhṛtaśca yaḥ || 11-1001 ||
nirṇīya pariṣanmadhye prāgvipākena kīrttitaḥ | śīrṣacchedyatayā devi dvitīyaḥ sa nigadyate || 11-1002 ||
yuddhe jito dhṛtaḥ śatruḥ kūṭayodhī bhaṭākṛtiḥ | sa tṛtīyo vinirdiṣṭaścaturthamavadhāraya || 11-1003 ||
ya ātatāyī pānthānāṃ kāntāre'pyatha vā gṛhe | viditaścāpi nirṇītaḥ sākṣibhiḥ satyavādibhiḥ || 11-1004 ||
sa hi turyaḥ samākhyātaḥ pañcamo nopapadyate | vakṣye vihaṅgān ye devyai balitvena nirūpitāḥ || 11-1005 ||
pārāvatāstāmracūḍā haṃsā vārdhrīṇasāstathā | ulūkā lohapṛṣṭhāśca sarvāghāṭāśca sārasāḥ || 11-1006 ||
kalaviṅkāścakorāśca cakravākāḥ śukā api | śatapatrā bharadvājā bhūliṅgāścaṭakāstathā || 11-1007 ||
kāraṇḍavāścakravākāḥ pāruśnāśca kulīyakāḥ | plvāḥ kuṭaravaścāpi varttakāḥ kukkubhā api || 11-1008 ||
tittiryurukakrauñcāśca navacāṣaśikhaṇḍinaḥ | yoktradātyūhasākalyapaiṅgarājanyavāyakāḥ || 11-1009 ||
jihīkā sukhilīkāśca mudguhārītavarttakāḥ | jihīñjīvāśca hārītāḥ koyaṣṭyaśmaṭaṭiṭṭibhāḥ || 11-1010 ||
vakakokilagṛdhrāśca kareṭuśconakhañjanāḥ | cirīkāścaiva jahikāḥ sīcāpuñjantamekalāḥ || 11-1011 ||
kaśāḥ suparṇā bhāruṇḍā hāmāyāścāpi pārvati | iti te kathitāḥ sarve ṣaṣṭibhedā vihāyasām || 11-1012 ||
devyai yogyabalitvena nānya uktā vihaṅgamāḥ | eteṣāṃ jātibhedāstu varttante ḍāmarādiṣu || 11-1013 ||
bahutvāt te na kathyante granthagauravabhītitaḥ | kapotabhrāmakā baṅkamanitthaturukādayaḥ || 11-1014 ||
pārāvatāstu daśadhā haṃsāḥ pañcavidhāstathā | rājahaṃsā mallikākhyā dhārttarāṣṭrā parisphuṭāḥ || 11-1015 ||
māheyā evamanye'pi jñeyā vigahajātayaḥ |
tathā |
adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi balinā yena yena hi || 11-1016 ||
yaṃ yaṃ kālamabhivyāpya tuṣṭā bhavati kālikā | aṣṭādaśavidhairmatsyaiḥ kacchapairapi caṇḍikā || 11-1017 ||
tṛpyate māsamātraṃ hi balitvena niyojitaiḥ | tāmracūḍasya balinā haṃsasārasayorapi || 11-1018 ||
tṛptā bhavati māsau dvau trīn māsān dvipinakrayoḥ | kalaviṅkairulūkaiḥ syāt tṛptā māsacatuṣṭayam || 11-1019 ||
pañca māsān bhavet tṛptā śukaiḥ pārāvatairapi | dārvāghāṭaiścakoraiśca ṣaṇmāsā(/)stṛptimāpnuyāt || 11-1020 ||
tṛpyate sapta māsān sā jihīkaiśca kulīyakaiḥ | caturviṃśatibhedaiśca kuraṅgairgavayairapi || 11-1021 ||
māsānaṣṭau bhavet tṛptā nava māsān pikairapi | hārītabalinā devī daśa māsā(/)śca tṛpyate || 11-1022 ||
tathā dātyūhadānena gajarājairvarānane | māsānekādaśa śivā tṛptimāyāti siddhidā || 11-1023 ||
godhikābalidānena tṛptā'bdaṃ vyāpya jāyate | avinā nakulenāpi tryabdaṃ tṛptā bhavedapi || 11-1024 ||
ājena balinā vā'pi tuṣṭā syāt pañcavatsaram | jīvañjīvena pāṅktena tuṣyate'ṣṭau ca hāyanān || 11-1025 ||
pārṣataiṇaina balinā varāhabalinā'pi ca | dvādaśābdamabhivyāpya tuṣṭā bhavati kālikā || 11-1026 ||
hāmāyanāmā yaḥ pakṣī siṃhākṛtidharo'ruṇaḥ | taddānāt tuṣyate devī pañcaviṃśativatsaram || 11-1027 ||
trividhairapi śārdūlairmahiṣairdvividhairapi | caturvidhaistathā khaḍgairbalitvena samarpitaiḥ || 11-1028 ||
śataṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvaccaṇḍikā prītimaśnute | eko vārdhrīṇaso'jaśca viśeṣaḥ parikīrttyate || 11-1029 ||
aparaḥ pakṣijātīyo himavaccaraṇasthitaḥ | vṛddhaḥ śmaśrudharaḥ śvetaḥ pādasphoṭīndriyojjhitaḥ || 11-1030 ||
trividho raktarasano niḥśṛṅgaḥ svarabhaṅgyajaḥ | pītacañcū raktaśirāḥ sitapakṣo'sitāṅghrikaḥ || 11-1031 ||
nīlagrīvaḥ pāṭalābhagalo vārdhrīṇasaḥ khagaḥ |
(kālikāpurāṇe'pi)
tripivaṃ tvindriyakṣīṇaṃ śvetaṃ vṛddhamajaṃ param || 11-1032 ||
vārdhrīṇasaṃ vijānīyāddhavyakavyeṣu saṃskṛtam | nīlagrīvo raktaśirāḥ kṛṣṇapādaḥ sitacchadaḥ || 11-1033 ||
vārdhrīṇasaḥ sa pakṣī syānmama viṣṇorapi priyaḥ |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
ajavārdhrīṇasaistuṣṭā bhavet triṃśativatsaram || 11-1034 ||
niraṅkasāmānyaśaśairbalitvena nirūpitaiḥ | jāyate guhyakālī sā tuṣṭā pañcaśataṃ samāḥ || 11-1035 ||
śarabhairatha siṃhaiśca śoṇitaiśca svadehajaiḥ | datte santuṣyate kālī sahasraṃ parivatsarān || 11-1036 ||
vārdhrīṇasavihaṅgena dattena vidhinā priye | abdaṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ tuṣyate jagadambikā || 11-1037 ||
caurātatāyirūpeṇa nāreṇa balinā tathā | trīṇi lakṣāṇi varṣāṇāṃ prītaye guhyakālikā || 11-1038 ||
ete te kathitā devi balayastṛptihetavaḥ |
atha niṣiddhabalayastatraiva |
adeyānadhunā vakṣye paśūnapi vihaṅgamān || 11-1039 ||
bhallūkān markaṭān pherūn sarpānotūn śunastathā | kramelakā(/)śca bāleyān śalyān viṭcaraśūkarān || 11-1040 ||
jalajeṣvapi maṇḍūkān rāsabhān śiśumārakān | kulīrān dīrghapṛṣṭhādīn mīnānapi ca bhūriśaḥ || 11-1041 ||
khageṣu vāyasā(/)ścillān durvidān kulikānapi | evamanye'pi vijñeyā nānāśāstrāgamādiṣu || 11-1042 ||
tathā |
kā(/)ścinniṣiddhān vakṣyāmi vihiteṣu baliṣvapi | grāmyāṇāmatha vanyānāṃ paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā || 11-1043 ||
striyaṃ naiva prayuñjita balikarmaṇi sādhakaḥ | jñānapūrvaṃ baliṃ datvā narakaṃ pratipadyate || 11-1044 ||
ajñānena vitīryāpi kiñcit pāpaṃ samaśnute | atrimāsasamutpannaṃ paśuṃ na vinivedayet || 11-1045 ||
nyūnaṃ tadardhānna khagaṃ jātu devyai samarpayet | bhagnaśṛṅgaṃ bhagnadantaṃ chinnalāṅgūlameva ca || 11-1046 ||
kāṇaṃ vyaṅgaṃ rogiṇaṃ ca śṛṅgāhatanaraṃ tathā | duṣṭaṃ galitaromāṇaṃ kṣīrapaṃ ca galadviśam || 11-1047 ||
paśuṃ na dadyādīdṛkṣaṃ tathā caiva vihāyasam | chinnatroṭiṃ chinnapakṣaṃ rugṇamāhāravarjitam || 11-1048 ||
anuḍḍīnaṃ tathā'kāśe māturaṅke paristhitam | vihitāvapi vijñātau na dadyāt paśupakṣiṇau || 11-1049 ||
tantrāntare |
kṛṣṇavarṇo baliryastu śvetapuccho yadā bhavet | chāgalaṃ tādṛśaṃ vidvān dūrataḥ parivarjayet || 11-1050 ||
evaṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇapucchaṃ varjayet matimān sadā |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
yasya yasya niṣiddho yaḥ sa idānīṃ nirūpyate || 11-1051 ||
naraṃ keśariṇaṃ vyāghraṃ cāṣaṃ khañjanameva ca | svakīyarudhiraṃ madyaṃ na dadyādbrāhmaṇaḥ kvacit || 11-1052 ||
tau dvau khagau tathā siṃhaṃ dvīpinaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathā | datvā rogī ca hīnāyurbhūtvā narakamaśnute || 11-1053 ||
ātmahatyāmavāpnoti datvā svarudhiraṃ dvijaḥ | datvā devyai dvijo madyaṃ brāhmaṇādvicyuto bhavet || 11-1054 ||
cāpḍālatvamavāpnoti sarvakarmavivarjitaḥ | na kṛṣṇasāraṃ vitaredvarhiṇaṃ ca narādhipaḥ || 11-1055 ||
kṛṣṇasāraṃ dadaddevyai dvitīyo varṇa īśvari | brahmaghnatvamavāpnoti sarvakarmavivarjitaḥ || 11-1056 ||
na vaiśyāḥ śūkaraṃ dadyurna varttakakulīyakau | dadatāṃ tatkṣaṇādeva mahāpātakatā bhavet || 11-1057 ||
varṇo'paro no vitaredgodhikāśukakhaḍginaḥ | mūṣaṃ mārjārakaṃ cāṣaṃ śūdro datvā patatyadhaḥ || 11-1058 ||
mohāddhaṭhādvā dadatāṃ sadyo brahmaghnatā bhavet | vānaprastho brahmacārī gṛhastho vā dayāparaḥ || 11-1059 ||
sāttviko brahmaniṣṭhaśca yaśca hiṃsāvivarjitaḥ | tena na dadyuḥ paśubalimanukalpaṃ carantyapi || 11-1060 ||
anukalpe'pi mukhye'dhikāriṇa evādhikāra iti prāguktam | anukalpavidhistu tatraivokto yathā |
sāttviko jīvahatyāṃ hi kadācidapi no caret | ikṣudaṇḍaṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍaṃ tathā vanyaphalādikam || 11-1061 ||
kṣīrapiṇḍaiḥ śālicūrṇaiḥ paśuṃ kṛtvā caredvalim | tattatphalaviśeṣeṇa tattatpaśumupānayet || 11-1062 ||
tathā |
mahiṣatvena kuṣmāṇḍaṃ chāgatvenaiva karkaṭīm | vṛntākaṃ kukkuṭatvena meṣatvena ca tumbikām || 11-1063 ||
rambhāpuṣpaṃ bījapūraṃ piṇḍaṃ jīvaṃ kalau bhavet | mānuṣatvena panasaṃ matsyatvenekṣudaṇḍakam || 11-1064 ||
śūraṇaṃ śambaratvena tathā kośātakaṃ mṛge | pāyasaṃ tu gajatvena mārjāratve kulitthakam || 11-1065 ||
paṭolaṃ śūkaratvena śarkarāvālukaṃ tathā | khaḍgatvena maheśāni matsyatve kadalīphalam || 11-1066 ||
mūṣatve mūlakaṃ caiva sāraṅgatve kaliñjakam | karitve nārikelaṃ ca kalpayet parameśvari || 11-1067 ||
māṣāḥ sarvabalitvena sarveṣāṃ kṛśarānnataḥ |
tathā | tattatpaśupradātṝṇāṃ phalāvāptyai varānane | ghṛtagodhūmaikṣavādyaiḥ phāṇitairannajaistathā || 11-1068 ||
kṛtvā taṃ taṃ paśuṃ dadyustattatphalamavāpnuyuḥ (-) iti |
atha praśastapaśulakṣaṇaṃ (ratnāvalyām)
ūrdhvaśṛṅgo lambakarṇa ekavarṇo'tipīvaraḥ | nīrogaḥ puṣṭakāyaśca sadarpaśca balorjitaḥ || 11-1069 ||
nādhikāṅgo na hīnāṅga ekadvitryādihāyanaḥ | praśastapaśurīdṛkṣo devīprītikaraḥ śubhaḥ || 11-1070 ||
tantrāntare |
kṛṣṇavarṇaśchāgalastu pṛṣṭhavaṃśe sito yadi | praśastaṃ taṃ vijānīyādviparītaṃ vivarjayet || 11-1071 ||
viparītamiti śvetavarṇam | pṛṣṭhāvacchedena nīlamityarthaḥ | (traipurapaddhatyām)
balyante chāgalabaliṃ tathā meṣaṃ sureśvari | pradadyāt sarvakāleṣu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 11-1072 ||
nitye naimittike kāmye māhiṣaṃ balimāharet | jayāya sarvakāmāya devīlokāptasiddhaye || 11-1073 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
paśūnāṃ yatra bāhulyaṃ bhavedvittānusārataḥ | tatraikaṃ prathamaṃ devi sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 11-1074 ||
ūrjasvinaṃ sundaraṃ ca balinaṃ paśumutsṛjet |
tathā | paśūnāmiha sarveṣāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caivameva hi || 11-1075 ||
kaścidviśeṣa utsarge phalaṃ daivādyudīraṇe |
(traipurapaddhatyām)
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ paśuṃ saṃsnāpya mantrataḥ || 11-1076 ||
devyagre sthāpayitvā'rghodakaiḥ saṃprokṣayet tataḥ | astramantreṇa saṃrakṣya kavacenāvaguṇṭhya ca || 11-1077 ||
mūlamantraṃ samuccārya dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtam | gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ samyak paripūjyopacārakaiḥ || 11-1078 ||
karṇe tasya paṭhenmantraṃ paśupāśavimocanam |
oṃ paśupāśāya vighnahe viprakarṇāya dhīmahi tanno jīvaḥ pracodayāt |
gāyatrīyaṃ samākhyātā paśupāśavimocinī || 11-1079 ||
imāṃ paṭheddakṣakarṇe tasya muktiprasiddhaye |
saṃprokṣayediti prokṣaṇaṃ mūlamantreṇaiva |
arghapātrodakaiḥ śuddhairmūlena prokṣayet triśaḥ || 11-1080 ||
iti mahākālokteḥ | gātryantaramuktaṃ tatraiva |
yoginībījato ṅentaṃ balirūpaṃ tu vidmahe | devīpriyaṃ pūrvavacca dhīmahīti tataḥ param || 11-1089 ||
tannaḥ paśuriti procya vadeccātha pracodayāt (-) iti ||
yoginībījaṃ chrīmiti (traipurapaddhatyām)
tataḥ khaḍgaṃ yajenmantrī mantreṇānena dakṣataḥ | tāraṃ ca bhuvaneśānīṃ kālīyugmaṃ samālikhet || 11-1090 ||
vajreśvarīpadaṃ paścāllohadaṃṣṭrāṃ tataḥ param | ṅentāṃ hṛdvasuyugmaikasaṅkhyavarṇo manurmataḥ || 11-1091 ||
anena gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ khḍgamabhyarcayedbudhaḥ | tatastasya muṣṭideśe madhye cāgre yathākramam || 11-1092 ||
gandhapuṣpākṣatairmantrī mithunatritayaṃ jayet | vāgīśīsahito brahmā lakṣmīnārāyaṇau tathā || 11-1093 ||
umāmaheśvarau ceti saṃproktaṃ mithunatrayam | tataścānena mantreṇa taṃ khaḍgamabhimantrayet || 11-1094 ||
khaḍgāyāsuranāśāya śaktikāryāya tatpara | paśuśchedyastvayā śīghraṃ khaḍganātha namo'stu te || 11-1095 ||
tatastu tāmrapātrasthakuśākṣatajalādikam | gṛhītvā mūlamuccārya saṃkalpya paśumutsṛjet || 11-1096 ||
gṛhītvā'kṣatatoyādi paśoḥ śirasi saṃtyajet | tatastenaiva khaḍgena mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 11-1097 ||
paśucchedaṃ prakurvīta svayaṃ devīmanusmaran |
(merutantrasiddhāntasārayoḥ )
yadā saṃcālayedgātraṃ gṛhītastu yathecchayā || 11-1098 ||
yāvanna cālayedgātraṃ paśustāvanna hanyate | uttarābhimukho bhūtvā baliṃ pūrvamukhaṃ tathā || 11-1099 ||
nirīkṣya sādhakaḥ paścādimaṃ mantramudīrayet | paśustvaṃ balirūpeṇa mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ || 11-1100 ||
praṇamāmi tataḥ sarvarūpiṇaṃ balirūpiṇam | caṇḍikāprītidānena dāturāpadvināśanam || 11-1101 ||
cāmuṇḍābalirūpāya bale tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ | yajñārthe paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā || 11-1102 ||
atastvāṃ ghātayāmyadya tasmādyajñe vadho'vadhaḥ | imaṃ deheṃ parityajya bhūtvā devavapurdharaḥ || 11-1103 ||
modasva prathamaiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa | ai(/) hrī(/) śrīmiti mantreṇa tvaṃ baliṃ matsvarūpiṇam || 11-1104 ||
cintayitvā nyaset puṣpaṃ kumbhakenāsya mastake |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
dhyāyet kusumamādāya khaḍgamādau varānane || 11-1105 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ pinākapāṇiṃ ca kālarātrisvarūpiṇam | ugraṃ raktāsyanayanaṃ raktamālyānulepanam || 11-1106 ||
raktāmbaradharaṃ caiva pāśahastaṃ kuṭumbinam | pivamānaṃ ca rudhiraṃ bhuñjānaṃ kravyasaṃhatim || 11-1107 ||
kṣobhayantaṃ jagat sarvaṃ kampanādipracāraṇaiḥ | veṣṭitaṃ mṛtyukālābhyāṃ vāmadakṣiṇabhāgataḥ || 11-1108 ||
tantrāntare |
tataḥ khaḍgaṃ yajenmantrī pādyādyairupacārakaiḥ | gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaiśca mantreṇānena mantravit || 11-1109 ||
mantrastu pūrvokta eva | (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
tato baddhāñjalirmantraṃ paṭhet khaḍgaṃ nirīkṣya vai | rasanā tvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ suralokaprasādhakaḥ || 11-1110 ||
bhuṅkṣvaitasya paśo raktaṃ kravyasaṃhatimeva ca | chindhīmamiva me śatruṃ maṅgalāni prayaccha me || 11-1111 ||
daityadānavarakṣo'sṛṅbhedonmatta namo'stu te | etena khaḍgamāmantrya tannāmāṣṭakamuccaran || 11-1112 ||
gṛhṇīyānniśitaṃ khaḍgaṃ yena sadyo bhavedvadhaḥ | asirviśasanaḥ khaḍgastīkṣṇadhāro durāsadaḥ || 11-1113 ||
śrīgarbho vijayaścaiva dharmapāla namo'stu te |
(merutantre)
ā(/) hū(/) phaḍiti mantraṃ japan saṃchedayedbalim | ekenaiva prahāreṇa cchinno daivatatuṣṭaye || 11-1114 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyāmapi)
candrahāsena khaḍgena chindyādekaprahārataḥ | utthāya hananaṃ kuryānnopaviśya kadācana || 11-1115 ||
(kālikāpurāṇe)
candrahāsena karttryā vā chedanaṃ mukhyamucyate | dātrāsidhenukrakacaśaṅkulābhistu madhyamam || 11-1116 ||
asidhenuḥ svalpakhaḍgaḥ śaṅkulā cakrakarttarī | kṣurakṣuraprabhallaiśca madhyamaṃ parikīrttitam || 11-1117 ||
ebhyo'nyaiḥ śaktibāṇādyairbaliśchedyaḥ kadā'pi na | nātti devī baliṃ taṃ tu dātā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt || 11-1118 ||
hastena chedayedyastu prokṣaṇaṃ sādhakaḥ paśum | pakṣiṇaṃ vā brahmahatyāṃ sa prāpnoti durutsahām || 11-1119 ||
nāmantrya khaḍgaṃ tu baliṃ niyuñjīta vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tatrāntare |
sarveṣāmuttamaḥ khaḍgaścandrahāsaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || 11-1120 ||
pañcāśadaṅgulaḥ kāryaḥ kiṃ vā tālatrayeṇa tu | karavīradalākāraḥ kiṃ vā padmadalākṛtiḥ || 11-1121 ||
athavā kubjakhaḍgena daṇḍakhaḍgena bhedayet |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
sahasrāyutalakṣāṇāṃ balīnāṃ sambhave sati || 11-1122 ||
dvau trīn pañca tathāṣṭau vā daśa vā dvādaśāpi vā | ebhyo'dhikān naiva kuryāddevī bhāvatayā sthitān || 11-1123 ||
prācyāśābhimukhān kṛtvā yugapanmantramīrayet | tantreṇaiva balīn sarvān prokṣayeddeśikottamaḥ || 11-1124 ||
chedakā api bhūyāṃsaḥ karttavyāḥ kamalānane | haridvīpyajakorabhralulāyākāśagāminaḥ || 11-1125 ||
dadyādetān vāmabhāge pānakāni ca yāni ca |
urabhro meṣaḥ | tathā |
matsyān grāhān śaśān khaḍgān kamaṭhān kolagodhikāḥ || 11-1126 ||
yāvato mṛgabhedā(/)śca dadyāt saṃmukha eva hi |
(śrīkramasaṃhitāyām)
yatnatastaṃ baliṃ dadyānna hanyādātmanā punaḥ || 11-1127 ||
yadi hanyāt pramādena rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
mahākālo'pi |
svahastena paśuṃ hatvā paśuyonimavāpnuyāt || 11-1128 ||
tantrāntare |
svayaṃ vā bhrātṛputro vā bhrātā vā suhṛdeva vā | sapiṇḍaśchedayedvā'pi śuddhāntaḥkaraṇo yadi ||| 11-1129 ||
na ripuṃ nāṅgahīnaṃ vā na kāṇaṃ nāpi kubjakam |
na yojayecchatrupakṣaṃ balicchedanakarmaṇi (-) ityuktam ||
mahiṣabalidāne viśeṣa ukto (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
viśeṣaḥ kaścidadhiko mahiṣe taṃ bruve'dhunā || 11-1130 ||
tadaṅge devatāḥ sarvāḥ pūjayet kusumākṣataiḥ | praṇavādinamo'ntaiśca madhye ṅentaiḥ padaistathā || 11-1131 ||
sthānāni devatāścāpi krameṇa kathayāmi te | brahmarandhre ca nāsāyāṃ karṇayo rasane tathā || 11-1132 ||
netrayorvadane caiva lalāṭe tadanantaram | dakṣagaṇḍe vāmagaṇḍe grīvāyāṃ keśa eva ca || 11-1133 ||
dakṣabhruvi tathā vāmabhruvi caivaṃ varānane | oṣṭhe'dhare ca skandhe ca hṛdaye pṛṣṭha eva ca || 11-1134 ||
jaṭhare caraṇe pucche sarvasmin deha eva ca | brahmā medinyathākāśaḥ sarvato mukha eva ca || 11-1135 ||
jyotīṃṣi viṣṇuścandraśca śakro vahnirmaheśvaraḥ | nir(-)ṛtirmitravaruṇau tathā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī || 11-1136 ||
dhaneśvaraḥ sarparāja ādityaḥ sādhya eva ca | gandharvendrastathā siddhā cāmuṇḍā sarvaśeṣagā || 11-1137 ||
anenaiva prakāreṇa narasyāpi prapūjayet | kramasiddhaṃ pūrvagatamado'dhikamihārhaṇam || 11-1138 ||
athobhayoḥ śeṣagatān mantrānākalaya priye | yamasya vāhanatvena khyātastvamapi kāsaraḥ || 11-1139 ||
vasataḥ śṛṅgayoragre mṛtyukālau sadā tava | bhavāneva paridveṣṭi javanā(/)sturagānapi || 11-1140 ||
tava rūpaṃ samāsthāya rambhāsurasutaḥ purā | bhagavatyā samaṃ yuddhaṃ kṛtavān darpamohitaḥ || 11-1141 ||
devyā tvaṃ nihataścāsi tathā krāntaṃ śirastava | vahasyataścaṇḍikāṃ tvaṃ śirasā bhṛṅgureṇa vā || 11-1142 ||
tvatto nānyo baliḥ kaściddevyāḥ prītipradāyakaḥ | ato dadāmi kālyai tvāṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā || 11-1143 ||
mayi kalyāṇamādhāya gaccha kāsara sadgatim |
narabalau viśeṣamāha |
manuṣyabalidāne tu viśeṣaḥ kaścidīritaḥ || 11-1144 ||
pūrvedyurakṛtāhāraṃ saṃparityaktamaithunam | snātaṃ raktāmbaradharaṃ naraṃ muṇḍitamastakam || 11-1145 ||
raktacandanadigdhāṅgaṃ kṛttaśmaśrunakhaṃ tathā | ajātāśrukamudriktaṃ na dīnaṃ nāpyadhomukham || 11-1145 ||
na bāḍavaṃ na cāṇḍālaṃ na klībaṃ patitaṃ na ca | caturvidhebhyo'pi śive svayamāgatamuttamam || 11-1146 ||
prokṣayet paśusāmānyarūpeṇa prathamaṃ tataḥ | mahiṣoktaprakāreṇa paścādetān manūn japet || 11-1147 ||
sarveṣu prāṇiṣu śreṣṭhastvaṃ manuṣya iti sthitaḥ | baliśreṣṭha mahābhāga devagarbhaśriyā vṛtaḥ || 11-1148 ||
rakṣa māṃ sarvabhītibhyaḥ siddhiṃ dehi tathottamām | rājyaṃ dehi yaśo dehi dehi cānuttamāṃ gatim || 11-1149 ||
ārogyaṃ dīrghamāyuśca prajāvṛddhiṃ raṇe jayam | kalyāṇaṃ vipulān bhogān dārānapi hṛdīpsitān || 11-1150 ||
kātyāyanyāṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ lakṣmīmapyadhikāṃ sthirām | datvā rājyaṃ parityajya śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam || 11-1151 ||
devīlokaṃ vraja kṣipraṃ sajñātisutabāndhavam | mahādānairmahāyajñaistapobhiratiduṣkaram || 11-1152 ||
yat sthānaṃ nāpyate lokaistat tvaṃ gaccha nararṣabha | aṅgīkṛto mahākālyā māṃsaśoṇitalipsayā || 11-1153 ||
devīlokaṃ suduṣprāpyaṃ prāpnuhi tvaṃ drutaṃ gataḥ | tatra gatvā śivaṃ dhyāhi māmakīnaṃ jagatpate || 11-1154 ||
devīlokagatiḥ kāmyā matprasādāt tavedṛśaḥ | tvatprasādādahaṃ śatrūn jayeyaṃ raṇamūrdhani || 11-1155 ||
ślokānaṣṭāvimān devi paṭhennarabalikṣaṇe |
gaṇḍake'pi viśeṣa uktastatraiva |
khaḍgamantraṃ samākhyāsye gaṇḍako yena dīyate || 11-1156 ||
dvipadehākṛte khaḍga śastrābhedyakalevara | tṛptā bhaveyuḥ pitarastvanmāṃsena surā api || 11-1157 ||
na ca tvatto'dhikaḥ kaścit pavitraḥ pṛthivītale | tvatkaroṭijapātrāṇi śastāni śrāddhakarmaṇi || 11-1158 ||
mayā devyā balitvena tvamadya viniveditaḥ |
mama vighnān samutsārya sadyo devīgaṇe bhava (-) iti |
