evaṃ hatvā paśūn sadyastadīyarudhiraṃ tathā || 11-1159 ||
svarṇādiracite pātre gṛhṇīyāduṣṇaphenilam |
(kālikāpurāṇe)
oṃ hrī(/) ai(/) hrī(/) śrī(/) kauśikī rudhireṇāpyāyatām (-) iti |
pātre niyojayedraktaṃ śirasyeva pradīpakam || 11-1160 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
atha pātrāṇi vakṣye'haṃ sthāpyate yatra śoṇitam | haime vā rājate tāmre grāhyaṃ raktaṃ mahībhṛtā || 11-1161 ||
sāmantairmāṇḍilakaiśca tāmre vā kāṃsyaraityayoḥ | daridragṛhibhiścāpi mārttike vā'tha dārave || 11-1162 ||
athavā patrapuṭake naiva lohe kadācana | na raṅge sīsake cāpi nārikelaphalatvaci || 11-1163 ||
kaulānāṃ sarvapātrebhyaḥ kapālaṃ śreṣṭhamiṣyate | eṣāṃ paśūnāṃ palalairyāvatī tṛptirīritā || 11-1163 ||
bhagavatyāḥ priye tṛptī rudhirairapi tāvatī | nitye naimittike vā'pi kātyāyanyāḥ prapūjane || 11-1164 ||
vinā baliṃ naiva dadyādāme palalaśoṇite | paśorvā pakṣiṇo vā'pi narasyāpi viśeṣataḥ || 11-1165 ||
atha mastakapatanaphalaṃ tatraiva |
evaṃ datvā baliṃ devyai balidānavidhiryathā | śubhāśubhaṃ vijānīyādrājyasya ca nṛpasya ca || 11-1166 ||
yadi vāyavyadigbhāge nair(-)ṛtye dakṣiṇe'pi vā | mastake patite caiva hāniratra vinirdiśet || 11-1167 ||
śeṣeṣu dikṣu sarvāsu vidikṣu ca phalaṃ śṛṇu | pūrve cottaradigbhāge patate yadi mastakam || 11-1168 ||
sarvasampatkaraṃ vidyādrājā rājyaṃ vinirdiśet | bhramitvā dakṣiṇe karṇe yadā patati vai śiraḥ || 11-1169 ||
tadā siddhiśca māsānte vāmakarṇe vipadbhavet | rājāmagre bhaveddhānirgṛhasthānāṃ bhavecchubham || 11-1170 ||
aiśānyāṃ madhyayoścaiva patate yadi mastakam | chinnaṃ śiro nipatitaṃ sahāsyaṃ yadi dṛśyate || 11-1171 ||
vibhūtiṃ tasya jānīyādrājā rājyaṃ vinirdiśet | tadā svalpena kālena sarvasiddhirbhaveddhruvam || 11-1172 ||
ekavāre bhavet siddhirdvivāre hānirucyate | gṛhasthānāṃ vijānīyādrājñāṃ tu viparītakam || 11-1173 ||
yadā'śru dṛśyate netre tadā hāniṃ vinirdiśet | yadā kaṭakaṭāśabdo dantānāṃ śrūyate kvacit || 11-1174 ||
tadā tu maraṇaṃ vidyādhāniṃ sarvatra nirdiśet |
(traipurapaddhatyām)
dakṣiṇe patite siddhirvāmabhāge ca ninditam || 11-1175 ||
savye tu patite chede devīmantraṃ smaredbudhaḥ | tataḥ kuṇḍādike hutvā hutibhirdaśapañcabhiḥ || 11-1176 ||
śamayeddhūṅkṛterdoṣaṃ balilakṣaṇalakṣitam |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
dadyādrākṣasadigbhāge mantrī baliśiraḥ svayam || 11-1177 ||
taddakṣiṇe raktapātraṃ viparītaṃ na saṃdadet | devasya saṃmukhaṃ kṛtvā chinnaṃ bhāgaṃ prakalpayet || 11-1178 ||
tadeva śastaṃ jānīyānmadhyamaṃ tadudīritam | balīnāmiti saṃjñānaṃ śiraśca purato dadet || 11-1179 ||
tathā |
na bhūmau sthāpayecchīrṣaṃ caiva viparītakam | śiraḥ salohitaṃ dadyāt pura eva na cānyataḥ || 11-1180 ||
rudhirādānakāle tu pātre svavibhavāhṛte | saindhavaṃ sthāpayet kiñcit phalānāmekameva hi || 11-1181 ||
tadraktaṃ havireva syāt puroḍāśaṃ ca tacchiraḥ | nāsāgrīvāgaṇḍupucchapalalāni nikṛttya hi || 11-1182 ||
paśūnāṃ vadane kṣiptvā tataḥ saṃsthāpayet puraḥ | tathā pakṣatripatraṃ ca vīnāṃ troṭau viniḥkṣipet || 11-1183 ||
paśuvaccaraṇasyāpi śīrṣe kamalalocane | balīnāṃ mastake dadyāt pradīpaṃ dhūpavarttikām || 11-1184 ||
dahanāllomakeśānāṃ yo gandha upatiṣṭhate | ghrāti taṃ caṇḍikā devī santuṣṭā tu prajāyate || 11-1185 ||
tasminneva hyavasare ādhikyaṃ dhūpadīpayoḥ | yathā vibhato devi karttavyaṃ bhaktitatparaḥ || 11-1186 ||
balyādhikye ca śīrṣārṇāṃ vidheyāḥ paṅktayastathā | sadhūpadīpāḥ kusumākṣatapuñjānvitāstathā || 11-1187 ||
tathā |
śiraśca saṃmukhe sthāpyaṃ sadīpaṃ pātravarjitam | sa cāpi haviraktaḥ syādatha vā tilajokṣitaḥ || 11-1188 ||
sārṣapaṃ na pradātavyaṃ na cānyaphalasambhavam | mūrdhābhiṣikto haviṣā tailena bahusiddhibhāk || 11-1189 ||
anyabījodbhavai rogaṃ śokaṃ mṛtyuṃ ca vindati | yathā lomāni dahyante yatnāt kāryaṃ tathā naraiḥ || 11-1190 ||
tantrāntare |
sūtravarttiṃ pradadyācca vastravartiḥ praśasyate | aṅguṣṭhasya pramāṇaṃ ca dīrghaṃ caiva ṣaḍaṅgulam || 11-1191 ||
kārpāsasūtrakairdadyādekaviṃśatisūtrakaiḥ | sugandhidravyaistat kuryāt karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ || 11-1192 ||
grāhāṇāṃ kacchapānāṃ ca godhāyāśca viśeṣataḥ | matsyānāmapi pakṣiṇāṃ na dīpaṃ dāpayecchive || 11-1193 ||
śīrṣopari jvaladdīpaṃ yāvatkālaṃ pravarttate | tāvatkālaṃ vaset svarge tasmādyatnena dāpayet || 11-1194 ||
lomadāhodbhavaṃ gandhaṃ ghrātvā devī prasīdati | tasmāt saṃvardhayeddīpaṃ tasmāt pātraṃ vivarjayet || 11-1196 ||
nirvāṇe mṛtyumāpnoti dīyamāne pradīpake |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
tataḥ pātraṃ puraḥ kṛtvā devyāḥ sapaśu śoṇitam || 11-1197 ||
śarkarāyutadūrvāṇāṃ pradadyāt trirmahāghṛtam | saindhavaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca kadalīphalameva ca || 11-1198 ||
pātayenmadhurāṇāṃ ca kāmamuddiśya sādhakaḥ | aṣṭadhā vibhajeddigvanmadhye caikaṃ kuśādibhiḥ || 11-1199 ||
datvā kiñcidghṛtaṃ tatra kuryāt tarpaṇamudrayā | tarpaṇaṃ bhāgabhājāṃ vai devīnāṃ dvirdvireva ca || 11-1200 ||
ādyantimau tārahārdī madhye ādimanorapi | tattannāmnā mantramapi tarpayāmīti saṃyutam || 11-1201 ||
dvitīyarūpaṃ ṅentaṃ ca taddvitīyapadoditam | madhye nityoditaśryākhyapātravat pīṭhagā kriyā || 11-1202 ||
pūrvasyāṃ diśi cāmuṇḍā dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu yoginī | ḍākinyuktā paścimāyāmuttarasyāṃ tu bhairavī || 11-1203 ||
vidārikā'gneyakoṇe nair(-)ṛtyāṃ pāparākṣasī | pūtanā cāpi vāyavye īśāne kālikā tathā || 11-1204 ||
tataḥ stutiṃ prakurvīta baddhāñjalipuṭo'grataḥ | jaya devi jaganmātarjaya pāpaughahāriṇi || 11-1205 ||
jaya janmajarāvyādhitṛṇadāvānalākṛte | jaya sarvavipattighne jaya tridaśavandite || 11-1206 ||
jaya nityānandarūpe jaya kalyāṇadāyini | jaya śatrukṣayakare jaya rogapraṇāśini || 11-1207 ||
jaya bhīme jayāghore jaya saṅkaṭatāriṇi | jayāmṛtarasāsvādatundilāmandavrgrahe || 11-1208 ||
trinetre vikarālāsye muṇḍamālābibhūṣite | sarvāsurakṣayakari khaḍgakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇi || 11-1209 ||
mahāghore mahārāve daityadarpaniṣūdini | imaṃ paśubaliṃ devi gṛhītvā kālarātrike || 11-1210 ||
prītā bhava mahācaṇḍe rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam | āyurdehi dhanaṃ dehi bhāgyaṃ rkīrtiṃ ca dehi me || 11-1211 ||
striyaṃ dehi sutān dehi sarvān kāmā(/)śca dehi me | ugracaṇḍe pracaṇḍā'si pracaṇḍakaravālini || 11-1212 ||
mahācaṇḍogradordaṇḍe viśveśvari namo'stu te | rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāpannaṃ tvatpādārpitamānasam || 11-1213 ||
hara pāpaṃ hara kleśaṃ hara śokaṃ harāsukham | hara rogaṃ hara kṣobhaṃ hara dainyaṃ harapriye || 11-1214 ||
stutimetāṃ paṭhitvaivaṃ daṇḍavat praṇamedbhuvi | guhyakāli jagaddhātri sarvāntaryāminīśvari || 11-1215 ||
gṛhītvemaṃ paśubaliṃ yathoktaphaladā bhava | kāyena manasā vācā tvatto nānyā gatirmama || 11-1216 ||
antaścarasi bhūtānāṃ draṣṭrī tvaṃ parameśvari |
(yāmale)
kātyāyani mahāmāye durge durgatitāriṇi || 11-1217 ||
namastubhyaṃ jagaddhātri kālarātrisvarūpiṇi | evaṃ stutvā mahādevyai datvā ca sumano'ñjalīn || 11-1218 ||
sāṣṭāṅgṃ praṇamedbhūmau bhaktiyuktena cetasā |
sumano'ñjalīniti bahuvacanaṃ kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyena tritve paryavasyati | tathā ca puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ datvā praṇamedityarthaḥ |
iti balidānavidhiḥ |
atha paśupakṣiṇāṃ vastvantarāṇāṃ ca daivatāni | (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
paśūnāṃ ca vihaṅgānāmanyeṣāmapi vastūnām || 11-1219 ||
bravīmi devatāḥ sarvāḥ krameṇotsargakarmaṇi | prājāpatyo gajaḥ proktasturago yamadaivataḥ || 11-1220 ||
tathā caikaśaphāḥ sarve kathitā yamadaivatāḥ | mahiṣaśca tathā yāmya uṣṭro vai nair(-)ṛto mataḥ || 11-1220 ||
govṛṣau rudradaivatyau chāga āgneya ucyate | meṣastu vāruṇo jñeyo varāho vaiṇavo mataḥ || 11-1221 ||
gorīdevyau vyāghrasiṃhau gaṇḍako brahmadaivataḥ | yāvanto mṛgabhedāḥ syuḥ kathitā vāyudevatāḥ || 11-1222 ||
yāvantaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve vāyavyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | prājāpatyāstathā matsyāḥ kacchapāḥ sādhyadaivatāḥ || 11-1223 ||
godhā varuṇadaivatyā grāhā api ca tādṛśāḥ | tathā ca babhrūśalabhāvādityeśānadaivatau || 11-1224 ||
kanyā dāsastathā dāsī prājāpatyā narāstathā | abhayaṃ śivadaivatyaṃ dharitrī viṣṇudaivatā || 11-1225 ||
tathā samudradaivatyaṃ ratnamuktāphalādikam | jalāśayāstathā sarve vāridhānī kamaṇḍaluḥ || 11-1226 ||
prapā kumbhaśca karakaṃ jñeyaṃ varuṇadaivatam | suvarṇamagnidaivatyaṃ lauhaṃ bhairavadaivatam || 11-1227 ||
kāṃsye pūṣā'śvinau cāpi devatā parikīrtitāḥ | raṅgaṃ nāsatyadaivatyaṃ sīsakaṃ vāyudaivatam || 11-1228 ||
tāmraṃ ca sūryadaivatyaṃ pittalaṃ kujadaivatam | rajataṃ candradaivatyaṃ kharparaṃ pitṛdaivatam || 11-1229 ||
guḍaṃ kuveradaivatyaṃ śarkarā mitradaivatā |
anyatra tu |
āpo guḍe devatāḥ syuḥ (---------------) ityuktam |
tathā |
jāṅgalaṃ vahni daivatyaṃ madhu syādyadaivatam || 11-1230 ||
tāmbūladevatā jñeyā śakro vidyādharo'tha vā |
tantrāntare |
tāmbūle devatāḥ śakravidyādharavināyakāḥ || 11-1231 ||
mahākālaḥ |
tathā mṛtyu~jayo devī ghṛteṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ | tailaṃ tu rāhudaivatyaṃ kārpāsaṃ ketudaivatam || 11-1232 ||
kṣīraṃ ca tārādaivatyaṃ dadhi cauṣadhidaivatam |
anyatra tu |
kṣīre nārāyaṇaḥ prokto dadhisarpāḥ prakirttitāḥ (-) ityuktam |
tathā
piṣṭaṃ śacīdaivataṃ ca sindūramapi pārvati || 11-1233 ||
tantrāntare |
anyeṣu devatāḥ sarve devaḥ piṣṭe prajāpatiḥ |
mahākālaḥ |
lavaṇaṃ cābdhidaivatyaṃ jalaṃ varuṇadaivatam || 11-1234 ||
devaḥ smaraśca gandharvo madhuparke ca candane | puṣpaṃ ca lakṣmīdaivatyaṃ dhūpe devo vanaspatiḥ || 11-1235 ||
apsarodaivataṃ jñeyaṃ sarvaṃ mṛgamadādikam | dīpo'pi vahnidaivatyo naivedyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam || 11-1236 ||
pādukā somadaivatyā chatraṃ syādindradaivatam | devatā kāmadhenuḥ syāccāmare tridaśeśvari || 11-1237 ||
vyajanaṃ vāyudaivatyamindraḥ siṃhāsanasya ca | mālā ca ratidaivatyā ḍākinī devatā surā || 11-1238 ||
māṃsaṃ nir(-)ṛtidaivatyaṃ vitānaṃ candradaivatam | prājāpatyāni śasyāni pakvānnāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 11-1239 ||
vācaspatyāni vāsāṃsi pāṇḍurāṇyasitāni ca | mayudaivāni raktāni durgādaivaṃ tu paṭṭakam || 11-1240 ||
vidyā brāhmī vinirdiṣṭā vidyāprakaraṇāni ca | sārasvatāni jñeyāni pustakādyāni pārvati || 11-1241 ||
pātrāṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ viśvakarmā'dhidaivatam |
(yāmale)
vādyaṃ caturvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ rudragandharvadaivatam || 11-1242 ||
mahākālaḥ |
drumāṇāṃ ca latānāṃ tu śākānāṃ haritaiḥ saha | phalānāmapi sarveṣāṃ devo jñeyo vanaspatiḥ || 11-1243 ||
ajināni tathā śayyā ratha āsanameva ca | upānahau tathā dolā yaccānyat prāṇivarjitam || 11-1244 ||
uttānāṅgiradaivatyaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | dhvajo vai dharmadaivatyaḥ sīraṃ paryanyadaivatam || 11-1245 ||
pāṣāṇādi tathā ratnaṃ kathitaṃ śakradaivatam | gṛhaṃ tu sarvadaivatyamanuktaṃ yanmayā priye || 11-1246 ||
tat sarvaṃ rudradaivatyaṃ jñeyamutsargakarmaṇi |
iti daivatāni |
atha kumārīpūjāvidhiḥ |
(mahātharvaṇasaṃhitāyām)
tataḥ kumārīyajanaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ || 11-1247 ||
yasmin kṛte tu vidhivat karmaṇaḥ sāṅgatā bhavet | akṛte cāṅgahāniḥ syādviśeṣāccharadarcane || 11-1248 ||
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
samāpya pūjāmāsāyaṃ pradoṣe paryupasthite | kumārīpūjanaṃ kuryādvidhinā pañcamaṃ hitam || 11-1249 ||
tathā |
bhaktabhadrābhadramubhe tadanakti sureśvari | svayaṃ tadrūpamāsthāya mūḍhabhāvamupeyuṣī || 11-1250 ||
didṛkṣurāyāti śivā bhaktipūjanasambhṛtiḥ | tasmāt tatrādaraḥ kāryo bhaktibhāvaṃ ca jānatā || 11-1251 ||
devatāstrividhotpātairyathādeśe hitāhitam | sūcayanti tathaivaiṣāṃ vārṣikaṃ suravandite || 11-1252 ||
tadvijñānārthamapyeṣā pūjitavyā prayatnataḥ | caturṇāmapi kaulānāṃ smarttānāmānukalpinām || 11-1253 ||
naivātra matabhedo'sti naivārcanabhidā'pi vā | na ca pūrvottarau pakṣau na ca saṃdehakalpanā || 11-1254 ||
bhavecca phalabāhulyaṃ tuṣṭirdevyāstathaiva ca | viśiṣya jñāyate'nena tathā bhāvi śubhāśubham || 11-1255 ||
jñāte śubhe bhavet toṣo'nyasma(/)ścopāyacintanam |
tathā |
na tathā tuṣyati śivā balihomastutīraṇaiḥ || 11-1256 ||
kumārīpūjanenātra yathā sadyaḥ prasīdati | na kevalaṃ pūjayet tāṃ bhojayeccāpi yatnataḥ || 11-1257 ||
tathā | vyaṅgatā cāpyakaraṇāt pūjāyāḥ parikīrttitā | kūmārīpūjanenātra yathā sadyaḥ prasīdati || 11-1258 ||

alikā nāsikā bāhū vakṣo jaṭharameva ca | pādau kṣmāṃ sparśato daṇḍapraṇāmaḥ sa hi gadyate || 11-1509 ||
āyurdehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhagavati dehi bhe | putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi kāmān sarvā(/)śca dehi me || 11-1510 ||
pracaṇḍe putrade nityaṃ suprīte suranāyike | kulodyotakare cogre jayaṃ dehi namo'stu te || 11-1511 ||
ugracaṇḍe pracaṇḍāsi pracaṇḍabalanāśini | namaste sarvadā devi viśveśvari namo'stu te || 11-1512 ||
durgottāriṇī durge tvaṃ sarvāśubhaniṣūdani | dharmārthamokṣade devi nityaṃ me varadā bhava || 11-1513 ||
durge devi mahābhāge trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam | mahiṣāsṛṅmadonmatte praṇato'smi prasīda me || 11-1514 ||
hara pāpaṃ hara kleśaṃ hara śokaṃ harāśubham | hara rogaṃ hara kṣobhaṃ hara mānaṃ hara priye || 11-1515 ||
kāli kāli mahākāli kālike pāpahāriṇi | dharmakāmaprade devi nārāyaṇi namo'stu te || 11-1516 ||
saṃgrāme vijayaṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi sadā gṛhe | dharmakāmarthasampattīrdehi devi namo'stu te || 11-1517 ||
mahiṣaghni mahāmāye cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālini | āyurārogyavijayaṃ dehi devi namo'stu te || 11-1518 ||
āyurdadātu me kālī putrānapi sadāśivā | arthakāmau mahāmāyā vibhavaṃ sarvamaṅgalā || 11-1519 ||
śiro me caṇḍikā pātu kaṇṭhaṃ pātu sureśvarī | hṛdayaṃ pātu cāmuṇḍā sarvataḥ pātu kālikā || 11-1520 ||
brahmāṇī caiva kaumārī vārāhī vaiṣṇavī tathā | māheśvarī nārasiṃhī indrāṇī śivadūtyapi || 11-1521 ||
mahākālī ca cāmuṇḍā bhairavī kauśikī tathā | ugracaṇḍā ca pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā || 11-1522 ||
caṇḍā caṇḍavatī caiva aticaṇḍā ca caṇḍikā | etāścānyāśca rudrāṇi yāste tiṣṭhanti śaktayaḥ || 11-1523 ||
tābhiḥ sahaiva māṃ rakṣa saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe tathā | nānāpurāṇavākyena nānādevarṣibhāṣitaiḥ || 11-1524 ||
sadāśivājñayā cāpi tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama | tvāṃ vihāyetarāṃ naiva saṃśraye devatāṃ śive || 11-1525 ||
ataḥ paraṃ yaducitaṃ tat karttuṃ mātararhasi | ādhyākulaṃ ca dāridryaṃ rogaṃ śokaṃ ca dāruṇam || 11-1526 ||
bandhusvajanavairāgyaṃ durge tvaṃ hara durgatim | rājyaṃ tasya pratiṣṭhā ca lakṣmīstasya sadā sthirā || 11-1527 ||
prabhutvaṃ tasya sāmarthyaṃ yasya tvaṃ mastakopari | dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama || 11-1528 ||
agatā'si yato durge māheśvari mamālayam | arghyaṃ puṣpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ baliṃ tathā || 11-1529 ||
gṛhāṇa varade devi kalyāṇaṃ kuru sarvadā | kṛtvaivaṃ vidhinā daṇḍapraṇāmastutipūrvakam || 11-1530 ||
pūjāṃ samarpayeddevyai gṛhītvā pāṇinā jalam | mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ sureśvari || 11-1531 ||
yadarcitaṃ mayā devi paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me | gṛhītuṃ śāradīṃ pūjāṃ marttyamaṇḍalamāgatām || 11-1532 ||
caṇḍike tvāṃ namāmyadya pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām | kāyena manasā vācā tvatto nānyā gatirmama || 11-1533 ||
antaścarasi bhūtānāṃ jñātrī tvaṃ sarvasākṣiṇī | etāvat kṛtyamuditaṃ śāradīyārcanakrame || 11-1534 ||
prātarārabhya deveśi rātreryāmatrayāvadhi | śivābaliṃ kumāryārcāṃ prabhūtaṃ balimeva vā || 11-1535 ||
hitvā'dastrayamaṣṭamyāmayameva vidhiḥ priye | tataḥ prasādaṃ devyā yadavaśiṣṭhaṃ bhavedanu || 11-1536 ||
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ siddhaṃ vā'siddhameva vā | bandhubhiḥ saha bhuñjīta hāsyakautukapūrvakam || 11-1537 ||
gītanṛtyādikaṃ paścāddevyagre viniyojayet | krīḍāṃ ca jñātibhiḥ sārdhaṃ vidadhīta vicakṣaṇaḥ || 11-1538 ||
etāvadaśaktā saṃkṣiptapūjoktā (kālikāpurāṇe)
samyak kalpoditā pūjā yadi karttuṃ na śakyate | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyameva vā || 11-1539 ||

vaḍavārūpeṇaikā svātiḥ sauraṃ rathaṃ vahati | sā bhāreṇākrāntā kruddhā'nyānyānnirīkṣate vāhān || 11-1544 ||
teṣāṃ tejaḥ sattvaṃ balaṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ nigṛhṇāti | sañjāyante rogā mahopasargaiḥ samanvitāḥ kaṣṭāḥ || 11-1545 ||
tasmāt svātyupatāpe vājiṣu pīḍā bhavenmahatī | evaṃ ca saptarātraṃ svāteḥ sampāta eva nirdiṣṭaḥ || 11-1546 ||
tatra dīvākarakiraṇairaspṛṣṭā vājino rakṣyāḥ | śālāṃ tatopaliptāṃ manoramāṃ varjitāṃ ca ravikiraṇaiḥ || 11-1547 ||
nānākāraiḥ puṣpairalaṅkṛtāṃ dhūpitāṃ kuryāt | tasyāṃ snātāsturagāḥ sudhūpitā arcitā dvitīyāyām || 11-1548 ||
puruṣaiśca śastrahastaiḥ saptāhaṃ rakṣitavyāstu |
tathā |
śubhe'hni muhūrte ca kṣmāpatiḥ sapurohitaḥ || 11-1549 ||
kṛtamaṅgalasaṃskārān vāhān śālāṃ prapūjayet |
jyotiḥśāstre'pi |
svātī nāma raveḥ patnī varadā rūpiṇī ratham || 11-1550 ||
vahantī sā'śvine māsi sūryaraśmisamāśritā | saptā'haṃ pīḍayedaśvā(/)stataḥ snānārcitān gṛhe || 11-1551 ||
revantaṃ pūjayitvā'tha baddhvā poṭalikāṃ gale |
tathā |
śuklapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śālāṃ saṃveṣṭya rakṣayet || 11-1552 ||
ādityaraśmito vāhān kaṭairvastrādikaistathā | astaṃ gate dinakare kaṭādīnapakarṣayet || 11-1553 ||
pravātārthaṃ punardadyādyāvat sandhyā na jāyate | śālāpraveśavihitāṃ rakṣāṃ kaṇṭhe pradāpayet || 11-1554 ||
lohakaṃ nimbapatrāṇi guggulaṃ sarṣapān ghṛtam | cailabaddhāṃ vacāṃ hiṅgu badhnīyādvājināṃ gale || 11-1555 ||
gharṣaṇaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ caiva tathā caivāpavarttanam | niśāśeṣe prakarttavyaṃ yāvaddūre divākaraḥ || 11-1556 ||
etatpratidinaṃ kuryāt saptarātramatandritaḥ | kārayedbrāhmaṇā(/)ścaiva śāntisvastyayanāni ca || 11-1557 ||
(brahmapurāṇe'pi)
śāntisvastyayane kārye tadā teṣāṃ dine dine | dhānyaṃ bhallātakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacāṃ siddhārthakā(/)stathā || 11-1558 ||
pañcaraṅgena sūtreṇa kaṇṭhe teṣāṃ tu bandhayet | vāyavyairvāruṇaiḥ sauraiḥ śāktairmantraiḥ savaiṣṇavaiḥ || 11-1559 ||
vaiśvadevaistathā'gneyairhomaḥ kāryo dine dine | turagā rakṣaṇīyāśca puruṣaiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ || 11-1560 ||
na ca tāḍyāḥ kvacit tatra na ca vāhyāḥ kadācana |

vedīṃ ca kalpayitvā dhuri ca vidhānena pāvakaṃ juhuyāt || 11-1562 ||
dhuri śālāśirobhāge |
sāyaṃ prātaśca śuciḥ purohito brahmacārī syāt | śālihotragaditena mantreṇānena homayet || 11-1563 ||
rohitāśva mahābhāga havyavāḍamarottama | dhūmadhvaja kratudvāra svargasya prathitaḥ pathi || 11-1564 ||
uttiṣṭha homaṃ hṛhṇemaṃ śāntirasya hayeṣu ca | svāheti tatra mantreṇa prāpayet prathamāhutim || 11-1565 ||
tataḥ prajāpatīndrāya somāya varuṇāya ca | vivasvate kuverāya suṣeṇāyāhiśāline || 11-1566 ||
ādityebhyastathā'śvimyāṃ rudrebhyo vasubhiḥ saha | viṣṇośca viśvadevānāṃ sādhyānāṃ marudbhiḥ sahaḥ || 11-1567 ||
vāsukipramukhānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ garuḍasya ca | sarvāsāṃ paurṇamāsīnāṃ tithīnāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ || 11-1568 ||
devīnāṃ nadīnāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ vanaspatīnām | svāhākāreṇa juhuyāt tṛtīyaṃ ca hutāśane || 11-1569 ||
devānāmeva sarveṣāṃ svāhākāreṇa homayet | durbalānīha rakṣāṃsi pratyūṣe brahmatejasā || 11-1570 ||
bhavanti tasmāt pratyūṣe svāpayet poṣayeddhayān | purohitastu dviḥ kālaṃ tarpayitvā dvijottamam || 11-1571 ||
puṇyāhaṃ kārayennityaṃ svastyāśīrmaṅgalānvitam | naṭanartakagandharvāḥ sūtacāraṇamāgadhāḥ || 11-1572 ||
turagānupatiṣṭheyuḥ saptāhaṃ śāntikāraṇāt | manojñān madhurān śabdān śrutvā gacchanti va grahāḥ || 11-1573 ||
vāditraṃ vāhanāgāre tasmānnityaṃ prayojayet | atikramya ca saptāhamaṣṭamyāṃ snāpayeddhyān || 11-1574 ||
varuṇāya baliṃ datvā paścāt toye'vagāhayet |
aṣṭamyāmiti dvitīyāmārabhyāṣṭamītithāvityarthaḥ | granthāntare |
tānaśvān samalaṅkṛtya vājiśālāṃ praveśya ca || 11-1575 ||
pratimāyāṃ citrapaṭe sthaṇḍile maṇḍale'tha vā | nānopacārasambhāraiḥ revantaṃ devamarcayet || 11-1576 ||
namo devādhidevāya turaṅgabalacāriṇe | sūryaputrāya devāya turaṅgānāṃ hitāya ca || 11-1577 ||
turaṅgapariṣadyasya nṛgajopari dhāvati | sāśvamaśvādhipaṃ rakṣa śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ vrajāmyaham || 11-1578 ||

tathā |
sūryaputra mahāvāho chāyāhṛdayanandana || 11-1579 ||
śāntiṃ kuru turaṅgānāṃ revantāya namo'stu te | evaṃ stutvā'tha vidhivaduccaiḥśravasamarcayet || 11-1580 ||

aśvayukśuklapakṣe tu svātīyoge suśobhane | pūrvamuccaiḥśravā nāma prathamaṃ sūryamāvahat || 11-1581 ||
tasmāt sāśvairnaraistatra pūjyo'sau śraddhayā sadā |
pūjanīyāśca turagā navamīṃ yāvadeva hi || 11-1582 ||

uccaiḥśravo namastubhyaṃ namaḥ kṣīrābdhinandana | vāhān vardhaya vāhendra sarvotpātaṃ vināśaya || 11-1583 ||
evaṃ stutvoccaiḥśravasaṃ turagān pūjayet tataḥ | nānopacāraisteṣāṃ tu karṇajāpamidaṃ paṭhet || 11-1584 ||
gandharvakulajāto'si mā bhūyāḥ kuladūṣakaḥ | brahmaṇaḥ satyavākyena somasya varuṇasya ca || 11-1585 ||
tejasā caiva sūryasya munīnāṃ tapasā tathā | rudrasya brahmacaryeṇa pavanasya balena ca || 11-1586 ||
prābhāvācca hutāśasya varttasva tvaṃ turaṅgama | smara tvaṃ rājaputro'si kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ smara || 11-1587 ||
surāsurairmathyamānāt kṣīrodādamṛtādibhiḥ | jāta uccaiḥśravā pūrvaṃ tena jāto'si tat smara || 11-1588 ||
yāṃ gatiṃ brahmahā gacchet pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā | bhūmyarthe nṛtavādī ca raṇe yastu parāṅmukhaḥ || 11-1589 ||
sūryācandramasau vāyuryāvat paśyanti duṣkṛtam | vraja tvaṃ tāṃ gatiṃ kṣīpraṃ tacca pāpaṃ bhavet tataḥ || 11-1590 ||
vikṛtiṃ yadi gacchethā yuddhe'dhvani turaṅgama | ripūn vijitya samare bharttrā saha sukhī bhava || 11-1591 ||
turaṅgama ciraṃ jīva paraśastrairalakṣitaḥ | sadā māṃ samare rakṣa svāmikāryaṃ sadā kuru || 11-1592 ||

grahahomastu karttavyo grahāṇāmarcanaṃ tathā | anena vidhinā yastu karoti turagotsavam || 11-1594 ||

avāpnuhi jayaṃ yuddhe samaye svasti no vraja | śrīstu somādbalaṃ kṛṣṇāt tejaḥ sūryājjavo'nilāt || 11-1599 ||

gauḍakāśmīradraviḍamārgeṇa trividho bhavet | aṣṭamyantaṃ japaḥ kāryastato'ṣṭamyāṃ tu homayet || 11-1602 ||

tathā |
ghaṭikāḥ ṣoḍaśa tyājyā ādyāḥ pratipadastu yāḥ | kalaśasthāpanaṃ kuryāt kalyāṇaṃ jāyate tadā || 11-1605 ||
navamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāddaśamyāṃ tu visarjanam | kāśmīrākhyaṃ kramaṃ devi śṛṇu yatnena pārvati || 11-1606 ||
navarātraṃ nirāhāro homo'ṣṭamyāṃ tathā bhavet | navamyāṃ viprabhojyaṃ syāddigvedhe pāraṇaṃ caret || 11-1607 ||
navarātraṃ nirāhāro nirvikalpaṃ jitendriyaḥ | aṣṭamīnavamīsandhau homakarma samācaret || 11-1608 ||
navamyāṃ viprabhojyaṃ syāddaśamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ caret | keralākhyaṃ kramaḥ prokto nirṇayaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 11-1609 ||
tithikṣaye tathā vṛddhau yathoktena tu vartmanā | aṣṭamīnavamīprāptau pūrvavedho na dūṣyati || 11-1610 ||
aṣṭamyāmardharātre tu yatkiṃcit kurute naraḥ | tattadakṣayamāyāti navadurgāprayogataḥ || 11-1611 ||
ekottarapraviddhyā vā stotraṃ jāpādikaṃ caret | prathame'hni japo yāvat tāvat kuryācca vā sudhīḥ || 11-1612 ||
udayāstamayaṃ japtvā trailokyavijayī bhavet | navarātravrate strīṇāṃ mṛtyuyogo bhavedyadā || 11-1613 ||
saiva devī na saṃdehastāṃ pūjya vijayī kalau | tāmbūlāgurukastūrīdivyāmbaravibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 11-1614 ||
sūryodayaṃ samārabhya punaḥ suryodayāntaram | tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 11-1615 ||
ekāsanagato bhūtvā navarātraṃ tu śāmbhavīm | mudrāmālambayeddevi navanāthādhipo bhavet || 11-1616 ||
guhāyāṃ maṭhikāyāṃ vā nirjane parvate'pi vā | adhomukho vā deveśi navarātraṃ nirambubhuk || 11-1617 ||
svamācchādya mṛdā devi tatra saṃsthāpayedghaṭam | yuvāṅkurān samāropya śāmbhavīṃ mudrikāṃ caret || 11-1618 ||
dṛḍhāsanī vā'śayanī yathoddiṣṭaṃ samācaret | kāpālikāvadhūtānāṃ vratametanmayeritam || 11-1619 ||
śāmbhavī mudrā tu (tripurāsārasamuccaye)
atha pārṣṇiniruddhakambunirnā dhvajamūlasthitasavyapādapārṣṇiḥ | ṛjukāyaśirodharo yatātmā viṣayebhyo vinivartitendriyaśca || 11-1620 ||
kākīcañcvagrakṛṣṭairmuhūrudaradarīṃ pūrayitvā samīrai (-) raṅguṣṭhābhyāmubhābhyāṃ nararipuvivare tarjanībhyāṃ ca netre | nāsārandhaṃ nirudhya sthiravimalamatirmadhyamābhyāmathāsyaṃ tvanyābhirnātigāḍhaṃ kamalajanilaye sthāpayenmānasaṃsvam (-) iti || 11-1621 ||
tathā (śaktisaṅgame)
ājñā bhavati deveśi tadaivopoṣaṇaṃ caret | ājñā yadi na jāyeta tadā grāmādhipasya ca || 11-1622 ||
deśādhipasya viprasya pūjakasya striyastathā | ājñāṃ gṛhītvā deveśi varaṃ prārthya sukhī bhavet || 11-1623 ||
bhaktaprītā ca sā durgā svayamājñāṃ prayacchati | vīraśāktavidhānena caṇḍadarpavrataṃ caret || 11-1624 ||
jihvāṃ saṃtroṭya yatnena dvivedeṣurasāṅgulām | jihvā sā punarāyāti tena siddhīśvaro bhavet || 11-1625 ||
navarātraṃ samāsādya mahāṣṭamyāṃ niśāmukhe | devīṃ yatnena saṃpūjya saṅkalpaṃ kāmanānvitam || 11-1626 ||
śiraḥpuṣpaṃ karttayitvā pūrṇaṃ madhyakaniṣṭhataḥ | yantre deve nivedyātha śivatulyo bhaveddhruvam || 11-1627 ||

dhāriṇyarjunabāṇānāṃ rāmasya priyavādini | kariṣyamāṇayātrāyā yathākālaṃ sukhaṃ mayā || 11-1751 ||
tatra nirvighnakarttrī tvaṃ bhava śrīrāmapūjite | iti saṃprārthya mūlasthāṃ gṛhītvā pītamṛttikām || 11-1752 ||
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tathā samīvṛkṣaṃ mahīpatiḥ | niyuddhaṃ prekṣya mallānāṃ bhaṭānāṃ śastralāghavam || 11-1753 ||
bharatānāṃ preṣaṇaṃ ca dhāvanaṃ gajavājinām | astaṃ gate dinamaṇau dīpikāśatasaṃvṛtaḥ || 11-1754 ||
praviśennagaraṃ rājā kolāhalapuraḥsaram | anena vidhinā yastu kurute śāradaṃ maham || 11-1755 ||
tasya devī sadā tuṣṭā sadā naiva vimuñcati | phalaṃ yacchāradārcāyā vaktuṃ tat kena śakyate || 11-1756 ||
īdṛśeva ca vāsantī pūjā kāryā madhau site || 11-1756ef ||
iti durgotsavavidhiḥ |
bibhratyadbhutabhūtibhūtapavacovaivitryacitrāmṛta (-) srotaḥśālini sannibandhasaritasaṃbhedamabhyarhitam | sanmuktopamayuktiśālini taraṅgaḥ prāradekādaśo vijñaśrīnaradevanirmitapuraścaryārṇave'smin nave || 11-1757 ||
[iti śrīmanmahārājādhirājapratāpasiṃhasāhaviracite puraścaryāṇave durgāmantrapuraścaraṇadurgotsavavidhirnāmaikādaśastaraṅgaḥ] || 11 ||
atha brahmāṇyādimantrāstatpuraścaraṇaviśeṣāśca nirūpyante |
(merutantre) munaya ūcuḥ |
devadeva mahādeva bhaktānugrahakāraka | brāhmyādyaṣṭau bhāskarasya rathe tiṣṭhanti śaktayaḥ || 12-1 ||
raṇe mṛtānāṃ yogena mṛtānāṃ sahagāminām | svargaṃ yāśca prayacchanti tanmanūn brūhi śaṅkara || 12-2 ||
śiva uvāca
brahmaśaktistu śaktīnāṃ nāyikā parikīrtitā | yogināṃ muktidatrī sā bhogināṃ bhogadā matā || 12-3 ||
brāmityekākṣaraṃ bījaṃ munirvāspatirmataḥ | gāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ baḥ śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ vacaḥ || 12-4 ||
atha dhyānam
dhyāyedbrāhmīṃ palāsthāṃ haṃsārūḍhāṃ caturbhujām | akṣamālāvarābhītikamaṇḍalukarāruṇām || 12-5 ||
bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni (---------) iti |
asya puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ palāśasamidhairhunet | tatpuṣpayuktasalilaistarpayenmārjayet kuśaiḥ || 12-6 ||
atha māheśvarīmantraḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi samyaṅmāheśvarīvidhim | oṃ hrī(/) namo bhagavati māheśvaryai hi saṃvadet || 12-7 ||
parame padamuccāryeśvaryai svāhāntako manuḥ | tārādirekaviṃśārṇo'śvāruḍhā tatparaṃ matam || 12-8 ||
dhyānam |
vṛṣārūḍhāṃ bhālacandrāṃ trinetrāṃ śaśisannibhām | dadhatīṃ śūlaḍamarumahāhivalayāṃ bhaje || 12-9 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ vilvapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥ | juhuyāt taddaśāṃśena mahadaiśvaryavān bhavet || 12-10 ||
atha kaumārīmantraḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kaumāryā vidhimuttamam | krau(/) kaumāryai nama iti ṣaḍarṇo mantra īritaḥ || 12-11 ||
munirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chandaḥ kaumārikā bhavet | devatā kaumidaṃ bījaṃ kaumāryai śaktirucyate || 12-12 ||
mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni hṛdi dhyāyecca devatām |
dhyānaṃ yathā |
śaktyakṣasragvarābhītikarāṃ bandhūkasannibhām || 12-13 ||
mayūradhvajinīṃ raktavastrāmaudumbarasthitām | haritkañcukikāṃ ramyāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 12-14 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṣaṭkaṃ japaḥ proktaḥ pañcakhādyaistathā hunet | madhuratrayasaṃyuktaḥ siddhamantrastadā bhavet || 12-15 ||
tarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā kumārīṇāṃ ca bhojanam |
atha vaiṣṇavīmantraḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vaiṣṇavīmantramadbhutam || 12-16 ||
akacaṭatapayaśā vaiṣṇavyā mantra īritaḥ | aṣṭākṣaro manuścāsya nārado'nuṣṭuvucyate || 12-17 ||
chandastu vaiṣṇavī devī nyāsaḥ praṇavapūrvakaḥ | mūlamantrākṣaraiḥ kuryāt tribhistribhiranukramāt || 12-18 ||
ekaikaṃ ca japet paścādaṅgāni ṣaḍanukramāt |
atha dhyānam |
śoṇapadmapratīkāśāṃ muktamūrdhajalambinīm || 12-19 ||
lasatkāñcanasambhūtakuṇḍalojjvalaśālinīm | svarṇaratnasamunnaddhakirīṭasūtradhāriṇīm || 12-20 ||
kṛṣṇaśuklāruṇairnetraistribhiścāruvibhūṣitām | bandhūkadantavasanāṃ śirīṣaprabhanāsikām || 12-21 ||
kambugrīvāṃ viśālākṣīṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhām | caturbhujāṃ suvasanāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām || 12-22 ||
dakṣiṇābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ tu khaḍgaṃ ca japamālikām | bibhratīṃ vāmahastabhyāmabhayaṃ ca varaṃ tathā || 12-23 ||
analpanāganāsoruṃ guptagulphāṃ supārṣṇikām | gātreṇa ratnastambhaṃ ca samyagālambya saṃsthitām || 12-24 ||
kimicchasīti vacanaṃ vyāharantīṃ muhurmuhuḥ | pañcānanaṃ puraḥ saṃsthaṃ nirīkṣantīṃ svavāhanam || 12-25 ||
īdṛśīṃ caṇḍikāṃ dhyāyediti śeṣaḥ | atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣadvayaṃ japedasya puraścaraṇakarmasu | daśāṃśaṃ homamājyena karttavyaṃ tarpaṇādikam || 12-26 ||
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
oṃ namo'nte ca vaiṣṇavyai mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | mantrārṇairatra cāṅgāni śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 12-27 ||
athāparājitāvaiṣṇavīmantrastatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vaiṣṇavīmaparājitām | tāramākarṣiṇipadamāveśini tato vadet || 12-28 ||
jvālāmālini ramaṇi rāmaṇi dharaṇīti ca | dharaṇi tapanītyuktvā tāpini manonmādini || 12-29 ||
śoṣiṇīti padaṃ procya tataḥ saṃmohinīti ca | tathā nīlapatāke ca mahānīle mahāpriye || 12-30 ||
mahāgneyi mahācaṇḍe mahāraudri maheti ca | vajriṇīti tathā'dityaraśmijāhnavi saṃvadet || 12-31 ||
yamaghaṇṭe kilikilicintāmaṇipadaṃ vadet | surabhisurotpanne ca sarasvatipadaṃ tataḥ || 12-32 ||
sarvakāmadughe procya yathā mama manīṣitam | kāryaṃ tanme sidhyatviti svāhānto'yaṃ manurmataḥ || 12-33 ||
ṣaḍdvādaśārṇo munyādiḥ prāgvat saukhyaprado manuḥ | japedvarṇaśataṃ homādikaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 12-34 ||
atha vārāhīmantraḥ |
atha vārttālikāṃ vakṣye vārāhīṃ śatrughātinīm | ai(/) lau(/) ṭha(/) ṭha(/) ṭhamiti hu(/) svāhānto'ṣṭākṣaro manuḥ || 12-35 ||
chando'nuṣṭup ca kapilo munirvārttālikā surī | vārāhyatra ṣaḍaṅgāni kramāddvibhvindubhūbhūbhiḥ || 12-36 ||
dvābhyāṃ dhyāyet tato devīṃ vidyudbhāsāṃ karāmbujaiḥ | dadhānāmaṅkuśaṃ pāśaṃ mudgaraṃ śaktimeva ca || 12-37 ||
vidyudbhāsāṃ trinetrāṃ ca nāśayantīṃ tathā ripūn |
atha puraścaraṇam |
vasulakṣaṃ japitvā'nte vilvapatrairhayārijaiḥ || 12-38 ||
dhātrīphalairbhṛṅgarājaiḥ kuśaiścāpi daśāṃśataḥ | homaḥ kāryastarpaṇādi kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam || 12-39 ||
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogān karttumarhati |
atha śyāmalāmantraḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mālāmantraṃ susiddhidam || 12-40 ||
oṃ ai(/) glau(/) ai(/) namaḥ procya tato bhagavatīti ca | vārtālivārāhiyugaṃ vārāhamukhivābhavam || 12-41 ||
glau(/) andhe andhinīti namo rundhe ca rundhini | namo bhañje bhañjinīti namo moheti mohini || 12-42 ||
namastambhe stambhinīti nama ai(/) glau(/) ca vāgbhavam | sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvavāgvadet || 12-43 ||
cittacakṣurmukhagatijihvāstambhaṃ kurudvayam | śīghraṃ vaśyaṃ kuru kuru ai(/) glau(/) ai(/) ṭhacatuṣṭayam || 12-44 ||
hū(/) phaṭ svāheti mantro'yaṃ vedarudrākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ | muniḥ śivo'sya jagatī chando vārtālikā surī || 12-45 ||
vārāhyasya ṣaḍaṅgāni vārttālī hṛdayaṃ smṛtam | vārāhyasya śiraḥ proktaṃ śikhā vārāhamukhyapi || 12-46 ||
andhe andhini varmoktaṃ rundhe rundhini netrakam | bhañje bhañjini cāstraṃ syāt tato dhyāyecca caṇḍikām || 12-47 ||
atha dhyānam |
raktābjakarṇikāyāṃ tu śavāsanasamāsthitām | muṇḍamālālasatkaṇṭhāṃ nīlābhāṃ dadhatīṃ karaiḥ || 12-48 ||
abhayaṃ muśalaṃ cāpi halaṃ cāpi varaṃ tathā | vārāhāsyāṃ tuṅgakucāṃ trinetrāmaruṇāmbarām || 12-49 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
japenmantraṃ sahasrāṇi bandhūkakusumaistilaiḥ |
juhuyāt (-----------------------------------------) iti ||
atha svapnavārāhīmantraḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vārāhīṃ svapnasaṃjñikām || 12-50 ||
oṃ hrī(/) namaśca vārāhīghore svapnaṃ visargayuk | ṭhadvayaṃ vahnijāyānto mantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ || 12-51 ||
īśvaro'sya muniḥ prokto jagatī chanda īritam | devatā svapnavārāhī bījaṃ tāraḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 12-52 ||
hṛllekhā śaktiruddiṣṭā ṭhadvayaṃ kīlakaṃ matam |
atha dhyānam |
tato dhyāyedghanaśyāmāṃ trinetrāmunnatastanīm || 12-53 ||
kolāsyāṃ candrabhālāṃ ca daṃṣṭroddhṛtavasundharām | khaḍgāṅkuśau dakṣiṇayorvāmayoścarmapāśakau || 12-54 ||
aśvārūḍhāṃ ca kolāsyāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām |
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ japeddaśāṃśena nīlapadmaistilairhunet || 12-55 ||
athendrāṇīmantraḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi indrāṇīṃ naṣṭarājyadām | indrāṇīṃ nama iti mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 12-56 ||
gururmuniśca gāyatrī chando devīndravallabhā | i(/) bījaṃ śaktirindraṇīṃ namaḥ kīlakamucyate || 12-57 ||
atha dhyānam |
vajrapāśavarābhītihastā śyāmāmbarāvṛtā | caturdantagajākalpacchāyāsaṃsthā hiraṇyabhā || 12-58 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṣaṭkaṃ japenmantraṃ mālatīkusumairhunet | trimadhvaktaistāvadeva rājyārthaṃ rājavṛkṣakaiḥ || 12-59 ||
atha cāmuṇḍāmantrastantrāntare |
māyābījaṃ samuccārya cāmuṇḍā ṅeyutā punaḥ | namo'nto nagavarṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 12-60 ||
śivo muniśca gāyatrī chando'muṣya ca devatā | cāmuṇḍā mantravarṇaiśca dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam || 12-61 ||
atha dhyānam |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmacaturbāhusamanvitā | khaṭvāṅgaṃ candrahāsaṃ ca bibhratī dakṣiṇe kare || 12-62 ||
vāme carma va pāśaṃ ca ūrdhvato bhāvataḥ punaḥ | dadhatī muṇḍamālāṃ ca vyāghracarmāmbarādharā || 12-63 ||
kṛśāṅgī dīrghadaṃṣṭrā ca atidīrghā'tibhīṣaṇā | lolajihvā nimnaraktanayanākārabhīṣaṇā || 12-64 ||
kabandhavāhanāsīnā vistāriśravaṇānanā |
atha puraścaraṇam |
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ madhuraplutaiḥ || 12-65 ||
pāyasairjuhuyānmantrī tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ |
atha mahālakṣmīmantrastatraiva |
māyābījaṃ samuddhṛtya svabījaṃ ca samuddharet || 12-66 ||
tato ṅentā mahālakṣmīrnamo'nto'ṣṭākṣaro manuḥ | munirasya śivaḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam || 12-67 ||
devatā tu mahālakṣmīrmantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
atha dhyānam |
suvarṇavarṇadīptāṅgī trinetrā siṃhavāhinī || 12-68 ||
īṣatprahasitā devī nīlotpaladalekṣaṇā | bhujaṣoḍaśasampannā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā || 12-69 ||
khaḍgaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ śaraṃ sūtramaṅkuśaṃ śūlapadmakam | dadhānā dakṣiṇairhastairanāthebhyo varapradā || 12-70 ||
tathā vāmairhastapadmaiḥ kheṭakaṃ ḍiṇḍimaṃ dhanuḥ | kamaṇḍaluṃ nāgapāśaṃ kapālaṃ pustakābhayam || 12-71 ||
jājvalyamānā tejobhiratīvāhlādakāriṇī |
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ madhuraplutaiḥ || 12-72 ||
vidadhyāt pāyasairhomamevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥ |
ityaṣṭamātṛkāprakaraṇam |
atha gorakṣanāthamantraḥ |
(kalpadrumatantre)
garga uvāca |
atha mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ yadunandana || 12-73 ||
japanti sādhakā vīrāstanmantrān śraddhayā'nvitāḥ | śīghraṃ bhavati siddhirvai sādhakānāṃ śivājñayā || 12-74 ||
tathā |
gorakṣasya manuṃ japtvā yogīndro bhavitā naraḥ | vinā gorakṣamantreṇa yogasiddhirna jāyate || 12-75 ||
gorakṣasya prasādena sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet |
mantrā yathā |
oṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) hu(/) phaṭ svāhā | oṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) go(/) gorakṣa hu(/) phaṭ svāhā | oṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) go(/) gorakṣa hu(/) hu(/) nirañjanātmane hū(/) phaṭ svāhā | oṃ śrī(/) go(/) hrī(/) ha(/) hā(/) gorakṣanāthāya nirañjanātmane ha(/) sa(/) phaṭ hasaḥ |
iti catvāro mantrāḥ | atha gāyatrī |
oṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) go(/) gobījāya vidmahe gorakṣāya dhīmahi tanno nirañjanaḥ pracodayāt |
atha ṛṣyādināsaḥ |
gorakṣanāthamantrasya bṛhadāraṇyako muniḥ || 12-76 ||
chando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca nātho gorakṣasaṃjñakaḥ |
karāṅganyāsastu |
oṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) go(/) gorakṣanāthāya aṅgaṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ(-) ityādi |
atha dhyānam |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo jaṭājūṭī trilocanaḥ || 12-77 ||
nirañjano nirākāro nirvikalpo nirāmayaḥ |
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ śatādhikaṃ japtvā sādhakaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ || 12-78 ||
sādhayet sarvakāryāṇi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | dhārayedyo naro nityaṃ mantramenaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 12-79 ||
sa yogasiddhimāpnoti gorakṣasya prasādataḥ |
atha śītalāmantro (merutantre)
atha vakṣye maheśasya vastraprakṣālikā tu yā || 12-80 ||
śītaleti ca vikhyātā masūryā cipiṭeśvarī | tāro māyā ramā śītalāyai hṛcca navākṣaraḥ || 12-81 ||
(yāmale tu) |
māyā śrīśītalā ṅentā hṛdanto'ṣṭākṣaro manuḥ (-) ityuktam |
(merau)
upamanyurmuniśchando bṛhatī śītalā surī | ṣaḍdīrghayuktrapālakṣmībījābhyāṃ syāt ṣaḍaṅgakam || 12-82 ||
atha dhyānaṃ (yāmalādau)
namāmi śītalāṃ devīṃ rāsabhasthāṃ digambarām | mārjanīkalaśopatāṃ sūrpālaṅkṛtamastakām || 12-83 ||
(merau)
dhyāyecca śītalāṃ devīṃ rāsabhasthāṃ digambarām | mārjanīsūrpahastāṃ ca raktapuṣpahimārcitām || 12-84 ||
tailādimalasaṃyuktavastrapoṭaliśīrṣakām | trikoṇāntaryajeddevīṃ kodravāṃ ca masūrikām || 12-85 ||
śarāvikāṃ ca koṇeṣu bhūpure tvaṣṭabhairavān |
atha puraścaraṇam |
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ pāyasena daśāṃśataḥ || 12-86 ||
hutvā kṛtvā tarpaṇādi mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate | nābhimātre jale sthitvā yaḥ sahasraṃ japenmanum || 12-87 ||
tena saṃmārjitāstīvrāḥ sphoṭā naśyanti tatkṣaṇāt | sādhito yena mantro'yaṃ tasya vaṃśe na śītalā || 12-88 ||
tenābhimantritaṃ bhasma yadgehe tatra sā na hi |
etatpuruṣasyāpi mantrastatraivoktaḥ |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhartturasyāḥ paraṃ manum || 12-89 ||
tāraḥ prāsādabījaṃ ya(/) va(/) vyomavyāpine dviṭhaḥ | ekādaśārṇamantro'yaṃ nyāsadhyānārcanādikam || 12-90 ||
prāsādamantravajjñeyamardhalakṣaṃ puraskṛtiḥ | daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādājyaistarpaṇādi tataścaret || 12-91 ||
iti śītalāprakaraṇam |
athoktadevatānāṃ pūjāyantrāṇi pradarśyante | tatrādau vighnarājayantraṃ (merutantre)
śrīparṇyādikṛte pīṭhe racayet kuṅkumādinā | caturdvārayutaṃ kuryāccaturasratrayaṃ śubham || 12-92 ||
tanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃ kāryaṃ pūjāpīṭhaṃ gaṇeśituḥ |
atha lakṣmīgaṇeśayantraṃ tatraiva |
aṣṭapatrāmbujadvandvaṃ karṇikākeśarojjvalam || 12-93 ||
caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtam |
śaktigaṇeśakṣiprasādaharembaharidrā gaṇeśayantraṃ vighnarājayantravat | atha mahāgaṇapatiyantraṃ tatraiva |
dharmādikḷpte pūrvokte tīvrādinavaśaktike || 12-94 ||
pūjāyantraṃ gaṇeśasya mātṛkāpadma ucyate | caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ caturasratrāyavṛtam || 12-95 ||
tatkarṇikāyāṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadantaśca trikoṇakam |
virañcigaṇanāyakayantraṃ vighnarājayantravat | vakratuṇḍayantraṃ lakṣmīgaṇeśayantravat | evamagrimayorapi vighnarājasamānam | atha sūryayantraṃ (saurapaddhatau)
likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tadbāhye'ṣṭadalaṃ likhet || 12-96 ||
caturasraṃ tato bāhye sūryayantramidaṃ smṛtam |
(mahākramārcanapaddhatau tu)
madhye'ṣṭadalapadmaṃ ca aṣṭaśṛṅgaṃ tataḥ param || 12-97 ||
dvādaśāraṃ ca kamalaṃ vedāsradvārameva h i(-) ityuktam | kvacit tu caturasrāvṛtamaṣṭadalamātramuktam | anyatra tu dvādaśadalapadmamuktam | atha viṣṇuyantraṃ tatraiva |
aṣṭapatraṃ likhet padmaṃ karṇikākeśarojjvalam | caturasrāvṛtaṃ bāhye pūjāpīṭhaṃ madhudviṣaḥ || 12-98 ||
atha matsyayantram |
ṣaṭpatraṃ vilikhet padmaṃ tadbāhye ca caturdalam | saptapatraṃ tu tadbāhye tadbāhye'ṣṭadalaṃ likhet || 12-99 ||
tataścaturdaśadalaṃ tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśacchadam | vasucchadaṃ tu tadbāhye caturasraṃ tato bahiḥ || 12-100 ||
kūrmayantraṃ tu bhūpurāvṛtamaṣṭadalapadmameva | atha varāhayantraṃ (prapañcasāre)
aṣṭapatramatha padmamullasatkarṇikaṃ vidhivadāracayya ca | maṇḍalaṃ ravisahasrasannibhaṃ śūkaraṃ yajata tatra siddhaye || 12-101 ||
atha nṛsiṃhayantram (viṣvaksenasaṃhitāyām)
aṣṭapatraṃ likhet padmaṃ karṇikākeśarānvitam | tadbāhye'ṣṭadalaṃ lekhyaṃ tadbāhye'pi vasucchadam || 12-102 ||
caturasraṃ tato bāhye yantraṃ śrīnārasiṃhakam |
anyatra tu pūrvoktaviṣṇuyantrameva śrīnṛsiṃhayantramuktam | atha vāmanayantram |
ṣaḍdalaṃ padmamālikhya tadbāhye ṣoḍaśacchadam || 12-103 ||
tadbahirvasupatraṃ ca tadbāhye dvādaśacchadam | aṣṭapatraṃ tato bāhye tadbahirbhūpuratrayam || 12-104 ||
atha paraśurāmayantram |
ādau caturdalaṃ padmaṃ tadbāhye'ṣṭadalaṃ likhet | aṣṭapatraṃ tato bāhye tadbahirdaśapatrakam || 12-105 ||
tadbahirdvādaśāraṃ ca ṣoḍaśāraṃ ca tadbahiḥ | tadbahirbhūpuradvandvaṃ caturdvāropaśobhitam || 12-106 ||
atha raghunāthayantram |
aṣṭapatraṃ likhet padmaṃ ṣaṭkoṇojjvalakarṇikam | punaraṣṭadalaṃ bāhye likhedvṛttatrayādbahiḥ || 12-107 ||
tadbahirdvādaśadalaṃ tadbāhye ṣoḍaśacchadam | dantapatraṃ ca tadbāhye bhūpuratritayāvṛtam || 12-108 ||
atra kecit |
dehātmanoryathā bhedo mantradaivatayostathā |
tasmāt pīṭhe mahāmantraṃ likhitvā tatra pūjayet(-) iti ||
vaśiṣṭhavacanādasmin saparyāyantre'pi sādhāraṇayantroktamantravarṇān yathāsthānaṃ likhitvā śrīrāmaḥ pūjya iti vadanti | dhāraṇayatre mantralikhinaprakārastu (rāmatāpinyā-) muktaḥ |
yathā |
trirekhāpuṭamālikhya madhye tāradvayaṃ likhet || 12-109 ||
tanmadhye bījamālikhya tadadhaḥ sādhyamālikhet | dvitīyāntaṃ ca tasyordhve ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ sādhakaṃ tathā || 12-110 ||
kurudvayaṃ ca tatpārśve likhedbījāntare ramām | tatsarvaṃ praṇavābhyāṃ ca veṣṭayedbuddhiḥ(-) ṛddhimān || 12-111 ||
dīrghabhāji ṣaḍasreṣu likhedbījaṃ hṛdādibhiḥ | koṇapārśve ramāmāye tadagre'naṅgamālikhet || 12-112 ||
krodhaṃ koṇāgrāntareṣu likhenmantryabhito giram | vṛttatrayaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ saroje vilikhet svarān || 12-113 ||
keśare cāṣṭapatre ca vagastikamatho likhet | teṣu mālāmanorvarṇān vilikherdūrm i(-)(45>saṃkhyayā || 12-114 ||
ante pañcākṣarānevaṃ punaraṣṭadalaṃ likhet | teṣu nārāyaṇāṣṭārṇaṃ likhet tatkeśare ramām || 12-115 ||
tadbahirdvādaśadalaṃ vilikheddvādaśākṣaram | tathonnamo bhagavate vāsudevāyetyavyayam || 12-116 ||
ādikṣāntān keśareṣu vṛttākāreṇa saṃlikhet | tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ likhet tatkeśare hriyam || 12-117 ||
varmāstraratisaṃyuktaṃ daleṣu dvādaśākṣaram | tatsandhiśrīrajādīnāṃ mantrān mantrī samālikhet || 12-118 ||
hṛ(/) sṛ(/) bhṛ(/) vṛ(/) ḷ(/) ṣṛ(/) jṛ(/) ca likhet samyagato bahiḥ | dvādaśāre mahāpadmaṃ nādavindusamāyutam || 12-119 ||
vilikhenmantrarājārṇaṃ teṣu patreṣu yatnataḥ | dhyāyedaṣṭa vasūnekādaśa rudrā(/)stathaiva ca || 12-120 ||
dvādaśenā(/)śca dhātāraṃ vaṣaṭkāraṃ tato bahiḥ | bhūgṛhaṃ vajraśūlāḍhyaṃ rekhātrayasamanvitam || 12-121 ||
dvāropetaṃ ca rāśyādibhūṣitaṃ phaṇisaṃyutam | evaṃ maṇḍalamālikhya tasya dikṣu vidikṣu ca || 12-122 ||
nārasiṃhaṃ ca vārāhaṃ likhenmantradvayaṃ tathā | kūṭarephānugrahendunādaśaktyādibhiryutaḥ || 12-123 ||
yo nṛsiṃhaḥ samākhyāto grahamāraṇakarmaṇi | antyārghīśaviyadvindunādairbījaṃ ca śaukaram || 12-124 ||
hū(/)kāraṃ cātra rāmasya mālāmantro'dhuneritaḥ | tāro natiśca nidrāyāḥ smṛtirvedaśca kāmikā || 12-125 ||
rudreṇa sahitā vahnimedhāmaravibhūṣitāḥ | dīrghā krūrayutāhlādinyatho dīrghā samānadā || 12-126 ||
kṣudhā krodhinyamoghā ca viśvamapyatha medhayā | yuktā dīrghā jvālinī ca sasūkṣmā mṛtyurūpiṇī || 12-127 ||
sapratiṣṭhā'hlādinī tvak kṣveḍaṃ prītiśca sāmarā | jyotistīkṣṇā'gnisaṃyuktā śvetā'nusvārasaṃyutā || 12-128 ||
kāmikā pañcamolāntā stāntānto dhānta ityatha | sasānanto dīrghayukto vāyuḥ sūkṣmayuto viṣā || 12-129 ||
kāmikā kāmikā rudrayuktā'thopisthirāsase | tāpinī dīrghayuktā bhūranīlo'nantago'nalaḥ || 12-130 ||
nārāyaṇātmakaḥ kālaḥ prāṇo'mbho vidyayā yutam | pītā ratistathā lānto yukto yonyā tathā natiḥ || 12-131 ||
saptacatvāriṃśadarṇo guṇāntastvaguṇaḥ svayam | ayaṃ rājyābhiṣiktasya rāmasyoktakramāllikhet || 12-132 ||
idaṃ sarvātmakaṃ yantraṃ prāguktamṛṣisevitam | sevakānāṃ mokṣakaramāyurārogyavardhanam || 12-133 ||
aputrāṇāṃ putradaṃ ca bahunā kimanena vai | prāpnuvanti kṣaṇāt samyagatra dharmādikānapi || 12-134 ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramamīśvareṇāpi durgamam | idaṃ yantraṃ samākhyātaṃ na deyaṃ prakṛte jane || 12-135 ||
śrīkṛṣṇabalarāmayoryantraṃ tu pūrvāktaviṣṇuyantrameva | buddhayantraṃ tu bhūpurāvṛtadvātriṃśaddalaṃ padmam |
evaṃ dhyātvā yajet padme dvātriṃśatpatrasaṃmite |
iti (merutantra-) vacanāt | viṣṇuyantrameva kalkiyantram | hayagrīvādiyantramapi viṣṇuyantrameva | gopālasundarīyantraṃ śrīcakraṃ taccāgre vakṣyate | atha śivayantraṃ (prapañcasāre)
aṣṭapatraguṇavṛttarāśibhirvīthikalpatarubhiḥ samāvṛtam || 12-136 ||
maṇḍalaṃ pratividhāya śūlinaḥ pīṭhamantranavaśaktibhiryajet |
kvacit tu bhūpuratrayāvṛtāṣṭadalapadmatrayātmakaṃ śaivayantramuktam |
karṇikākeśarabhrājadvasupatratrayaṃ likhet || 12-137 ||
caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtam (-) iti ||
(siddhāntasaṃgrahe)
bhūpuratrayamadhye tu likhedaṣṭadalatrayam | keśarānādyapatreṣu madhye vinduṃ prakalpayet || 12-138 ||
atha dakṣiṇāmūrtiyantraṃ (merutantre)
padmatrayasamopete bhūgṛhatritayānvite |
caturdvārayut e(----------------------------)iti ||
atha pāśupatāstramantrayantraṃ tatraiva |
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikākeśarānvitam || 12-139 ||
caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtam |
atha vaṭukayantraṃ tatraiva |
śaive pīṭhe yajeddevamantarvyomāṣṭapatrakam || 12-140 ||
ūrdhvatrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇamaṣṭapatraṃ gṛhāvṛtam |
atha kṣetrapālayantraṃ tatraiva |
śaive pīṭhe yajedaṣṭapatre diksvarabhūṣite || 12-141 ||
atha bhavānīyantraṃ tantrāntare |
ādau trikoṇamālikhya tadbāhye'ṣṭadalāmbujam | bhūpuraṃ cāpi tadbāhye bhavānīmantra pūjayet || 12-142 ||
etadeva trikoṇa śūnyaṃ yantrāntaram | garuḍayantraṃ tu vakṣyamāṇamātṛkāyantrameva | pūjayenmātṛkāpadme garuḍaṃ vedavigraham (-) iti (merutantra-) vacanāt | kārttavīryayantraṃ tu pūrvoktaviṣṇuyantrameva | kāmyapūjāyāṃ tu viśeṣa ukto (merutantre)
athāto dakṣiṇe mārge vakṣyate kāmyapūjanam | śuddhabhūmāvaṣṭagandhairlikhedyantraṃ taducyate || 12-143 ||
likheddaśadalaṃ padme karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet | plau(/) klīmomaiśca patreṣu praṇavādyāni saṃlikhet || 12-144 ||
mantrasya navabījāni tato yantrāntareṣu ca | phaḍādidaśavarṇā(/)śca mantrasyaiva samālikhet || 12-145 ||
śaṣasahān svarā(/)ścāpi keśareṣu dviśo likhet | veṣṭayet kādibhirvarṇaiḥ śaṣasahavivarjitaiḥ || 12-146 ||
tadbāhye caturasraṃ tu veṣṭayedbhūtavarṇikaiḥ | kāmanābhedatastāni vāyvagnikṣmā jalaṃ nabhaḥ || 12-147 ||
pañca hrasvāḥ pañca dīrghā ekārādyāśca pañca ca | pañcavarṇā pañca yādyāḥ ṣakṣarāśca sahau kramāt || 12-148 ||
stambhane pārthivairāpyaiḥ śāntau vaśye ca taijasaiḥ | uccāṭane vāyavīyairvidverṣe cāpi nābhasaiḥ || 12-149 ||
māraṇe taijasaiḥ śāntau cāpyaiḥ puṣṭau ca pārthivaiḥ | asmin yantre toyapūrṇaghaṭe bhūpaṃ prapūjayet || 12-150 ||
kumbhaṃ spṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ tena secayet | samyak sādhyaṃ tadā sa syāt putravān rogavarjitaḥ || 12-151 ||
yaśasvī dīrghajīvī ca satkalatro'nurañjakaḥ | vāksiddhaścāpi tejasvī pratāpī vijitendriyaḥ || 12-153 ||
śatrūpadravamāpanno grāme vā maṇḍape pure | saṃsthāpayedidaṃ yantramaribhītinivṛttaye || 12-154 ||
atha vakṣye vāmagānāṃ yantrabhedaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat | likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ sasādhyaṃ phro(/) ca madhyataḥ || 12-155 ||
yau(/) yaimādyantayostasya likhet patreṣu ca kramāt | mantrabījāṣṭakaṃ cānte dale lekhyaṃ punaśca phaṭ || 12-156 ||
patrāntare śeṣavarṇānante varṇadvayaṃ likhet | dviśaḥ svarān keśareṣu dvidhoṣmārṇasamanvitān || 12-157 ||
vṛttadvayaṃ ca tadbāhye tayorvīthyāṃ ca kādikān | uṣmonā(/)ścaturasraṃ tu vajrāṣṭakasamanvitam || 12-158 ||
tadbāhye vilikhet tatra pūrvavadbhūtavarṇikān | snānārthaṃ ghaṭamānīyamanyat pūrvavadīritam || 12-159 ||
atha hanumadyantraṃ tantrāntare |
aṣṭapatraṃ likhet padmaṃ karṇikākeśarojjvalam | bhūpuraṃ ca tato bāhye likhitvā tatra pūjayet || 12-160 ||
atha smarayantraṃ tatraiva |
yantraṃ likhet tato vidvān vasupatrāmbujaṃ śubham | tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ caturasreṇa saṃyutam || 12-161 ||
atha mātṛkāyantraṃ (śāradāyām)
vyomendau rasanārṇakarṇikamacāṃ dvandvaiḥ sphuratkaśaraṃ yantrāntargatapañcavargayaśalārṇāditrivargaṃ kramāt | āśāsvastriṣu lāntalāṅgaliyujā kṣoṇīpureṇāvṛtaṃ padmaṃ kalpitamatra pūjayata tāṃ varṇātmikāṃ devatām || 12-162 ||
vyoma hakaraḥ | induḥ sakāraḥ | au iti svarūpam | rasanārṇo visargaḥ | tena hsauriti | āśāsvityādi | āśāsu dikṣu | asriṣu koṇeṣu | lānto vakāraḥ | lāṅgalī ṭhakāraḥ | tathā caturdikṣu vakārayukteṣu koṇeṣu ṭhakāra yuktenetyarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ spaṣṭam | bhūtalipiyantraṃ tu aṣṭadalopari ṣoḍaśadalaṃ tadupari caturdvārayuktaṃ caturasramiti (śāradā-)ṭīkāyāmuktam |
atha śyāmāsaparyāyantraṃ (kālītantre)
ādau trikoṇaṃ vinyasya trikoṇaṃ ca bahirnyaset | tato vai vilikhenmantrī trikoṇatrayamuttamam || 12-163 ||
tato vṛttaṃ samālikhya likhedaṣṭadalaṃ tataḥ | vṛttaṃ vilikhya vidhivallikhedbhūpuramekakam || 12-164 ||
yantrāntaramuktaṃ (kumārīkalpe)
ādau trikoṇaṃ vinyasya trikoṇaṃ tadbahirnyaset | bahistrikoṇamālikhya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ ca bahirnyaset || 12-165 ||
madhye tu vaindavaṃ cakraṃ bījenāpi vibhūṣitam | ṣaṭkoṇāt tu bahiḥ padmaṃ bhūpuraikeṇa saṃyutam || 12-166 ||
jñātvaivaṃ muktimāpnoti yantrametanna saṃśayaḥ | padmamaṣṭadalaṃ | bhūpuraṃ ca caturdvārayuktam | taduktaṃ (bhairavatantre)
śaktyagnibhyāṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tatra śaktitrayaṃ likhet | padmamaṣṭadalaṃ bhūmipūścaturdvārasaṃyutam || 12-167 ||
śaktyagnibhyāmiti | śaktiradhomukhatrikoṇam | agnirūrdhvamukhaṃ trikom | tābhyāṃ ṣaṭkoṇe siddhe tanmadhye vā'dhomukhatrikoṇatrayaṃ likhedityarthaḥ |
tathā | svarṇādiracite pātre raktacandanacarcite | svayambhukusumākte vā raktākte cānyathā śuci || 12-168 ||
raktacandanalekhanyā'tha vā svarṇaśalākayā |
raktacandanacarcite paśunā svayambhukusumādyakte vīreṇa yantraṃ lekhanīyamityarthaḥ | (kumārīkalpe)
etat tu vilikhet tāmre kuṇḍagolavilepite || 12-169 ||
svayambhukusumairyukte kuṅkumāruṇasevite |
(svatantratantre)
svayambhukusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthaṃ rocanā'guruḥ || 12-170 ||
kāśmīramṛganābhī ca madyaṃ malayajodbhavam | eṣa gandhaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvadā caṇḍikāpriyaḥ || 12-171 ||
etena gandhayogena yonicakrakramaṃ likhet |
(muṇḍamālāyām)
tāmrapātre kapāle vā śmaśāne kāṣṭhanirmite || 12-172 ||
śanibhaumadine vā'pi vīramṛtakasambhave | svarṇe raupye tathā lauhe cakramarcyaṃ vidhānataḥ || 12-173 ||
atrāpi kapālādividhevīreparatvaṃ veditavyam | atha guhyakālīyantraṃ (mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
savindutryārapañcāravibhinnanavakoṇayuk | vṛttayorantare'ṣṭārayutaṃ tadanu bhāvini || 12-174 ||
vasvarkabhūpacchadanāmbhojavṛttānvitaṃ tataḥ | aṣṭāśanisamāyuktamantarbahirathāpi ca || 12-175 ||
aṣṭaśūlāṣṭamuṇḍāḍhyaṃ vahnijvālāyutena hi | śmaśānenāvṛtaṃ śeṣe śoṇitodena veṣṭitam || 12-176 ||
yantrarājamidaṃ devi pūjanāya prakalpitam | bharataścyavanaścāpi hārītaśca javālakaḥ || 12-177 ||
dakṣaścaite janāḥ pañca pūjayantyamunā'mbikām | vinduḥ pañcāraṣaṭkoṇatrikoṇanavakoṇagaḥ || 12-178 ||
aṣṭāravṛttasahitaṣoḍaśacchadapadmayuk | punarvṛttānvitaḥ śeṣe pūrvavat sakalaṃ priye || 12-179 ||
pūjyo'yaṃ rāmayakṣeśanāhuṣāṇāṃ varānane |
atha kāmakalāyantraṃ tatraiva |
yantramasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi tatra dhehi manaḥ priye || 12-180 ||
bhūpure vasupatrāḍhye padmamaṣṭadalānvitam | keśarāṇi prakalpyāni tadantaścāpi karṇikām || 12-181 ||
karṇikāntastrikoṇasya tritayaṃ pṛthageva hi | bahistrikoṇakoṇeṣu likhedbījatrayaṃ śubham || 12-182 ||
māyābījaṃ tu vāme syāt krodhabījaṃ tu dakṣiṇe | adhaḥ pāśaṃ vinirdiśya kandarpārṇaṃ tu madhyataḥ || 12-183 ||
tadantaḥsthāyinī devī tatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | etadyantraṃ mahādevi sarvakāmaphalapradam || 12-184 ||
etasya sarvayantrāṇi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
atha śmaśānakālīyantraṃ (svatantratantre)
padmaṃ cāṣṭadalaṃ vṛttaṃ tadbāhye'ṣṭakavargakam || 12-185 ||
dharaṇyāṃ vilikhedādyaṃ catuṣkaṃ ca catuṣkakam | parvādi utarāntaṃ ca madhye devīṃ prapūjayet || 12-180 ||
atha siddhilakṣmīyantraṃ kālānalatantre |
yantroddhāramahaṃ vakṣye siddhilakṣmyā dvija śṛṇu | caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ vṛttatrayeṇa veṣṭitam || 12-181 ||
aṣṭāraṃ ca ravidalaṃ punaraṣṭadalaṃ likhet | ṣaṭkoṇamadhye koṇaṃ ca tatra vinduṃ vicintayet || 12-182 ||
atha tārāyantraṃ (pheravīye)
aṣṭapatraṃ likhet padmaṃ trikoṇojjvalakarṇikam | māyāṃ pūrvadale nyasya yāmye bījaṃ dvitīyakam || 12-183 ||
tathottare paścime ca phaṭkāraṃ vilikhet tataḥ |
madhye bījaṃ likhitvā (----------------) iti ||
(phetkāriṇītantre)
sayoni gomayenāṣṭapatramabjaṃ suśobhanam || 12-184 ||
bhūpuraṃ vasuvajrāḍhyaṃ yantramekajaṭātmakam |
(merutantre)
tatastāṃ pūjayet pīṭhe padme ṣaṭkoṇakarṇike || 12-185 ||
dharāgṛhāvṛte pīṭhamādāvarcyaṃ saśaktikam || 12-185ef ||
etayorbhūpuramadhikamuktam | tathā trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇayorvikalpaḥ (nīlatantre)
vyomendau rasanārṇakarṇikamacāṃ dvandvaiḥ sphuratkeśaraṃ vargollāsivasucchadaṃ vasumatīgehena saṃveṣṭitam | tārādhīśvaravārivarṇavilasaddikkoṇasaṃśobhitaṃ yantraṃ nīlatanoḥ paraṃ nigaditaṃ sarvārthasiddhipradam || 12-186 ||
idaṃ ca nīlasarasvatīyantraṃ nīlatanorityabhidhānāt | (phetkāriṇītantro-)ktayantramekajaṭāyāḥ | (pheravīyamerutantroktaṃ) ca tārāyā iti sampradāyavidaḥ |
kecit tu vyomendāvityādinā dhāraṇayantramuktam | pūrvoktāni yantrāṇi tāraikajaṭānīlasarasvatīsādhāraṇānīti vadanti | (matsyasūkte)
anuktakalpe yantraṃ tu likhet padmaṃ dalāṣṭakam | ṣaṭkoṇakarṇikaṃ vṛttaṃ vedadvāropaśobhitam || 12-187 ||
atha śrīyantraṃ (yāmale)
vindutrikoṇavasukoṇadaśārayugmaṃ manvasranāgadalasaṃyutaṣoḍaśāram | vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrarājamuditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ || 12-188 ||
asmin yantre keśarā na karttavyāḥ |
yo'smin yantre maheśāni keśarāṇi prakalpayet | yoginīsahitāstasya hiṃsāṃ kurvanti bhairavāḥ || 12-189 ||
iti (bhūtabhairavokteḥ) etaddarśanaphalamuktaṃ (yāmale)
samyak śatakratūn kṛtvā yat phalaṃ samavāpnuyāt | tat phalaṃ labhate bhaktyā kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanam || 12-190 ||
mahāṣoḍaśadānādi kṛtvā yallabhate phalam | tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanam || 12-191 ||
sārdhatrikoṭitīrtheṣu snātvā yat phalamaśnute | labhate tat phalaṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanam || 12-192 ||
atha pūjāphalam |
koṭiliṅgapratiṣṭhāyāṃ yat phalaṃ samudāhṛtam | tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ śrīcakrasya ca pūjanāt || 12-193 ||
atha dānaphalam |
śrīcakraṃ kārayitvā tu yo dadyāt sādhakāya ca | bhūcakraṃ tena dattaṃ hi saśailavanasāgaram || 12-194 ||
athaitatpādodakamāhātmyam |
gaṅgāpuṣkaranarmadāsayamunāgodāvarīgomatī (-) gaṅgādvāragayāprayāgavadarīvārāṇasīsindhuṣu | revāsetusarasvatīprabhṛtiṣu brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍodare tīrthasnānasahasrakoṭiguṇitaṃ śrīcakrapādodakam || 12-195 ||
athaitaccakroddhāraprakārastantrāntaroktaḥ pradarśyate |
vṛttaṃ kṛtveṣṭamānena madhye sūtraṃ tu pātayet | pūrvapaścimalagnāgraṃ dvicatvariṃśavadbhavet || 12-196 ||
pūrvadigbhāgataḥ kāryā rekhā doṣāpanupattaye | tyaktvā ṣaḍbhāgamādyā syādrekhā yāmyottarāśritā || 12-197 ||
pañcabhāgā(/)statastyaktvā dvitīyā'pi tathā bhavet | tato bhāgacatuṣkoṇa dūratastritayā bhavet || 12-198 ||
tato bhāgatrayaṃ tyaktvā rekhā syāt tu caturthikā | bhāgadvayaṃ tatastyaktvā rekhā kāryā'tha pañcamī || 12-199 ||
tato bhāgacatuṣkeṇa ṣaṣṭhī rekhā tathā bhavet | saptamī syāt tribhirbhāgaiścaturbhāgaistathā'ṣṭamī || 12-200 ||
navamī pañcabhirbhāgairevaṃ rekhā vidhāya tu | antaraṃ vṛttataḥ ṣadbhiraṃśairādyantarekhayoḥ || 12-201 ||
sūryādigrahanāmāni navānāṃ dhārayet kramāt | pārśvadvaye'pi karttavyaṃ rekhāgrāṇāṃ vimārjanam || 12-202 ||
agrayorubhayorlupyet sūrye bhāgatrayaṃ trayam | pañcabhāgān pralupyeta dvitīyā pārśvayordvayoḥ || 12-203 ||
mārjanaṃ ca bhavedevamagrayoḥ śanibhaumayoḥ | budharekhāgrayorlupyādbhāgān ṣoḍaśa yatnataḥ || 12-204 ||
aṣṭādaśa vilupyeta bhāgān gurvagrayordvayoḥ | ṣoḍaśobhayato lupyedbhāgān bhṛgvagrayostathā || 12-205 ||
rāhuketvoḥ krameṇa syādaṣṭaṣaḍbhāgamārjanam | sūryāgre cumbataḥ śukre madhyaṃ somāgrake punaḥ || 12-206 ||
cumbataḥ ketumadhyaṃ tu bhaumāgre vṛttacumbake | budhāgre rāhumadhyaṃ tu cumbatastadvadeva hi || 12-207 ||
cumbataḥ śanimadhyaṃ tu agrabhāgau bṛhaspateḥ | pūrvasyāṃ vṛttamadhyaṃ cumbato'gre śanerapi || 12-208 ||
rāhvagre sūryamadhyaṃ tu cumbatastadvadeva hi | ketvagre cumbato bhaumaṃ bhṛgvagre somacumbake || 12-209 ||
evaṃ cakraṃ likhitvā tu bhavedatimanoramam (-) iti |
bālāyantraṃ tu vakṣyamāṇatripurabhairavīyantravat | (tripurāsārasamuccaye) yantrāntaramuktam |
trikoṇaṃ vilikhyānu vṛttaṃ dalānāṃ tataḥ pañcakaṃ tadbahiścāpi vṛttam | punaḥ ṣaḍdalaṃ bāhyataścāpi vṛttaṃ likhedaṣṭapatrāṇi tadbāhyato'pi || 12-210 ||
atha bhuvaneśvarīyantram (śāradāyām)
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ bāhye vṛttaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirdalaiḥ | vilikhet karṇikāmadhye ṣaṭkoṇamatisundaram || 12-211 ||
caturasraṃ caturdvārameva maṇḍalamālikhet |
atha tripurabhairavīyantraṃ (śāradāyām)
padmamaṣṭadalopetaṃ navayonyāḍhyakarṇikam || 12-212 ||
caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ bhūgṛhaṃ vilikhet tataḥ |
atha caitanyabhairavīyantraṃ (jñānārṇave)
trikoṇaṃ caiva ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatraṃ varānane || 12-213 ||
caturasraṃ caturdvāramevaṃ maṇḍalamālikhet |
bhuvaneśvarībhairavīkamaleśvarabhairavyorapi tadeva yantram | sampatpradābhairavīyantraṃ tripurabhairavīyantravat | kāmeśvarabhairavīyantraṃ caitanyabharavīyantravat | atha ṣaṭkūṭābhairavīyantraṃ (jñānārṇave)
yantramasyā varārohe trikoṇaṃ saṃpuṭaṃ likhet || 12-214 ||
bahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ ravipatraṃ tato likhet | caturasraṃ caturdvāramevaṃ maṇḍalamālikhet || 12-215 ||
atha rudrabharavīyantraṃ tatraiva |
trikoṇaṃ caiva vṛttaṃ ca vṛttāṣṭadalapaṅkajam |
vṛttaṃ bhūmaṇḍalaṃ ca (--------------) iti ||
atha chinnamastāyantraṃ (yāmale)
trikoṇaṃ vinyasedādau tanmadhye maṇḍalatrayam || 12-216 ||
tanmadhye vilikhedyoniṃ dvāratrayasamanvitam | bahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ bhūvimbatritayaṃ punaḥ || 12-217 ||
kūrmabījaṃ likhenmadhye trikoṇe hasamanvitam |
(tantrāntare)
athocyate yantrarājaṃ vairocanyā maheśvari || 12-218 ||
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ prathamaṃ lekhyaṃ madhyadeśe trikoṇakam | sūryavimbaṃ tato dadyāccaturasraṃ tataḥ param || 12-219 ||
bhūgolaṃ ca tato dadyāccaturasraṃ tataḥ param | aṣṭapatraṃ tato dadyādyathāsthānaṃ ca deśikaḥ || 12-220 ||
candrabimbaṃ tato dadyādvahnivimbaṃ tataḥ param | bhūgolaṃ ca tato dadyādbhūpuratritayaṃ tataḥ || 12-221 ||
vajraśūlasamāyuktaṃ koṇe ṭaṅkaṃ niyojayet | kiñjalke keśare dadyānmatravarṇā(/)strikoṇake || 12-222 ||
iti kāmopari dhyāyeddevīṃ vairocanīṃ śubhām |
(tantrāntare)
bhairavoktamahaṃ vakṣye yantraṃ sarvasamṛddhidam || 12-223 ||
trikoṇaṃ prathamaṃ lekhyaṃ ṣaṭkoṇairveṣṭayecca tat | trivimbaṃ ca tato dadyādguṇānāṃ pariṇāmakam || 12-224 ||
bhūpuratritayaṃ kuryādvajraśūlasamanvitam | koṇadeśe tato dadyāṭṭaṅkāstraṃ sumanoharam || 12-225 ||
yathāsthāne likheddhīmān karttṛkharparakaṃ śubham | ratikāmopari dhyāyeddevīṃ vairocanīṃ śubhām || 12-226 ||
(merutantre)
trikoṇaṃ rasakoṇaṃ vā'ṣṭadalaṃ bhūpuraṃ tataḥ |
atha dhūmāvatīyantraṃ tantrāntare |
likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ bhūpureṇa ca veṣṭitam || 12-227 ||
atha vagalāmukhīyantraṃ (merutantre)
sauvarṇe vā'tha vā raupye paittale vā'tha bhūrjake | karpūrāgurukastūrīśrīkhaṇḍakuṅkumairapi || 12-228 ||
likhedyantraṃ prayatnena lekhanyā hematārayoḥ | madhye yoniṃ samālekhya tadbāhye tu ṣaḍasrakam || 12-229 ||
tadbāhye'ṣtadalaṃ padmaṃ tadbāhye ṣoḍaśacchadam | caturasratrayaṃ bāhye caturdvāropaśobhitam || 12-230 ||
atha mātaṅgīyantraṃ tantrāntare |
ṣaṭkoṇāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ likhedyantraṃ manoramam | etasmin pūjayet pīṭhe navaśaktīḥ kramādimāḥ || 12-231 ||
atha yantrāntaraṃ (merutatre)
trikoṇaṃ pañcakoṇaṃ ca bahiraṣṭadaladvayam | ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāṣṭadalaṃ bhūputritayaṃ likhet || 12-232 ||
etaddvayamapyucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinyāḥ | rājamātaṅgīyantraṃ tu taddhyānāt prāgevoktam | vaśyamātaṅgyādibhedānāmapi tadeva yantramākalanīyam |
atha sumukhīyantram |
trikoṇaṃ pañcakoṇaṃ ca vṛttamaṣṭadalāvṛtam | caturasraṃ ca tadbāhye sumukhīyantramīritam || 12-233 ||
atha lakṣmīyantraṃ (merutantre)
dharmādikalpite pīṭhe bhūpuradvāraśobhite | dalādaṣṭake keśarākhye karṇikāyāṃ yajedimām || 12-234 ||
bhūpurāveṣṭitamaṣṭadalapadmatrayātmakaṃ yantramanyatroktam | atha sarasvatīyantraṃ tantrāntare |
padmamaṣṭadale lekhyaṃ caturasrāvṛtaṃ śubham | yantrametadvarārohe vāgdevyāḥ parikīrttitam || 12-235 ||
tvaritāyā nityaklinnāyāśca yantraṃ pūrvoktabhuvaneśvarīyantravat | athānnapūrṇāyantraṃ (merutantre)
trikoṇaṃ ca catuḥpatraṃ vasupatraṃ tataḥ param | kalāpatraṃ ca bhūvimbaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtam || 12-236 ||
pratyaṅgirāyantramannapūrṇāyantravat | atha kubjikāyantram |
vindutrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇamaṣṭapatraṃ sakeśaram | śrīmatkubjeśvarīyantraṃ sadvāraṃ bhūpuratrayam || 12-237 ||
tantrāntare |
vindutrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇamaṣṭapatrāmbujaṃ tathā | samātṛbījāṣṭadalamaṣṭaśṛṅgaṃ sabhūpuram || 12-238 ||
gaṅgāyantraṃ tu sarasvatīyantravat | bhūpurāvṛtaṣaḍasraṃ vāgmatīyantram | aṣṭadalakamaladvayātmakaṃ candrayantram | atha bhaumayantraṃ (merutantre)
trikoṇaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya pañcadhā vibhajet tataḥ | tṛtīyarekhāṃ cihnābhyāṃ lāñchayet samabhāgataḥ || 12-239 ||
ādyarekhāgrayugalaṃ tṛtīyācihnayornyaset | dvitīyāgre samākṛṣya tṛtīyācihnayornyasen || 12-240 ||
yutā rekhā tṛtīyā tu samā bhājyā samaṃ tataḥ | turyā cihnadvayenātha tribhiścihnaiśca pañcamī || 12-241 ||
tṛtīyāgre prakurvīta pañcamyā madhyacihnaje | turyāgre yojayet samyak pañcamyā cihnayordvayoḥ || 12-242 ||
atha mīnadvaye dadyāt sūtrayugmaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | evamekādhikā samyak koṣṭhānāṃ viṃśatirbhavet || 12-243 ||
budhādīnāṃ yantraṃ tu bhūpurāvṛtāṣṭadalakamalam | teṣāṃ yantrāntarāṇi vistarabhayānna likhyante | piṅgalādigrahamātṛyantraṃ tu trikoṇapañcakoṇāṣṭadalabhūpurarūpam | ṣaḍdalādbahiraṣṭadalamindrayantram | agniyantramapi tadeva | aṣṭadalamātramagneryantrāntaram | yamayantramindrayantravat | nair(-)ṛtayantraṃ tu pañcakoṇagarbhāṣṭadalapadmam | ṣaḍdalādbahiraṣṭadalavaruṇayantram | ṣaḍdalādbahiraṣṭadalatrayaṃ vāyuyantram | kuverayantramaṣṭadalamātram | īśānayantraṃ śivayantravat | brahmayantraṃ tu daśadalapadmam | viṣṇuyantramevānantayantram | ṣaṭkoṇakarṇikaṣoḍaśadalapadmaṃ brāhmīyantram | pañcakoṇagarbhāṣṭadalakamalaṃ kaumārīyantram | vaiṣṇavīyantramaṣṭadalapadmam | tadeva vārāhīyantramapi |
mālāmantraṃ tu yantrāntaramuktaṃ (merutantre)
yonipañcāsraṣaṭkoṇāṣṭapatraśatapatrakam | sahasradalabhūvimbasaṃvītaṃ dvāraśobhitam || 12-244 ||
kailāśācalamadhyasthaṃ pīṭhametadvicintayet |
trikoṇaṣoḍaśadalāṣṭadaladaśadaladvayātmakaṃ svapnavārāhīyantraṃ tatraivoktam | ṣaṭkoṇagarbhāṣṭadalapadmamaindrīcāmuṇḍāmahālakṣmīyantram |
navadurgātmakacāmuṇḍāmantrayantraṃ tu tatrāntare |
etanmantrāvṛtatryasraṣaṭkoṇāṣṭadalaṃ likhet || 12-245 ||
pañcaviṃśaddalaṃ bāhye caturasrāvṛtaṃ śubham |
atha durgāyantraṃ (merutantre)
aṣṭapatrāmbujadvandvaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtam || 12-246 ||
caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ kuṅkumādibhiruddharet |
atha yantrapuraścaraṇaṃ tatrāntare |
ādau yantrasya siddhyarthe tanmantrasya puraskriyām || 12-247 ||
kṛtvā'yutapramāṇena paścādyantrasya vā'caret | yathā'dhāre yathādravyairyantraṃ saṃlikhya yatnataḥ || 12-248 ||
tatrāvāhyaiva taddevaṃ saṃpūjya vidhipūrvakam | dhyātvā baliṃ japaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ visarjayet || 12-249 ||
ekaikavāramāvarttya tanmantraṃ saṃsmaran budhaḥ | itthaṃ japādibhiḥ siddhe yantre nāsādhyatā kvacit || 12-250 ||
diksahasrapramāṇena yantre kāryā puraskriyā |
atha dhāraṇayantrasādhanamuktaṃ (merutantre)
atha yantravidhiṃ vakṣye sarvatantreṣu gopitam || 12-251 ||
siddhasya likhanādeva yantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate | na bhāvi yatra kāryaṃ tu siddhasyāpi tadā bhavet || 12-252 ||
duḥsvapnadarśanaṃ pūrvaṃ tadā yantraṃ na kārayet | sādhakasya śubhe ghasre samārādhyeṣṭadevatām || 12-252 ||
svapyāt tridivasaṃ bhūmau haviṣyāśī jape rataḥ | etadyantraṃ kariṣyāmi mama tat kīdṛśaṃ prabho || 12-252 ||
svapne vadaitaddeveśi tadaṅgatvena pūjanam | pradoṣasamaye kṛtvā likhet tridivasaṃ bhuvi || 12-253 ||
tṛtīyadivase rātrau yathā svapnaḥ prajāyate | tathaivājñāṃ gṛhītvā tu satsvapne cālikhedbhuvi || 12-254 ||
asvapne vā'tha duḥsvapne naiva kuryāllikheddhi tat | jīvasaṃsthāpanaṃ yantre kuryādyena phalaṃ labhet || 12-255 ||
ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ sādhakapadaṃ madhyabījordhvato likhet | dvitīyāntaṃ sādhyamadhaḥ kurudvandvaṃ ca pārsvayoḥ || 12-256 ||
hasauryantrasya jīvaḥ syānmadhyabhāgādadho likhet | haṃsaḥ so'haṃ manorasya likhedekaikamakṣaram || 12-257 ||
īśānādiṣu koṇeṣu dakṣapārśve ca idvayam | udvayaṃ vāmapārśve ca pūrvāśādau likhet kramāt || 12-258 ||
la(/) ra(/) ma(/) kṣa(/) tathā va(/) ya(/) sa(/) ha(/) pūrvādike likhet | īśānapūrvayormadhye ā(/) hrī(/) vāyavyasaumyayoḥ || 12-259 ||
evaṃ dikpālabījāni daśadikṣu nyaset kramāt |
yantrarājāya vidmahe varapradāya dhīmahi tanno yantraḥ pracodayāt |
etasyāḥ pratikāṣṭhāyāṃ likhedvarṇatrayaṃ trayam || 12-260 ||
bahiḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāyā mantraṃ sarvatra veṣṭayet | evaṃ tu likhitaṃ yantraṃ bhavet siddhipradāyakam || 12-261 ||
sthalānuktau bhūrjapatre kṣaume vā tāmrapatrake | yantraṃ vilikhya guṭikāṃ baddhvā sūtreṇa veṣṭayet || 12-262 ||
lākṣayā'cchāditaṃ svarṇe rupye tāmra'tha vā kṣipet | yaddevatārka yantraṃ syāt tadbījena ca pūjayet || 12-263 ||
tadabhāve mātṛkārṇairyantrapūjāṃ samācaret | aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu mūlaṃ japtvā hunedghṛtam || 12-264 ||
tatsaṃpātena saṃsiktaṃ kṛtvā yantraṃ niyojayet | mūrdhni bāhau gale vā'pi tattadiṣṭārthasiddhaye || 12-265 ||
(merutantre)
upāsyā vā bhūtalipiryantrasiddhividhāyinī | akleśenaiva sarveṣāṃ yantrāṇāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt || 12-266 ||
atha bhūtalipinirṇayaḥ (śāradāyām)
atha bhūtalipiṃ vakṣye sugopyāmapi durlabhām | yāṃ prāpya śambhormunayaḥ sarvān kāmān prapedire || 12-267 ||
pañca hrasvāḥ sandhivarṇā vyomerāgnirjalaṃdharā | antamādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ madhyamaṃ kramāt || 12-268 ||
pañcavargākṣarāṇi syurvāntaḥ śvetendubhiḥ saha | eṣā bhūtalipiḥ proktā dvicatvāriṃśadakṣaraiḥ || 12-269 ||
pañca hrasvā iti akārādayaḥ | sandhivarṇā ekārādayaścatvāraḥ | vyoma hakāraḥ | iro yakāraḥ agnī rephaḥ | jalaṃ vakāraḥ | dharā pṛthvī tadbījaṃ lakāraḥ | antamityādi vargasyeti śeṣaḥ | vāntaḥ śakāraḥ | śvetaḥ ṣakāraḥ | indu sakāraḥ | tathā |
āyaṃvarārṇāḥ vargāṇāṃ pañcamāḥ śārṇasaṃyutāḥ | vargādyā iti vijñeyā nava durgāḥ smṛtā amī || 12-269 ||
āyaṃvarārṇā iti | aśca e ca aṃvarārṇaśca te | āyaṃvarārṇā akāraikārahakārā ityarthaḥ | vargāṇāṃ pañcamā ṅañaṇanamāḥ | śārṇaḥ śakāraḥ | ete varṇā navānāṃ vargāṇāmādyā ityarthaḥ | bhūtalipitvaṃ darśayati |
vyomerāgnijalakṣoṇīvargavarṇān pṛthagviduḥ | dvitīyavarge bhūrna syānnavame sajalaṃdharā || 12-270 ||
bhūrna syāditi | dvitīyavarṇasya varṇacatuṣṭayātmakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | evamagre'pi bodhyam |
tathā |
viriñciviṣṇurudrāśviprajāpatidigīśvarāḥ | kriyādiśaktisahitā navadurgeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 12-271 ||
ṛṣiḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrtirgāyatrī chanda īritam | devatā kathitā sadbhiḥ sākṣādvarṇeśvarī parā || 12-272 ||
hādiṣaḍvarṇakaiḥ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgāni sajātibhiḥ |
(merutantre)
svarahīnairhayādyaiśca mantrārṇaiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥ || 12-273 ||
atha dhyānaṃ (śāradāyām)
dhyāyaillipitarormūle devīṃ tanmayapaṅkaje | vadanti sudhiyo vṛkṣaṃ nityaṃ varṇamayaṃ śubham || 12-274 ||
parasaṃvinmahābījaṃ vindunādamahāśipham | pṛthivyakṣaraśākhābhiḥ sarvāśāsu vijṛmbhitam || 12-275 ||
salilākṣarapatraiḥ svaiḥ saṃchāditayugatrayam | vahnivarṇāṅkurairdīptaṃ ratnairiva suradrumam || 12-276 ||
marudvarṇalasatpuṣpairdyotayantaṃ vapuḥśriyam | ākāśārṇaphalairnamraṃ sarvabhūtāśrayaṃ param || 12-277 ||
parāmṛtākhyamadhubhiḥ siñcantaṃ parameśvarīm | vedāgamādibhiḥ kḷptasamunnatimanoharam || 12-278 ||
śivaśaktimayaṃ sākṣācchāyāśritajagattrayam | etāmāśritya sudhiyaḥ sarvān kāmān prapedire || 12-279 ||
aṅkonmuktaśaśāṅkakoṭisadṛśīmāpīnatuṅgastanīṃ candrārdhānvitamastakāṃ madhumadādālolanetratrayām | bibhrāṇāmaniśaṃ varaṃ japavaṭīṃ vidyāṃ kapālaṃ karai (-) rādyāṃ yauvanagarvitāṃ lipitanuṃ vāgīśvarīmāśraye || 12-280 ||
atha puraścaraṇam |
lakṣaṃ nyasejjapet tāvajjuhuyādayutaṃ tilaiḥ | pūjayedanvahaṃ devīṃ pīṭhe prāgīrite sudhīḥ || 12-281 ||
(merutantre'pi)
lakṣaṃ prajapyādayutaṃ tilairhutvā ca tarpayet | evaṃ bhūtalipiḥ sevyā yantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 12-282 ||
śrīvidyārādhane vā'pi samartho jāyate naraḥ |
iti bhūtalipipuraścaraṇam |
atha mātṛkānyāsapuraścaraṇam (śāradāyām)
dīkṣitaḥ proktamārgeṇa nyasellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ || 12-282 ||
japet tatsaṃkhyayā vidvānayutaṃ madhurāplutaiḥ | vidadhīta tilairhomaṃ mātṛkāmanvahaṃ japet || 12-283 ||
iti mātṛkānyāsapuraścaraṇam | atha trilohīmudrā tatraiva |
somasūryāgnirūpāḥ syurvarṇā lohatrayaṃ tathā | raupyaminduḥ smṛto hema sūryastāmraṃ hutāśanaḥ || 12-284 ||
lohabhāgāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ svarādyakṣarasaṃkhyayā | tairlohaiḥ kārayenmudrāmasaṅkalitasaṅgatām || 12-285 ||
sāgraṃ sahasraṃ saṃjapya spṛṣṭvā tāṃ juhuyāt tataḥ | tasyāṃ saṃpātayenmantrī sarpiṣā pūrvasaṃkhyayā || 12-286 ||
niḥkṣipya kumbhe tāṃ mudrāmabhiṣekoktavartmanā | āvāhya pūjayeddevīmupacāraiḥ samāhitaḥ || 12-287 ||
abhiṣiñcya vinītāya dadyāt tāṃ mudrikāṃ guruḥ | iyaṃ rakṣā kṣudrarogaviṣajvaravināśinī || 12-288 ||
vyālacauramṛgādibhyo rakṣāṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ | yuddhe vijayamāpnoti dhārayenmanujeśvaraḥ || 12-289 ||
somasūryāgnirūpā iti | akārādayaḥ svarāḥ somarūpāḥ | kādayo māntāḥ sparśavarṇāḥ sūryarūpāḥ | yakārādayo vyāpakavarṇā agnirūpā ityarthaḥ | tatheti | tathaiva lohatrayamapi somasūryāgnirūpamityarthaḥ | etadeva sphuṭayati raupyamityādinā | bhāgā aṃśāḥ | svarādyakṣarasaṃkhyayeti | raupyasya ṣoḍaśa | hemnaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | tāmrasya daśabhāgā ityarthaḥ | asaṅkalitasaṅgatāmiti | asaṅkalitāmekarūpatāmanāpannām | saṅgatāṃ parasparasambaddhām | saṃjapyeti | japaścātra mātṛkāvarṇānāmeva | tasyāṃ saṃpādayediti | vāheti dutvā tasyāṃ mudrāyāṃ saṃpātājyaṃ niḥkṣipedityarthaḥ | abhiṣikoktavartmaneti | kāmyābhiṣekoktarītyatyerthaḥ | kāmyābhiṣekastu tatraiva |
pūrvoktaṃ paṅkajaṃ kṛtvā kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvavat | kvāthena pūrayenmantrī yathāvat kṣīraśākhinām || 12-290 ||
aṣṭagandhaṃ viloḍyāsmin navaratnasamanvite | āvāhya pūjayeddevīṃ mātṛkāmuktamārgataḥ || 12-291 ||
sahasraṃ sādhitaistoyairabhiṣiñcet priyaṃ naram | bhānuvāre śubhe lagne brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet || 12-292 ||
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbhaktiyuktaḥ svaśaktitaḥ | rakṣākaraṃ viśeṣeṇa kṛtvā drohopaśāntidam || 12-293 ||
aiśvaryajananaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvasaubhāgyasiddhidam |
abhiṣekamimaṃ prāhurviśvasaṃmohanaṃ param (-) iti ||
devīṃ mātṛkāsarasvatīm | abhiṣiñcyeti | abhiṣekastu vilīmamātṛkāvarṇaiḥ kāryaḥ |
abhiṣiñcedvilomena sādhyantaṃ dattadakṣiṇam || 12-294 ||
ityabhiṣekāntare tatraivoktatvāt | atha navaratnamudrā tatraiva |
vibhajenmātṛkāṃ mantrī navavargān yathākramāt | aṣṭāvaṣṭau svarāḥ sparśāḥ pañcaśo vyāpakā api || 12-295 ||
navavargāḥ samutpannāḥ navaratneśvaragrahāḥ | arkendaraktajñagurubhṛgumandāhiketavaḥ || 12-296 ||
māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ cāru vidrumaṃ gāruḍaṃ punaḥ | puṣparāgaṃ lasadvajraṃ nīlaṃ gomedakaṃ śubham || 12-297 ||
vaidūryaṃ navaratnāni mudrāṃ taiḥ kalpayecchubhām | japahomādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanā || 12-298 ||
yo mudrāṃ dhārayedenāṃ tasya syurvaśagā grahāḥ | vahate tasya saubhāgyaṃ lakṣmīrapyahatā bhavet || 12-299 ||
kṛtyā drohā vinaśyanti naśyanti sakalāpadaḥ | rakṣobhūtapiśācādyā nekṣante taṃ bhayākulāḥ || 12-300 ||
uparyupari vardhante dhanaratnādisampadaḥ |
iti navaratnamudrā | atha ṣoḍhānyāsapuraścaraṇaṃ tantrāntare |
devībhāvasamāyuktaḥ ṣoḍhānyāsaparo bhavet || 12-301 ||
daśavidyāvidhau sā ca daśadhā bhinnabhinnataḥ | pratyekaṃ ṣaḍṛṣiṃ taṃ taṃ taddhyānaṃ ca samācaret || 12-302 ||
ṛṣicchandādikaṃ yatra kīrtitaṃ parameśvari | tadeva tatra gaditamanukte mūladevavat || 12-303 ||
dhyānaṃ chandādikaṃ stotraṃ devīvat sarvameva tu | ayutaṃ ca puraścaryā nyāsastatkramayogataḥ || 12-303 ||
iti ṣoḍhānyāsapuraścaraṇam | atha sahasranāmastavakavacānāṃ puraścaraṇaṃ tatraiva |
īśvara uvāca |
sahasranāmastotreṣu kavaceṣvapi pārvati | kavacādau tu yā proktā sā vai kāryā puraskriyā || 12-304 ||
yatrānuktā puraścaryā tatra kiṃ vā vidhīyate | ayutaṃ tu puraścaryā stotramātre prakīrtitā || 12-305 ||
sahasranāmakavace puraścaryā tviyaṃ matā | evaṃ puraskriyāṃ kṛtvā daśāṃśaṃ havanādikam || 12-306 ||
tarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ devi kutracit parikīrttitam | mahākālamate proktaṃ tatrasthaṃ cet samācaret || 12-307 ||
viprasaṃtoṣaṇenaiva sarvaṃ siddhyati pārvati | havanaṃ tu tathā kāryaṃ puraścaryādikaṃ bhavet || 12-308 ||
sahasranāmarūpaṃ vai kīdṛśaṃ parameśvari | tathā ca kavacaṃ devi kiṃrūpaṃ parikīrttitam || 12-309 ||
śivadevyostu saṃvādo brahmarandhraṃ prakīrttitam | anye ślokāḥ keśatulyā ṛṣiḥ śira udīritam || 12-310 ||
chando mukhaṃ bhaveddevi devatā hṛdayaṃ bhavet | bījaṃ guhyamiti proktaṃ śaktiṃ tu padagāṃ viduḥ || 12-311 ||
sarvāṅgaṃ kīlakaṃ devi hyarthavādaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | stotramadhye sthitaṃ yadyat tat sarvaṃ stotrarūpakam || 12-312 ||
evaṃ ca devadeveśi stotrarūpaṃ prakīrttitam | tathaiva kavacaṃ devi jñātvā pāṭhaṃ paṭhet priye || 12-313 ||
aṅgahīne bhavennāśaḥ sarvathā parameśvari | phalastutyādikaṃ devi aṅgamityabhidhīyate || 12-314 ||
ādyopāntaṃ vinā devi phalamardhaṃ prakīrttitam | atrārthe pratyayo devi ṣaḍaṅgādyā yathā smṛtāḥ || 12-315 ||
havanaṃ kavacādīnāṃ ślokānte vihitaṃ ca vā | ādyopāntaṃ paṭhitvā tu paścāt tu havanaṃ matam || 12-316 ||
ādau pūrṇaṃ tu saṃpaṭhya tathaivānte maheśvari | madhye nāmāni pādyāni puraścaryā prakīrttitā || 12-317 ||
ślokānte havanaṃ proktaṃ ślokānte mārjanādikam | tatra stotroktavidhinā puraścaryādikaṃ caret || 12-318 ||
stotramāvarttya saṃpūrṇaṃ tadante gaṇānāṃ caret | saṃpūrṇahomayogo'yaṃ kathitaste priyaṃvade || 12-319 ||
sārūpyaṃ kavacākhyaṃ ca sāyujyaṃ stotramīritam | sānnidhyaṃ nāmasāhasraṃ tritayaṃ parikīrttitam || 12-320 ||
kavacaṃ kavacarūpaṃ syāt stotraṃ sahacaro bhavet | sahasranāmastotraṃ tu pūjāsthāne prakīrttitam || 12-321 ||
pūjā durgāsvarūpā syādbalidānaṃ tu māraṇam | mantro rājā puraścaryā rājyasaṃpattirīritā || 12-322 ||
saṃpattyā tu vinā rājā na śobhati maheśvari | saṃpattimūlametaddhi sarvameva prakīrttitam || 12-323 ||
homo mantraḥ iti proktaḥ parjanyāstraṃ tu tarpaṇam | jalaṃ durgasvarūpaṃ vai tvabhiṣekaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 12-324 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ tu duṣṭasainyaprabhakṣaṇam | devatāguruvidyaikyaṃ tvātmaikyaṃ paribhāvya ca || 12-325 ||
sarvasiddhiśvaro bhūtvā trailokyādhipatirbhavet | yathā ca rājarājyādau śatrusainyabhayaṃ bhavet || 12-326 ||
siddhirājye mahādevi tathaiva parikīrttitam | durgayantrādikaṃ devi deśarājye yathā matam || 12-327 ||
tathaiva siddhirājyasya puraścaryādikaṃ matam | mantro rājā gururmantrī gaṇeśā dvārapālakāḥ || 12-328 ||
sādhanaṃ śavamuṇḍasya siṃhāsanamitīritam | sādhakena tathā kāryaṃ yena sarvaṃ tu sidhyati || 12-329 ||
naimittikaṃ ca kāmyaṃ ca hayadviradakau matau | homadhūpaḥ patākāḥ syājjayastu siddhabhūmikā || 12-330 ||
siddhirājādhipe devi kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale | ṣoḍhānyāsādikaṃ senā devatā rājyadāyikā || 12-331 ||
yantraṃ tu vajradurgaṃ tu jīvacakraṃ tvabhedakam | kavacādi puraścaryā proktā kiṃ śrotumicchasi || 12-332 ||
iti stavakavacasahasranāmapuraścaraṇam | anuktapuraścaraṇānāṃ stavakavacādīnāṃ puraścaraṇametat | uktapuraścaraṇānāṃ tu teṣāṃ kalpoktameva tat kāryam | atha karpūrastavapuraścaraṇaṃ (vīratantre)
devyuvāca |
karpūrākhyamidaṃ stotraṃ yaduktaṃ bhavatā purā | ṣaṭkarmasādhanaṃ tasya prayogaṃ vada śaṅkara || 12-333 ||
śrīśiva uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi karpūrastavasādhanam | sakṛt kṛte'pi deveśi kālī tuṣṭā bhavet sadā || 12-334 ||
śanibhaumadine devi snātvā prayatamānasaḥ | saṃpūjya kālikāṃ devīṃ saṅkalpaṃ samyagācaret || 12-335 ||
kṛtvā ṣoḍhādikaṃ devi paṭhet stotramanuttamam | ayutaikapramāṇena taddaśāśaṃ hunet sudhīḥ || 12-336 ||
tarpaṇaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ ca brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ | paścāt svakāryasiddhyarthaṃ prayogānācaret tathā || 12-337 ||
rājño bhaye samutpanne durbhikṣe śatrusaṃkaṭe | trāsotpanne maheśāni rogaśokabhaye tathā || 12-338 ||
paṭhet stotraṃ mahākālyāḥ sarvaśāntiṃ prayacchati | kumārīpūjanaṃ cānte karttavyaṃ susamāhitaḥ || 12-339 ||
evaṃ kṛte maheśāni samyak siddhirbhaveddhruvam |
iti karpūrastavapuraścaraṇam |
atha saptaśatīstavavidhānam |
(muktāvalyām)
saptaśatyā vidhānaṃ tu śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yatnataḥ || 12-340 ||
yajjñātvā sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt |
(merutantre)
saptaśatyāstu sakalaṃ tattvaṃ vedmyahameva hi || 12-341 ||
pādonaṃ śrīharirvetti vettyardhaṃ tu prajāpatiḥ | vyāsasturyāṃśakaṃ vetti koṭyaṃśamitare janāḥ || 12-342 ||
(vārāhītantre)
ṛṣicchandādikaṃ nyasya paṭhet stotraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
ṛṣyādinyāsa ukto (merutantre)
saptaśatyāścaritre tu prathame padmabhūrmuniḥ || 12-343 ||
chando gāyatramuditaṃ mahākālī tu devatā | vāgbījaṃ pāvakastattvaṃ dharmārthe viniyojanam || 12-344 ||
madhyamasya caritrasya munirviṣṇurudāhṛtaḥ | uṣṇikchando mahālakṣmīrdevatā bījamadrijā || 12-345 ||
vāyustattvaṃ dhanaprāptyai viniyoga udāhṛtaḥ | uttarasya caritrasya muniḥ śaṅkara ucyate || 12-346 ||
mahāsarasvatī devī triṣṭūp chanda udāhṛtam | kāmo bījaṃ ravistattvaṃ kāmāptyai viniyojanam || 12-346 ||
tantrāntare |
navārṇamantravarṇaistu ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret |
devatātrayadhyānāni (durgāprakaraṇe) proktāni | atha pāṭhakramo (vārāhītantre)
ādhāre sthāpayitvā tu pustakaṃ vācayet tataḥ || 12-347 ||
hastasaṃsthāpanāddevi bhavedardhaphalaṃ yataḥ | yāvanna pūryate'dhyāyastāvanna viramet paṭhan || 12-348 ||
yadi pramādādadhyāye virāmo bhavati priye | punaradhyāyamārabhya paṭhet sarvaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 12-349 ||
anukramāt paṭheddevi śiraḥkampādikaṃ tyajet |
(mahākālasaṃhitāyām)
brāhmaṇān varayitvaivaṃ vastrālaṅkaraṇāsanaiḥ || 12-350 ||
vidadhyāt kāmanollekhaṃ pūjāṃ śaktyā ca pustake | śanaiḥ paṭhet pāṭhako'pi varṇoccāraṇapūrvakam || 12-351 ||
suvyaktaṃ nāpi viśliṣṭaṃ na śiraścāragīvat | tanumāndolayannāpi na hasanna rudan vrajan || 12-352 ||
nāśnannānyairālapa(/)śca na madhye chinnavat tathā | ācāntaḥ kṛtaśaucaśca padorudgamanīyavān || 12-353 ||
etena vidhinā'dhīte tuṣyate jagadambikā | yathoktaphaladātrī ca bhavati prāṇavallabhe || 12-354 ||
(vārāhītantre)
praṇavaṃ cādito datvā stotraṃ vā saṃhitāṃ paṭhet | ante ca praṇavaṃ dadyādityuvācādipuruṣaḥ || 12-355 ||
tathā |
svayaṃ ca likhitaṃ yacca śūdreṇa likhitaṃ bhavet | abrāhmaṇena likhitaṃ taccāpi viphalaṃ bhavet || 12-356 ||
stotre na dṛśyate yatra praṇavaṃ tatra vinyaset | sarvatra pāṭhe vijñeyastvanyathā viphalaṃ bhavet || 12-357 ||
(devīpurāṇe)
vācakaṃ pūjayitvā tu yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ | vācayīta tato rājan devīmāhātmyamuttamam || 12-358 ||
tadante śāntiśabdastu janasya sanṛpasya ca | anena vidhinā rājan yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi || 12-359 ||
cintayedvācayedvā'pi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu | vājapeyasahasrasya aśvamedhaśatasya ca || 12-360 ||
yat phalaṃ labhate tāta tat phalaṃ śatadhā bhavet (-) ityādi ||
(marīcikalpe)
rātrisūktaṃ japedādau madhye saptaśatīstavam | prānte tu japanīyaṃ vai devīsūktamiti kramaḥ || 12-361 ||
evaṃ saṃpūṭitaṃ stotraṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye |
atra rātrisūktaṃ ca |
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā (-) ityādi prathamacaritrasthastutirūpaṃ devīsūktam | namo devyai (-) ityādi tṛtīyacaritrasthastutirūpamiti nāgojibhaṭṭādayaḥ | anye tu sūktadvayaṃ vaidikamevetyāhuḥ |
(merutantre)
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇoktaṃ nityaṃ caṇḍīstavaṃ paṭhet || 12-362 ||
puṭitaṃ mūlamantreṇa japannāpnoti vāñchitam |
mūlamantrastu durgāprakaraṇokto navārṇaḥ | atha puraścaraṇaṃ (marīcikalpe)
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm || 12-363 ||
vṛddhyaikottarayā jāpyaṃ pūrvasaṃpuṭitaṃ tu tat | evaṃ devi mayā proktaḥ pauraścaraṇikaḥ kramaḥ || 12-364 ||
tadante havanaṃ kuryāt pratiślokena pāyasaiḥ | rātrisūktaṃ prati (-) ṛcaṃ tathā devyāstu sūktakam || 12-365 ||
pratiślokeneti | tasya (kātyāyanītantro-)ktamantravibhāgena | tadajñāne tu ślokenaiva homaḥ kārya iti sāmpradāyikāḥ | navarātre prakārāntareṇa puraścaramuktaṃ tatraiva |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi navarātravidhānakam | japedekottarāṃ vṛddhiṃ dināni navasaṃkhyayā || 12-366 ||
navākṣarīvidhānena saṃpūjyātha vicakṣaṇaḥ | sahasraṃ prajapenmantraṃ pratyekaṃ ca yathāvidhi || 12-367 ||
hutvā daśāṃśato homaṃ tatra siddhimavāpnuyāt |
iti puraścaraṇam | atha prasaṅgācchatacaṇḍovidhirlikhyate | tathā ca (merutantre)
śatacaṇḍīvidhānaṃ tu pravakṣye prītaye nṛṇām || 12-368 ||
nṛpopadravamāpanne durbhikṣe bhūmikampane | ativṛṣṭyāmanāvṛṣṭau paracakrabhaye kṣaye || 12-369 ||
sarve vighnā vinaśyanti śatacaṇḍīvidhau kṛte | rogāṇāṃ vairiṇāṃ nāśo dhanaputrasamṛddhayaḥ || 12-370 ||
śaṅkarasya bhavānyā vā prasādanikaṭe śubham | maṇḍapaṃ dvāravedyāḍhyaṃ kuryāt sadhvajatoraṇam || 12-371 ||
tatra kuṇḍaṃ prakurvīta pratīcyāṃ madhyato'pi vā | snātvā nityakṛtiṃ kṛtvā yojayeddaśavāḍavān || 12-372 ||
jitendriyān sadācārān kulīnān satyavādinaḥ | vyutpannā(/)ścaṇḍikāpāṭhe ratān lajjādayāvataḥ || 12-373 ||
madhuparkavidhānena vastrasvarṇādidānataḥ | japārthamāsanaṃ mālāṃ dadyāt tebhyo'pi bhojanam || 12-374 ||
te haviṣyānnamaśnanto mantrārthagatamānasāḥ | bhūmau śayānāḥ pratyekaṃ japeyuścaṇḍikāstavam || 12-375 ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇoktaṃ daśakṛtvaḥ sacetasaḥ | navārṇaṃ caṇḍikāmantraṃ japeyuścāyutaṃ kvacit || 12-376 ||
vāḍavā viprāḥ | atra ca | pañcabhiḥ saptabhirvā'pi navaikādaśabhistathā | adīrghadivase kṣipraṃ vidadhyāccaṇḍikāmakham || 12-377 ||
ayugmabrāhmaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ śatāvṛttaṃ susiddhaye | tripañcasaptanavabhirdinaiḥ pakṣeṇa vā punaḥ || 12-378 ||
devīmāhātmyapāṭhaṃ tu yugairvipraiḥ kṛtaṃ ca yat | niṣphalaṃ ca bhavet sarvaṃ bhūtināśaṃ ca prāpnuyāt || 12-379 ||
iti yadvacanatrayaṃ kroḍatantranāmnā paṭhyate tat tu nirmūlam | tantrānupalambhādanekatantravirodhācca |
tathā |
yajamānaḥ pūjayecca kanyānāṃ daśakaṃ śubham | dvivarṣādyā daśābdāntāḥ kumārīḥ paripūjayet || 12-380 ||
tathā |
viprāṃ sarveṣṭasaṃsiddhyaiḥ yaśase kṣatriyodbhavām | vaiśyajāṃ dhanalābhāya putrāptyai śūdrajāṃ yajet || 12-380 ||
dvivarṣādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ nāmāni |
dvivarṣā sā kumāryuktā trimūrtirhāyanatrikā | caturabdā tu kalyāṇī pañcavarṣā tu rohiṇī || 12-381 ||
ṣaḍabdā kālikā proktā caṇḍikā saptahāyanā | aṣṭavarṣā śāmbhavī syāddurgā tu navahāyanā || 12-382 ||
śubhadā daśavarṣoktā tā mantraiḥ paripūjayet | ekābdāyāḥ prītyabhāvo rudrābdā tu vivarjitā || 12-383 ||
mantrākṣaramayīṃ lakṣmīṃ mātṝṇāṃ rūpadhāriṇīm | navadurgātmikāṃ sākṣāt kanyāmāvāhayāmyaham || 12-384 ||
kumārikādikanyānāṃ pūjāmantrān bruve'dhunā | jagatpūjye javadvandye sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇi || 12-385 ||
pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa kaumāri jaganmātre namo'stu te | tripurāṃ tripurādhārāṃ trivargajñānarūpiṇīm || 12-386 ||
trailokyavanditāṃ devīṃ trimūrtiṃ pūjayāmyaham | kalātmikāṃ kalātītāṃ kāruṇyahṛdayāṃ śivām || 12-387 ||
kalyāṇajananīṃ nityāṃ kalyāṇīṃ pūjayāmyaham | aṇimādiguṇādhārāmakārādyakṣarātmikām || 12-388 ||
anantaśaktikāṃ lakṣmīṃ rohiṇīṃ pūjayāmyaham | kāmacārīṃ śubhāṃ kāntāṃ kālacakrasvarūpiṇīm || 12-389 ||
kāmadāṃ karuṇodārāṃ kālikāṃ pūjayāmyaham | caṇḍabījāṃ caṇḍamayīṃ caṇḍamuṇḍaprabhañjanīm || 12-390 ||
pūjayāmi sadā devīṃ caṇḍikāṃ caṇḍavikramām | sadānandakarīṃ śāntāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām || 12-391 ||
sarvabhūtātmikāṃ lakṣmīṃ śāmbhavīṃ pūjayāmyaham | durgame dustare kārye bhavaduḥkhavināśinīm || 12-392 ||
pūjayāmi sadā bhaktyā durgāṃ durgatināśinīm | sundarīṃ svarṇavarṇābhāṃ sukhasaubhāgyadāyinīm || 12-393 ||
subhadrajananīṃ devīṃ subhadrāṃ pūjayāmyaham | etairmantrairlakṣaṇāḍhyāṃ tāṃ tāṃ kanyāṃ samarcayet || 12-394 ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpairbhakṣyabhojyairvastrairābharaṇairapi | vedyāṃ viracite ramye sarvatobhadramaṇḍale || 12-395 ||
ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivat tatrāvāhyārcayecchivām | tadagre kanyakāścāpi bhojayedbrāhmaṇānapi || 12-396 ||
upacāraiśca vividhaiḥ pūrvoktāvaraṇānyapi | evaṃ caturdinaṃ kṛtvā pañcahomān samācaret || 12-397 ||
etena prathame'hni pratyekamekaikāvṛttiḥ | dvitīye dve dve | tṛtīye tisrastisraḥ | caturthe catasraścatasra ityuktaṃ bhavati | taduktaṃ (rudrayāmale)
ekaṃ dve trīṇi catvāri japeddinacatuṣṭaye |
pañcame divase prātarhomaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ (-) iti ||
atha brāhmaṇahomadravyāpyuktāni (merutantre)
pāyasānnaistu madhvaktairdrākṣārambhāphalairapi || 12-398 ||
mātuluṅgairikṣukhaṇḍairnārikelaiḥ puraistilaiḥ | jātīphalairāmraphalai ramyairmadhuravastubhiḥ || 12-399 ||
saptaśatyā daśāvṛttyā pratiślokaṃ hutaṃ caret | ayutaṃ ca navārṇena sthāpite'gnau vidhānataḥ || 12-400 ||
homavidhau yo viśeṣaḥ sa cāgre vakṣyante mayā | kṛtvā'varaṇadevānāṃ homaṃ tannāmamantrataḥ || 12-401 ||
kṛtvā purṇāhutiṃ samyagdevamagniṃ visṛjya ca | abhiṣiñcecca yaṣṭāraṃ vipraughaḥ kalaśodakaiḥ || 12-402 ||
abhiṣekamantrāstu |
viśveśvarīṃ jagaddhātrīm (-) ityādi | devyā yayā tatamidam (-) ityādi | namo devyai mahādevyai (-) ityādi | devi prapannārttihare prasīda (-) iti catvāraḥ ślokāḥ | niṣkaṃ suvarṇamatha vā pratyekaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśet |
(mārīcikalpe tu)
pañcasvarṇāḥ śatāvṛtte pakṣāvṛtte tu tattrayam | pañcāvṛtte svarṇamekaṃ trirāvṛtte tadardhakam || 12-403 ||
ekāvṛtte pādamekaṃ dadyādvā śaktito budhaḥ (-) ityuktam |
(kātyāyanītantre)
