ekaikaṃ daśaviprebhyo dadyādgomithunaṃ samam | niṣkatrayasamāyuktaṃ vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitam || 12-404 ||
(meutantre)
bhojayecca pṛthagviprān bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ | tebhyo'pi dakṣiṇāṃ datvā gṛhṇīyādāśiṣastathā || 12-405 ||
evaṃ kṛte jagadvaśyaṃ sarve naśyantyupadravāḥ | rājyaṃ dhanaṃ yaśaḥ putrāniṣṭamannaṃ labheta ca || 12-406 ||
(kātyāyanītantre)
yadyat kāryaṃ samuddiśya kriyate śatacaṇḍikā | tat tat tasya mahālakṣmīḥ satyamāśu prayacchati || 12-407 ||
atha sahasracaṇḍīvidhānamuktaṃ (merau)
etaddaśaguṇaṃ kuryāccaṇḍīsāhasrajaṃ vidhim | vidyāvataḥ sadācārān brāhmaṇān vṛṇuyācchatam || 12-408 ||
pratyahaṃ caṇḍikāpāṭhān vidadhyuste daśāmitān | ayutaṃ prajapeyuste pratyekaṃ navavarṇakam || 12-409 ||
pūrvoktāḥ kanyakāḥ pūjyāḥ pūrvamantraiḥ śataṃ śubhāḥ | evaṃ daśāhaṃ saṃpādya homaṃ kuryuḥ prayatnataḥ || 12-410 ||
saptaśatyāḥ śatāvṛttyāṃ pratiślokaṃ vidhānataḥ | lakṣasaṃkhyaṃ navārṇaṃ ca pūrvoktairdravyasaṃcayaiḥ || 12-411 ||
hotṛbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ datvā pūrvoktān bhojayeddvijān | sahasrasaṃmitān sādhūn devyārādhanatatparān || 12-412 ||
evaṃ sahasrasaṃkhyāte kṛte caṇḍīvidhau nṛṇām | siddhyatyabhīpsitaṃ sarvaṃ duḥkhaughaśca vinaśyati || 12-413 ||
mārīdurbhagarogādyā naśyanti vyasanoccayāḥ |
(rudrayāmale)
rājyabhraṃśe mahotpāte janamāre mahābhaye || 12-414 ||
gajamāre'śvamāre ca paracakrabhaye tathā | ityādivividhe duḥkhe kṣayarogādije bhaye || 12-415 ||
sahasracaṇḍikāpāṭhaṃ kuryādvā kārayet tathā |
(merutantre)
nemaṃ vidhiṃ vadedduṣṭe khale caure gurudruhi || 12-416 ||
sādhau jitendiye dānte vadedvidhimimaṃ param | evaṃ sā caṇḍikā tuṣṭā vaktṝn śrotṝn prarakṣati || 12-417 ||
atha homavidhiḥ |
caturasre same kuṇḍe samantāddhastamātrake | ekāvaraṇasaṃyukte yonimaṇḍalamaṇḍite || 12-418 ||
daśāṃśavidhinā homamuktahavyena sādhayet | nityacaṇḍyāṃ navacaṇḍyāṃ kuṇḍamevaṃvidhaṃ smṛtam || 12-419 ||
etaddviguṇitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ śatacaṇḍyāṃ prakīrttitam | saṃskārairaṣṭabhiḥ kuṇḍaṃ saṃskṛtyāgniṃ nidhāpayet || 12-420 ||
kuṇḍamadhye bhuvaṃ darbhaiḥ parimārjya pralepayet | prāgagrāḥ sruvamūlena rekhāstisraḥ samullikhet || 12-421 ||
pāṃśumuddhṛtya rekhāṇāmabhyukṣaṇamataḥ param | kuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamaḥ saptamudrayā || 12-422 ||
astrāvaguṇṭhitaṃ kuṇḍe saṃskāraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ | aṣṭamaṅgalanāmānaṃ kuṇḍe'gniṃ sannidhāpayet || 12-423 ||
atra sarvatra māyābījamantraḥ |
caṇḍikāpāṭhasaṃpūrṇe brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe dvijam | tatastadagnimat kuṇḍaṃ navavastreṇa bhūṣayet || 12-424 ||
kuṇḍasyottarataḥ sthāpyā praṇītā vāripūritā | praṇītāpātrataḥ sarve sthāpyāḥ pātragaṇāḥ kramāt || 12-425 ||
ājyasthālī carusthālī gavyakṣīrasamanvitā | sruksruvau ca ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ taṇḍulāḥ kuśamūlakāḥ || 12-426 ||
pālāśāḥ samidhastisraḥ pūrṇapātramataḥ param | saptadvīpeśvarīṃ dhyātvā gṛhītvā kuśamūlakam || 12-427 ||
niḥkṣipet prokṣaṇīpātre vāruṇaṃ bījamuccaret | tena darbhasamūhena śatasaṃkhyena ceśvari || 12-428 ||
kramāt pātrāṇi saṃprokṣan prokṣaṇīpātravāriṇā | ājyapātre carusthālyāṃ niḥkṣipedghṛtataṇḍulam || 12-429 ||
yathākrameṇa karttavyaṃ tato'dhiśrayaṇaṃ tayoḥ | ādau vai pāyasaṃ kāryaṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ tayoḥ || 12-430 ||
savyaṃ pālāśakāṣṭhena tribhirdarbhaiśca sojjvalam | sruvayoḥ sthāpanaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇe sthāpanaṃ kṛtam || 12-431 ||
udvāsya prathamaṃ pūrvādānīyāgneḥ pradakṣiṇam | kuṇḍācāryāntare sthāpyaṃ svabījajapagauravāt || 12-432 ||
svabījaṃ tvamṛtabījam |
abhighārya svabījena vāyavye sthāpayeccarun | tiṣṭhan pālāśasamidho maunī vaiśvānare kṣipet || 12-433 ||
kuśamulakayuktābhiḥ prokṣiṇyadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇam | paryukṣyāgniṃ praṇītāyāṃ niḥkṣipet kuśamūlakam || 12-434 ||
nidhāya dakṣiṇaṃ jānu bhūmāvagnimukhaṃ hunet | anvārabdhasruveṇājyaṃ nirdhūme havyavāhane || 12-435 ||
prajāpatiṃ mahākālīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm | etadagnimukhaṃ proktaṃ māyābījapurassaram || 12-436 ||
saṃśravān prokṣaṇīpātre niḥkṣipedyajñasādhanān | vidadyāt kalpitaṃ homamuktena haviṣā śamī || 12-437 ||
kalpitaṃ saṅkalpitamityarthaḥ |
tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ dadyāddhaviṣā svojjvale'nale |
māyābījaṃ brahmāṇīmāheśvarīkaumārīvaiṣṇavīnārasiṃhī (-) aindrīcāmuṇḍāyai vicce viṣṭete svāhā |
eṣa prokto mahādevīmantraḥ sviṣṭakṛdāhutau || 12-438 ||
ājyena navāhutikaṃ māyābījādināmabhiḥ |
nandāraktadantikāśākambharīdurgābhīmābhrāmarīkālīśivadūtīcāmuṇḍāyai prajāpatibhyaḥ |
gandhapuṣpaphalopetāṃ kṛtvā yajñātmikāṃ śrucam || 12-439 ||
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyādghṛtenācchinnadhārayā | navākṣareṇa mantreṇa mahālakṣmīparāyaṇaḥ || 12-440 ||
dhyātvā yajñapuroḍāśamamṛtaṃ devadurlabham | prokṣaṇīpātramadhyasthānmantreṇāśnāti saṃsravāt || 12-441 ||
yasmāt prāśastaṃ saṃsravapuroḍāśaṃ prāśnāmi sukhapuṇyadam (-) iti mantraḥ |
salilena praṇītāyāstīrthadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | karoti mārjanaṃ darbhaiḥ śatena ślokapāṭhataḥ || 12-442 ||
yāḥ śivāḥ śaktayo yāśca tābhiśca savitā saha |
yāśca yāḥ sannidhānasthāstāste kṛṇvantu bheṣajam (-) iti ||
saṃsṛkṣornikhilaṃ viśvaṃ muhuḥ śukraṃ prajāpateḥ | mātaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmāpo devyaḥ punantu mām || 12-443 ||
alakṣmīṃ malarūpāṃ yāḥ sarvabhūteṣu saṃsthitam |
kṣālayanti jalasparśādāpo devyaḥ punantu mām (-) iti mantra ||
abhiṣiñcedathātmānaṃ caturbhiścaṇḍikāstavaiḥ || 12-444 ||
śūlena pāhi no devītyādiślokacatuṣṭayam |
ṛtvikkakarttṛyajamānābhiṣeke tu pūrvoktaślokacatuṣṭayameva |
dānaṃ dadyādvidhānena hemadhenvambarādikam || 12-445 ||
sajapaṃ homamāvedya mahālakṣmīṃ praṇamya ca | śūlena pāhi no devītyetaiḥ ślokaiḥ prakṣiṇam || 12-446 ||
vidadhyāt susthiro bhūtvā caṇḍikādhyānatatparaḥ |
ityetaiḥ (-) śūlena (-) ityādibhiḥ tairasmānrakṣa sarvataḥ (-) ityantairityarthaḥ |
namo devyā iti ślokaiḥ pañcabhirdhyānatatparaḥ || 12-447 ||
kṛtvā pañcanamaskārānupaviśyāsane śubhe | sarvasvarūpe ityādiṣaḍbhiḥ ślokaiḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ || 12-448 ||
prārthayejjagatāṃ dhātrīṃ praṇataḥ san hṛdīpsitam |
svaśarīre samāropya dadyādasyai visarjanam (-) iti |
anena vidhinā yastu prakuryāccaṇḍikārcanam || 12-449 ||
tasya tuṣṭā mahālakṣmīḥ sarvān kāmān prayacchati |
iti homavidhiḥ | (prayogasāre)
caṇḍīpāṭhaphalaṃ rājan śṛṇuṣva gadato mama || 12-450 ||
ekāvṛttyādipāṭhānāṃ pratyahaṃ paṭhatāṃ nṛṇām | saṅkalpapūrvaṃ sampūjya nyasyāṅgeṣu manūn sakṛt || 12-451 ||
paścādbalipradānena phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ | upasargopaśāntyarthaṃ trirāvṛttaṃ paṭhennaraḥ || 12-452 ||
grahadoṣopaśāntyarthaṃ pañcāvṛttaṃ varānane | mahābhaye samutpanne saptāvṛttamudīrayet || 12-453 ||
navāvṛttyābhavecchāntirmucyet prāṇārttijādbhayāt | rājavaśyāya bhūtyai ca rudrāvṛttamudīrayet || 12-454 ||
arkāvṛttyā kāmasiddhirvairināśaśca jāyate | manvāvṛttyā ripurvaśyastathā strīvaśyatāmiyāt || 12-455 ||
saukhyaṃ pañcadaśāvṛttyā śriyaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ | kalāvṛttyā putrapautradhanadhānyāgamaṃ viduḥ || 12-456 ||
rājabhītivināśāya vairasyoccaṭanāya ca | kuryāt saptadaśāvṛttaṃ tathā'ṣṭādaśakaṃ priye || 12-457 ||
mahārṇavavimokṣāya viṃśāvṛttaṃ paṭhennaraḥ | pañcaviṃśāvarttanācca bhavedbandhavimokṣaṇam || 12-460 ||
saṅkaṭe samanuprāpte duścikitsāmaye tadā | jātidhvaṃse kulacchede āyuṣo nāśa āgate || 12-461 ||
vairivṛddhau vyādhivṛddhau dhananāśe tathā kṣaye | tathaiva trividhotpāte tathā caivātipātake || 12-462 ||
kuryādyatnācchatāvṛttaṃ tataḥ sampadyate śubham | vipadastasya naśyanti ante yāti parāṃ gatim || 12-463 ||
śriyo vṛddhiḥ śatāvṛttyā rājyavṛddhistathā parā | manasā cintitaṃ devi siddhyedaṣṭottarācchatāt || 12-464 ||
śatāśvamedhayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti suvrate | sahasrāvarttanyallakṣmīrāvṛṇoti svayaṃ sthirā || 12-465 ||
bhuktvā manogatān kāmān naro mokṣamavāpnuyāt | yathā'śvamedhaḥ kratuṣu devānāṃ ca yathā hariḥ || 12-466 ||
stavānāmapi sarveṣāṃ tathā saptaśatīstavaḥ | nātaḥ parataraṃ stotraṃ kiñcidasti varānane || 12-467 ||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanānāṃ ca pāvanam | athavā bahunoktena kimetena varānane || 12-468 ||
caṇḍikāyāḥ śatāvṛttyāḥ sarvāḥ siddhyanti siddhayaḥ |
(merutantre)
kalau na caṇḍīsadṛśī siddhadā bhuvanatraye || 12-469 ||
vāmadakṣiṇamārgābhyāmadhikāriphalapradā | tatrādimaṃ caritraṃ tu roganāśāya yojayet || 12-470 ||
upasargavināśāya madhyamaṃ yojayedbudhaḥ | antyaṃ viṣamakāmastu caritraṃ pariśīlayet || 12-471 ||
caritradvayaśīlasya na vaṃśaśchidyete kvacit | paṭhedādyantacaritaṃ vipattistasya naśyati || 12-472 ||
anādyaṃ paṭhate yastu mārayedacirādripūn | svārthānusārapadyaṃ ca saptaśatyāstu yojayet || 12-473 ||
yastanmatreṇa puṭitaṃ tatprastārāṅkasaṃkhyā | paṭheccaṇḍīṃ tathā'dyante sa kāmastasya siddhyati || 12-474 ||
svaśatrūn daityabhāvena svamitrān devatādhiyā | bhāvayan yojayeccaṇḍīṃ trisandhyaṃ māsamātrakam || 12-475 ||
mṛtā vā mṛtakalpā vā śatravaḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ | sitapakṣatimārabhya cāṣṭamyantamiṣasya yaḥ || 12-476 ||
japellakṣaṃ manuṃ khādyaistrimadhurāplutaiḥ | pratyahaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ caṇḍīmādyantayoḥ paṭhet || 12-477 ||
viprān guruṃ samārādhya vāñchitaṃ labhate drutam |
atha (kātyāyanītantro-)ktāḥ kati cit prayogā likhyante | pratimantramādyantayoḥ praṇavaṃ (-) japenmantrasiddhiḥ | saṃpraṇavavyāhṛtitrayamādāvante tu vilomaṃ tadityevaṃ pratiślokaṃ kṛtvā śatāvṛttapāṭhe'tiśīghraṃ siddhiḥ | pratiślokamādau jātavedase iti ṛcaṃ paṭhet sarvakāmasiddhiḥ | apamṛtyuvāraṇāyādāvante ca śataṃ tryambakaṃ japet | pratiślokaṃ śaraṇāgatadīnārtta (-) iti ślokaṃ paṭhet sarvakāryasiddhiḥ | pratiślokaṃ karotu sā naḥ śubha (-) ityardhaṃ paṭhet sarvakāmāptiḥ | svābhīṣṭavaraprāptyai evaṃ devyā varaṃ labdhvā (-) iti ślokaṃ paṭhet | sarvāpannivaraṇāya pratiślokaṃ (-) durge smṛtā (-) iti paṭhet | asya kevalasyāpi ślokasyāpi kāmānusāreṇa lakṣamayutaṃ sahasraṃ śataṃ vā japaḥ | sarvavādhā (-) ityasya lakṣajape ślokoktaṃ phalam | itthaṃ yadā yadā (-) iti ślokasya lakṣajape mahāmārīśāntiḥ | tato vavre nṛpo rājya (-) iti mantrasya lakṣajape punaḥ svarājyalābhaḥ | hīnasti daityatejāṃsi (-) ityanena sadīpabalidāne ghaṇṭābandhane ca bālagrahaśāntiḥ | ādyāvṛttimanulomena paṭhitvā tato viparītakrameṇa punaranulomena vāmāvṛttitraya uktaprakāreṣu śīghraṃ siddhirbhavati | sarvāpannivāraṇāya (-) durge smṛtā (-) ityardham | tato yadantike yacca dūrake (-) ityṛcaṃ tadante (-) dāridryaduḥkha (-) ityardhameva kāryānusāreṇa lakṣamayutaṃ sahasraṃ śataṃ vā japaḥ | māraṇārtham evamuktvā samutpannā (-) iti pratiślokaṃ paṭhet | māraṇoktāvṛttibhiḥ phalasiddhiḥ |
jñānināmapi cetāṃsi (-) iti ślokatrayamātreṇa sadyo mohanamityanubhava siddham | pratimantraṃ tacchlokapāṭhe tvavaśyam | rogānaśeṣā (-) iti ślokasya pratiślokapāṭhe sakalaroganāśaḥ tanmātrajape'pi samaṃ phalam | ityuktvā sā tadā devī gambhīrā (-) iti ślokasya pratiślokapāṭhe yathā jape vā vidyāprāptiḥ vāgvaikṛternāśaśca | bhagavatyā kṛtaṃ sarvam (-) ityādidvādaśottaraśatākṣaro mantraḥ sarvakāmadaḥ sarvāpannivāraṇaśca | devi prapannārttihare (-) iti ślokasya yathākāryaṃ lakṣāyutasahasraśatānyame jape pratiślokapāṭhe vā sarvāpannivṛttiḥ sarvakāmāptiśca | eṣu prayogeṣu pratiślokaṃ dīpāgre kevalameva vā namaskārakaraṇe'tiśīghraṃ siddhiḥ | atra sarvatra prayoge trayodaśapātreṣu ekasminneva pātre vā trayodaśadīpāḥ pradeyāḥ | pratiślokaṃ kāmabīja (-) saṃpuṭitasyaikacatvāriṃśaddinaṃ trirāvṛttau sarvakāmasiddhiḥ | ekaviṃśatidinaparyantamuktarītyā pratyahaṃ daśāvṛttau vaśīkaraṇam | māyābīja (-) puṭitasya phaṭpallava (-) sahitasya saptadinaparyantaṃ trayodaśāvṛttapaṭhane uccāṭanasiddhiḥ | tādṛśasyaiva dinacatuṣṭayamekādaśāvṛttau sarvopadravanāśaḥ | ekonapañcāśaddinaparyantaṃ pratiślokaṃ śrībīja (-) saṃpuṭitasya pañcadaśāvṛttau lakṣmī prāptiḥ | pratiślokaṃ vāgbhavabīja (-) saṃpuṭitasya śatāvṛttyā vidyāprāptiḥ | atha parārthe prayoge (-) oṃ punastvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatāṃ punarbramāṇo vasunītha yajñaiḥ | ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvavardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ | iti vaidikamantraṃ pratyadhyāyaṃ pratyāvṛtti vā paṭhet | navārṇamantrapuṭitaprayogastu kamānāmātre karttavyaḥ | taduktaṃ (vārāhītantrādau)
śatamādau śataṃ cānte japenmantraṃ navākṣaram || 12-478 ||
caṇḍīsaptaśatīmadhye saṃpuṭo'yamudāhṛtaḥ | sakāmaiḥ saṃpuṭo jāpyo niṣkāmaiḥ saṃpuṭaṃ vinā || 12-479 ||
sarvakāmaprasiddhyarthaṃ navārṇapuṭitaṃ japet (-) iti ||
atra navārṇamantrau prasiddhau | tatraiko durgāprakaraṇe uktaḥ | anyastu (vārāhītantre)
vedādirvāgbhavaṃ caiva māyā kāmastathaiva ca | pṛthvī repho vāmanetraṃ nādavinduvibhūṣitam || 12-480 ||
māyā kāmo namaḥ paścānmūlamantra udāhṛtaḥ |
asya puraścaraṇamapi tatraivoktam |
lakṣaṃ japenmūlamantraṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye (-) iti |
(kātyāyanītantre)
sthitikramo bhuktikāme muktikāme ca saṃhṛtiḥ || 12-481 ||
śrīkāme puṣṭikāme ca sṛṣṭikrama udāhṛtaḥ |
sṛṣṭikramādayaśca tatraivoktāḥ |
ādimārabhya prajapet sṛṣṭikrama ihocyate || 12-482 ||
japecchakrādimārabhya śumbhadaityabadhāvadhi | ādyācchakrādiparyantaṃ sthitikrama udāhṛtaḥ || 12-483 ||
śeṣamārabhya ādyantaṃ saṃhāro'yaṃ kramo bhavet |
(merutantre) caritratrayaprayogasaṃkhyāṃ yathākramamuktvā (-)
evaṃ saptaśataṃ cātra prayogāḥ parikīrttitāḥ || 12-484 ||
tasmāt saptaśatītyetat proktaṃ vyāsena dhīmatā |
(kātyāyanītantre) tu saptaśatahomamantrā evāsya saptaśatītvavyavahāraprayojakā ityuktam | te ca mantrāstatraiva |
mārkaṇḍeya ṛṣiproktaprathamaślokataḥ priye || 12-485 ||
vyomādivarṇasambhūto dvitīyasvarasaṃyutaḥ |
vyoma hakārastasyādiḥ sakāraḥ | dvitīyasvara ākāraḥ | tena sā iti | tathā |
nṛpāntaṃ pravadenmantrāḥ sarve cāṣṭādaśa priye || 12-486 ||
vaiśyovāca tataḥ ślokā vyomādyāḥ pañca mantrakāḥ |
vyomādya ādyo yeṣāmiti mṛganayanāvat samāsaḥ |
nṛpasyoktirmāntavarṇo dvādaśasvarasaṃyutaḥ || 12-487 ||
māntavarṇo yakāraḥ | sa ca dvādaśasvareṇa aikāreṇa yuktaḥ |
sakāro vindusaṃyuktaścānte sa manurīdṛśaḥ | vaiśyovāca punardevi svaraikādaśa āditaḥ || 12-488 ||
svaraikādaśa ekāraḥ |
vahnibījaṃ vinduyuktamante syānmanupañcakam |
vahnibījaṃ ramiti |
mārkaṇḍeya (-) ṛṣiproktaṃ mantratrayamudāhṛtam || 12-489 ||
tādivarṇaṃ ca bhuvanasvarayugvāhanaṃ param |
bhuvanasvara au | tadyuktaṃ vāhanaṃ vau iti |
rājovāceti ṣaṇmantrā bhāditāntāḥ śubhānane || 12-490 ||
athovāca ṛṣirjñānamastītyādi sureśvari | sarveśvareśvarī cānte mantrā vai dvādaśa sphuṭāḥ || 12-491 ||
rājovāceti bhagavannādirante vidāṃ varam | mantratrayamidaṃ khyātaṃ tata ṛṣiruvāca ha || 12-492 ||
nityaiva sā padaṃ cādau prabhurante'ṣṭamantrakāḥ | brahmovāca tataśca tvaṃ svāhādiśca mahāsurau || 12-493 ||
ante pañcadaśaite syurmantrāḥ syuḥ parameśvari | evaṃ stutādi (-) ṛṣyuktivāntamantrāśca sapta vai || 12-494 ||
tato bhagavaduktiśca bhavetādimanudvayam | vañciteti ca ṛṣyuktirmantrau dvau parameśvari || 12-495 ||
ṛṣyuktiśca tathetyādi mantradvayamudāhṛtam | sarve ślokāstvihādhyāye aṣṭayuk saptatiḥ kramāt || 12-496 ||
madhye caturviṃśatikā ardhamantrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ | sarvāścāhutayo jñeyāścaturuttarakaṃ śatam || 12-497 ||
uvācāntāstatra bodhyāḥ mantrā bhuvanasaṃkhyakāḥ |
iti prathamacaritramantranirṇayaḥ |
īśvara uvāca |
dvitīye ṛṣiruvāceti navaṣaṣṭyāhutiḥ kramāt || 12-498 ||
tatastṛtīye'dhyāye tu ṛṣiruvāceti deśikaiḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśacca tathā mantrāḥ ślokā jñeyā varānane || 12-499 ||
devyuvāceti mantrānte mantraḥ śloko mataḥ priye | ṛṣeruktiḥ punaḥ ślokāḥ pañca mantrāḥ sanātanāḥ || 12-500 ||
evamāhutayastatra catvāriṃśaccaturyutam | caturthe kramato devi ṛṣyuktiḥ ṣaṭ ca viṃśatiḥ || 12-501 ||
punastathaiva ṛṣyuktiḥ ślokau dvau mantrarūpiṇau | evaṃ stuteti mantro'yamatiguhyaḥ śubhānane || 12-502 ||
devyuvāceti vriyatāṃ matro'yaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ | devā ūcustataścoktvā bhagavatyā kṛtaṃ vadet ||
mantro'yaṃ śatavarṇāḍhyo dvādaśottarayuk punaḥ |
tato (-) ṛṣiruvāceti iti prasāditeti ca |
catuḥsaṃkhyāstu te ślokā mantrāstāvanta eva hi || 12-503 ||
ślokāścaturthe'dhyāye tu ṣaṭtriṃśat parameśvari | ardhamantradvayenaiva catvāriṃśaddviyuk punaḥ || 12-504 ||
evaṃ madhyacaritrasya pañcāśacca śatottaram | tathā pañcaśataṃ mantrā mahālakṣmyā vibhedataḥ || 12-505 ||
iti madhyamacaritramantranirṇayaḥ |
ṛṣiruvāca tripurā viṣṇumāyāṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ | ṣaṇmantrāḥ ślokarūpāste devā ūcustataḥ param || 12-506 ||
namo devyāditaḥ ślokāstriṃśadvinamramūrtibhiḥ | viṣṇumāyādito bhrāntirūpānte trīṇi ṣaṣṭiyuk || 12-507 ||
avatārapṛthaṅmantrāsteṣāṃ triṣaṣṭirāhutīḥ | citirūpeṇa mantreṇa āhutitrayamācaret || 12-508 ||
evaṃ mantrā aśītiste ṛṣiruvāca ityatha | evaṃ stavādiyuktānāṃ tvayā kasmānna gṛhyate || 12-509 ||
mantrāḥ saptadaśaite tu ṛṣyuktirniśamyeti vai | ityāditritayairmantraiḥ śuddhabhedāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 12-510 ||
atha dūta uvāceti devi daityeśvaraḥ param | ityādinavamantrāśca punā ṛṣiruvāca ha || 12-511 ||
ityuktetyādimantreṇa ekena ca sarasvatī | devyuvāceti ślokāstu catvāro mantrabhedataḥ || 12-512 ||
dūta uvāceti punaravaliptā'si ityatha | mantrāścatvāro vijñeyā devyuvāca tataḥ param || 12-513 ||
evametadbalī śumbho (-) sa ca yuktaṃ karotu yat | iti mantradvayaṃ ślokā ardhamantrāśca te nava || 12-514 ||
ekonatriṃśacca śatādadhikā mantrarūpakāḥ |
iti pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ |
ṛṣiruvācetyākarṇeti ślokāścatvāra īritāḥ || 12-515 ||
punā ṛṣiruvāceti tenājñaptastataḥ param | mantratrayamidaṃ proktaṃ devyuvāceti vai tathā || 12-516 ||
daityeśvareṇa prahito (-) eko mantraḥ prakīrttitaḥ | tataśca ṛṣiruvāca ityktaḥ so'bhyadhāvata || 12-517 ||
ityādidvādaśaślokāḥ ṣaṣṭhe'dhyāye prakīrttitāḥ | caturviṃśatibhedāstā devatāhutayaḥ kramāt || 12-518 ||
iti ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ |
ṛṣyuktirājña (-) ityāditrayoviṃśatimātaraḥ | ṛṣiruvāca tāvānītau mātṛbhedadvayaṃ kramāt || 12-519 ||
saptaviṃśatyatra devi bhavantyāhutayaḥ kramāt | atrādhyāyadvaye devi dhūmrākṣī tu prakīrttitā || 12-520 ||
iti saptamo'dhyāyaḥ |
ṛṣiścaṇḍe ca nihate ityādhyāyāvasānakam | triṣaṣṭhyāhutayaḥ proktā ekā tvardhāhutirmatā || 12-521 ||
raktākṣī devatā aṣṭau mahāśaktyaḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
ityaṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ |
rājā vicitramityādi ślokadvayamudāhṛtam || 12-522 ||
ṛṣiścakāra kopaṃ hi ityādiślokarūpataḥ | ekacatvāriṃśadiha āhutirnavame śubhe || 12-523 ||
devatā bhairavī tāvacchṛṇu gopyaṃ varānane |
iti navamo'dhyāyaḥ |
ṛṣirniśumbhanihatamityādidvayamantrakam || 12-524 ||
tato devīti mantro dvau ekaivāhaṃ manūttamau | punardevyekamantreṇa vyaktamantrā udīritāḥ || 12-525 ||
ṛṣistataḥ pravavṛte sārdhadvāviṃśatistvayam | dvātriṃśanmanavastatra eko hyardhamanurmataḥ || 12-526 ||
prathamaṃ siṃhamāsīnā śūlapāśavidhāriṇī | mukhyā caturbhujā bāṇacāpahastā śubhekṣaṇā || 12-527 ||
iti daśamo'dhyāyaḥ |
ṛṣiḥ sumedhā vikhyātaḥ prokto devyā hate śubhe | catustriṃśat tathā ślokā mantrāstatsaṃkhyakāśca te || 12-528 ||
tato devyekamantreṇa varadā'haṃ sureśvari | devā ūcustathā sarvavādhāpraśamanaṃ tathā || 12-529 ||
ślokenaikena deveśi devyuvāca tataḥ param | vaivasvate'ntare prāptetyādiślokāścaturdaśa || 12-530 ||
sārdhasarvāhutirdevi pañcāśat pañcasaṃyutāḥ | vaiṣṇavī devatā hyatra mahāgaruḍavāhinī || 12-531 ||
ityekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
devyuvāceti ca tata ebhiḥ stavaiśca māṃ sadā | dūretyardhena sahitā aṣṭāviṃśatirūpakāḥ || 12-532 ||
tataśca ṛṣiruvāca ityuktvā ślokamāditaḥ | ūrdhayugdaśabhiḥ ślokairmantrāstatsaṃkhyakā matāḥ || 12-533 ||
evaṃ tu dvādaśādhyāye ekacatvāriṃśadāhutīḥ |
iti dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
tatastrayodaśe'dhyāye ṛṣiruvāca ityatha || 12-533 ||
etat te kathitaṃ bhūpetyādisārdhatrayaṃ manuḥ |
manucatuṣṭayamityarthaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāceti tato vavre manudvayam || 12-534 ||
devyuvāca punaścaiva svalpaślokatrayeṇa vai | ardhānāmeva mantratvādbhavatyatra ṣaḍāhutiḥ || 12-536 ||
ṣaṭsaṃkhyāhutirityarthaḥ |
tato mārkaṇḍeya uvāceti datvā tayoriti | dvau mantrau punaruccārya sāvarṇirbhavitā manuḥ || 12-537 ||
ekonatriṃśatsaṃkhyākā'hutiratra vidhīyate | evaṃ trayodaśādhyāye home tarpaṇakarmaṇi || 12-538 ||
śatāni saptasaṃkhyāni tava proktāni śailaje | sakārādinakārānto manuḥ paramadurlabhaḥ || 12-539 ||
sa saṃpradāyavidhinā jñātavyo mama vallabhe | anyathā viphalo mantraḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditaḥ || 12-540 ||
vidhineti | aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmiti kīlakenetyarthaḥ | tatra home svāhāntā ete mantrāḥ pūjāyāṃ namo'ntāḥ | tarpaṇe tarpayāmyantāḥ | kecit tanmantraṃ paṭhitvā tattadadhyāyadevatāyai svāhā (-) ityevam | tattadadhyāyahome tattadadhyādevatāṃ tarpayāmi (-) iti tarpaṇe | tattadadhyāyadevatāyai namaḥ (-) iti pūjane ityāhuḥ | evaṃ homāśaktau | jayantī (-) mantreṇa namo devyā iti mantreṇa sarvamaṅgala (-) iti mantreṇa vā homapūjātarpaṇāni | juhuyāt stotramantrairvā caṇḍikāyai śubhaṃ haviḥ (-) ityapi (rahasye) | ādau tu kavacaṃ kṛtvā paścāt saptaśatīṃ jayet (-) ityādivacanāt |
kavacapāṭhe kriyamāṇe tacchlokairāhutayo na deyāḥ |
andhakaśca purā daityo durgāhomaparāyaṇaḥ |
kavacāhutimantreṇa maheśena nipātitaḥ (-) iti tantrāntaravacanāt | kavacaṃ cātraśūlena pāhino devi (-) ityādiślokacatuṣṭayarūpamiti kecit | tatra (kātyāyanītantra-) viruddhe (kātyāyanītanro-)ktamantravibhāga evābhiyuktaiḥ spaṣṭīkṛtyābhidarśitaḥ | tathā hi |
aṣṭasaptatyuttaraṃ tu ślokānāṃ śatapañcakam || 12-541 ||
proktaṃ saptaśatīstotre tatsaptaśatasaṃkhyayā | vibhajya juhuyānmantramiti kātyāyanīmatam || 12-542 ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvācaikaḥ sāvarṇyādyāstataḥ param | ślokamantrāḥ saptadaśa ardhaślokātmakastataḥ || 12-543 ||
ekonaviṃśadevaṃ syurvaiśyoktirviṃśatistathā | punarardhaṃ punaḥ ślokaṃ trayamardhaṃ punarbhavet || 12-544 ||
pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyā syādrājā ṣaḍviṃśatistathā | ardhaślokātmakaṃ mantradvayamardhaṃ punarbhavet || 12-545 ||
ekonatriṃśadevaṃ tu mantrasaṃkhyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ | punarardhaṃ punaḥ ślokatrayamardhaṃ punarbhavet || 12-546 ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ punaścārdhaślokaḥ ślokātmakaḥ punaḥ | ardhaślokātmako mantro rājārdhaślokamantrakaḥ || 12-547 ||
mantrāścatvāriṃśadeva ślokamantracatuṣṭayam | punarardhamṛṣiścārdhaślokamantrāḥ punardaśa || 12-548 ||
punarardhaṃ punā rājā ekonā ṣaṣṭirucyate | punarardhaṃ punaḥ ślokaḥ punarardhaṃ punā ṛṣiḥ || 12-549 ||
punarardhaṃ punaḥ ślokāḥ ṣaṇmantrāḥ punarardhakāḥ | nidrāṃ bhagavatīṃ viṣṇoratulāṃ tejasaḥ prabhuḥ || 12-550 ||
ityeva pāṭho mantrāṇāmekasaptatirucyate | brahmārdhaślokamantro'tha ślokamantrāstrayodaśa || 12-551 ||
ardhaślokaḥ punaḥ śloka ṛṣiḥ ślokāstu pañca vai | punarardhaṃ tu mantrāṇāṃ sapañcanavatiḥ smṛtāḥ || 12-552 ||
bhagavānardhamantrau dvau ṛṣiḥ ślokārdhakaṃ punaḥ | ślokaḥ punā ṛṣiḥ ślokadvayaṃ mantradvayaṃ bhavet || 12-553 ||
ślokānāmaṣṭasaptatyā caturbhiradhikaṃ śatam | adhyāyādāveva ṛṣiruvāceti sakṛnmanuḥ || 12-554 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭimitāḥ ślokāstāvanto manavo matāḥ | ekonasaptatiḥ sarve'dhyāye mantrā dvitīyake || 12-555 ||
ādāvṛṣiruvācaikaṃ pañcaviṃśat tataḥ param | nihanyamānādyāḥ ślokā mukharāgākulākṣarāḥ || 12-556 ||
ityantā devyuvācaiko garja garjeti cāparaḥ | śloko (-) ṛṣiruvāceti punaśca ślokapañcakam || 12-557 ||
catuścatvāriṃśadaivaṃ sarve mantrāstṛtīyake | ādāvṛṣiruvāceti śakrādyāḥ ślokamantrakāḥ || 12-558 ||
ṣaḍviṃśāstu ṛṣiḥ ślokadvayaṃ devī tataḥ param | vriyatāṃ tradaśāḥ sarve yadasmatto'bhivāñchitam || 12-559 ||
ityardhaślokamantro'tha devā ucustataḥ param | bhagavatyā kṛtaṃ sarvamityardhaślokamantrakaḥ || 12-560 ||
yadayaṃ niyatādyaṃ ca ślokamantratrayaṃ bhavet | ṛṣiślokāstu catvāro manavaḥ parikīrttitāḥ || 12-561 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśacchlokake'dhyāye catvāriṃśaddvayādhikam | ṣaṭsaptatiślokayukte'dhyāye mantrāstu pañcame || 12-562 ||
ekonatriṃśadadhikaṃ śataṃ kātyāyanīmate | ādau ṛṣiruvāceti purā śumbhādayaśca ṣaṭ || 12-563 ||
ślokamantrāstato devā ūcuścaivāṣṭamo manuḥ | namo devyādikāḥ ślokāḥ pañca mantrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 12-564 ||
trayodaśaiva mantrāstu yā devītyādayo'pi ca | ekaviṃśatikāḥ ślokā bhrāntyantāsteṣu mantrakāḥ || 12-565 ||
pratiśloke trayo mantrā jñeyāste ca triṣaṣṭikāḥ | yā devī sarvabhūteṣu viṣṇumāyeti śabditā || 12-566 ||
namastasyai iti prokto viṃśatyakṣarako manuḥ | namastasyai iti proko dvitīyaścaturakṣaraḥ || 12-567 ||
aṣṭākṣarastṛtīyo'pi namatasyaiva namo namaḥ | evaṃ dvāṃviṃśatiśloke jñeyaṃ mantratrayaṃ budhaiḥ || 12-568 ||
punaḥ ślokātmako mantrastrimantraḥ ślokakaḥ punaḥ | trayoviṃśacchlokakeṣu mantrā vai saptaṣaṣṭikāḥ || 12-569 ||
pūrvaistrayodaśairmantraiḥ sahāśītirudāhṛtā | stutā surairiti ślokadvayaṃ caiva punā ṛṣiḥ || 12-570 ||
punaḥ saptadaśaślokā ṛṣiḥ ślokatrayaṃ tataḥ | dūtaścaiva nava ślokā ṛṣireko'mbikā tataḥ || 12-571 ||
eka ityasyaikaślokaḥ ityarthaḥ |
catuḥślokī punardūtaścatuḥślokī punaḥ śivā | ślokadvayaṃ militvā tu catvāriṃśannavādhikam || 12-572 ||
aśītyā'pi ca saṃyoga ekonatriṃśatā'dhikam | śatamevaṃ tu vijñeyamāhutīnāṃ ca pañcame || 12-573 ||
viṃśatiślokasaṃyukte ṣaṣṭhe'dhyāye prakīrttitā | sarve ślokā mantrarūpā devye kā'tha ṛṣitrayam || 12-574 ||
caturviṃśatimantrāṇāmityevaṃ parikīrttitam | pañcaviṃśacchlokayukte'dhyāye mantrāstu saptame || 12-575 ||
sarve mantrāḥ ślokarūpā ṛṣyuvācadvayaṃ tataḥ | saptaviṃśatirevaṃ tu mantrasaṃkhyā prakīrttitā || 12-576 ||
sārdhaikaṣaṣṭiślokādyeṣṭame'dhyāye prakīrttitāḥ | ekaṣaṣṭiślokamantrā ante'rdhaślokamantrakaḥ || 12-577 ||
ādāveka ṛṣiścaiva triṣaṣṭirmantrasaṃtatiḥ | ekonacatvāriṃśadbhiḥ ślokairyukte samīritāḥ || 12-578 ||
adhyāye navame mantrāstāvanto'tha manudvayam | rājā ṛṣiśceti caikacatvāriṃśanmanustvayam || 12-579 ||
sārdhasaptānvitairviṃśacchlokaistu daśame'nvite | saptaviṃśatimantrāstu ślokarūpāstato'ntimaḥ || 12-580 ||
ardhaślokātmako mantra ṛṣyuvācadvayaṃ tathā | devyuvācadvayaṃ caiva dvātriṃśanmantrasaṃgrahaḥ || 12-581 ||
ślokānāṃ sārdhapañcāśajjñeyamekādaśe sphuṭam | pañcāśacchlokamantrāstadante'rdhaślokamantrakaḥ || 12-582 ||
śākambharīti vikhyātiṃ tadā yāsyāmyahaṃ bhuvi | eṣo'rdhamantra ityāhuḥ kecidatra vicakṣaṇāḥ || 12-583 ||
devīdvayamṛṣiścaiko devā ekamitīritam | pañcādhikaṃ tu pañcāśanmantrā jñeyāḥ parisphuṭam || 12-584 ||
aṣṭatriṃśacchlokayukte'pyadhyāye dvādaśātmake | catvāriṃśacca ekaśca mantrāstatrāhutidvayam || 12-585 ||
ardhaślokātmakaṃ ślokāḥ saptatriṃśanmitā ṛṣiḥ | devyuvāceti caivaikamevaṃ saṃkhyā sphuṭoditā || 12-586 ||
trayodaśe sārdhasaptadaśaślokāḥ prakīrttitāḥ | ṛṣiruvācetyārabhya bhogasvargāpavargadāḥ || 12-587 ||
ityantāḥ pañcamantrāste mārkaṇḍeyastataḥ param | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvetyardhamantraḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 12-588 ||
ślokamantrāstato jñeyāḥ pañcaivāthārdhamantrakam | devyuvāceti mantro'yaṃ tataḥ ślokastu mantrakaḥ || 12-589 ||
mārkaṇḍeyastato mantraḥ ślokau mantradvayaṃ tataḥ | tato devīṣaḍardhāni sapta mantrāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 12-590 ||
mārkaṇḍeyastataḥ paścāddvayaṃ mantradvayaṃ smṛtam | āvṛttyā tvadhiko mantraḥ sāvarṇirbhavitā manuḥ || 12-591 ||
ekonatriṃśatsaṃkhyākā mantrā atra smṛtā budhaiḥ (-) iti | atha prasaṅgāt praśnavidhirucyate (tantravidhānamuktāvalī-)dhṛtavacanāni |
trayodaśadalaṃ padmaṃ likhitvā sumanoharam | ekāṅkādikrameṇāṅkairdalāni paripūrayet || 12-592 ||
pratyadhyāye ślokasaṃkhyāḥ pṛthaglekhyāśca paṅktiśaḥ | pūjayet pustake durgāṃ navarṇena vidhānavit || 12-593 ||
devi durge namastubhyaṃ sarvajñe sarvadarśini | siddhikāryasya vā siddhiṃ satyaṃ mantraṃ pradarśaya || 12-594 ||
evaṃ saṃprārthya vā phalaṃ vā'kṣatameva vā | kumāryā vā śiśorhastādadhyāyāṅke nidhāyayet || 12-595 ||
viditvā caivamadhyāyaṃ tatpadyāṅke nidhāpayet | ślokaṃ jñātvā tato mantrī vācayīta sphuṭākṣaram || 12-596 ||
ślokasyārthānusāreṇa jñeyaṃ vijñaiḥ śubhāśubham | varadānārthakāḥ ślokā devītuṣṭyarthakāśca ye || 12-597 ||
trāṇābhyupagamārthāśca bhāvibhavyārthakāśca ye | devotsavābhidheyā ye ślokāste siddhisūcakāḥ || 12-598 ||
daityānāṃ saṃkhyayo yatra devīvikramavarṇanam | amarṣavarṇanaṃ devyā asureṣu raṇājire || 12-599 ||
evaṃ vidhāśca ye ślokāḥ saṃgrāmavijayapradāḥ | prārthanārthāśca ye ślokāḥ stotrarūpāstathaiva ca || 12-600 ||
sūcayanti ca te siddhiṃ dīrghakālavilambinīm | yadi syāduttaraśloko varadānārthakastathā || 12-601 ||
siddhimīdṛgapi ślokasturṇamevābhiśaṃsati | āpado varṇanaṃ tasyā vedanaṃ ca suparvaṇām || 12-602 ||
bhūbhṛdviśośca saṃvādo varṇanaṃ vipadastayoḥ | dūtavākyaṃ ca daityānāṃ vikramasya ca varṇanam || 12-603 ||
prayāṇavarṇanaṃ teṣāṃ kāryanāśasya sūcakam |
āpada iti suparvaṇāmāpado varṇanamityanvayaḥ | tasyā āpado vedanaṃ jñānaṃ kathanamiti yāvat | svargānnirākṛtāḥ sarve tena devagaṇā bhuvi || 12-604 ||
vicaranti (-) ityadirūpamityarthaḥ |
kecidiṣṭamaniṣṭaṃ vā ślokānāvedayanti ca | tādṛśaślokalābhe tu punaḥ praśnaṃ samācaret || 12-605 ||
iti saptaśatīprakaraṇam |
atha prāṇāyāmapuraścaraṇaṃ taduktaṃ (siddhāntasaṃgrahe)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi prāṇāyāmapuraskriyām | baddhapadmāsano mantrī samakāyaśiro'dharaḥ || 12-606 ||
vaśīkṛtendriyagrāmo nākulaḥ kampavarjitaḥ | mūlādhāre'nāhate vā bhrūmadhye vā svapaṅkaje || 12-607 ||
mantraṃ jyotirmayaṃ dhyāyedyenāsau prāṇasaṃyamaḥ |
prāṇasaṃyamaḥ prāṇāyāmo yena mantreṇa karttavya ityarthaḥ | tathā | tatsvarūpaṃ śivaṃ dhyāyet pūrvoktenaiva vartmanā || 12-608 ||
prāṇāyāmaṃ careddhīmān pūrakādikalakṣaṇam |
śivamiti prakṛtadevatābhiprāyeṇa | tathā |
prātaḥkālaṃ samārabhya yāvadyāmadvayaṃ bhavet || 12-609 ||
haviṣyānnaistathā naktaṃ prakuryādbhojanaṃ mitam | na kuryādyoṣitāṃ sparśaṃ na paśyet pāmaraṃ janam || 12-610 ||
śuddhabhūmau kuśāstīrṇe śayīta vijitendriyaḥ | evaṃ lakṣamitaṃ kuryāt prāṇāyāmaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 12-611 ||
tato homādikaṃ kuryāt puraścaryoktavartmanā | bhojanaṃ kārayedviprān guruṃ saṃtoṣayet tathā || 12-612 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ śuddhavigrahaḥ | mantrasiddhimavāpnoti yogasiddhiṃ viśeṣataḥ || 12-613 ||
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmapi syādāśrayastu saḥ | yanmantraṃ sādhayenmantrī sa mantrastasya sidhyati || 12-614 ||
iti prāṇāyāmapuraścaraṇam | atha puraścaraṇavyatiriktena mantrasiddhiprakāro (vīratantre)
atha samyak pravakṣyāmi gurusiddhiparamparām | evaṃ jñātvā viśeṣajño gopayet prītaye mama || 12-615 ||
etatprakāśanālloke mahāhāniḥ pade pade || 12-615ef ||
śivaśikhiśītabhānuṃ pañcamāntyasvarāḍhyaṃ dvitayamidamapūrvaṃ bījamugraprabhāyāḥ | kṣaṇamapi ramaṇīnāṃ maṇḍalāntarvibhāvya kṣapayati duradṛṣṭaṃ vādirāḍjāyate saḥ || 12-616 ||
śivo hakāraḥ | śikhī vahnistadbījaṃ rephaḥ | sitabhānuranusvāraḥ | pañcamāntyasvara ukārastena humiti praṇavādivahnijāyāntasyograprabhāmantrasya dvitīyaṃ bījamityarthaḥ | tathā |
sa jayati ripuvargān vādirājān vivāde ramayati ramaṇīnāṃ cittacauraścirāyuḥ | kavayati kavirājairapyadṛṣṭaṃ sukāvyaṃ madhumatirapi heyā kiṃ punaḥ siddhisaṃghāḥ || 12-617 ||
kulayuvatisuyonau mantravarṇān vilikhya nikhilanigamavarṇān suptadoṣādiduṣṭān | viditagurukulāntarbāhyavartmā vidhijño madhupuṭitapaṭīyān bhāvayecchāntacittaḥ || 12-618 ||
kulapathamanusandhyātarpaṇāsaktacitta (-) stava janani jano yastarpayet tīrthatoyaiḥ | sa kila suratapuṣpairgandhamālyānurūpai racitayuvativeśastaddhiyā dhyāyate saḥ || 12-619 ||
paricarati samastairnyāsapūrvaiḥ prasiddhaiḥ stavaparikarajālairyonicakre prapūjya | suvimalakulajātāṃ hrīghriṇāvarjitāṃ yaḥ svayamapi racitāṅgaḥ kṣobhakṛdyoginīnām || 12-620 ||
paśuripukulacakre saṃspṛśanmadhyaśākhaṃ suratarusuranāthaḥ pāpabhraṣṭasuveśaḥ | kulapatikulanāthastaddvayaṃ yojayitvā manupuṭitavimṛṣyaṃ yojayet tadbahiryaḥ || 12-621 ||
janani tava kalānāṃ ko vidāṃ kāmarūpaḥ kumatirahitacittaḥ saṃlikhet tāntridhāre | vigatabhayavivādadhvāntajālaḥ sudhāṃśu (-) stava caraṇatalāntardhṛtyajālairvidheyaḥ || 12-622 ||
parikalitavapustaddharmabhirdevapūjyaiḥ paricarati sa vijño mokṣacaryādhiyā saḥ | madanamadavadhūnāṃ bījamuddhṛtya śaktiṃ tadanu kaṭhatabījaṃ lokadhātrīṃ tadantaḥ || 12-623 ||
yadi japati madantarbhāvamāsādya sadyaḥ suranagaragatistaiḥ siddhavargaiḥ sa pūjyaḥ | śivabhṛgumadapṛthvīśaktiyuktaṃ susiddho hariharacaturāsyasvasvabhūtiprabhūtam || 12-624 ||
paramavaradasaṃjñaḥ kṣobhakṛt kāminīnā (-) madhipatirapi vācāṃ śrīpatiḥ sārvabhaumaḥ | bhṛgumadakathitādhaḥ kāmabījaṃ tadagre bhuvanabhayavināśaḥ kṣobhiṇīṃ yojayitvā || 12-625 ||
japati yadi sakṛdvā cintyate vīrasiṃhaḥ kulayuvatikulāntaḥ kṣobhakṛt kāmabhāvāt | madanamadalatādhaḥ śaktibījaṃ niyojya smaraharaharirūpī kāmarūpaḥ kuveraḥ || 12-626 ||
ripukulahariṇākṣīlocanāmbhojavidyu (-) dvipulajananiṣekāt khaṇḍitāntogratāpaḥ | śivabhṛgumadamūlaṃ lobhamūlaṃ bhajanti yadi vividhagurūṇāṃ vartmamūlaṃ vimṛṣya || 12-627 ||
nidhipatirapi nātho gīṣpatirbhadracetā yadi bhavati tadetanmukhyamurvopatitvam | varuṇavalavivarjaṃ ghrāṇamekaṃ vivarjaṃ tadupari mṛgacihnaṃ dvandvametadbhavānyāḥ || 12-628 ||
nikhilamunivarāṇāṃ mokṣadānaikadakṣaḥ sadasatasamadharmā kṣemakṛnmantrarājaḥ | śivaśamanayayuktaṃ bījametadbhavānyā analaśivasadharmāścādirājaṃ svatantram || 12-629 ||
tava samanayayuktaṃ bījametadbhavānyā dvitayamapi vimānaṃ vaktumośo maheśaḥ | kimiha kamalajanmā janmadhārāsahasrai (-) riti bhajati narāṇāṃ mantrarājaṃ svabhāgyai || 12-630 ||
bhavati janani yuṣmatpādapadmoyabhakta (-) styajasi parapumāṃsaṃ nedṛśaṃ kvāpi kāle | na khalu vapupurarghyaṃ tasya kācit kadāci (-) nnihitagurumukhādvā prāpya kasmādakasmāt || 12-631 ||
smararipupurapāre mokṣacaryāsvapāre paramapadavilīnaḥ sarvasaubhāgyabhogaiḥ | analapuravibhāge kālikārandhrabījaṃ tadapi yadi vidadhyāddikṣitaṃ daṇḍavarṇam || 12-632 ||
nayanayutalakāraṃ mastake nāmayuktaṃ tadanu vikaṭadaṃṣṭrāsotkaṭaṃ bījayuktam | yadi japati samastaṃ guhyaguhyātiguhyaṃ trijagati kimihāste kleśalabhyaṃ kathaṃ cit || 12-633 ||
kramapacitamapūrvaṃ sarvamevānubaddhyaṃ manuraparavibhāvyastasya madhyastharūpam | bhajati yadi cidānandātmadhṛk kevalo'sau vividhabhuvanamukhyaḥ kautukī mānamukhyaḥ || 12-634 ||
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | yathānukramato loke kiṃ na sādhyati yogirāṭ || 12-635 ||
atha bhairavasādhanaṃ (merutantre)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi nānābhairavasādhanam | śmaśāne te tu tiṣṭhanti kāle kāle pure pure || 12-636 ||
niyamaṃ kaṃ cidekaṃ yo na tyajeddharmagarbhitam | vāmamārgādinirato'pyadveṣṭetaravartmanām || 12-637 ||
hīne gurāvapūrṇe vā sādhane lokabhītitaḥ | sa bhavedbhairavo devastasya deśasya śāsakaḥ || 12-638 ||
tatratyabhūtavetālāḥ sadā saṃsevayanti tam | svamārgapracyutānāṃ sa śāsanaṃ kurute sadā || 12-639 ||
kṣīṇakarmaṇi tasmi(/)śca gate grāmo vilīyate | anyasmin bhairave jāte grāmo vasati niścitam || 12-640 ||
yadāmnāyo bhairavo'sau tacchāsanaṃ tu taddiśi | tena mārgeṇa vaśayet kāryārthaṃ bhairavaṃ tu tam || 12-641 ||
vāgramākāyamāyākhyāstāro bījaṃ kramādbhavet | pūrvādyūrdhvāntakānāṃ tadāmnāyānāṃ krameṇa ca || 12-642 ||
āmnāyabījaṃ grāmasya bījaṃ bhrā(/) bhairavasya ca | grāmanāma tataḥ procya pitṛgehe nivāsine || 12-643 ||
tatasteṣāṃ manumimaṃ japeddaśasahasrakam | niśi śmaśāne ca baliṃ tadāmnāyoktavartmanā || 12-644 ||
japādau ca japānte ca nityaṃ dadyādananyadhīḥ | vaṭukoktaṃ hunedgavyaṃ tarpaṇādi tataścaret || 12-645 ||
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī bhūtānāṃ nigrahakṣamaḥ | tasmin deśe bhavet tasya pratyakṣīkaraṇaṃ śṛṇu || 12-646 ||
kṛtanityakriyaḥ prātaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ | sāyaṃ sandhyādikaṃ kṛtvā śāntipāṭhaṃ vidhāya ca || 12-647 ||
pragṛhītvā ca sāmagrīṃ sāyaṃ sottarasādhakaḥ | vrajecchmaśānasāmagrīṃ śṛṇu susthiramāṣakān || 12-648 ||
anaṅkurān jalatilān mudgā(/)stadvanmasūrikān | tathaiva caṇakān bhaktaṃ pāyasān pūpaśaṣkulīḥ || 12-649 ||
kanyakākarttitaṃ sūtraṃ kuṅkumena surañjitam | aṣṭau vitastidīrghāśca muṣṭisthūlāśca khādirāḥ || 12-650 ||
kolā eko hastamātraṃ gandhapuṣpādikaṃ tathā | balidravyaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ pūrvāmnāye samatsyakam || 12-651 ||
samāṃsaṃ paścimāmnāye samadyaṃ cottare bhavet | grāmamadhye śmaśāne ca ūrdhvāmnāye saraktakam || 12-652 ||
yathāyogyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ gacchecca bhayavarjitaḥ | pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ smṛtvā'sya devatām || 12-653 ||
baddhāñjaliridaṃ vākyaṃ pravadet sādhakottamaḥ | atra śmaśāne yāḥ kāściddevatāḥ nivasanti hi || 12-654 ||
tāḥ prayacchantu me siddhiṃ prasannāḥ santu pāntu mām | pūrve māṃ śaṅkaraḥ pātu tathā'gneyyāṃ ca śūladhṛk || 12-655 ||
kapālī dakṣiṇe pātu nair(-)ṛtye jaṭilo'vatu | paścime pārvatībharttā vāyavyāṃ pramathādhipaḥ || 12-656 ||
uttare muṇḍamālāḍhya īśāne vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ pātu tathā śambhuradhastāddhūlidhūsaraḥ || 12-657 ||
agrato bhairavaḥ pātu pṛṣṭhataḥ pātu khecaraḥ | dakṣiṇe bhūdharaḥ pātu vāme tu piśitāśanaḥ || 12-658 ||
keśān pātu viśālākṣo mūrdhānaṃ ca marutpriyaḥ | mastakaṃ pātu bhṛgvīśo netre pātu mahāmanāḥ || 12-659 ||
kapolau pātu vīreśo gaṇḍau gaṇḍādimardanaḥ | uttaroṣṭhe virūpākṣastvadhare yoginīpriyaḥ || 12-660 ||
danteṣu dakṣavidhvaṃsī civuke nṛkapāladhṛk | kaṇṭhe rakṣatu māṃ devo nīlakaṇṭho jagadguruḥ || 12-661 ||
dakṣaskandhe girīndreśo vāmaskandhe ca sundaraḥ | bhuje ca dakṣiṇe sarvamantranāthaḥ sadā'vatu || 12-662 ||
vāme bhuje sārvabhaumo hṛdaye pātu pāṇḍuraḥ | dakṣastanaṃ paśupatirvāmaṃ pātu maheśvaraḥ || 12-663 ||
uttare sarvakalyāṇakārako'vatu māṃ sadā | nābhau kāmapravidhvaṃsī jaṅghe pātu dayāmayaḥ || 12-664 ||
jānunī pātvajāmitro gulphau gaurīpatiḥ sadā | pādapṛṣṭhaṃ jñānanidhistathā pādāṅgulorharaḥ || 12-665 ||
pādādhaḥ pātu satataṃ vyomakeśo jagatpriyaḥ | iti rakṣāṃ samādhāya mantrarakṣāṃ tataścaret || 12-666 ||
oṃ hrā(/) hru(/) hru(/) hru(/) ca pūrve oṃ hrī(/) hru(/) hro(/) hutāśane | oṃ hrī(/) śrī(/) dakṣiṇe nyasya oṃ glu(/) slu(/) cāpi nair(-)ṛte || 12-667 ||
oṃ plu(/) mlu(/) ylu(/) pratīcyāṃ ca tāraḥ pro(/) pru(/) samīraṇe | oṃ bhrā(/) bhairavaḥ saumyāyāṃ oṃ blu(/) plu(/) bhru(/) ca phaṭ śive || 12-668 ||
oṃ glau(/) blu(/) mūrdhadeśe'tho srā(/) sru(/) sra(/) srastvadhaḥ smṛtam | evaṃ rakṣāṃ samādhāya kīlyāḥ kīlādigaṣṭake || 12-669 ||
madhye mahākīlamatho dikpālārcanamārabhet | tato mantramimaṃ brūyāt prārthayet premasaṃyutaḥ || 12-670 ||
bhrā(/) bhairava dviruccārya bhayaṅkarahare vadet | māṃ rakṣa rakṣa hu(/) phaṭ ca svāhā dvāviṃśadarṇakaḥ || 12-671 ||
palāśabhājane māṣān kṛtvā prācīṃ vrajet tataḥ | kīlasya nikaṭe cendramāvāhya paripūjayet || 12-672 ||

pracaṇḍaṃ caṇḍakeśaṃ ca caṇḍātmānaṃ ca cāmaram | cāritraṃ ca camatkāraṃ cañcalaṃ cārubhūṣaṇam || 12-704 ||

brāhmyādyāścāṣṭapatreṣu bahirvīthyāṃ digīśvarān | tadbāhyāyāṃ tadastrāṇi tadbāhyāyāṃ tvimān yajet || 12-706 ||
pracaṇḍacaṇḍordhvakeśabhīṣaṇābhiṣaṇābhidhāḥ | vyomakeśo vyomavāho vyomavyāpaka eva ca || 12-707 ||

āgatya ca gṛhe paścāt tryahaṃ kuryānmahotsavam | evaṃ kaliyuge siddhiḥ śmaśānasya prakīrttitā || 12-713 ||

iti bhairavasādhanam |

athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yoginīsādhanottamam | sarvārthasādhanaṃ nāma dehināṃ sarvasiddhidam || 12-715 ||

dhyānaṃ yathā |
pūrṇacandramukhīṃ gaurīṃ vicitrāmbaradhāriṇīm || 12-721 ||

yadi mātā tadā vittaṃ divyaṃ ca sumanoharam | bhūpatitvaṃ prāthitaṃ yat taddadāti dine dine || 12-729 ||

samabhyarcyārdharātrau ca śrūyate nūparadhvanim | samāyātyantikaṃ dadyāt puṣpāsanamanuttamam || 12-797 ||
kimicchasi vada tvaṃ me bhava bhāryeti sādhakaḥ | bhāryākarma karotyevaṃ rājyaṃ yacchati kāmikam || 12-798 ||
yāti varṣasahasrāṇi pratyahaṃ paritoṣitā | pratipattithimārabhya kṛtvā candanamaṇḍalam || 12-799 ||
dhūpaṃ ca gugguluṃ datvā japedaṣṭasahasrakam | trisandhyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā suśobhanām || 12-800 ||
prajapet sakalāṃ rātriṃ samāyāti niśātyaye | kāmitā sā bhavedbhāryā cānyathā mriyate dhruvam || 12-801 ||
dadāti kāmikaṃ bhojyaṃ siddhadravyaṃ rasāyanam | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi jīvate'nte mṛte punaḥ || 12-802 ||
janma rājakule kuryāddadyāt krodhaprasādataḥ | rātrau devagṛhaṃ gatvā candanena ca maṇḍalam || 12-803 ||
kṛtvā dhūpaṃ tato datvā'yutaṃ māsayutaṃ manum | māsānte mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā rātrau japaṃ caret || 12-804 ||
niśātyaye samāyāti pradadyāt kusumāsanam | kṛte ca svāgataṃ pṛcchet kimicchasi ca bhāṣate || 12-805 ||
sādhakaḥ prāha bhāryā tvaṃ bhava yaccha rasāyanam | yāti varṣasahasrāṇi apsarāḥ svayamurvaśī || 12-806 ||
parastrīṃ varjayet sarvāṃ cānyathā mriyate dhruvam | ekākī śayane sthitvā śucī rātrau ca kuṅkumaiḥ || 12-807 ||
likhitvā bhūṣiṇīṃ bhūrje candanena tu dhūpayet | japedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu māsaṃ yāvat prayatnataḥ || 12-808 ||
māsānte tu samabhyarcya japedaṣṭasahasrakam | rātryardhāntikamāyāti bhāryā bhavati kāmitā || 12-809 ||
siddhadravyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca tuṣṭā yacchati bhūṣiṇī | krodharājaḥ punaḥ prāha yadi nāyāti sādhakaḥ || 12-810 ||
anena krodhayogena japedapsarasāṃ cayam | viṣaṃ prāthamikaṃ bījamuddharecca kaṭudvayam || 12-811 ||
amukīṃ krodhabījaṃ ca vātamādarasaṃyutam | japet sakṛt samuddhṛtya mantramaṣṭasahasrakam || 12-812 ||
mriyate śīryate mūrdhni prasphuṭatyapsareti ca | vandayedapsarovṛndaṃ mantreṇānena sādhakaḥ || 12-813 ||
viṣabandhadvayaṃ procyahanayugmamudīrayet | amukīṃ krodhamantro'yamapsarovaśyakārakaḥ || 12-814 ||
atha vakṣye'psarovaśyakārakaṃ manumuttamam | viṣaṃ caladvayaṃ procya amukīṃ vaśyamānaya || 12-815 ||
sakūrcāstrajapādevāpsarovaśyamiyāddhruvam |
atha jvālāmukhīsādhanaṃ (phetkāriṇītantre)
namo bhagavatītyuktvā jvālāmālinyataḥ param || 12-816 ||
gṛdhragaṇaparivṛte dviṭhānto manurīritaḥ | oṃ namo hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ bhagavati śiraḥ smṛtam || 12-817 ||
jvālāmālini ca śikhā gṛdhragaṇaparivṛte | varmasvāhāstramityetajjātiyuktaṃ nyaset tanau || 12-818 ||
abhuktvā niyataṃ caitajjayamantraṃ japejjayī |
atha mantrāntaraṃ tatraiva |
rudrāṅganāgnijāyābhyāṃ rudrajvālāmukhītyapi || 12-819 ||
mantrāntaraṃ samākhyātaṃ jvālāmukhyā anantaram | dīpatailāktapādo'rdharātre gurudināditaḥ || 12-820 ||
japedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu trayoviṃśativāsarān | pratyahaṃ palaṣaṭkaṃ ca dadātīti na saṃśayaḥ || 12-821 ||
pūrvamantramāhātmyamāha |
nārāyaṇena kathitamagastyaiḥ kathitaṃ punaḥ | susiddhimicchatā gopyo nāmāpi na samīrayet || 12-822 ||
putrasya nṛpateścāpi dhārmikasya viśeṣataḥ | navadurgāvidhānena darśayet kāryagauravāt || 12-823 ||
nṛpo'pi samyagācāro mantrajño vividhaṃ dhanam | nivedya vidhivat paścānmantragrahaṇamācaret || 12-824 ||
smṛtimātreṇa vaivarṇān ripūn sarvān vināśayet | pradadyāddakṣiṇāṃ tasya sahasraṃ śatameva vā || 12-825 ||
gavāṃ suvarṇaṃ niṣkāṇāṃ bhūmiṃ vā śasyaśālinīm | sarvaśāntimavāpnoti sarvarakṣākṛtirbhavet || 12-826 ||
niṣkamalaṅkāraḥ |
iti jvālāmukhīsādhanam |
atha karṇapiśācīmantrastatraiva |
kahayugmaṃ kālike ca gṛhṇa yugmaṃ tathaiva ca | piṇḍaṃ piśāci svāheti dvīpārṇaḥ kathito manuḥ || 12-827 ||
dhyānam |
dhyāyet piśācīṃ calaśūlahastāṃ śyāmāṃ sudīrghāṃ yuvatīṃ trinetrām | kruddhāṃ vivarṇāṃ tanuvṛttamadhyāṃ guñjāphalaiḥ kalpitahārayaṣṭim ||
sādhanaprakāramāha |
ekaviṃśaddinaṃ yāvadudayāstamayaṃ japet | nityaṃ sāyaṃ svamāhāraṃ piṇḍaṃ harmyopari kṣipet || 12-828 ||
trisaptāhācca tuṣṭā sā śayyāṃ gatvā piśācinī | pañcaviṃśatideśānāṃ kathāṃ ca kathayatyapi || 12-829 ||
triṃśaddinaiśca deveśi jambūdvīpakathāṃ nayet | dvātriṃśatā tathā gauri trailokyaṃ śrāvayeddhruvam || 12-830 ||
trisvādubalidānena sarvaṃ vadati tatkṣaṇāt | sabhāyāṃ yadi saṃghāte dyūte ca ripusaṃsadi || 12-831 ||
sarvaṃ kathayati kṣipraṃ nūnaṃ tuṣṭā piśācinī | kenāpi naiva vedyā sā sādhakastāṃ prapaśyati || 12-832 ||
iti karṇapiśācīsādhanam |
atha vibhūṣiṇyādisādhanāni (phetkāriṇītantre)
ādyā vibhūṣiṇī devī parā kuṇḍaladhāriṇī || 12-833 ||
hāriṇī siṃhinī caiva haṃsinī tu tato naṭī | devī kāmeśvarī caiva proktā devī ratipriyā || 12-834 ||
vibhūṣiṇīmantramāha |
krodhāstradvayamāyānte bhūtinī ca trikūrcataḥ | tāralajjādvayādastradvayānte ca vibhīṣikā || 12-835 ||
krodhadvayānto mantro'yaṃ vibhūṣiṇyā udīritaḥ || 12-835ef ||
dhyānam |
karttrī caiva kare pare naraśirastuṅgākṛtirbhīṣaṇā dantāntargatamāṃsaśoṇitavasāsaṃyuktabhūtavratā | kālavyālakarālasattvavikaṭavyālambidaṃṣṭrāṅkurā yasyāḥ keśakulākulākhilamahīśailā'stu sā rakṣatu || 12-836 ||
sādhanaprakāramāha |
ekavṛkṣataraṃ gatvā yāminyāṃ pravaset tryaham | japedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu dhyāyannavyagramānasaḥ || 12-837 ||
japānte pūjanaṃ nāmnā'gurudhūpaṃ nivedayet | prajapedardharātre tu samāyāti vibhūṣiṇī || 12-838 ||
candanodakamiśreṇa dattārghā tuṣyati dhruvam | mātā vā bhaginī bhāryā hṛṣṭā bhavati kāmitā || 12-839 ||
karamelanakaṃ kṛtvā mātā bhūtvā jagattraye | śatāṣṭaparivārasya sadā'bhyañjanabhūṣaṇam || 12-840 ||
bhaginī cenmahāyogin sahasrayojanādapi | dadāti striyamānīya divyaṃ rasarasāyanam || 12-841 ||
bhāryā cet spṛṣṭamāropya svargaṃ nayati tatkṣaṇāt | dine ratnasahasraṃ tu rasaṃ caiva rasāyanam || 12-842 ||
dadyāditi śeṣaḥ |
sarvāśāḥ pūratyeva sadā devī vibhūṣaṇī |
atha kuṇḍaladhāriṇīmantrastatraiva |
dhruvamāyāstrayugalā proktā kuṇḍaladhāriṇī || 12-843 ||
japedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu māsamātraṃ dine dine | karṇe kuṇḍaladhāriṇī śaśikuṇḍaladhāriṇī || 12-844 ||
āyāti rudhireṇārghā deyāstuṣṭā vadatyapi | kiṃ karttavyaṃ mayā vatsa māteti bhava sādhakaḥ || 12-845 ||
pañcāśatā dinenāpi trailokyamapi dāsyati |
atha sindūrahāriṇīmantrastatraiva |
krodhadvayāstrayugataḥ sindūrahāriṇīpadam || 12-846 ||
kūrcatrayāntaḥ saṃproktaḥ sindūrahāriṇīmanuḥ || 12-846ef ||
dhyānam |
svarṇālaṅkṛtihāriṇī caladalavyālolaśākhāmbarā sotkaṇṭhīkṛtagātrakarmasubhagā śubhrāṃśucandraprabhā | antaḥ saṃtatakāntidantamalinā trailokyaśobhāspadā pāyādūrdhanavāṃśuśūlalatikā sindūrahāriṇyasau || 12-847 ||
śūnyadevālayaṃ gatvā japedaṣṭasahasrakam | śīghramāyātyāgatā sā bhāryā bhavati kāmitā || 12-848 ||
pañcaviṃśati dināni vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇam | dadāti sādhakendrāya devī sindūrahāriṇī || 12-849 ||
atha siṃhinīmantrastatraiva |
lajjādvayāstrayugalaṃ siṃhinīti padaṃ tataḥ | krodhabījatrayādyantaḥ kīrttitaḥ siṃhinīmanuḥ || 12-850 ||
dhyānam |
śailāgradrumasvargadantavadane durgāntadaityasthitā keśā asthisamastaviṣṇucaraṇaprabhraṣṭasaṃtrāsinī | yā dantāntaralambidhāraṇaraṇe prakṣubdhasiddhāṅganā seyaṃ pātu samastakaṇṭakakulavyākampimālākulā || 12-851 ||
gatvaikaliṅgaṃ yāminyāṃ prajapedayutaṃ manum | tato hṛṣṭā'tivaradā siṃhinyāyāti pūjitā || 12-852 ||
kiṃ karomi vadatyevaṃ bhāryā bhavati kāmitā | dīnāya vastrayugalaṃ dadyādrasarasāyanam || 12-853 ||
atha haṃsinīmantrastatraiva |
tāratrikūrcāstrayugāddhaṃsinī bhūtinī tataḥ | kūrcatrayāntaḥ kathito haṃsinīmanuruttamaḥ || 12-854 ||
dhyānam |
śubhrā śubhrasarojatulyanayanā dugdhāsavenārcitā prārabdhadhvanimugdhamānavavadhūsaṃsevitā sādaram | kiñcittuṅgavilolapāṅgavalitavyāmugdhamīlanmukhī muktāyuktavilolahāralalitā śrīhaṃsinī pātu naḥ || 12-855 ||
vajrapāṇigṛhaṃ gatvā pratimāṃ śobhanāṃ likhet | hayamāreṇa saṃpūjya japedayutasaṃkhyakam || 12-856 ||
yāvadardhaniśāṃ devī haṃsinyāyāti niścitam | candanārghapradānena hṛṣṭā vadati sādhakam || 12-857 ||
kiṃ mayā te prakarttavyaṃ kiṅkarī bhava sādhakaḥ | vastrālaṅkārabhojyādyaṃ vyayārthaṃ saṃprayacchati || 12-858 ||
tadaśeṣavyayābhāvānna dadāti prakupyati |
atha ceṭīsādhanaṃ tatraiva |
tataḥ kūrcayugaṃ cāstrayugaṃ ceṭī tataḥ param || 12-859 ||
ṅe'ntaṃ krodhayugaṃ coktvā ceṭīyugmaṃ trapāṃ tataḥ || 12-859ef ||
dhyānam |
gacchantī mitabhāṣiṇī śaśimukhī bhraṣṭottarīyādharā bibhrantī kalasaṃ sarojayugalaṃ svarṇāntasīmantinī | śrīkhaṇḍādivilepanāmalavapuḥsaurabhyasaṃbhāvitā kiñciddharmasamārjitārpitakarā pāyādiyaṃ ceṭikā || 12-860 ||
kutrāpi bhīṣaṇasthāne nāmoccāraṇamātrataḥ | dhruvaṃ ceṭī samāgatya cetīkarma karotyapi || 12-861 ||
athavā'sya gṛhadvāre tryahaṃ rātrau japaṃ caret | āgatya niyataṃ devī ceṭīkarma karoti ca || 12-862 ||
atha kāmeśvarīmantrastatraiva |
tārakūrcāstrayukkāmeśvari bhūtinyataḥ param | ṅentaṃ krodhatrayaṃ kāmeśvarīmantra udāhṛtaḥ || 12-863 ||
dhyānam |
kāmaskandhasamāgatā madhulatāvāsantipuṣpānvitā gāyantī madhurādharasmitamukhī vīṇāvatī cañcalā | raktāmbhojavilocanā madhumadairmattā samantādiyaṃ pāyāt puṣpadhanurdharā madhūmatī kāmeśvarī bhūtinī || 12-864 ||
mātṛsthānaṃ samāgātya kṛtvā māṃsasya bhakṣaṇam | māṃsādinā baliṃ datvā sahasraṃ sapta vāsarān || 12-865 ||
japānniyatamāyāti rudhirārghaṃ nivedayet | kāmeśvarī bhavet tuṣṭā bhāryā bhavati kāmitā || 12-866 ||
sarvāśāḥ pūrayatyeva rājyaṃ yacchati niścitam |
atha ratipriyāmantrastatraiva |
tāraṃ lajjā ca kūrcāstradvayayuktā ratipriyā || 12-867 ||
krodhatrapāstrayukkāmeśvarīmantroktavat kriyā || 12-867ef ||
dhyānam |
hemaprākāramadhye suraviṭapitaṭe hemapīṭhādhirūḍhā yakṣīmālāvisarpatparimalakusumodbhāsidhammillabhārā | pīnottuṅgastanāḍhyā kuvalayanayanā raktavarṇā karābhyāṃ bhrāmyadraktotpalābhā sakalasurayutā divyabhūṣāṅgarāgā || 12-868 ||
rātrau devagṛhaṃ gatvā tatra śayyāṃ prakalpayet | sitavastraṃ candanaṃ ca jātīpuṣpaṃ pradāpayet || 12-869 ||
dhūpaṃ tu guggulaṃ datvā'ṣṭasahasraṃ japenmanum | japānte nityamāyāti cumbanāliṅganādābhiḥ || 12-870 ||
kāmitā jāyate bhāryā satyaṃ devī kumārikā | dadyādaṣṭadinenaiva divyaṃ vastrayugaṃ tataḥ || 12-871 ||
kāmikaṃ bhojanaṃ divyaṃ parivārasya dāsyati | anyadvaiśvānaragṛhāddravyamānīya yacchati || 12-872 ||
sahasrametāni japejjapānte siddhyati dhruvam | muhurmuhurjapenmantramityāha krodhabhūpatiḥ || 12-873 ||
iti vibhūṣiṇyādisādhanāni |
atha dharitrīsādhanam | taduktaṃ (vaiṣṇavīkalpe)
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dharitrīsādhanaṃ param | rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca sarvatantreṣu gopitam || 12-874 ||
sarvaiśvaryakaraṃ nṝṇāṃ durlabhaṃ paramādbhutam | yajjñātvā sādhakeśreṣṭho dhanadena samo bhavet || 12-875 ||
śaratkāle ca kedāramadhye kamalasaṃkule | vinirmāya kuṭīṃ ramyāṃ sthāpayet kalaśaṃ śubham || 12-876 ||
bhaumāṣṭamyāmāhṛtayā mṛdā naktaṃ vinirmitam | gandharvakardamairliptaṃ veṣṭitaṃ śuklavāsasā || 12-877 ||
vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa tatrāvāhya vasundharām | nānopacārasambhāraistrisandhyaṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ || 12-878 ||
bhūbījaṃ tāramāyānte ṅentā caiva vasundharā | hṛdayaṃ vahnijāyānto dvādaśārṇo manuḥ smṛtaḥ || 12-879 ||
mahāvarāho'sya munirgāyatrī chanda īritam | vasundharā devatā ca bhūbījaṃ bījamucyate || 12-880 ||
māyābījaṃ dharitryāśca viniyogaḥ prasādane | mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā dhyāyedvasundharām || 12-881 ||
dhyānam |
phūllāmbhoruhamadhyasthāmindīvaradalaprabhām | pītakauśeyavasanāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 12-882 ||
nīlotpaladvayaṃ śālimañjarīṃ cekṣukaṃ karaiḥ | bibhrāṇāṃ sarvalokasya dhātrīṃ vasumatīṃ bhaje || 12-883 ||
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ vedalakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ | japānte vasudhādevī bhāṣate kalaśodarān || 12-884 ||
varaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi yat te manasi varttate | iti bruvāṇāṃ tāṃ devīṃ prasūnāñjalibhistrībhiḥ || 12-885 ||
saṃpūjya praṇamedbhūmau daṇḍavat sādhakottamaḥ |
ślokārdhapatitamantraḥ |
namastubhyaṃ bhagavati jagaddhātri vasundhare || 12-886 ||
viṣṇupatni varāhasya daṃṣṭrākoṭikṛtālaye | viśvambhare namastubhyaṃ sarvabhūtāśraye dhare || 12-887 ||
ratnānāṃ ca nidhīnāṃ ca tvadabhyantaravarttinām | labdhukāmo'smi kalyāṇi prasādāt tava medini || 12-888 ||
iti saṃprārthayeddevīṃ sā dadāti varaṃ tataḥ | drakṣyasi prāpsyasītyevaṃ tataḥ paśyati sādhakaḥ || 12-889 ||
pade pade ca ratnāni vidhānaṃ yojanatraye | tatastāni samādāya yatheṣṭaṃ viharedbhuvi || 12-890 ||
ādau puraskriyāṃ kuryādvarṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum | taddaśāṃśaṃ ca juhuyāt saṃskṛte havyavāhane || 12-891 ||
sasarpiṣā pāyasena taddaśāṃśaṃ ca tarpayet | mārjayet taddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena vaiṣṇavān || 12-892 ||
viprān saṃbhojayenmantrī tataḥ sādhanamācaret | puraścaryāmakṛtvā tu na mantraḥ ko'pi siddhyati || 12-893 ||
iti dharitrīsādhanam |
evaṃ kinnaryādisādhanāni vistarabhayādupekṣitāni |
merutantraṃ mahākālasaṃhitāṃ śaktisaṅgam | vāḍavānalatantraṃ ca tantraṃ kālānalābhidham || 12-894 ||
kālītantraṃ parātantraṃ tantrarājaṃ tathaiva ca | muṇḍamālākhyatantraṃ ca yoginīhṛdayaṃ tathā || 12-895 ||
kumārītantramāmnāyarahasyaṃ śrīmatottamam | kulikāmnāyatantraṃ ca kulacūḍāmaṇiṃ tathā || 12-896 ||
tantracūḍāmaṇiṃ tadvadbhāvacūḍāmaṇiṃ tathā | samayācāratantraṃ ca viśvasāraṃ tathaiva ca || 12-897 ||
bhairavyā bhuvaneśvaryāścāmuṇḍāyāstathaiva ca | yoginyāścāpi vārāhyāḥ pañca tantrāṇi ca kramāt || 12-898 ||
nīlatantraṃ gautamīyatantraṃ phetkāriṇīmapi | vāmakeśvaratantraṃ ca vīratantraṃ tathaiva ca || 12-899 ||
saṃmohanākhyatantraṃ ca tantraṃ gandharvasaṃjñakam | māheśvarīyatantraṃ ca tantraṃ prathamasaṃjñakam || 12-900 ||
tadvat kātyāyanītantraṃ bālātantraṃ tathaiva ca | uḍḍīśaṃ mālinītantraṃ guhyātantraṃ tathaiva ca || 12-901 ||
kauleśaṃ kubjikātantraṃ kularatnāvalīmapi | viśuddheśvaratantraṃ ca gaṇeśvaravimarṣiṇīm || 12-902 ||
siddhasārasvataṃ śambhuvidyātantraṃ tathaiva ca | tadvadbhairavatantraṃ ca jñānārṇavakulārṇavau || 12-903 ||
tathaiva vaiṣṇavīkalpaṃ kālīkalpaṃ kulāmṛtam | śrīmatpratyaṅgirākalpaṃ tārākalpaṃ tathaiva ca || 12-904 ||
niruttarākhyatantraṃ ca tantramuttarasaṃjñakam | tantraṃ tadvat svatantrākhyaṃ mantradevaprakāśikām || 12-905 ||
śrīkramaṃ vrahmarudrādiyāmalāni kulāgamam | śaiṣāgamaṃ somaśambhumataṃ devyāgamaṃ tathā || 12-906 ||
ḍāmaraṃ bhūtapūrvaṃ ca yakṣaparvaṃ ca ḍāmaram | vaināyakīsaṃhitāṃ ca vaiśampāyanasaṃhitām || 12-907 ||
agastyasaṃhitāṃ tadvadbṛhacchrīkramasaṃhitām | surendrasaṃhitāṃ caiva nandikeśvarasaṃhitām || 12-908 ||
vaśiṣṭhasaṃhitāṃ tadvadvāyavīyāṃ ca saṃhitām | gorakṣasaṃhitāṃ tadvatsiddhanāthādyasaṃhitām || 12-909 ||
saṃhitāṃ caiva vārāhīṃ mahātharvaṇasaṃhitām | saṃhitāṃ tattvasārādyāṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitām || 12-910 ||
viṣvaksenīsaṃhitāṃ ca tathaiva brahmasiṃhatām | nibandheṣu kriyāsāraṃ tripurāsārasaṃgraham || 12-911 ||
prapañcasāraṃ siddhāntasāraṃ mantramahodadhim | śāradātilakaṃ cāpi puraścaraṇacandrikām || 12-912 ||
mantraratnāvalīṃ tadvadācārakusumāvalīm | sagraheṣu prasiddheṣu tārābhaktisudhārṇavam || 12-913 ||
āgamādyāṃ kalpalatāṃ mantraratnākaraṃ tathā | kriyāsaṃgrahanāmānaṃ granthaṃ siddhāntasaṃgraham || 12-914 ||
kālītattvaṃ tathā śyāmārahasyaṃ mantracaṇḍikām | tārārahasyavṛttiṃ ca durgābhaktitaraṅgiṇīm || 12-915 ||
tantrasāraṃ tantraratnaṃ tantracintāmaṇiṃ tathā | tattvasāraṃ yogasāraṃ śrīrāmārcanacandrikām || 12-916 ||
granthaṃ vidhānamālākhyaṃ vidhimuktāvalīmapi | nānāvidhāḥ paddhatīśca tathopaniṣado'pi ca || 12-917 ||
jyotiḥśāstraṃ śālihotraṃ purāṇāni smṛtīrapi | samyagālokya lokānāmupakāravidhitsayā || 12-918 ||
mahārājadhirājena surarājānukāriṇā | śrīmatpratāpasiṃhena vidyābdheḥ pāradṛśvanā || 12-919 ||
saṃvatsare niśānāthavahnināgadharā (-) (1831)ṅkite |
tapasyarjunapakṣe hi tithau bhāskaravāsare | puraścaryāṇavo nāma grantha eṣa vinirmitaḥ || 12-920 ||
mahīmahīpālagaṇottamāṅgasragdhūlibhirdhūsarapādapadmaḥ | vīro mahādānamahāhaveṣu pratāpasiṃho nṛpatiścakāsti || 12-921 ||
unmīlayan svajanamānasamānasāni saṃkocayan pratinṛpānanakairavāṇi | saṃmodayan sakalakovidalokakokān yasya pratāpasavitodayate dharāyām || 12-922 ||
yasya kṣoṇipateḥ pratāpatapane vibhrājamāne pare rājante na mahīkṣitaḥ kṣititale khadyotapotadyutaḥ | yatkīrttīndumarīcibhistribhuvane śubhrīkṛte sarvataḥ śyāmatvaṃ dviṣatāmakīrttitimirastomeṣu viśrāmyati || 12-923 ||
yāvallokopakārī racayati dinakṛdvāsarānastatandra (-) ścandro yāvat triyāmāḥ kumudaviśadayā jyotsnayā'laṅkaroti yāvannāmāni viṣṇoḥ prajapati janatā santi bhūtāni yāvad (-) bhūbharttustasya kīrtiḥ sphuratu vasumatī maṇḍale tāvadeṣā || 12-924 ||
yadviṣṇuṃ pravadanti vaiṣṇavagaṇāḥ śaivāḥ śivaṃ manvate gāṇeśā nigadanti dantivadanaṃ śaurā dineśaṃ viduḥ | cicchaktiṃ kalayanti śāktanivahāḥ sāṅkhyā paraṃ pūruṣaṃ brahmābrahmavido vadantyavatu vastaddaivyasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ || 12-925 ||
bibhratyadbhutabhūtibhūtapavacovaicitryacitrāmṛta (-) srotaśālini sannibandhanasaritsambhedamabhyarhitam | navye'smin naradevanirmitapuraścaryārṇave dvādaśaḥ sadyuktiṃ sphuṭamauktikotkararucottuṅgastaraṅgo gataḥ || 12-926 ||
[iti śrīgirirājacakracūḍāmaṇinaranārāyaṇetyādivividhavirudāvalīvirājamānamānonnata śrīmanmahārājādhirājaśrīpratāpasiṃhasāhadevaviracite puraścaryārṇave brāhmyādimantrapuraścaraṇapūrvakayantrastavakavacādipuraścaraṇabhedanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvādaśastaraṅgaḥ samāptaḥ] || 12 ||
